@nb.njit(cache=True)
def _fit_tail_c(sf, bu, by, n, K, y_clip):
    lo = n - 2 * K - 1 if n - 2 * K - 1 > 0 else 0
    valid_count = 0
    code_sum = 0.0
    monitor_sum = 0.0
    for j in range(lo, n):
        if sf[by + j] < y_clip:
            code_sum += sf[bu + j]
            monitor_sum += sf[by + j]
            valid_count += 1
    if valid_count < 2:
        return math.nan, sf[bu + n - 1] if n > 0 else 0.0
    mean_code = code_sum / valid_count
    mean_monitor = monitor_sum / valid_count
    cross_sum = 0.0
    code_square_sum = 0.0
    for j in range(lo, n):
        if sf[by + j] < y_clip:
            du = sf[bu + j] - mean_code
            cross_sum += du * (sf[by + j] - mean_monitor)
            code_square_sum += du * du
    d_monitor_d_heater_code = cross_sum / code_square_sum if code_square_sum > 0.0 else math.nan
    return d_monitor_d_heater_code, sf[bu + n - 1]

nodes.name: pi_step
nodes.meaning: run the compiled twin of _pi_ring_step with the same operations and ordering.
comments: run the compiled twin of _pi_ring_step with the same operations and ordering.
integer_base selects a ring's state block in s.
float_base selects its block in sf.
code_buffer/monitor_buffer select MAP arrays within that block.
constants below define the ABI.
shared _fit_slope_c/_fit_tail_c mirror the Python fits without creating array views.
nodes.signature: pi_step(p, pf, s, sf, obs, act)

source_ref.code:
@nb.njit(cache=True)
def pi_step(p, pf, s, sf, obs, act):
    n_r = p[_IP_N_RINGS]
    m_max = p[_IP_M]
    start = p[_IP_START]
    law = p[_IP_LAW]
    J = p[_IP_J]
    H = p[_IP_H]
    K = p[_IP_K]
    target_fraction = pf[_FP_FRACTION]
    k_c = pf[_FP_K_C]
    t_ratio = pf[_FP_T_RATIO]
    k2 = pf[_FP_K2]
    smin = pf[_FP_SIGMA_MIN]
    smax = pf[_FP_SIGMA_MAX]
    map_step = pf[_FP_MAP_STEP]
    ramp_step = pf[_FP_RAMP_STEP]
    recap_step = pf[_FP_RECAP_STEP]
    fall_frac = pf[_FP_FALL_FRAC]
    cap_ratio = pf[_FP_CAP_RATIO]
    cap_min = pf[_FP_CAP_MIN]
    lock_tol = pf[_FP_LOCK_TOL]
    fine_step = pf[_FP_FINE_STEP]
    near_ratio = pf[_FP_NEAR_RATIO]
    drop_frac = pf[_FP_DROP_FRAC]
    guard_frac = pf[_FP_GUARD_FRAC]
    guard_def = pf[_FP_GUARD_CODES]
    fall_level = pf[_FP_FALL_LEVEL]
    rec_level = pf[_FP_REC_LEVEL]
    rec_drop = pf[_FP_REC_DROP]
    lo = pf[_FP_CODE_LO]
    hi = pf[_FP_CODE_HI]
    R = _FS_HIST + J + 2 * H
    first = s[0] == 1
    active_ring = obs[OBS_ACTIVE_RING]
    for i in range(n_r):
        integer_base = 1 + _IS_PER_RING * i
        float_base = i * R
        if first:
            if p[_IP_HAS_INIT] == 1:
                u0 = float(p[_IP_INIT_CODES + i])
            elif p[_IP_OFF_APPLIED] >= 0:
                u0 = float(obs[p[_IP_OFF_APPLIED] + i])
            else:
                u0 = 0.0
            sf[float_base + _FS_U] = u0
            sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF] = u0
            sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] = u0
            s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = start if p[_IP_DELAY] <= 0 else ST_HOLD
            s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 1
            sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD] = guard_def
            s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
        sample_count = obs[p[_IP_OFF_COUNT] + i]
        ok = sample_count > 0
        if p[_IP_OFF_VALID] >= 0 and obs[p[_IP_OFF_VALID] + i] == 0:
            ok = False
        if active_ring >= 0 and active_ring != i:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            acc = 0.0
            for m in range(sample_count):
                acc += float(obs[p[_IP_OFF_SAMPLES] + i * m_max + m])
            y = acc / sample_count
            sf[float_base + _FS_Y] = y
            history_base = float_base + _FS_HIST
            history_count = s[integer_base + _IS_HIST_N]
            hmax = y
            hmin = y
            if history_count > 0:
                hmax = sf[history_base]
                hmin = sf[history_base]
                for j in range(1, history_count):
                    if sf[history_base + j] > hmax:
                        hmax = sf[history_base + j]
                    if sf[history_base + j] < hmin:
                        hmin = sf[history_base + j]
            st = s[integer_base + _IS_STATE]
            u = sf[float_base + _FS_U]
            # p[_IP_INIT_CODES + n_r] is the offset of adc_overrange (-1 - absent)
            clip = p[_IP_INIT_CODES + n_r] >= 0 and obs[p[_IP_INIT_CODES + n_r] + i] != 0
            if st == ST_HOLD:
                s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] += 1
                if s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] >= p[_IP_DELAY]:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = start
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] = u
            elif st == ST_CAPTURE:
                if y < sf[float_base + _FS_Y_LO] or sf[float_base + _FS_Y_LO] <= 0.0:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_LO] = y
                if y > sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = y
                if (
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] > cap_ratio * sf[float_base + _FS_Y_LO] + cap_min
                    and y < (1.0 - rec_drop) * sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]
                ):
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_MAP
                    s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N] = 0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = 0.0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] = u
                    s[integer_base + _IS_FINE_SEEN] = 0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_RISE_MAX] = 0.0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_STEP_PREV] = 0.0
                elif u >= hi:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_FAULT
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = sf[float_base + _FS_U_START]
                else:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = u + ramp_step if u + ramp_step < hi else hi
            elif st == ST_MAP:
                code_buffer = float_base + _FS_HIST + J
                monitor_buffer = code_buffer + H
                map_count = s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N]
                if map_count < H:
                    sf[code_buffer + map_count] = u
                    sf[monitor_buffer + map_count] = y
                    map_count += 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N] = map_count
                if y > sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = y
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_MAX] = u
                ymax = sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]
                if clip:
                    pk = float(p[_IP_INIT_CODES + n_r + 1])  # the ADC full scale
                    sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK] = pk
                    monitor_response_per_heater_code, reference_code = _fit_slope_c(
                        sf, code_buffer, monitor_buffer, map_count, target_fraction, pk, K
                    )
                    sf[float_base + _FS_SLOPE] = monitor_response_per_heater_code
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF] = reference_code
                    d = sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] - u
                    sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD] = guard_frac * d if d > 0.0 else guard_def
                    if monitor_response_per_heater_code < 0.0:
                        s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_LOCK
                    else:
                        s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_DECLIP
                        s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N] = 0
                    s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                elif ymax > 0.0 and (ymax - y) > fall_frac * ymax:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK] = ymax
                    monitor_response_per_heater_code, reference_code = _fit_slope_c(
                        sf, code_buffer, monitor_buffer, map_count - 1, target_fraction, ymax, K
                    )
                    sf[float_base + _FS_SLOPE] = monitor_response_per_heater_code
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF] = reference_code
                    d = sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] - sf[float_base + _FS_U_MAX]
                    sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD] = guard_frac * d if d > 0.0 else 0.0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_GUARD] = sf[float_base + _FS_U_MAX] + sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD]
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = 0.0
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = (
                        ST_RETURN if monitor_response_per_heater_code < 0.0 else ST_FAULT
                    )
                elif s[integer_base + _IS_FINE_SEEN] == 1 and (ymax - y) > drop_frac * ymax:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK] = ymax
                    monitor_response_per_heater_code, reference_code = _fit_slope_c(
                        sf, code_buffer, monitor_buffer, map_count, target_fraction, ymax, K
                    )
                    sf[float_base + _FS_SLOPE] = monitor_response_per_heater_code
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF] = reference_code
                    d = sf[float_base + _FS_U_START] - sf[float_base + _FS_U_MAX]
                    sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD] = guard_frac * d if d > 0.0 else 0.0
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = (
                        ST_LOCK if monitor_response_per_heater_code < 0.0 else ST_FAULT
                    )
                    s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                elif map_count >= H or u <= lo:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_FAULT
                else:
                    W = p[_IP_W]
                    n_ref = p[_IP_N_REF]
                    j = map_count - 1
                    j0 = p[_IP_SETTLE] + W
                    if s[integer_base + _IS_FINE_SEEN] == 0 and j >= j0 and j < H:
                        du = sf[code_buffer + j - W] - sf[code_buffer + j]
                        monitor_response_per_heater_code = (
                            (sf[monitor_buffer + j] - sf[monitor_buffer + j - W]) / du if du > 0.0 else 0.0
                        )
                        if j < j0 + n_ref:
                            sf[float_base + _FS_STEP_PREV] += monitor_response_per_heater_code
                            if j == j0 + n_ref - 1:
                                sf[float_base + _FS_RISE_MAX] = sf[float_base + _FS_STEP_PREV] / n_ref
                        elif monitor_response_per_heater_code < near_ratio * sf[float_base + _FS_RISE_MAX]:
                            s[integer_base + _IS_FINE_SEEN] = 1
                    step = fine_step if s[integer_base + _IS_FINE_SEEN] == 1 else map_step
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = u - step if u - step > lo else lo
            elif st == ST_DECLIP:
                code_buffer = float_base + _FS_HIST + J
                monitor_buffer = code_buffer + H
                map_count = s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N]
                if map_count < H:
                    sf[code_buffer + map_count] = u
                    sf[monitor_buffer + map_count] = y
                    map_count += 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_MAP_N] = map_count
                if (not clip) and y < target_fraction * sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK]:
                    monitor_response_per_heater_code, reference_code = _fit_tail_c(
                        sf,
                        code_buffer,
                        monitor_buffer,
                        map_count,
                        K,
                        0.999 * float(p[_IP_INIT_CODES + n_r + 1]),
                    )
                    sf[float_base + _FS_SLOPE] = monitor_response_per_heater_code
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF] = reference_code
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = (
                        ST_LOCK if monitor_response_per_heater_code < 0.0 else ST_FAULT
                    )
                    s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                elif u >= hi or map_count >= H:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_FAULT
                else:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = u + ramp_step if u + ramp_step < hi else hi
            elif st == ST_RETURN or st == ST_RECAPTURE:
                step_codes = ramp_step if st == ST_RETURN else recap_step
                if u >= sf[float_base + _FS_U_GUARD] and y > sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = y
                if (
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] > rec_level * sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK]
                    and y < (1.0 - rec_drop) * sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX]
                ):
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_LOCK
                    s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                elif u >= hi or u >= sf[float_base + _FS_U_GUARD] + pf[_FP_SPAN]:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_FAULT
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = sf[float_base + _FS_U_GUARD] - sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD]
                else:
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U] = u + step_codes if u + step_codes < hi else hi
            elif st == ST_LOCK:
                peak = sf[float_base + _FS_PEAK]
                if history_count >= 1 and (hmax - y) > fall_frac * peak and y < fall_level * peak:
                    s[integer_base + _IS_STATE] = ST_RECAPTURE
                    s[integer_base + _IS_N_FALL] += 1
                    s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
                    sf[float_base + _FS_U_GUARD] = u + sf[float_base + _FS_GUARD]
                    sf[float_base + _FS_Y_MAX] = 0.0
                else:
                    e = _pi_error_c(
                        y,
                        u,
                        sf[float_base + _FS_U_REF],
                        peak,
                        sf[float_base + _FS_SLOPE],
                        target_fraction,
                        law,
                        smin,
                        smax,
                    )
                    if s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] == 1:
                        sf[float_base + _FS_E_PREV] = e
                        sf[float_base + _FS_V] = 0.0
                        s[integer_base + _IS_FRESH] = 0
                    else:
                        v = sf[float_base + _FS_V] + k2 * e
                        sf[float_base + _FS_V] = v
                        du = k_c * ((e - sf[float_base + _FS_E_PREV]) + t_ratio * e) + v
                        candidate_code = u + du
                        if candidate_code < lo:
                            sf[float_base + _FS_U] = lo
                            if v < 0.0:
                                sf[float_base + _FS_V] = 0.0
                        elif candidate_code > hi:
                            sf[float_base + _FS_U] = hi
                            if v > 0.0:
                                sf[float_base + _FS_V] = 0.0
                        else:
                            sf[float_base + _FS_U] = candidate_code
                        sf[float_base + _FS_E_PREV] = e
                    if peak > 0.0 and abs(y / peak - target_fraction) < lock_tol:
                        s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] += 1
                    else:
                        s[integer_base + _IS_LOCK_CNT] = 0
            for j in range(J - 1, 0, -1):
                sf[history_base + j] = sf[history_base + j - 1]
            sf[history_base] = y
            if history_count < J:
                s[integer_base + _IS_HIST_N] = history_count + 1
        act[p[_IP_OFF_HEATER] + i] = np.int64(np.rint(sf[float_base + _FS_U]))
    s[0] = 0

def reset(self, spec: ControllerSpec) -> None:
        p = self.params
        n = spec.n_rings
        cfg = PiLock._cfg(self, spec)               # sets nominal, law, k_c, t_ratio, code_lo, code_hi
        if p.start == "lock" and (p.peak_codes is None or p.slope_per_code is None):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: start='lock' needs peak_codes and slope_per_code (the factory table)")
        init = _ring_list(p.init_codes, n, "init_codes", 0.0, self.name)
        # user ints, in p_i64 order from _IP_START - start, law, J, H, K, has_init, lock_steps, settle, W, n_ref, delay
        self.params_i64 = np.concatenate([[_START[p.start], self.law, int(p.jump_steps), int(p.map_buffer),
                                           int(p.fit_half_width), 0 if p.init_codes is None else 1,
                                           int(p.lock_steps), int(p.map_settle_steps), int(p.slope_window),
                                           int(p.ref_steps), int(round(p.start_delay_s / spec.period_s))],
                                          np.rint(init).astype(np.int64)]).astype(np.int64)
        # user floats - the first _N_USER_F entries of the settings tuple, span, then the factory tables
        self.params_f64 = np.concatenate([np.asarray(cfg[:_N_USER_F], dtype=float), [float(p.recapture_span_codes)],
                                          _ring_list(p.peak_codes, n, "peak_codes", 0.0, self.name),
                                          _ring_list(p.slope_per_code, n, "slope_per_code", math.nan, self.name)])
        super().reset(spec)

nodes.name: monitor_mean
nodes.meaning: Block mean of the monitor samples released since the last step, (B, N) float, with the valid mask (at least one sample and monitor_valid) and the clip flag.
comments: Block mean of the monitor samples released since the last step, (B, N) float, with the valid mask (at least one sample and monitor_valid) and the clip flag.
Rings without a valid sample keep `prev` (or the latest).

source_ref.code:
def monitor_mean(obs: Observation, prev: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    samples = np.asarray(obs.sensors["tx.monitor.samples"], dtype=np.float64)
    sample_count = np.asarray(obs.sensors["tx.monitor.count"], dtype=np.int64)
    max_samples = samples.shape[-1]
    sample_mask = np.arange(max_samples)[None, None, :] < sample_count[:, :, None]
    sample_sum = np.where(sample_mask, samples, 0.0).sum(axis=2)
    valid = sample_count > 0
    if "monitor_valid" in obs.sensors:
        valid &= np.asarray(obs.sensors["monitor_valid"], dtype=bool)
    y = np.where(valid, sample_sum / np.maximum(sample_count, 1), np.nan)
    fallback = np.asarray(obs.sensors["tx.monitor.latest"], dtype=np.float64) if prev is None else prev
    y = np.where(valid, y, fallback)
    clip = np.asarray(obs.sensors["adc_overrange"], dtype=bool) if "adc_overrange" in obs.sensors\
        else np.zeros_like(valid)
    return y, valid, clip

nodes.name: require_simultaneous
nodes.meaning: Refuse `controller_interface.schedule = round_robin` for a controller built on `RampFSM`.
comments: Refuse `controller_interface.schedule = round_robin` for a controller built on `RampFSM`.
the FSM moves every ring's heater at every controller edge and reads the next monitor sample as the response at that drive.
Under round_robin the engine applies only ring j % N at edge j, so the other rings' commands are never applied, and the sweeps and the lock integrator run on drives that the ring does not have.

nodes.meaning: init
nodes.signature: __init__(self, spec: ControllerSpec, prm: RampParams, design: NominalDesign | None=None)

source_ref.code:
def __init__(self, spec: ControllerSpec, prm: RampParams, design: NominalDesign | None = None):
        self.spec = spec
        self.prm = prm
        nominal = nominal_design(spec) if design is None else design
        self.design = nominal
        B, N = spec.n_batch, spec.n_rings
        self.B, self.N = B, N
        self.code_min = int(spec.heater_dac.code_min)
        self.code_max = int(spec.heater_dac.code_max)
        self.q = nominal.drive_q if nominal.drive_q is not None else drive_exponent(prm.law)
        full_scale_codes = float(spec.adc.full_scale_codes)
        self.fs = full_scale_codes
        linewidth_drive = nominal.fwhm_w
        # configured up-sweep step (scalar) - ``dw_up`` is the (B, N) step in use, which a supervisor may set per world
        # or ring (the WDM supervisor maps at one step and acquires at another, world by world)
        self.dw_up0 = float(prm.dw_up if prm.dw_up is not None else (linewidth_drive / 3.5 if linewidth_drive else 0.004))
        self._dw_up = np.full((B, N), self.dw_up0)
        self.dw_down = prm.dw_down if prm.dw_down is not None else (linewidth_drive / 10.0 if linewidth_drive else 0.0015)
        self.dw_re = prm.dw_reapproach if prm.dw_reapproach is not None else (linewidth_drive / 5.0 if linewidth_drive else 0.003)
        self.detect = prm.detect_frac * full_scale_codes
        self.jump = prm.jump_frac * full_scale_codes
        self.drop_min = 0.01 * full_scale_codes
        self.g_loop = 2.0 * math.pi * prm.lock_bw_hz * spec.period_s
        if self.g_loop >= 1.0:
            raise ValueError(f"lock_bw_hz = {prm.lock_bw_hz} is too high for the {spec.rate_hz:.4g} Hz controller")
        new_state_array = lambda v=0.0, dt=np.float64: np.full((B, N), v, dtype=dt)
        self.state = new_state_array(ST_IDLE, np.int64)
        self.active = new_state_array(True, bool)
        if prm.rings is not None:
            self.active[:] = False
            self.active[:, list(prm.rings)] = True
        per_ring = lambda v: np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64), (N,))[None, :].repeat(B, axis=0)
        self.w = per_ring(prm.w_start).copy()
        self.w_meas = self.w.copy()           # drive that the current measurement reflects (one period of lag)
        self.code = code_of_w(self.w, self.code_max, self.q, self.code_min)
        self.u = self.code.astype(np.float64)  # lock integrator (codes)
        self.w_lo = per_ring(prm.w_lo).copy()
        self.w_hi = per_ring(prm.w_hi).copy()
        self.w_up0 = self.w.copy()
        self.park_w = self.w.copy()
        self.dw_down_max = 6.0 * nominal.fwhm_w if nominal.fwhm_w else 0.1   # longest red branch scanned down (strong self-heating - G P_peak up to ~5 FWHM)
        self.y_prev = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.y_floor = new_state_array(np.inf)
        self.floor_at_max = new_state_array(np.inf)
        self.y_max = new_state_array(-np.inf)
        self.w_max = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.y_pk = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.w_pk = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.y_bg = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.w_event = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.y_land = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.setpoint = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.slope_code = new_state_array(np.nan)           # dy/dcode at the set-point, red side (< 0)
        self.ki = new_state_array(0.0)
        self.jumps = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.w_jump = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.jumped = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.bistable = new_state_array(False,
            bool)        # the resonance was found by a jump (self-heating bistability)
        self.partial = new_state_array(False, bool)         # the peak lies below w = 0 - y_pk is a lower bound
        self.w_jump_ev = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.lost = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.retries = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.steps = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.rail = new_state_array(0, np.int64)            # steps of the current UP/REAPPROACH ramp spent at full scale (w = 1)
        self.fail_steps = new_state_array(0, np.int64)      # steps spent in FAIL (a standalone controller re-arms after a while)
        self.w_lock_in = new_state_array(np.nan)            # drive at the lock entry (the window follows the tracked drift)
        self.w_good = new_state_array(np.nan)               # drive of the last locked step with the monitor in range
        self.w_hi_full = self.w_hi.copy()     # window top of the search (a lock-loss search narrows w_hi)
        self.relock = new_state_array(False, bool)          # the running search follows a loss of lock (height-checked)
        self.rise_ref = new_state_array(np.nan)             # peak height above background of the lock that was lost
        controller_period_s = spec.period_s
        self.retry_reset_steps = max(int(round(prm.retry_reset_s / controller_period_s)), 1)
        self.rearm_steps = (None if prm.fail_rearm_s is None
                            else max(int(round(prm.fail_rearm_s / controller_period_s)), 1))
        self.clipped = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.locked = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.saturated = new_state_array(False, bool)
        # MAP mode (supervisors, factory calibration) - record every resonance passed by the up-sweep
        E = 2 * spec.n_lines + 4
        self.map_mode = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.map_done = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.skip = new_state_array(0, np.int64)               # COUNT search - resonances to pass before the one to take
        self.map_target = new_state_array(spec.n_lines + 1, np.int64)
        self.ev_w = np.full((B, N, E), np.nan)
        self.ev_y = np.full((B, N, E), np.nan)
        self.ev_floor = np.full((B, N, E), np.nan)
        self.ev_wfloor = np.full((B, N, E), np.nan)   # drive of the floor before each resonance (between lines)
        self.ev_n = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.w_floor = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.w_floor_at_max = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.y_start = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.buf_w = np.full((B, N, _DOWN_BUF_LEN), np.nan)
        self.buf_y = np.full((B, N, _DOWN_BUF_LEN), np.nan)
        self.buf_n = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        # resonances an UP search passed outside its window (drive of each maximum), since the search started - a supervisor aligns them with a stored map to measure the comb drift and re-centre the window
        self.sk_w = np.full((B, N, E), np.nan)
        self.sk_n = new_state_array(0, np.int64)

nodes.name: start
nodes.meaning: supervisor interface
comments: supervisor interface
Begin a search (UP) on the rings in `mask`.
the search starts at drive `w_from` (default - their current drive) inside [w_lo, w_hi] (default - the params' window) and passes `skip` resonances before taking one.
this COUNT search is robust to a drift of the whole resonance comb, as long as the start state is the one the count refers to.
nodes.signature: start(self, mask, w_from=None, w_lo=None, w_hi=None, skip=0)

source_ref.code:
def start(self, mask, w_from=None, w_lo=None, w_hi=None, skip=0):
        m = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool) & self.active
        self.skip = np.where(m, skip, self.skip)
        if w_from is not None:
            self.w = np.where(m, w_from, self.w)
        if w_lo is not None:
            self.w_lo = np.where(m, w_lo, self.w_lo)
        if w_hi is not None:
            self.w_hi = np.where(m, w_hi, self.w_hi)
        self.w_hi_full = np.where(m, self.w_hi, self.w_hi_full)
        self.relock = np.where(m, False, self.relock)
        self.w = np.where(m, np.maximum(self.w, 0.0), self.w)
        if not getattr(self, "_mapping_call", False):
            self.map_mode = np.where(m, False, self.map_mode)
        self._enter_up(m)
        self.retries = np.where(m, 0, self.retries)
        self.jumps = np.where(m, 0, self.jumps)
        self._apply_code(m)

nodes.name: start_map
nodes.meaning: Begin a MAP sweep on the rings in `mask`.
comments: Begin a MAP sweep on the rings in `mask`.
the sweep ramps up from `w_from` and records every resonance passed (drive `ev_w`, landing level `ev_y`, floor before it `ev_floor`).
it stops when `n_events` are recorded (default L + 1 - one full FSR) or the drive passes `w_hi`, and then holds with `map_done`.

source_ref.code:
def start_map(self, mask, w_from=0.0, w_hi=None, n_events=None):
        m = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool) & self.active
        self.map_mode = np.where(m, True, self.map_mode)
        self.map_done = np.where(m, False, self.map_done)
        if n_events is not None:
            self.map_target = np.where(m, int(n_events), self.map_target)
        self.ev_w[m] = np.nan
        self.ev_y[m] = np.nan
        self.ev_floor[m] = np.nan
        self.ev_n = np.where(m, 0, self.ev_n)
        self.y_start = np.where(m, np.nan, self.y_start)
        self._mapping_call = True
        try:
            self.start(m, w_from=w_from, w_lo=0.0, w_hi=1.0 if w_hi is None else w_hi)
        finally:
            self._mapping_call = False

def park(self, mask, w):

        self.w = np.where(m, w, self.w)
        self.state = np.where(m, ST_HOLD, self.state)

nodes.name: park_from_below
nodes.meaning: Move the rings in `mask` to drive `w` approaching from below - drop to 0 if above, then ramp up by dw_up per step (state PARK, then HOLD).
comments: Move the rings in `mask` to drive `w` approaching from below - drop to 0 if above, then ramp up by dw_up per step (state PARK, then HOLD).
Under self-heating bistability the state reached depends on the approach direction - from below it is the state an up-sweep recorded at `w`.

source_ref.code:
def park_from_below(self, mask, w):
        m = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool) & self.active
        self.park_w = np.where(m, w, self.park_w)
        self.w = np.where(m & (self.w > w), 0.0, self.w)
        self.state = np.where(m, ST_PARK, self.state)
        self.locked = np.where(m, False, self.locked)
        self.map_mode = np.where(m, False, self.map_mode)
        self._apply_code(m)

nodes.name: _apply_code

source_ref.code:
def _apply_code(self, m):
        codes = code_of_w(self.w, self.code_max, self.q, self.code_min)
        self.code = np.where(m, codes, self.code)
        self.u = np.where(m, self.code.astype(np.float64), self.u)

nodes.name: _enter_up
nodes.meaning: enter up

source_ref.code:
def _enter_up(self, m):
        self.state = np.where(m, ST_UP, self.state)
        self.partial = np.where(m, False, self.partial)
        self.w_up0 = np.where(m, self.w, self.w_up0)
        self.y_floor = np.where(m, np.inf, self.y_floor)
        self.floor_at_max = np.where(m, np.inf, self.floor_at_max)
        self.y_max = np.where(m, -np.inf, self.y_max)
        self.w_max = np.where(m, np.nan, self.w_max)
        self.jumped = np.where(m, False, self.jumped)
        self.locked = np.where(m, False, self.locked)
        self.steps = np.where(m, 0, self.steps)
        self.rail = np.where(m, 0, self.rail)
        self.sk_n = np.where(m, 0, self.sk_n)

nodes.name: rearm
nodes.meaning: Restart the search of the rings in `mask` (normally rings in FAIL, see `fail_steps`) with a fresh retry count, from the start drive of their last search and in their last window.
comments: Restart the search of the rings in `mask` (normally rings in FAIL, see `fail_steps`) with a fresh retry count, from the start drive of their last search and in their last window.

source_ref.code:
def rearm(self, mask) -> None:
        m = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool) & self.active
        if not np.any(m):
            return
        self.w = np.where(m, self.w_up0, self.w)
        self.w_hi = np.where(m, self.w_hi_full, self.w_hi)       # undo a lock-loss narrowing
        self.relock = np.where(m, False, self.relock)            # and its height test - take what is there now
        self.retries = np.where(m, 0, self.retries)
        self.fail_steps = np.where(m, 0, self.fail_steps)
        self._enter_up(m)
        self._apply_code(m)

def _enter_down(self, m):
        self.state = np.where(m, ST_DOWN, self.state)
        self.bistable = np.where(m, self.jumped, self.bistable)
        self.w_jump_ev = np.where(m, np.where(self.jumped, self.w_jump, self.w_max), self.w_jump_ev)
        self.w_event = np.where(m, self.w_max, self.w_event)
        self.y_land = np.where(m, self.y_max, self.y_land)
        self.y_bg = np.where(m, np.where(np.isfinite(self.floor_at_max), self.floor_at_max, self.y_floor),
                             self.y_bg)
        self.y_max = np.where(m, -np.inf, self.y_max)
        self.w_max = np.where(m, np.nan, self.w_max)
        self.buf_n = np.where(m, 0, self.buf_n)
        self.steps = np.where(m, 0, self.steps)

def _set_peak(self, m):
        self.y_pk = np.where(m, self.y_max, self.y_pk)
        self.w_pk = np.where(m, self.w_max, self.w_pk)
        self.y_bg = np.where(m, np.minimum(self.y_bg, self.y_floor), self.y_bg)
        self.setpoint = np.where(m, self.y_bg + self.prm.alpha * (self.y_pk - self.y_bg), self.setpoint)
        if np.any(m):
            self._measure_slope(m)
        self.jumped = np.where(m, False, self.jumped)
        self.y_max = np.where(m, -np.inf, self.y_max)
        self.steps = np.where(m, 0, self.steps)

source_ref.code:
def _measure_slope(self, m):
        for b, n in zip(*np.nonzero(m)):
            point_count = int(min(self.buf_n[b, n], _DOWN_BUF_LEN))
            w = self.buf_w[b, n, :point_count]
            y = self.buf_y[b, n, :point_count]
            target_code = self.setpoint[b, n]
            s_code = np.nan
            if point_count >= 3 and np.isfinite(target_code):
                peak_index = int(np.argmax(y))
                red_drive, red_monitor = w[:peak_index + 1], y[:peak_index + 1]          # red branch - w decreasing, y increasing
                crossing_indices = np.flatnonzero((red_monitor[:-1] <= target_code) & (red_monitor[1:] > target_code))
                if crossing_indices.size:
                    i = int(crossing_indices[-1])
                    lo, hi = max(i - 2, 0), min(i + 3, red_drive.size - 1)
                    dw = red_drive[hi] - red_drive[lo]
                    if dw < 0:
                        s_w = (red_monitor[hi] - red_monitor[lo]) / dw              # dy/dw < 0 on the red side
                        wc = 0.5 * (red_drive[hi] + red_drive[lo])
                        x = max(wc, 1e-9) ** (1.0 / self.q)
                        dwdc = self.q * x ** (self.q - 1) / self.code_max
                        s_code = s_w * dwdc
                elif peak_index >= 2:
                    # the scan started nearer the peak than the set-point - use the mean slope of the red branch
                    dw = red_drive[peak_index] - red_drive[0]
                    if dw < 0:
                        s_w = (red_monitor[peak_index] - red_monitor[0]) / dw
                        x = max(0.5 * (red_drive[0] + red_drive[peak_index]), 1e-9) ** (1.0 / self.q)
                        s_code = s_w * self.q * x ** (self.q - 1) / self.code_max
            if not (np.isfinite(s_code) and s_code < 0):
                # fallback - Lorentzian slope at x = 1 over the measured half-width of the red branch in codes
                half_width_drive = max(abs(self.w_event[b, n] - self.w_max[b, n]), 4 * self.dw_down)
                x = max(self.w_max[b, n], 1e-9) ** (1.0 / self.q)
                half_width_codes = half_width_drive / (self.q * x ** (self.q - 1) / self.code_max)
                s_code = -0.5 * (self.y_max[b, n] - self.y_bg[b, n]) / max(half_width_codes, 1.0)
            self.slope_code[b, n] = s_code
            self.ki[b, n] = self.g_loop / abs(s_code)

source_ref.code:
def _retry(self, m):
        retry = m & (self.retries < self.prm.max_retries)
        fail = m & ~retry
        self.retries = np.where(retry, self.retries + 1, self.retries)
        self.w = np.where(retry, np.maximum(self.w - 4.0 * self.dw_up, self.w_lo), self.w)
        self._enter_up(retry)
        self._enter_fail(fail)
        self.w = np.where(fail, self.w_lo, self.w)            # FAIL parks at the window's low edge, as below

advance active rings by one controller period using monitor block means in ADC codes.
UP requires a maximum after a floor and inside the search window.
reject startup transients.
MAP records crossings.
COUNT skips the requested number.
ordinary acquisition enters DOWN.
DOWN records the stable branch, finds the true peak, and estimates lock slope.

a DOWN fall can otherwise leave the ring on a neighbouring line's hot branch.
continuous REAPPROACH instead requires a high maximum near the recorded peak followed by a decline.
this works without a thermal jump.
integrate monitor error with Ki=2*pi*lock_bw_hz*period/abs(measured_dy_dcode).
clamp heater code.
a low signal or sustained rail triggers relock.
move the search window by drift tracked while near the target.
limit the immediate search to the lost resonance and reject peaks below the configured fraction of its old height.
a dark line must not cause capture of another line.
loss counts as a retry.

exhausting retries parks at the low window edge.

w_meas associates this observation with the previous command.

its history sets the final thermal branch.
nodes.signature: step(self, y: np.ndarray, valid: np.ndarray, clipped: np.ndarray | None=None)

source_ref.code:
def step(self, y: np.ndarray, valid: np.ndarray, clipped: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
        prm = self.prm
        self.fail_steps = np.where(self.active & (self.state == ST_FAIL), self.fail_steps + 1, self.fail_steps)
        valid_updates = self.active & np.asarray(valid, dtype=bool)
        if clipped is not None:
            self.clipped |= valid_updates & np.asarray(clipped, dtype=bool) & (self.state != ST_LOCK)
        y = np.where(valid_updates, y, self.y_prev)
        dy = y - self.y_prev
        self.steps = np.where(valid_updates, self.steps + 1, self.steps)
        new_jump = valid_updates & np.isfinite(dy) & (dy > self.jump) & np.isin(self.state, (ST_UP, ST_REAPPROACH))
        self.jumps = np.where(new_jump, self.jumps + 1, self.jumps)
        self.w_jump = np.where(new_jump, self.w_meas, self.w_jump)
        self.jumped |= new_jump
        measured_drive = self.w_meas

        # UP - search
        state_mask = valid_updates & (self.state == ST_UP)
        if np.any(state_mask):
            # a resonance is a maximum that FOLLOWS a floor - a new minimum restarts the maximum
            new_minimum = state_mask & (y < self.y_floor)
            self.y_floor = np.where(new_minimum, y, self.y_floor)
            self.w_floor = np.where(new_minimum, measured_drive, self.w_floor)
            self.y_max = np.where(new_minimum, y, self.y_max)
            self.w_max = np.where(new_minimum, measured_drive, self.w_max)
            self.floor_at_max = np.where(new_minimum, y, self.floor_at_max)
            self.w_floor_at_max = np.where(new_minimum, measured_drive, self.w_floor_at_max)
            new_maximum = state_mask & (y > self.y_max)
            self.y_max = np.where(new_maximum, y, self.y_max)
            self.w_max = np.where(new_maximum, measured_drive, self.w_max)
            self.floor_at_max = np.where(new_maximum, self.y_floor, self.floor_at_max)
            self.w_floor_at_max = np.where(new_maximum, self.w_floor, self.w_floor_at_max)
            rise = self.y_max - self.floor_at_max
            drop = np.maximum(self.drop_min, prm.drop_frac * rise)
            # the maximum must come from the sweep, not from a transient at its start
            inside_window = ((self.w_max >= self.w_lo) & (self.w_max <= self.w_hi)
                     & (self.w_max >= self.w_up0 + 1.5 * self.dw_up))
            found = state_mask & (rise >= self.detect) & (y <= self.y_max - drop) & inside_window
            self.y_start = np.where(state_mask & np.isnan(self.y_start), y, self.y_start)
            # COUNT search - pass this resonance and keep going
            passed = found & ~self.map_mode & (self.skip > 0)
            if np.any(passed):
                self.skip = np.where(passed, self.skip - 1, self.skip)
                self.y_floor = np.where(passed, y, self.y_floor)
                self.w_floor = np.where(passed, measured_drive, self.w_floor)
                self.y_max = np.where(passed, y, self.y_max)
                self.w_max = np.where(passed, measured_drive, self.w_max)
                self.floor_at_max = np.where(passed, y, self.floor_at_max)
                self.jumped = np.where(passed, False, self.jumped)
                found = found & ~passed
            mapped = found & self.map_mode
            if np.any(mapped):
                world_indices, ring_indices = np.nonzero(mapped)
                k = np.minimum(self.ev_n[world_indices, ring_indices], self.ev_w.shape[2] - 1)
                self.ev_w[world_indices, ring_indices, k] = self.w_max[world_indices, ring_indices]
                self.ev_y[world_indices, ring_indices, k] = self.y_max[world_indices, ring_indices]
                self.ev_floor[world_indices, ring_indices, k] = self.floor_at_max[world_indices, ring_indices]
                self.ev_wfloor[world_indices, ring_indices, k] = self.w_floor_at_max[world_indices, ring_indices]
                self.ev_n = np.where(mapped, self.ev_n + 1, self.ev_n)
                # keep searching from here - the next resonance must follow a new floor
                self.y_floor = np.where(mapped, y, self.y_floor)
                self.w_floor = np.where(mapped, measured_drive, self.w_floor)
                self.y_max = np.where(mapped, y, self.y_max)
                self.w_max = np.where(mapped, measured_drive, self.w_max)
                self.floor_at_max = np.where(mapped, y, self.floor_at_max)
                full = mapped & (self.ev_n >= self.map_target)
                self.state = np.where(full, ST_HOLD, self.state)
                self.map_done |= full
                found = found & ~mapped
            # a passed resonance outside the window - forget it and keep searching
            skip = state_mask & (rise >= self.detect) & (y <= self.y_max - drop) & ~inside_window
            record_crossing = skip & (self.w_max >= self.w_up0 + 1.5 * self.dw_up)    # not a transient at the search start
            if np.any(record_crossing):
                world_indices, ring_indices = np.nonzero(record_crossing)
                kk = np.minimum(self.sk_n[world_indices, ring_indices], self.sk_w.shape[2] - 1)
                self.sk_w[world_indices, ring_indices, kk] = self.w_max[world_indices, ring_indices]
                self.sk_n = np.where(record_crossing, self.sk_n + 1, self.sk_n)
            self.y_max = np.where(skip, y, self.y_max)
            self.w_max = np.where(skip, measured_drive, self.w_max)
            self.floor_at_max = np.where(skip, y, self.floor_at_max)
            self.y_floor = np.where(skip, y, self.y_floor)
            self._enter_down(found)
            continuing = state_mask & ~found & (self.state == ST_UP)
            self.w = np.where(continuing, self.w + self.dw_up, self.w)
            # a maximum inside the window needs a few more steps for its fall to be confirmed.
            # the drive is clipped
            # to w = 1 at the end of every step, so a window reaching full scale (the default w_hi = 1) is ended by the steps spent at the rail - without that count, a search that finds nothing (no light, a resonance out of reach) would hold the heater at full scale for ever
            self.rail = np.where(continuing & (self.w > 1.0), self.rail + 1, np.where(continuing, 0, self.rail))
            over = continuing & ((self.w > self.w_hi + np.where(self.map_mode, 0.0,
                3.0 * self.dw_up)) | (self.rail > 3))
            map_over = over & self.map_mode
            self.state = np.where(map_over, ST_HOLD, self.state)
            self.map_done |= map_over
            self._fail_or_retry(over & ~self.map_mode)

        # DOWN - true peak on the red branch
        state_mask = valid_updates & (self.state == ST_DOWN) & (self.steps > 1)
        first_down_step = valid_updates & (self.state == ST_DOWN) & (self.steps <= 1)
        self.w = np.where(first_down_step, self.w - self.dw_down, self.w)
        if np.any(state_mask):
            k = np.minimum(self.buf_n, _DOWN_BUF_LEN - 1)
            world_indices, ring_indices = np.nonzero(state_mask)
            self.buf_w[world_indices, ring_indices, k[world_indices, ring_indices]] = measured_drive[world_indices,
                ring_indices]
            self.buf_y[world_indices, ring_indices, k[world_indices, ring_indices]] = y[world_indices, ring_indices]
            self.buf_n = np.where(state_mask, self.buf_n + 1, self.buf_n)
            self.y_floor = np.where(state_mask, np.minimum(self.y_floor, y), self.y_floor)
            new_maximum = state_mask & (y > self.y_max)
            self.y_max = np.where(new_maximum, y, self.y_max)
            self.w_max = np.where(new_maximum, measured_drive, self.w_max)
            rise = self.y_max - self.y_bg
            fall = np.maximum(self.drop_min, prm.drop_frac * rise)
            peak = state_mask & (rise >= self.detect) & (y <= self.y_max - fall)
            # bistable = the UP sweep rose by a jump AND the true peak lies well below the up-sweep's event (a hot branch spanning more than two up-steps).
            # a sharp resonance can exceed jump_frac in one up-step without bistability.
            # here dw_up is about FWHM/3.5, and the peak is large.
            # its down-scan peak lies within about one step of the up-sweep maximum.
            # use continuous re-approach - a jump search would wait for a jump that never occurs.
            # only a long hot branch can hand the DOWN scan to the hot branch of another line (whose red flank the continuous rule would take), and a long branch keeps the jump rule.
            # (A test on the size of the final fall does not work - the block-mean monitor smears a fold over two steps, and on g26 nominal ring 2 the DOWN scan of line 2 continues onto line 7's hot branch, tests/verification/test_ctrl_b_wdm.py.)
            long_branch = (self.w_event - self.w_max) > 2.0 * self.dw_up
            self.bistable = np.where(peak, self.bistable & long_branch, self.bistable)
            # after lock loss, accept only a resonance at least relock_height_frac times the lost peak.
            # a lower peak can be another line during laser failover, or an occupied line.
            # skip it and continue upward without spending a retry.
            weak = peak & self.relock & ((self.y_max - self.y_bg) < prm.relock_height_frac * self.rise_ref)
            if np.any(weak):
                self.w = np.where(weak, self.w_event + self.dw_up, self.w)
                self._enter_up(weak)
                peak = peak & ~weak
            self._enter_reapproach(peak)
            continuing = state_mask & ~peak & (self.state == ST_DOWN)
            # the heater cannot cool - when the red branch reaches w = 0 (or runs longer than dw_down_max) before its peak, the ring is still on the red side - take the highest point seen as a partial peak and lock
            end = continuing & ((self.w - self.dw_down < 0.0) | (self.w - self.dw_down < self.w_event - self.dw_down_max))
            rising = end & (y >= self.y_max - self.drop_min) & (self.y_max - self.y_bg >= self.detect)
            rising &= ~(self.relock & ((self.y_max - self.y_bg) < prm.relock_height_frac * self.rise_ref))
            if np.any(rising):
                self.partial = np.where(rising, True, self.partial)
                self._set_peak(rising)
                self._enter_lock(rising)
            self._retry(end & ~rising)
            continuing = continuing & ~end
            self.w = np.where(continuing, self.w - self.dw_down, self.w)

        # REAPPROACH - back to the red side of the SAME resonance. Bistable case - the jump recurs near the drive
        # where the UP sweep jumped (the fall-off of the DOWN scan may have left the ring on the hot branch of the next bluer line, whose red flank must not be taken for this one).
        # Continuous case - a high maximum near w_pk, then a fall.
        state_mask = valid_updates & (self.state == ST_REAPPROACH)
        if np.any(state_mask):
            tol = 4.0 * self.dw_up
            bistable_capture = state_mask & self.bistable & new_jump & (measured_drive >= self.w_jump_ev - tol)
            near = state_mask & ~self.bistable & (measured_drive >= self.w_pk - 2.0 * self.dw_re)
            new_maximum = near & (y > self.y_max)
            self.y_max = np.where(new_maximum, y, self.y_max)
            high = self.y_max >= self.y_bg + 0.6 * (self.y_pk - self.y_bg)
            continuous_capture = near & high & (y < self.y_max - self.drop_min)
            red = (bistable_capture | continuous_capture) & (self.steps > 1)
            self._enter_lock(red)
            continuing = state_mask & ~red
            self.w = np.where(continuing, self.w + self.dw_re, self.w)
            limit = np.where(self.bistable, self.w_jump_ev, self.w_pk) + tol
            self.rail = np.where(continuing & (self.w > 1.0), self.rail + 1, np.where(continuing, 0, self.rail))
            over = continuing & ((self.w > limit) | (self.rail > 3))      # a peak near full scale - the limit is unreachable
            self._retry(over)

        # LOCK - integral loop on the red side
        state_mask = valid_updates & (self.state == ST_LOCK)
        if np.any(state_mask):
            monitor_error = y - self.setpoint
            self.u = np.where(state_mask, self.u + self.ki * monitor_error, self.u)
            lo, hi = float(self.code_min), float(self.code_max)
            self.saturated = np.where(state_mask, (self.u <= lo) | (self.u >= hi), self.saturated)
            self.u = np.where(state_mask, np.clip(self.u, lo, hi), self.u)
            self.code = np.where(state_mask, np.rint(self.u).astype(np.int64), self.code)
            self.w = np.where(state_mask, w_of_code(self.code, self.code_max, self.q), self.w)
            low = state_mask & (y < self.y_bg + prm.lost_frac * (self.y_pk - self.y_bg))
            self.lost = np.where(low, self.lost + 1, np.where(state_mask, 0, self.lost))
            # drive of the last step in lock (monitor within 0.2 of the peak height of its set-point) - the drift the loop tracked since the lock entry is w_good - w_lock_in.
            # the integrator wanders while the error is large (a dark line - the monitor drops to the other lines' leakage, often above the loss threshold, and the loop runs the heater to its rail), so those steps do not count
            near_r = np.abs(y - self.setpoint) < 0.2 * np.maximum(self.y_pk - self.y_bg, 1.0)
            self.w_good = np.where(state_mask & near_r, self.w, self.w_good)
            # a lock held for retry_reset_s clears the retry count - occasional losses over a long run do not add up
            self.retries = np.where(state_mask & (self.steps >= self.retry_reset_steps), 0, self.retries)
            gone = state_mask & ((self.lost >= prm.lost_steps) | (self.saturated & (self.steps > prm.lost_steps)))
            if np.any(gone):
                # restart a little blue of the peak in a window around that peak.
                # move both peak drive and window by the drift tracked during lock.
                # a few kelvin can shift resonance by several linewidths, making the acquisition map stale.
                # the new search must find the same resonance.
                tracked_drift = np.where(gone & np.isfinite(self.w_good) & np.isfinite(self.w_lock_in),
                             self.w_good - self.w_lock_in, 0.0)
                self.w_lo = np.where(gone, np.clip(self.w_lo + tracked_drift, 0.0, 1.0), self.w_lo)
                self.w_hi_full = np.where(gone, np.clip(self.w_hi_full + tracked_drift, 0.0, 1.0), self.w_hi_full)
                self.w_pk = np.where(gone, self.w_pk + tracked_drift, self.w_pk)
                self.w_jump_ev = np.where(gone, self.w_jump_ev + tracked_drift, self.w_jump_ev)
                # the immediate re-search covers only this resonance (up to its up-sweep event + 6 steps) - a search that ran while the light was gone (a dropout longer than a few steps) would otherwise climb past it in the dark and take the next resonance up, a foreign line.
                # a re-arm after FAIL restores the full window (w_hi_full)
                top = np.fmax(self.w_pk, self.w_jump_ev) + 6.0 * self.dw_up
                self.w_hi = np.where(gone, np.minimum(self.w_hi_full, top), self.w_hi)
                self.locked = np.where(gone, False, self.locked)
                self.relock = np.where(gone, True, self.relock)
                self.rise_ref = np.where(gone, self.y_pk - self.y_bg, self.rise_ref)
                # a loss counts as a retry - past max_retries the ring FAILs (parked at w_lo) instead of cycling for ever, e.g. a set-point beyond full scale (lock -> rail -> loss -> search -> lock ...)
                again = gone & (self.retries < prm.max_retries)
                lo_w = np.maximum(self.w_pk - 6.0 * self.dw_up, 0.0)
                self.w = np.where(again, lo_w, self.w)
                self.retries = np.where(again, self.retries + 1, self.retries)
                self._enter_up(again)
                self._enter_fail(gone & ~again)
                self.w = np.where(gone & ~again, self.w_lo, self.w)
                self.w_up0 = np.where(gone, lo_w, self.w_up0)          # a re-arm starts from the moved peak too

        # PARK - ramp up to the park drive
        state_mask = self.active & (self.state == ST_PARK)
        if np.any(state_mask):
            self.w = np.where(state_mask, np.minimum(self.w + self.dw_up, self.park_w), self.w)
            self.state = np.where(state_mask & (self.w >= self.park_w), ST_HOLD, self.state)

        # drive -> code for the sweeping states
        sweep = (valid_updates & np.isin(self.state, (ST_UP, ST_DOWN, ST_REAPPROACH, ST_FAIL))) | state_mask
        sweep |= self.active & (self.state == ST_HOLD) & state_mask
        self.w = np.clip(self.w, 0.0, 1.0)
        codes = code_of_w(self.w, self.code_max, self.q, self.code_min)
        self.code = np.where(sweep, codes, self.code)
        self.w_meas = np.where(valid_updates, self.w, self.w_meas)
        self.y_prev = np.where(valid_updates, y, self.y_prev)
        return self.code.copy()

def reset(self, spec: ControllerSpec) -> None:
        super().reset(spec)
        require_simultaneous(spec, self.name)
        params = self.params
        if params.policy not in ("fixed", "cyclic", "any"):
            raise ValueError(f"WdmSupervisor: policy {params.policy!r} must be fixed, cyclic or any")
        self.fsm = acquisition = RampFSM(spec, params)
        self.d = acquisition.design
        B, N, L = spec.n_batch, spec.n_rings, spec.n_lines
        self.B, self.N, self.L = B, N, L
        self.bound_assignment = "tx.assignment" in spec.actuators
        self.policy = params.policy if self.bound_assignment else "fixed"
        ring_to_line = spec.ring_to_line if spec.ring_to_line is not None else tuple(range(N))
        self.declared = np.array([int(x) % L for x in ring_to_line], dtype=np.int64)
        self.order = [int(x) for x in spec.bus_order]
        self.dw_map = float(params.map_dw) if params.map_dw is not None else (self.d.fwhm_w / 2.5 if self.d.fwhm_w else 0.006)
        # the acquisition's up-search passes several resonances (COUNT search) at the map's step - the peak itself is measured on the slower DOWN scan (dw_down)
        self.dw_acq = max(acquisition.dw_up0, self.dw_map) if params.dw_up is None else acquisition.dw_up0
        self.delay_ticks = int(round(params.start_delay_s / spec.tick_s))
        self.t0: int | None = None                    # tick of the first step after reset (start delay origin)
        self._synced = False                          # codes taken from tx.heater.applied at the first step
        self.fits: list = [None] * B                  # bank pattern fit of each world (cyclic / any cold start)
        self.fresh_fits: list = [[] for _ in range(B)]   # (fsr, exponent, curvature) of confident fresh-map fits
        self.exponents = law_exponents(self.d, acquisition.q)   # drive-law exponents tried by the pattern fits
        self.w_min_target = float(params.w_min_target)
        new_state_array = lambda v=0.0, dt=np.float64: np.full((B, N), v, dtype=dt)
        self.phase = np.full(B, PH_WAIT, np.int64)
        self.cursor = np.zeros(B, np.int64)          # index into the bus order (MAP and ACQUIRE)
        self.busy = np.zeros(B, bool)                 # the cursor ring has been started
        self.events = [[np.zeros(0) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(B)]
        self.ev_floor_w = [[np.zeros(0) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(B)]
        self.ev_height = [[np.zeros(0) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(B)]
        self.labels = [[np.zeros(0, np.int64) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(B)]
        self.map_ok = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.map_events = new_state_array(0, np.int64)
        self.target_line = new_state_array(-1, np.int64)
        self.target_ev = new_state_array(-1, np.int64)
        self.assigned = np.repeat(self.declared[None, :], B, axis=0).astype(np.int64)
        self.shift = np.zeros(B, np.int64)
        self.wrong = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.supply_limited = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.captured = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.retried = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.w_lock0 = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.excess = np.zeros(B, np.int64)
        self.drift = np.zeros(B)                      # drive drift since the map, from the rings acquired so far
        self.drifts = [[] for _ in range(B)]
        self.drift_ring = new_state_array(np.nan)                   # per-ring drift measured at an online barrel shift
        self.retarget = np.zeros(B, bool)             # ACQUIRE after an online barrel shift (rings move one by one)
        self.drift_used = new_state_array(0.0)                      # drift applied to each ring's last acquisition window
        self.moved = new_state_array(False, bool)                   # the supervisor has moved the ring since the reset
        self.fresh = new_state_array(False, bool)                   # the ring's map was taken right before its acquisition
        self.mapping = new_state_array(False, bool)
        self.map_capped = new_state_array(False, bool)              # the fresh map was cut short by the supply budget
        self.drift_meas = new_state_array(np.nan)                   # comb drift measured at the lock (_verify_lock)
        self.acq_uncertain = new_state_array(False,
            bool)           # the lock does not sit where the map says (not vouched)
        self.y = new_state_array(np.nan)
        self.t_die_c = np.full(B, np.nan)
        # every ring holds its applied code until the supervisor moves it
        acquisition.state[:] = ST_HOLD

def _w_cap(self, b, n, w_max: float) -> float:
        acquisition = self.fsm
        codes = acquisition.code[b].copy()
        ws = np.linspace(0.0, w_max, 41)
        ok_w = 0.0
        for w in ws:
            codes[n] = int(code_of_w(w, acquisition.code_max, acquisition.q))
            if not self._budget_ok(codes):
                break
            ok_w = float(w)
        return ok_w

def _ring_events(self, b, n):
        if self.table is not None:
            w, line_labels = self.table.events(b, n)
            floor_drives = np.full(w.size, np.nan)
            sel = np.isfinite(self.table.w[b, n])
            event_order = np.argsort(self.table.w[b, n][sel])
            peak_heights = (self.table.height[b, n] - self.table.floor[b,
                n])[sel][event_order]     # rise above the floor, as a map
            if w.size > 1:
                floor_drives[1:] = w[:-1] + 0.4 * np.diff(w)            # the table has no floor drives - 40 % into the gap
            if w.size:                                        # a ring without table entries has no events at all
                floor_drives[0] = max(w[0] - 0.6 * (np.diff(w).min() if w.size > 1 else 0.05), 0.0)
            shift = self._table_shift(b)
            return w + shift, line_labels, np.maximum(floor_drives + shift, 0.0), peak_heights
        return self.events[b][n], self.labels[b][n], self.ev_floor_w[b][n], self.ev_height[b][n]

def _table_shift(self, b) -> float:
        table = self.table
        design = self.d
        if (table is None or not np.isfinite(self.t_die_c[b]) or not np.isfinite(table.t_cal_c[b]) or not design.s0_m_per_k
                or not design.tuning_m_per_w_drive):
            return 0.0

nodes.name: _plan_assignment
nodes.meaning: choose target lines and resonance events for world b.
comments: choose target lines and resonance events for world b.
fixed keeps the declared map.
cyclic tries it first when supply-feasible, then lower-total-drive barrel shifts.
if none fits, choose the least-drive available shift and let acquisition flag shortages.
any solves a minimum-drive linear assignment, then acquisition checks the projected supply per ring.
a ring without a line has assignment/event -1.
no remapping is allowed without tx.assignment ownership.

source_ref.code:
def _plan_assignment(self, b) -> None:
        N, L = self.N, self.L
        cost = np.full((N, L), np.inf)
        event_indices = np.full((N, L), -1, np.int64)
        for n in range(N):
            w, ln, _, _ = self._ring_events(b, n)
            for m in range(L):
                k = self._target_index(b, n, m)
                if k >= 0:
                    cost[n, m] = w[k]
                    event_indices[n, m] = k

        def feasible(lines):
            if np.any(~np.isfinite(cost[np.arange(N), lines])):
                return False
            # the lock sits a little above the resonance found by the up-search - same margin as ACQUIRE's check
            codes = code_of_w(cost[np.arange(N), lines] + 2.0 * self.dw_acq, self.fsm.code_max, self.fsm.q)
            return self._budget_ok(codes)

        lines = self.declared.copy()
        shift = 0
        if self.policy == "cyclic":
            # PAT-1 - the next shift towards lower heater power is +1 (every ring one channel bluer) - try the declared map first, then the shifts in order of their total drive
            shifts = sorted(range(L), key=lambda s: (s != 0, float(np.sum(np.where(
                np.isfinite(cost[np.arange(N), (self.declared + s) % L]), cost[np.arange(N), (self.declared + s) % L],
                10.0)))))
            for s in shifts:
                candidate_lines = (self.declared + s) % L
                if feasible(candidate_lines):
                    lines, shift = candidate_lines, s
                    break
            else:
                # no shift fits the budget - the one with the least total drive (the supply sequencing of ACQUIRE then flags the rings that do not fit) rather than the declared map, which may be the costliest
                total_drives = [float(np.sum(cost[np.arange(N), (self.declared + s) % L])) for s in range(L)]
                if np.isfinite(min(total_drives)):
                    shift = int(np.argmin(total_drives))
                    lines = (self.declared + shift) % L
        elif self.policy == "any":
            from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
            c = np.where(np.isfinite(cost), cost, 1e3)
            r, col = linear_sum_assignment(c[:, :L])
            lines = np.full(N, -1, np.int64)
            lines[r] = col
        self.shift[b] = shift
        self.target_line[b] = lines
        self.assigned[b] = lines
        # a ring left without a line ('any' with more rings than lines - line -1) gets no target resonance either
        self.target_ev[b] = np.where(lines >= 0, event_indices[np.arange(N), np.clip(lines, 0, L - 1)], -1)

nodes.name: _start_ring
nodes.meaning: start the acquisition of ring n of element b in a window around its target resonance k.
comments: start the acquisition of ring n of element b in a window around its target resonance k.
extend the window half a local spacing on either side of the resonance drive, then add drift.
a fresh cold-start map uses zero drift.
an online barrel shift uses that ring's drift.
otherwise use median drift from the rings acquired so far.
with a factory table (warm start) the window reaches 0.75 of the spacing below and 0.35 above, since the rings acquired before this one heat it through the crosstalk (resonances come at lower drive).
from_zero drops to code zero, then searches upward.
under bistability, that approach matches the map's sweep from the blue side.
otherwise start half a spacing below the window.

source_ref.code:
def _start_ring(self, b, n, from_zero: bool = False) -> bool:
        acquisition = self.fsm
        k = int(self.target_ev[b, n])
        w, _, _, _ = self._ring_events(b, n)
        if k < 0 or k >= w.size:
            return False
        sp = np.diff(w)
        med = float(np.median(sp)) if sp.size else 0.05
        below = float(w[k] - w[k - 1]) if k >= 1 else med
        above = float(w[k + 1] - w[k]) if k + 1 < w.size else med
        dr = self.drift_ring[b, n]
        if self.fresh[b, n] and not self.retarget[b]:
            used = 0.0
        else:
            used = dr if np.isfinite(dr) else float(self.drift[b])
        self.drift_used[b, n] = used
        c = float(w[k] + used)
        lo_frac, hi_frac = (0.75, 0.35) if (self.table is not None and not self.retarget[b]) else\
            (self.params.window_frac, self.params.window_frac)
        lo = max(c - lo_frac * below, 0.0)
        hi = c + hi_frac * above
        mask = np.zeros((self.B, self.N), bool)
        mask[b, n] = True
        cur = float(acquisition.w[b, n])
        start = max(lo - 0.5 * below, 0.0)
        if from_zero:
            acquisition.start(mask, w_from=0.0, w_lo=lo, w_hi=hi)
        else:
            acquisition.start(mask, w_from=cur if start <= cur < lo else start, w_lo=lo, w_hi=hi)
        self.moved[b, n] = True
        self.acq_uncertain[b, n] = False
        return True

nodes.name: _verify_lock
nodes.meaning: check a fresh lock of ring n against its map (cold start) or table (warm start) - sets `acq_uncertain`.
comments: check a fresh lock of ring n against its map (cold start) or table (warm start) - sets `acq_uncertain`.
under common comb drift d, the target drive must equal w[k]+d.
the last passed resonance, RampFSM.sk_w, must equal w[k-1]+d.
allow d within 0.3 local spacings of the window's drift estimate.
a fresh map uses zero drift.
a ring can warm by a full channel spacing after its map on sampled g26 worlds.
then a neighbouring resonance can enter the target window.
the passed resonance moves away from w[k-1], even if the found resonance looks correct.
this distinguishes window-A pairs whose neighbours are only 1 nm apart.
Such a lock is not vouched for (telemetry line_confident 0).

only the resonances next to the target are compared - an up-search from w = 0 often sees one or two extra resonances at its start that the map did not (the start capture depends on the ring's temperature).

the window itself is not moved - on the near-periodic g26 pattern a drift of one spacing cannot be told from a start one resonance later (moving the window breaks worlds that the fixed window gets right).

source_ref.code:
def _verify_lock(self, b, n) -> None:
        acquisition = self.fsm
        k = int(self.target_ev[b, n])
        w, _, _, _ = self._ring_events(b, n)
        if k < 0 or k >= w.size or not np.isfinite(acquisition.w_event[b, n]):
            return
        sp = np.diff(w)
        med = float(np.median(sp)) if sp.size else 0.05
        below = float(w[k] - w[k - 1]) if k >= 1 else med
        above = float(w[k + 1] - w[k]) if k + 1 < w.size else med
        tol = 0.3 * min(below, above)
        used = float(self.drift_used[b, n])
        found_drive = float(acquisition.w_event[b, n])
        uncertain = abs(found_drive - w[k] - used) > tol
        passed_count = int(min(acquisition.sk_n[b, n], acquisition.sk_w.shape[2]))
        passed_drives = acquisition.sk_w[b, n, :passed_count]
        passed_drives = passed_drives[np.isfinite(passed_drives) & (passed_drives < found_drive)]
        if k >= 1 and passed_drives.size:
            s_last = float(passed_drives.max())
            self.drift_meas[b, n] = s_last - float(w[k - 1])
            uncertain |= abs(self.drift_meas[b, n] - used) > tol
        else:
            self.drift_meas[b, n] = found_drive - float(w[k])
        self.acq_uncertain[b, n] = bool(uncertain)

def _map_step(self, b, y):
        acquisition = self.fsm
        if self.cursor[b] >= self.N:
            self.phase[b] = PH_ASSIGN
            return
        n = self.order[self.cursor[b]]
        mask = np.zeros((self.B, self.N), bool)
        mask[b, n] = True
        if not self.busy[b]:
            acquisition.dw_up[b] = self.dw_map
            acquisition.start_map(mask, w_from=0.0, w_hi=self.params.map_w_max, n_events=self.L + 2)
            self.busy[b] = True
            return
        if acquisition.map_done[b, n] and acquisition.state[b, n] == ST_HOLD:
            k = self._take_map(b, n)
            # park between lines, approached from below - at the floor before the SECOND resonance.
            # the state at a drive below the first resonance depends on history (a line whose hot branch reaches w = 0 holds the ring after the heater drops), while the floor after the first resonance is reached on that line's far
            # red tail from any state at w = 0
            fw = self.ev_floor_w[b][n]
            park = float(fw[1]) if k >= 2 and np.isfinite(fw[1]) else 0.0
            acquisition.park_from_below(mask, park)
            self.moved[b, n] = True
            self.cursor[b] += 1
            self.busy[b] = False
            if self.cursor[b] >= self.N:
                self.phase[b] = PH_ASSIGN

comments: store ring n's map (drives, floor drives, heights above the floor) from the FSM - flag a ring that sat

def _take_map(self, b, n) -> int:
        acquisition = self.fsm
        k = int(min(acquisition.ev_n[b, n], acquisition.ev_w.shape[2]))
        w = acquisition.ev_w[b, n, :k].copy()
        o = np.argsort(w)
        self.events[b][n] = w[o]
        self.ev_floor_w[b][n] = acquisition.ev_wfloor[b, n, :k][o].copy()
        self.ev_height[b][n] = (acquisition.ev_y[b, n, :k] - acquisition.ev_floor[b, n, :k])[o].copy()
        self.map_events[b, n] = k
        ys = acquisition.y_start[b, n]
        hmed = float(np.median(self.ev_height[b][n])) if k else np.inf
        fl = float(np.nanmin(acquisition.ev_floor[b, n, :k])) if k else ys
        self.captured[b, n] |= bool(np.isfinite(ys) and ys - fl > 0.3 * hmed)
        return k

comments: label a just-measured ring map with the most specific trusted prior available.

def _label_fresh(self, b, n) -> None:
        grid = self.spec.line_grid_hz
        w = self.events[b][n]
        if grid is None or w.size < 3:
            self.labels[b][n] = np.full(w.size, -1, np.int64)
            self.map_ok[b, n] = False
            return
        bank = self.fits[b]
        fitted_events = drop_first([w], self.L)[0]
        reference_fit = None
        if bank is not None and bank[n].get("ok", False) and np.isfinite(bank[n].get("fsr_hz", np.nan)):
            reference_fit = (float(bank[n]["fsr_hz"]), float(bank[n].get("exponent", 1.0)), float(bank[n]["curvature"]))
        elif len(self.fresh_fits[b]) >= 2:
            previous_fits = np.array(self.fresh_fits[b])
            exponent = float(np.median(previous_fits[:, 1]))
            matching_exponent = previous_fits[previous_fits[:, 1] == exponent] if np.any(previous_fits[:,
                1] == exponent) else previous_fits
            reference_fit = (float(np.median(matching_exponent[:, 0])), exponent,
                float(np.median(matching_exponent[:, 2])))
        if reference_fit is not None:
            # narrowed around this world's confident fits - a fit on the narrow window's border is a guess, as on the prior's border (require_interior, the default)
            fsr, exponent, c = reference_fit
            fit = label_lines_by_pattern(fitted_events, grid, fsr_range_hz=(0.985 * fsr, 1.015 * fsr), n_fsr=61,
                                         curvature_range=(c - 0.15, c + 0.15), n_curv=13, exponents=(exponent,))
        else:
            fit = label_lines_by_pattern(fitted_events, grid, fsr_range_hz=fsr_prior_hz(self.d),
                exponents=self.exponents)
        if fit["ok"] and bank is None:
            self.fresh_fits[b].append((float(fit["fsr_hz"]), float(fit["exponent"]), float(fit["curvature"])))
        fit = with_first(fit, w, grid)
        self.labels[b][n] = np.asarray(fit["lines"], np.int64)
        self.map_ok[b, n] = bool(fit["ok"])
