nodes.name: bias_bank_step_row
nodes.meaning: bias bank
comments: bias bank
one plant tick of the bias DAC path for one world (ring.bias_dac), in the same event order as the heater.
register latch -> latency FIFO -> DAC transfer V = v_min + (v_max - v_min)*frac(code) -> + held DAC noise ->
slew (slew_v_per_s, V/s) -> settle (settle_tau_s) -> + v_offset (scenario bias_offset_v, additive) -> V_bias.
noise - noise_rms_codes (Nx,) is the rms in codes of this DAC, so V_n = noise_rms_codes*LSB*z with LSB = (v_max - v_min)/(2^bits - 1).
a new draw from z (N,) (standard normal, from the counter RNG of mrm/core/rng.py) is taken on ticks with tick % noise_period_ticks == 0 and held in between.
so its spectrum does not depend on dt when a finite update rate sets the period (with noise_period_ticks = 1 only its rms is dt-invariant).
z may be (N,) or (1,).
outputs (N,) - code_dac, v_target, out_v_avg (tick average, V), out_v_end (V).

@njit(cache=True)
def bias_bank_step_row(tick, cmd, cmd_valid,
                       reg, pending, has_pending, last_update, fifo, y_slew, y_out, noise_hold,
                       bits, bit_err, bow, v_min, v_max, latency_ticks, min_update_ticks,
                       noise_period_ticks, noise_rms_codes, z,
                       slew_v_per_s, settle_tau_s, dt, v_offset,
                       code_dac, v_target, out_v_avg, out_v_end):
    code_max = (1 << bits) - 1
    latch_row(cmd, cmd_valid, reg, pending, has_pending, last_update, tick, min_update_ticks, 0, code_max)
    fifo_row(reg, fifo, tick, latency_ticks, code_dac)
    bias_target_row(code_dac, bits, bit_err, bow, v_min, v_max, v_target)
    if tick % noise_period_ticks == 0:
        for n in range(noise_hold.shape[0]):
            lsb = (v_max[_bidx(v_max, n)] - v_min[_bidx(v_min, n)]) / code_max
            noise_hold[n] = noise_rms_codes[_bidx(noise_rms_codes, n)] * lsb * z[_bidx(z, n)]
    for n in range(v_target.shape[0]):
        v_target[n] = v_target[n] + noise_hold[n]
    slew_settle_row(v_target, y_slew, y_out, slew_v_per_s, settle_tau_s, dt, out_v_avg)
    for n in range(out_v_avg.shape[0]):
        off = v_offset[_bidx(v_offset, n)]
        out_v_avg[n] = out_v_avg[n] + off
        out_v_end[n] = y_out[n] + off

@njit(cache=True)
def _integ_lin(a, b, grid, col):
    sgn = 1.0
    if b < a:
        a, b = b, a
        sgn = -1.0
    total = 0.0
    g = grid.shape[0]
    # below the grid - hold col[0]
    if a < grid[0]:
        hi = b if b < grid[0] else grid[0]
        total += col[0] * (hi - a)
        a = hi
    # above the grid - hold col[-1]
    if b > grid[g - 1]:
        lo = a if a > grid[g - 1] else grid[g - 1]
        total += col[g - 1] * (b - lo)
        b = lo
    if b > a:
        j = np.searchsorted(grid, a, side="right") - 1
        if j < 0:
            j = 0
        x0 = a
        f0, _ = _interp_lin(x0, grid, col)
        while x0 < b:
            x1 = grid[j + 1] if j + 1 < g else b
            if x1 > b:
                x1 = b
            f1, _ = _interp_lin(x1, grid, col)
            total += 0.5 * (f0 + f1) * (x1 - x0)
            x0 = x1
            f0 = f1
            j += 1
    return sgn * total

nodes.name: junction_eval_row
nodes.meaning: Junction table lookup for one world, scaled to the ring (schema junction/1, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4).
comments: Junction table lookup for one world, scaled to the ring (schema junction/1, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4).
the table describes a junction over the full circumference, on a grid of reverse voltage (V, forward negative) - dneff (relative to 0 V), alpha_fca (1/m, absolute), c' (F/m), r_s' (ohm*m).
with fill fraction f and ring length L (m) the ring-level quantities are dneff_ring = f * dneff(V)       (round-trip phase 2*pi/lambda * [n_eff L + f L dneff(V)])
alpha_ring = f * alpha_fca(V)   (ring-averaged free-carrier loss, 1/m - it feeds Q_i(V) and the heat fraction eta(V) through the loss budget)
C_j        = f * L * c'(V)      (F)
R_s        = r_s'(V) / (f * L)  (ohm - the junction conducts in parallel along its length)
Linear interpolation - outside the grid the end value is held and FLAG_GRID_CLIP is set.
v, fill, length_m (Nx,) - outputs (N,).
Optional temperature axis - in the depletion approximation every column depends on V + V_bi.
so a drift of the built-in voltage is applied by evaluating at v + dV_bi/dT * (T_junction - T_ref).

dV_bi/dT comes from mrm.materials.dvbi_dt_v_per_k - about -1.1 to -1.2 mV/K at 1e17..1e18 cm^-3 (compact-model notes docs/research/03_mrm_compact_models.md, section 5.1 - the design critique quotes about -2 mV/K).
the caller adds that shift to v (and to both NRZ levels).

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def junction_eval_row(v, grid, dneff_col, alpha_col, c_col, rs_col, fill, length_m,
                      out_dneff, out_alpha, out_c_f, out_rs_ohm, out_flags):
    for n in range(out_dneff.shape[0]):
        voltage_v = v[_bidx(v, n)]
        fill_fraction = fill[_bidx(fill, n)]
        ring_length_m = length_m[_bidx(length_m, n)]
        # one bracket for the four columns - the same values as four _interp_lin calls
        grid_left, grid_weight, clipped = _interp_bracket(voltage_v, grid)
        index_change = _interp_at(voltage_v, grid_left, grid_weight, grid, dneff_col)
        loss_per_m = _interp_at(voltage_v, grid_left, grid_weight, grid, alpha_col)
        capacitance_per_m = _interp_at(voltage_v, grid_left, grid_weight, grid, c_col)
        series_resistance_ohm_m = _interp_at(voltage_v, grid_left, grid_weight, grid, rs_col)
        out_dneff[n] = fill_fraction * index_change
        out_alpha[n] = fill_fraction * loss_per_m
        out_c_f[n] = fill_fraction * ring_length_m * capacitance_per_m
        junction_length_m = fill_fraction * ring_length_m                       # junction length on the ring, m
        out_rs_ohm[n] = series_resistance_ohm_m / junction_length_m if junction_length_m > 0.0 else np.inf
        if clipped:
            out_flags[n] = out_flags[n] | FLAG_GRID_CLIP

nodes.name: data_activity_heat_row
nodes.meaning: data-activity heat
comments: data-activity heat
write junction and driver heat in W for one world.
junction heat is 0.5*C_eff*Vpp^2*bitrate*transition_density times R_s/(R_s + R_drv).
C_eff comes from junction_swing_capacitance_row.

driver heat is p_static_w + e_tr_j*bitrate*transition_density.
enable multiplies both outputs.
a squelched driver can stay enabled with zero data swing and still dissipate static power.
add_load_share also puts the R_drv share of charging loss in the driver output.
leave it off when e_tr_j already includes that load, to avoid counting it twice.
random NRZ has transition_density 0.5.
inputs have one entry per ring or one shared entry.
C_eff uses F, resistances ohm, e_tr_j J, p_static_w W, and bitrate_hz bits/s.
outputs have N entries.
source - compact-model notes, section 'heat sources in the ring'.

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def data_activity_heat_row(c_eff, swing_vpp, bitrate_hz, transition_density, enable, r_s, r_drv,
                           p_static_w, e_tr_j, add_load_share, out_pj, out_pd):
    for n in range(out_pj.shape[0]):
        driver_enabled = enable[_bidx(enable, n)]
        data_swing_v = swing_vpp[_bidx(swing_vpp, n)]
        transitions_per_bit = transition_density[_bidx(transition_density, n)]
        junction_resistance_ohm = r_s[_bidx(r_s, n)]
        driver_resistance_ohm = r_drv[_bidx(r_drv, n)]
        charging_power_w = 0.5 * c_eff[_bidx(c_eff, n)] * data_swing_v * data_swing_v * bitrate_hz * transitions_per_bit
        junction_heat_share = (
            junction_resistance_ohm / (junction_resistance_ohm + driver_resistance_ohm)
            if (junction_resistance_ohm + driver_resistance_ohm) > 0.0 else 1.0
        )
        if math.isinf(junction_resistance_ohm):
            junction_heat_share = 1.0
        out_pj[n] = driver_enabled * charging_power_w * junction_heat_share
        driver_power_w = p_static_w[_bidx(p_static_w, n)] + e_tr_j[_bidx(e_tr_j, n)] * bitrate_hz * transitions_per_bit
        if add_load_share != 0:
            driver_power_w += charging_power_w * (1.0 - junction_heat_share)
        out_pd[n] = driver_enabled * driver_power_w

        law_codes = np.array([DRIVER_LAWS[x] if isinstance(x, str) else int(x) for x in laws], dtype=np.int64)
        law_codes = _param_b(law_codes, B, "law", np.int64)
        if np.any((law_codes < 0) | (law_codes > 3)):
            raise ValueError("law must be one of voltage, current, power, dac_pwm")
        if not 1 <= bits <= 30:
            raise ValueError("bits must be in 1..30")
        if np.any(law_codes == LAW_DAC_PWM) and not 1 <= pwm_bits < bits:
            raise ValueError("dac_pwm needs 1 <= pwm_bits < bits")
        dt_clk = 1
        if pwm_ripple and np.any(law_codes == LAW_DAC_PWM):
            clk = pwm_period_s / (1 << pwm_bits)
            dt_clk = int(round(dt_s / clk))
            if dt_clk < 1 or abs(dt_clk * clk - dt_s) > 1e-6 * clk:
                raise ValueError(f"pwm_ripple needs dt ({dt_s} s) to be a whole number of PWM clocks ({clk} s)")
        lat = _param_b(_whole_ticks(latency_s, dt_s, "ring.heater.latency_s"), B, "latency_s", np.int64)
        depth = int(lat.max()) + 1
        if max_latency_s is not None:
            depth = max(depth, int(_whole_ticks(max_latency_s, dt_s, "max_latency_s").max()) + 1)
        min_upd = _update_period_ticks(dac_max_update_hz, dt_s, "ring.heater.dac_max_update_hz")
        n_dac = bits - pwm_bits if np.all(law_codes == LAW_DAC_PWM) else bits
        full = (1 << bits) - 1
        hi = full if code_max is None else int(code_max)
        if not 0 <= int(code_min) <= hi <= full:
            raise ValueError(f"need 0 <= code_min <= code_max <= {full}")
        v_fs = _param_bn(v_full_scale_v, B, N, "v_full_scale_v")
        i_fs = _param_bn(i_full_scale_a, B, N, "i_full_scale_a")
        p_fs = _param_bn(p_full_scale_w, B, N, "p_full_scale_w")
        _check_full_scales(law_codes, B, N, v_fs, i_fs, p_fs)
        r0 = _param_bn(r_cold_ohm, B, N, "r_cold_ohm")
        slew = _param_bn(np.asarray(slew_codes_per_s, dtype=np.float64) / full, B, N, "slew_codes_per_s")
        settle = _param_bn(settle_tau_s, B, N, "settle_tau_s")
        comp = _param_bn(compliance_v, B, N, "compliance_v")
        if not (np.all(r0 > 0) and np.all(slew > 0) and np.all(settle >= 0) and np.all(comp > 0)):
            raise ValueError("need r_cold_ohm > 0, slew_codes_per_s > 0, settle_tau_s >= 0, compliance_v > 0")
        if pwm_ripple and np.any(law_codes == LAW_DAC_PWM) and np.any(settle > 0):
            warnings.warn("pwm_ripple with settle_tau_s > 0: the PWM ripple term is added after the settle filter, "
                          "so it is not attenuated by it (the ripple is overestimated)", stacklevel=2)
        return cls(
            dt_s=float(dt_s), law=law_codes, bits=int(bits), pwm_bits=int(pwm_bits), pwm_ripple=int(bool(pwm_ripple)),
            dt_clk=dt_clk, code_lo=int(code_min), code_hi=hi,
            bit_err_lsb=_bit_err_param(bit_err_lsb, B, N, n_dac, "bit_err_lsb"),
            inl_bow_lsb=_param_bn(inl_bow_lsb, B, N, "inl_bow_lsb"), latency_ticks=lat, fifo_depth=depth,
            min_update_ticks=max(min_upd, 1), slew_u_per_s=slew, settle_tau_s=settle, r_cold_ohm=r0,
            tcr_per_k=_param_bn(tcr_per_k, B, N, "tcr_per_k"), tcr_ref_k=_param_bn(tcr_ref_k, B, N, "tcr_ref_k"),
            v_full_scale_v=v_fs, i_full_scale_a=i_fs, p_full_scale_w=p_fs, compliance_v=comp,
            supply_power_max_w=_param_b(supply_power_max_w, B, "supply_power_max_w"),
            supply_current_max_a=_param_b(supply_current_max_a, B, "supply_current_max_a"),
            B=int(B), N=int(N))

field map - law = heater.driver_mode (B,), bits = heater.dac_bits, pwm_bits / pwm_period_s =
heater.pwm_bits and pwm_period_s use PAT-2 defaults when absent.
flags.heater_pwm_ripple selects PWM ripple.
r_cold_ohm has shape (B,N), tcr_per_k uses 1/K, and tcr_ref_k is heater.r_ref_temp_k (K).
missing full-scale limits map from NaN to infinity - check the selected law's own full scale.
other limits are compliance_v, code_min, code_max, slew_codes_per_s, settle_tau_s, and supply limits.
dac_max_update_hz comes from heater.max_update_hz.
latency_s = (timing.heater_latency_ticks + the thermal transport delay in whole ticks) * dt.
the thermal
system holds one heater-to-ring transport delay per world (ThermalSystem.transport_delay_s - the uncertainty set spans 0 to 2 us).
the heater FIFO applies it, so that delay has one owner.
it is rounded to the nearest
tick (pass transport_delay=False to leave it out).
DAC errors - bit_err_lsb = dac_bit_errors_from_spec(dac_dnl_lsb, n, heater.dac_bit_err_z[..., :n]) with n = bits - pwm_bits for a dac_pwm world (the coarse DAC) and n = bits otherwise - inl_bow_lsb =
heater.inl_bow_u * dac_inl_lsb.
Keyword arguments override any `build` argument.

@classmethod
    def from_plant_params(cls, pp, *, transport_delay: bool = True, max_latency_s=None,
                          **overrides) -> "HeaterDriverParams":
        h, t = pp.heater, pp.timing
        B, N = int(pp.batch), int(pp.n_rings)
        dt = float(t.dt_s)
        law = np.asarray(h.driver_mode, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
        bits = int(h.dac_bits)
        pwm_bits = int(h.pwm_bits) if int(h.pwm_bits) > 0 else PAT2_PWM_BITS
        pwm_period = np.asarray(h.pwm_period_s, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
        pwm_period = float(pwm_period[np.isfinite(pwm_period)][0]) if np.any(np.isfinite(pwm_period)) \
            else PAT2_PWM_PERIOD_S
        lat = np.asarray(t.heater_latency_ticks, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
        sysm = getattr(pp.thermal, "system", None)
        td = getattr(sysm, "transport_delay_s", None) if sysm is not None else None
        if transport_delay and td is not None:
            lat = lat + np.rint(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(td, dtype=float).reshape(-1), (B,)) / dt).astype(np.int64)
        z = np.asarray(h.dac_bit_err_z, dtype=float)
        dnl = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(h.dac_dnl_lsb, dtype=float).reshape(-1), (B,))
        err = np.zeros((B, N, bits))
        for b in range(B):
            n_dac = bits - pwm_bits if law[b] == LAW_DAC_PWM else bits     # bits of the DAC that the law uses
            if dnl[b] > 0.0:
                err[b, :, :n_dac] = dac_bit_errors_from_spec(float(dnl[b]), n_dac, z[b, :, :n_dac])
        bow = np.asarray(h.inl_bow_u, dtype=float) * np.asarray(h.dac_inl_lsb, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)

        # a per-world full scale or limit as (B, 1), with nan (key absent) -> inf (no limit).
        def fs(x):
            x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)
            return np.where(np.isfinite(x), x, np.inf)
        kw = dict(law=law, bits=bits, pwm_bits=pwm_bits, pwm_period_s=pwm_period,
                  pwm_ripple=bool(pp.flags.heater_pwm_ripple), r_cold_ohm=np.asarray(h.r_cold_ohm, dtype=float),
                  tcr_per_k=np.asarray(h.tcr_per_k, dtype=float), tcr_ref_k=np.asarray(h.r_ref_temp_k, dtype=float),
                  v_full_scale_v=fs(h.full_scale_v), i_full_scale_a=fs(h.full_scale_a),
                  p_full_scale_w=fs(h.full_scale_w), compliance_v=fs(h.compliance_v), code_min=int(h.code_min),
                  code_max=int(h.code_max),
                  latency_s=lat * dt, max_latency_s=max_latency_s, dac_max_update_hz=float(h.max_update_hz),
                  slew_codes_per_s=np.asarray(h.slew_codes_per_s, dtype=float),
                  settle_tau_s=np.asarray(h.settle_tau_s, dtype=float), bit_err_lsb=err, inl_bow_lsb=bow,
                  supply_power_max_w=float(h.supply_power_max_w), supply_current_max_a=float(h.supply_current_max_a))
        kw.update(overrides)
        return cls.build(B, N, dt, **kw)

def __init__(self, params: HeaterDriverParams, initial_code=0):
        actuator_params = self.p = params
        n_worlds, n_rings = actuator_params.B, actuator_params.N
        initial_codes = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(initial_code, dtype=np.int64), (n_worlds, n_rings)).copy()
        initial_codes = np.clip(initial_codes, actuator_params.code_lo, actuator_params.code_hi)
        self.reg = initial_codes.copy()
        self.pending = initial_codes.copy()
        self.has_pending = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int8)
        self.last_update = np.full((n_worlds, n_rings), _NEVER, np.int64)
        self.fifo = np.repeat(initial_codes[:, :, None], actuator_params.fifo_depth, axis=2)
        initial_drive_fraction = np.empty((n_worlds, n_rings))
        initial_ripple = np.empty((n_worlds, n_rings))
        for b in range(n_worlds):
            heater_target_row(initial_codes[b], int(actuator_params.law[min(b, actuator_params.law.shape[0] - 1)]),
                actuator_params.bits, actuator_params.pwm_bits,
                              actuator_params.bit_err_lsb[min(b, actuator_params.bit_err_lsb.shape[0] - 1)],
                              actuator_params.inl_bow_lsb[min(b, actuator_params.inl_bow_lsb.shape[0] - 1)], 0, 0,
                                  1, initial_drive_fraction[b], initial_ripple[b])
        self.y_slew = initial_drive_fraction.copy()
        self.y_out = initial_drive_fraction.copy()
        self._code_dac = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int64)
        self._u_target = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._ripple = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._u_avg = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._p_w = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._v_v = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._i_a = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._r_ohm = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings))
        self._flags = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int8)
        self._scale = np.ones(n_worlds)
        self._no_cmd = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int64)      # the command arrays of a tick without a command
        self._no_valid = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.bool_)

def step(self, tick: int, cmd=None, cmd_valid=None, t_heater_pre_k=None, g_self_k_per_w=0.0,
             code_add=None) -> HeaterTickOut:
        params = self.p
        n_worlds, n_rings = params.B, params.N
        if cmd is None:
            command_codes, command_valid = self._no_cmd, self._no_valid
        else:
            command_codes = np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(cmd, dtype=np.int64), (n_worlds, n_rings)))
            command_valid = (np.ones((n_worlds, n_rings), np.bool_) if cmd_valid is None
                     else np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(cmd_valid, dtype=np.bool_), (n_worlds,
                         n_rings))))
        heater_temp_before_own_heat_k = (
            params.tcr_ref_k if t_heater_pre_k is None
            else _param_bn(t_heater_pre_k, n_worlds, n_rings, "t_heater_pre_k")
        )
        self_heating_gain_k_per_w = _param_bn(g_self_k_per_w, n_worlds, n_rings, "g_self_k_per_w")
        heater_bank_step(np.int64(tick), command_codes, command_valid, self.reg, self.pending, self.has_pending,
            self.last_update,
                         self.fifo, self.y_slew, self.y_out, params.law, params.bits, params.pwm_bits,
                             params.pwm_ripple, params.dt_clk,
                         params.bit_err_lsb, params.inl_bow_lsb, params.code_lo, params.code_hi,
                             params.latency_ticks, params.min_update_ticks,
                         params.slew_u_per_s,
                         params.settle_tau_s, params.dt_s, params.r_cold_ohm, params.tcr_per_k, params.tcr_ref_k,
                             params.v_full_scale_v,
                         params.i_full_scale_a, params.p_full_scale_w, params.compliance_v, params.supply_power_max_w,
                         params.supply_current_max_a, heater_temp_before_own_heat_k, self_heating_gain_k_per_w,
                             self._code_dac, self._u_target, self._ripple, self._u_avg,
                         self._p_w, self._v_v, self._i_a, self._r_ohm, self._flags, self._scale,
                         None if code_add is None else np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(
                             np.asarray(code_add, dtype=np.int64), (n_worlds, n_rings))))
        return HeaterTickOut(self._p_w, self._v_v, self._i_a, self._r_ohm, self._u_avg, self._code_dac, self.reg,
                             self._flags, self._scale)

              update_rate_hz=np.inf, latency_s=0.0, max_latency_s=None, slew_v_per_s=np.inf, settle_tau_s=0.0,
              noise_rms_codes=0.0, bit_err_lsb=None, inl_bow_lsb=0.0) -> "BiasDacParams":
        if not 1 <= int(bits) <= 30:
            raise ValueError("bias DAC bits must be in 1..30")
        lat = _param_b(_whole_ticks(latency_s, dt_s, "ring.bias_dac.latency_s"), B, "latency_s", np.int64)
        depth = int(lat.max()) + 1
        if max_latency_s is not None:
            depth = max(depth, int(_whole_ticks(max_latency_s, dt_s, "max_latency_s").max()) + 1)
        per = _update_period_ticks(update_rate_hz, dt_s, "ring.bias_dac.update_rate_hz")

def step(self, tick: int, cmd=None, cmd_valid=None, z=None, v_offset=None) -> BiasTickOut:
        params = self.p
        n_worlds, n_rings = params.B, params.N
        if cmd is None:
            command_codes, command_valid = self._no_cmd, self._no_valid
        else:
            command_codes = np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(cmd, dtype=np.int64), (n_worlds, n_rings)))
            command_valid = (np.ones((n_worlds, n_rings), np.bool_) if cmd_valid is None
                     else np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(cmd_valid, dtype=np.bool_), (n_worlds,
                         n_rings))))
        noise_draws = self._no_noise if z is None else np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(z,
            np.float64), (n_worlds, n_rings)))
        bias_offset_v = self._no_offset if v_offset is None else _param_bn(v_offset, n_worlds, n_rings, "v_offset")
        bias_bank_step(np.int64(tick), command_codes, command_valid, self.reg, self.pending, self.has_pending,
            self.last_update,
                       self.fifo, self.y_slew, self.y_out, self.noise_hold, params.bits, params.bit_err_lsb,
                           params.inl_bow_lsb,
                       params.v_min_v, params.v_max_v, params.latency_ticks, params.min_update_ticks,
                           params.noise_period_ticks,
                       params.noise_rms_codes, noise_draws, params.slew_v_per_s, params.settle_tau_s, params.dt_s,
                           bias_offset_v,
                       self._code_dac, self._v_target, self._v_avg, self._v_end)
        return BiasTickOut(self._v_avg, self._v_end, self._code_dac, self.reg)

def eval(self, v, fill, length_m):
        v2 = np.atleast_2d(np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64))
        B, N = v2.shape
        outs = [np.zeros((B, N)) for _ in range(4)]
        flags = np.zeros((B, N), np.int8)
        junction_eval(np.ascontiguousarray(v2), self.v_reverse_v, self.dneff, self.alpha_fca_per_m,
                      self.capacitance_f_per_m, self.r_series_ohm_m, _param_bn(fill, B, N, "fill"),
                      _param_bn(length_m, B, N, "length_m"), outs[0], outs[1], outs[2], outs[3], flags)
        return {"dneff": outs[0], "alpha_per_m": outs[1], "c_f": outs[2], "r_s_ohm": outs[3], "flags": flags}

nodes.name: depletion_shift_m
nodes.meaning: compute the resonance shift from the analytic depletion law.
comments: compute the resonance shift from the analytic depletion law.
input - v = V (V) - reverse bias, with forward bias negative
input - shift_amp_m = A (m/V^m) - shift coefficient despite the _m suffix
input - v_bi = V_bi (V) - built-in junction voltage
input - m = m (1) - depletion-law exponent
output - return = Delta_lambda_r (m) - positive for a red shift
Delta_lambda_r = A*((V+V_bi)^m-V_bi^m).
floor V+V_bi at 1e-6 V - the depletion model excludes forward conduction.
the configured exponent range is 1/3 to 1/2.
charge-control derivation gives m=1-m_C, or 1/2 to 2/3 - both conventions agree at 1/2.

nodes.name: analytic_junction_table
nodes.meaning: Analytic fallback table (method 'analytic') on the junction grid, for a full-circumference junction.
comments: Analytic fallback table (method 'analytic') on the junction grid, for a full-circumference junction.
dneff(V)   = (n_g/lambda) * dlambda(V)       with dlambda from depletion_shift_m (Delta lambda = lambda/n_g * dneff, full circumference - compact-model notes section 5.2)
C'(V)      = c0' * (1 + V/V_bi)^(-m_cap),     m_cap = 1 - m by default, so that dlambda/dV is proportional to C(V) (charge control, notes section 5.3)
alpha(V)   = alpha0 - (4 pi q/lambda) * dneff(V), floored at 0  (loss ratio q = lambda dalpha/(4 pi dn), notes section 5.4, q ~ 0.06 derived from Nedeljkovic 2011)
r_s'(V)    = r_series_ohm_m (constant)
shift_amp_m - A for the FULL circumference (a ring fit gives A_fit/fill).
units SI.
nodes.signature: analytic_junction_table(*, shift_amp_m: float, v_bi_v: float, m: float=0.5, lambda_m: float, n_g: float, c0_f_per_m: float, alpha0_per_m: float, loss_ratio_q: float, r_series_ohm_m: float, m_cap: float | None=None, v_grid=None)

source_ref.code:
def analytic_junction_table(*, shift_amp_m: float, v_bi_v: float, m: float = 0.5, lambda_m: float, n_g: float,
                            c0_f_per_m: float, alpha0_per_m: float, loss_ratio_q: float,
                            r_series_ohm_m: float, m_cap: float | None = None,
                            v_grid=None) -> JunctionTable:
    if not (1.0 / 3.0 - 1e-12 <= m <= 2.0 / 3.0 + 1e-12):
        raise ValueError("m must be in [1/3, 2/3] (contract [1/3, 1/2]; charge control [1/2, 2/3])")
    # 451 points = 10 mV spacing (design choice - linear-interpolation error of the sqrt law below 1e-4 relative)
    g = (np.linspace(JUNCTION_GRID_V_MIN, JUNCTION_GRID_V_MAX, 451) if v_grid is None
         else np.asarray(v_grid, dtype=np.float64))
    if np.any(g + v_bi_v <= 0.0):
        raise ValueError("grid reaches V <= -V_bi (forward conduction)")
    mc = 1.0 - m if m_cap is None else m_cap
    dl = shift_amp_m * ((g + v_bi_v) ** m - v_bi_v ** m)
    dneff = n_g / lambda_m * dl
    cap = c0_f_per_m * (1.0 + g / v_bi_v) ** (-mc)
    alpha = np.maximum(alpha0_per_m - 4.0 * np.pi * loss_ratio_q / lambda_m * dneff, 0.0)
    return JunctionTable(g, dneff, alpha, cap, np.full(g.shape, float(r_series_ohm_m)), method="analytic",
                         meta={"shift_amp_m": shift_amp_m, "v_bi_v": v_bi_v, "m": m, "m_cap": mc,
                               "lambda_m": lambda_m, "n_g": n_g, "loss_ratio_q": loss_ratio_q})

returns: JunctionTable(g, dneff, alpha, cap, np.full(g.shape, float(r_series_ohm_m)), method='analytic', meta={'shift_amp_m': shift_amp_m, 'v_bi_v': v_bi_v, 'm': m, 'm_cap': mc, 'lambda_m': lambda_m, 'n_g': n_g, 'loss_ratio_q': loss_ratio_q})

nodes.name: analytic_junction_table_from_ring
nodes.meaning: Analytic table from the ring-level schema keys (fidelity.junction_model = analytic - schema ring.junction.*).
comments: Analytic table from the ring-level schema keys (fidelity.junction_model = analytic - schema ring.junction.*).

the runtime scales the table by fill f and length L (junction_eval_row), so the full-circumference values are A_full   = eff0 * V_bi^(1 - m) / (m f)       from eff0 = d(dlambda)/dV at 0 V = A m V_bi^(m - 1) (ring)
c0'      = C_ring(0)/(f L),   r_s' = R_s,ring * f L,   alpha0_full = alpha_fca,ring(0 V)/f
and junction_eval_row reproduces eff0, C_ring(0), R_s,ring and alpha_fca,ring at 0 V exactly.

loss modulation - give loss_ratio_q (notes section 5.4 - 0.06 derived, range 0.03..0.15), or dqi_dv_frac_per_v with the ring's total intrinsic loss alpha_i_total_per_m, converted by dQi/Qi/dV = -d(alpha_ring)/dV / alpha_i and d(alpha_ring)/dV = -(4 pi q / lambda) (n_g/lambda) eff0  ->  q = dqi * alpha_i * lambda^2 / (4 pi n_g eff0).
units SI (eff0 in m/V, C in F, alpha in 1/m).
nodes.signature: analytic_junction_table_from_ring(*, eff_at_0v_m_per_v: float, v_bi_v: float, m: float, fill_fraction: float, ring_length_m: float, lambda_m: float, n_g: float, capacitance_at_0v_f: float, series_resistance_ohm: float, alpha_fca_ring_per_m: float, loss_ratio_q: float | None=None, dqi_dv_frac_per_v: float | None=None, alpha_i_total_per_m: float | None=None, m_cap: float | None=None, v_grid=None)

source_ref.code:
def analytic_junction_table_from_ring(*, eff_at_0v_m_per_v: float, v_bi_v: float, m: float, fill_fraction: float,
                                      ring_length_m: float, lambda_m: float, n_g: float, capacitance_at_0v_f: float,
                                      series_resistance_ohm: float, alpha_fca_ring_per_m: float,
                                      loss_ratio_q: float | None = None, dqi_dv_frac_per_v: float | None = None,
                                      alpha_i_total_per_m: float | None = None, m_cap: float | None = None,
                                      v_grid=None) -> JunctionTable:
    if not 0.0 < fill_fraction <= 1.0:
        raise ValueError("fill_fraction must be in (0, 1]")
    if loss_ratio_q is None:
        if dqi_dv_frac_per_v is None or alpha_i_total_per_m is None:
            raise ValueError("give loss_ratio_q, or dqi_dv_frac_per_v together with alpha_i_total_per_m")
        loss_ratio_q = dqi_dv_frac_per_v * alpha_i_total_per_m * lambda_m ** 2 / (4 * np.pi * n_g * eff_at_0v_m_per_v)
    fl = fill_fraction * ring_length_m
    return analytic_junction_table(
        shift_amp_m=eff_at_0v_m_per_v * v_bi_v ** (1.0 - m) / (m * fill_fraction), v_bi_v=v_bi_v, m=m,
        lambda_m=lambda_m, n_g=n_g, c0_f_per_m=capacitance_at_0v_f / fl,
        alpha0_per_m=alpha_fca_ring_per_m / fill_fraction, loss_ratio_q=float(loss_ratio_q),
        r_series_ohm_m=series_resistance_ohm * fl, m_cap=m_cap, v_grid=v_grid)

returns: analytic_junction_table(shift_amp_m=eff_at_0v_m_per_v * v_bi_v ** (1.0 - m) / (m * fill_fraction), v_bi_v=v_bi_v, m=m, lambda_m=lambda_m, n_g=n_g, c0_f_per_m=capacitance_at_0v_f / fl, alpha0_per_m=alpha_fca_ring_per_m / fill_fraction, loss_ratio_q=float(loss_ratio_q), r_series_ohm_m=series_resistance_ohm * fl, m_cap=m_cap, v_grid=v_grid)

nodes.name: junction_table_from_plant_params
nodes.meaning: the junction table the runtime uses (junction_eval_row), built from PlantParams.junction and optics.
comments: the junction table the runtime uses (junction_eval_row), built from PlantParams.junction and optics.
LUT mode (fidelity.junction_model = lut) - the artefact table of the cross-section, one row (Bt = 1).
Analytic mode - one full-circumference table per world (Bt = B) from `analytic_junction_table_from_ring` with the world's ring values.
the table holds the carrier-induced index change dneff(V) of the junction, which does not depend on the ring's wavelength.
eff_at_0v (a resonance shift per volt, measured on G25) is converted with the bank-mean lambda_res_cold / n_g.
so a ring at another line shifts by (lambda/n_g)_ring / (lambda/n_g)_mean x eff_at_0v (about +-0.6 % across a 2.8 THz bank).
alpha_fca_per_m (from realize - the ring FCA at the reference bias bias_ref_v) is moved to its 0 V value
through the loss law alpha(V) = alpha(0) - (4 pi q/lambda) dneff(V).
Without a loss budget (alpha_fca nan)
the table has no FCA and no loss modulation.
q is junction.loss_ratio_q, else derived from dqi_dv_frac_per_v with alpha_i, else 0.
the per-length capacitance c' = C/(f L) and r_s' = R_s f L use the world's mean over the rings.
the ring
length L varies slightly with the sampled n_g at a fixed FSR, so ring k then gets C = c' f L_k, proportional
to its length - the physics of a junction along the ring.
raises if eff_at_0v / fill or fill differ between the rings of a world beyond `rtol`, or c', r_s' by more than 1 % - a per-world table cannot hold per-ring junction physics (no preset varies them).

def junction_table_from_plant_params(pp, *, rtol: float = 1e-9) -> JunctionTable:
    j, o = pp.junction, pp.optics
    if int(j.model) == 1:
        return JunctionTable(np.asarray(j.lut_v_reverse_v, float), np.asarray(j.lut_dneff, float)[None],
                             np.asarray(j.lut_alpha_fca_per_m, float)[None],
                             np.asarray(j.lut_capacitance_f_per_m, float)[None],
                             np.asarray(j.lut_r_series_ohm_m, float)[None], method="lut")
    B = int(pp.batch)

    # the per-world mean of x over the rings - raises if a ring differs from it by more than tol (relative).
    def uniform(name, x, tol=rtol):
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
        x2 = x.reshape(x.shape[0], -1)
        ref = np.mean(x2, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        if np.any(np.abs(x2 - ref) > tol * np.maximum(np.abs(ref), 1e-300)):
            raise ValueError(f"junction_table_from_plant_params: {name} differs between the rings of a world; the "
                             f"per-world junction table cannot represent it")
        return ref[:, 0]
    fill = uniform("fill_fraction", j.fill_fraction)
    eff_per_fill = uniform("eff_at_0v / fill", np.asarray(j.eff_at_0v_m_per_v) / np.asarray(j.fill_fraction))
    length = np.asarray(o.length_m, float)
    c_per_len = uniform("capacitance / (fill length)", np.asarray(j.capacitance_at_0v_f) / (j.fill_fraction * length),
                        1e-2)
    rs_len = uniform("series resistance * fill length", np.asarray(j.series_resistance_ohm) * j.fill_fraction * length,
                     1e-2)
    vbi = np.asarray(j.v_bi_v, float).reshape(-1)
    m = np.asarray(j.depletion_exponent, float).reshape(-1)
    v_ref = np.asarray(o.bias_ref_v, float).reshape(-1)
    lam = np.mean(np.asarray(o.lambda_res_cold_m, float), axis=1)
    ng = np.mean(np.asarray(o.n_g, float), axis=1)
    a_fca = np.asarray(o.alpha_fca_per_m, float)
    q_given = np.asarray(j.loss_ratio_q, float).reshape(-1)
    dqi = np.asarray(j.dqi_dv_frac_per_v, float)
    rows = []
    for b in range(B):
        f, L1 = float(fill[b]), 1.0     # tables are per unit length - c' = C/(f L), r_s' = R_s f L
        a_full = eff_per_fill[b] * vbi[b] ** (1.0 - m[b]) / m[b]          # A_full = eff0 V_bi^(1-m)/(m f)
        if np.isfinite(q_given[b]):
            q = float(q_given[b])
        elif np.any(dqi[b] != 0.0) and np.all(np.isfinite(a_fca[b])):
            eff0 = eff_per_fill[b] * f
            q = float(np.mean(dqi[b]) * np.mean(np.asarray(o.alpha_i_per_m)[b]) * lam[b] ** 2
                      / (4.0 * np.pi * ng[b] * eff0))
        else:
            q = 0.0
        alpha_ref = float(np.mean(a_fca[b])) if np.all(np.isfinite(a_fca[b])) else 0.0
        # alpha_full(0) from the ring FCA at the reference bias - alpha(V) = alpha(0) - (4 pi q/lambda) dneff(V)
        dneff_ref = ng[b] / lam[b] * a_full * ((v_ref[b] + vbi[b]) ** m[b] - vbi[b] ** m[b])
        alpha0_full = alpha_ref / f + 4.0 * np.pi * q / lam[b] * dneff_ref
        rows.append(analytic_junction_table(
            shift_amp_m=float(a_full), v_bi_v=float(vbi[b]), m=float(m[b]), lambda_m=float(lam[b]), n_g=float(ng[b]),
            c0_f_per_m=float(c_per_len[b]) * L1, alpha0_per_m=float(alpha0_full), loss_ratio_q=q,
            r_series_ohm_m=float(rs_len[b])))
    g = rows[0].v_reverse_v
    return JunctionTable(g, np.stack([r.dneff[0] for r in rows]), np.stack([r.alpha_fca_per_m[0] for r in rows]),
                         np.stack([r.capacitance_f_per_m[0] for r in rows]),
                         np.stack([r.r_series_ohm_m[0] for r in rows]), method="analytic",
                         meta={"rows": "per world", "source": "PlantParams.junction (analytic)"})

returns: JunctionTable(g, np.stack([r.dneff[0] for r in rows]), np.stack([r.alpha_fca_per_m[0] for r in rows]), np.stack([r.capacitance_f_per_m[0] for r in rows]), np.stack([r.r_series_ohm_m[0] for r in rows]), method='analytic', meta={'rows': 'per world', 'source': 'PlantParams.junction (analytic)'})

JunctionTable(np.asarray(j.lut_v_reverse_v, float), np.asarray(j.lut_dneff, float)[None], np.asarray(j.lut_alpha_fca_per_m, float)[None], np.asarray(j.lut_capacitance_f_per_m, float)[None], np.asarray(j.lut_r_series_ohm_m, float)[None], method='lut')

def heater_steady_state(code=None, *, law="voltage", drive_frac=None, bits: int = 16, pwm_bits: int = PAT2_PWM_BITS,
                        v_full_scale_v=np.inf, i_full_scale_a=np.inf, p_full_scale_w=np.inf, compliance_v=np.inf,
                        r_cold_ohm, tcr_per_k, r_th_heater_k_per_w, t_base_minus_ref_k=0.0,
                        bit_err_lsb=None, inl_bow_lsb=0.0) -> dict:
    law_c = DRIVER_LAWS[law] if isinstance(law, str) else int(law)
    _check_full_scales(np.array([law_c]), 1, 1, np.atleast_2d(np.asarray(v_full_scale_v, float)),
                       np.atleast_2d(np.asarray(i_full_scale_a, float)),
                       np.atleast_2d(np.asarray(p_full_scale_w, float)))
    if drive_frac is None:
        c = np.asarray(code, dtype=np.int64)
        shape = c.shape
        flat = np.ascontiguousarray(c.reshape(-1))
        u = np.empty(flat.size)
        rip = np.empty(flat.size)
        nd = bits - pwm_bits if law_c == LAW_DAC_PWM else bits
        be = _bit_err_param(bit_err_lsb, 1, 1, nd, "bit_err_lsb")[0]
        heater_target_row(flat, law_c, bits, pwm_bits, be, np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(inl_bow_lsb, float)), 0, 0, 1,
                          u, rip)
    else:
        u = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(drive_frac, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1))
        shape = np.shape(drive_frac)
    M = u.size

    # x broadcast to the flat (M,) operating points.
    def row(x):
        return np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64), (M,)))

    outs = [np.zeros(M) for _ in range(4)]
    flags = np.zeros(M, np.int8)
    heater_power_row(u, law_c, row(t_base_minus_ref_k), row(r_th_heater_k_per_w), row(r_cold_ohm), row(tcr_per_k),
                     np.zeros(1), row(v_full_scale_v), row(i_full_scale_a), row(p_full_scale_w), row(compliance_v),
                     outs[0], outs[1], outs[2], outs[3], flags)
    return {"p_w": outs[0].reshape(shape), "v_v": outs[1].reshape(shape), "i_a": outs[2].reshape(shape),
            "r_ohm": outs[3].reshape(shape), "u": u.reshape(shape), "flags": flags.reshape(shape)}

returns: {'p_w': outs[0].reshape(shape), 'v_v': outs[1].reshape(shape), 'i_a': outs[2].reshape(shape), 'r_ohm': outs[3].reshape(shape), 'u': u.reshape(shape), 'flags': flags.reshape(shape)}

nodes.name: electrothermal_loop_gain
nodes.meaning: compute the heater's small-signal electrothermal loop gain.
comments: compute the heater's small-signal electrothermal loop gain.
input - law (1) - voltage, current, dac_pwm, or regulated-power drive selector
input - p_w = P_H (W) - heater power
input - tcr_per_k = alpha (1/K) - resistance temperature coefficient
input - r_th_heater_k_per_w = R_th,H (K/W) - heater-to-heater thermal resistance
input - t_heater_minus_ref_k = T_H-T_0 (K) - optional heater temperature rise
output - return = L (1), with L = (dP_H/dT_H)*R_th,H
when no temperature rise is supplied, use R_th,H*P_H.
current drive gives L=alpha*R_th,H*P_H/(1+alpha*(T_H-T_0)).
voltage and dac_pwm give the negative of that value, and regulated power gives zero.
the closed-loop static gain multiplier is 1/(1-L).
with current drive and self-heating alone, that multiplier is exactly 1+alpha*R_th,H*P_H.

nodes.name: pwm_ripple_pp_k
nodes.meaning: compute steady peak-to-peak temperature ripple from a PWM power waveform.
comments: compute steady peak-to-peak temperature ripple from a PWM power waveform.
input - delta_p_w = Delta_P (W) - power difference between the two PWM levels
input - duty = D (1) - high-level duty fraction
input - period_s = T_PWM (s) - PWM period
input - residues_k_per_w = r_j (K/W) - Foster-network thermal residues
input - taus_s = tau_j (s) - thermal time constants
output - return = Delta_T_pp (K) - total peak-to-peak temperature ripple
each pole contributes r_j*Delta_P*(1-exp(-D*T_PWM/tau_j))*(1-exp(-(1-D)*T_PWM/tau_j))/(1-exp(-T_PWM/tau_j)).
for positive residues, all poles peak at the falling edge, so their ripples add.
compare the thermal time constants with the PAT-2 period of 2.56 us.

source_ref.code:
def pwm_ripple_pp_k(delta_p_w, duty, period_s, residues_k_per_w, taus_s):
    r = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(residues_k_per_w, float))
    tau = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(taus_s, float))
    D = float(duty)
    T = float(period_s)
    pp = r * (-np.expm1(-D * T / tau)) * (-np.expm1(-(1 - D) * T / tau)) / (-np.expm1(-T / tau))
    return float(delta_p_w) * float(np.sum(pp))

nodes.name: dac_bit_errors_from_spec
nodes.meaning: convert standard-normal mismatch draws to DAC bit-weight errors in LSB.
comments: convert standard-normal mismatch draws to DAC bit-weight errors in LSB.
bit i sums 2^i independent unit elements, so its error standard deviation grows as sqrt(2^i).
choose unit-element sigma = dnl_sigma_lsb/sqrt(2^n_bits - 1).
the major mid-scale carry then has DNL standard deviation dnl_sigma_lsb.
z has shape (..., n_bits), from the counter RNG's variation stream.

nodes.name: dac_transfer_curve
nodes.meaning: return the full transfer fraction, endpoint INL in LSB, and DNL in LSB.
comments: return the full transfer fraction, endpoint INL in LSB, and DNL in LSB.
fraction and INL have 2^n_bits entries.
DNL has one fewer entry.
evaluate up to 12 bits with dac_frac.
for wider DACs, use the same binary-weight formula in vectorized form.

source_ref.code:
def dac_transfer_curve(n_bits: int, bit_err_lsb=None, inl_bow_lsb: float = 0.0):
    codes = np.arange(1 << n_bits, dtype=np.int64)
    bit_errors_lsb = np.zeros(n_bits) if bit_err_lsb is None else np.asarray(bit_err_lsb, float)
    fractions = (
        np.array([dac_frac(int(c), n_bits, bit_errors_lsb, float(inl_bow_lsb)) for c in codes])
        if n_bits <= 12 else None
    )
    if fractions is None:  # vectorized path for wide DACs
        bit_weights = 2.0 ** np.arange(n_bits) + bit_errors_lsb
        active_bits = ((codes[:, None] >> np.arange(n_bits)[None, :]) & 1).astype(np.float64)
        ideal_fractions = codes / ((1 << n_bits) - 1)
        fractions = (
            active_bits @ bit_weights + inl_bow_lsb * 4 * ideal_fractions * (1 - ideal_fractions)
        ) / bit_weights.sum()
    full_scale_code = (1 << n_bits) - 1
    output_codes = fractions * full_scale_code
    inl_lsb = output_codes - codes
    dnl_lsb = np.diff(output_codes) - 1.0
    return fractions, inl_lsb, dnl_lsb

def data_activity_heat_w(c_eff_f, swing_vpp, bitrate_hz, transition_density, r_s_ohm, r_drv_ohm,
                         p_static_w=0.0, e_tr_j=0.0, enable=1.0, add_load_share=False):
    broadcast_inputs = np.broadcast_arrays(*[np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64) for x in
                                 (c_eff_f, swing_vpp, transition_density, enable, r_s_ohm, r_drv_ohm, p_static_w,
                                  e_tr_j)])
    shape = broadcast_inputs[0].shape
    flat_inputs = [np.ascontiguousarray(a.reshape(-1)) for a in broadcast_inputs]
    junction_power_w = np.zeros(flat_inputs[0].size)
    driver_power_w = np.zeros(flat_inputs[0].size)
    data_activity_heat_row(flat_inputs[0], flat_inputs[1], float(bitrate_hz), flat_inputs[2], flat_inputs[3],
        flat_inputs[4], flat_inputs[5], flat_inputs[6], flat_inputs[7],
                           int(bool(add_load_share)), junction_power_w, driver_power_w)
    return junction_power_w.reshape(shape), driver_power_w.reshape(shape)

def __init__(self, maps: ChannelMaps, batch: int, n_rings: int, n_lines: int, latency_ticks: int,
                 period_ticks: int, *, assign0=None, init_heater=0, init_bias=0):
        self.maps = maps
        B, N, L = int(batch), int(n_rings), int(n_lines)
        self.B, self.N, self.L = B, N, L
        self.latency_ticks = int(latency_ticks)
        cap = pipe_capacity(latency_ticks, period_ticks)
        self.vals = np.zeros((B, cap, max(maps.act_size, 1)), np.int64)
        self.ticks = np.zeros((B, cap), np.int64)
        self.meta = np.zeros((B, 2), np.int64)
        self.act = np.tile(maps.act_init, (B, 1)) if maps.act_size else np.zeros((B, 1), np.int64)
        self.sat = np.zeros_like(self.act)
        self.assign = (np.full((B, N), -1, np.int64) if assign0 is None
                       else np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(assign0, np.int64), (B, N)).copy())
        self.bs_thr = np.zeros((B, N), np.int64)
        self.pga = np.zeros((B, N), np.int64)
        self.tune = np.zeros((B, L), np.int64)
        for i in range(maps.act_map.shape[0]):           # registers start at the channel init values
            row = maps.act_map[i]
            dst, o, sz = int(row[AM_DST]), int(row[AM_OFFSET]), int(row[AM_SIZE])
            if dst == DST_HEATER:
                self.act[:, o:o + sz] = init_heater
            elif dst == DST_BIAS:
                self.act[:, o:o + sz] = init_bias
        self._scratch = np.zeros_like(self.act[0])

def pop(self, tick: int):
        n_worlds, n_rings = self.B, self.N
        heater_codes = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int64)
        heater_valid = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.bool_)
        bias_codes = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.int64)
        bias_valid = np.zeros((n_worlds, n_rings), np.bool_)
        popped = np.zeros(n_worlds, np.bool_)
        for b in range(n_worlds):
            if pipe_pop_row(self.vals[b], self.ticks[b], self.meta[b], np.int64(tick), self._scratch):
                popped[b] = True
                apply_act_row(self._scratch, self.maps.act_map, heater_codes[b], heater_valid[b], bias_codes[b],
                    bias_valid[b], self.assign[b],
                              self.bs_thr[b], self.pga[b], self.tune[b])
        return heater_codes, heater_valid, bias_codes, bias_valid, popped

def release(self, now: int, *, heater_applied, bias_applied, bitstat=None) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
        sensors, new = self.monitor.channels(self.monitor.release(now))
        for bank in (self.temps, self.readback):
            if bank is not None:
                bank_sensors, bank_new_flags = bank.release(now)
                sensors.update(bank_sensors)
                new.update(bank_new_flags)
        if self.datapath is not None:
            if bitstat is not None:
                bitstat()
            bank_sensors, bank_new_flags = self.datapath.release(now)
            sensors.update(bank_sensors)
            new.update(bank_new_flags)
        n_worlds, n_rings = heater_applied.shape
        sensors["tx.heater.applied"] = np.asarray(heater_applied)
        sensors["tx.bias.applied"] = np.asarray(bias_applied)
        new["tx.heater.applied"] = np.ones((n_worlds, n_rings), bool)
        new["tx.bias.applied"] = np.ones((n_worlds, n_rings), bool)
        return sensors, new

source_ref.code:
def g26_line_table(*, center_m: float = G26_CENTER_M, spacing_hz: float = G26_SPACING_HZ,
                   offset_hz: float = G26_OFFSET_HZ, n_per_direction: int = G26_LINES_PER_DIRECTION,
                   tx_slot: int = 0, tx_laser: str = "local", rx_laser: str = "remote") -> LineTable:

    lines_per_direction = int(n_per_direction)
    if lines_per_direction < 1 or tx_slot not in (0, 1):
        raise ValueError("need n_per_direction >= 1 and tx_slot in {0, 1}")
    center_frequency_hz = C0 / center_m
    # set A at fc + (j - (n-1)/2) spacing - offset/2, set B = set A + offset - the 2n lines are centred at fc
    first_grid_hz = (
        center_frequency_hz + (np.arange(lines_per_direction) - (lines_per_direction - 1) / 2.0) * spacing_hz
        - offset_hz / 2.0
    )
    frequencies_hz = np.concatenate([first_grid_hz, first_grid_hz + offset_hz])
    grid_slot = np.concatenate([np.zeros(lines_per_direction, np.int64), np.ones(lines_per_direction, np.int64)])
    order = np.argsort(frequencies_hz)
    frequencies_hz, grid_slot = frequencies_hz[order], grid_slot[order]
    direction = np.where(grid_slot == tx_slot, DIR_TX, DIR_RX)
    source = np.where(direction == DIR_TX, 0, 1)
    return LineTable(frequencies_hz, direction, source, np.zeros(2 * lines_per_direction, np.int64), (tx_laser,
        rx_laser))

returns: LineTable(frequencies_hz, direction, source, np.zeros(2 * lines_per_direction, np.int64), (tx_laser, rx_laser))

nodes.name: levy_bm
nodes.meaning: kernels
comments: kernels
Standard Brownian motion W(j) (unit variance per unit time) at integer j in [0, 2^depth].
Levy midpoint construction - W(2^depth) = sqrt(2^depth) z_0, and the midpoint m of a dyadic interval [a, b] (heap id h, root 1) is (W(a) + W(b))/2 + sqrt((b - a)/4) z_h.
z are counter-RNG normals keyed by (ring, tick = node id, slot).
so W(j) is a pure function of j - the same path whatever order or step it is evaluated in.
Cost - up to depth + 1 normals (the endpoint, then one per level of the binary search for j).
returns: wa if j == a else wb

nodes.name: laser_tick_row
nodes.meaning: Frequency (Hz) and power (W) of the L lines of one world over plant interval [k, k+1) .
comments: Frequency (Hz) and power (W) of the L lines of one world over plant interval [k, k+1) .
f0, p0 (L,) - static frequency (grid + static error, Hz) and nominal power at the module output (W).

f_rate (Hz/s), p_rate (1/s) - linear drift - f_rw (Hz/sqrt(s)), p_rw (1/sqrt(s)) - random-walk coefficients - rho_f, rho_p - shared variance fraction per module - module (L,) int64 source laser, n_mod modules.
tcomp - time compression, grid_s - Brownian grid period G (scenario s), depth - Levy depth.
rin_per_hz - one-sided RIN (1/Hz - 0 = off).
enable (L,) bool (laser.line_enable), f_offset (L,) Hz and p_scale (L,) scenario steps (failover), tune_hz (L,) laser.tune offset.
Cache - cache_j (1,) int64 (grid index held in w_lo, -1 = empty), w_lo / w_hi (2, L + n_mod) the Brownian values at grid j and j + 1 (pure functions of j, so the cache never changes results).
Line l comes from laser module m = source_laser[l].
at scenario time t_s = (k + 1/2) dt c, with c = scenario.time_compression -
f_l = f0_l + r_f,l t_s + D_f,l sqrt(G) [sqrt(rho_f) W_m^f(t_s/G) + sqrt(1 - rho_f) W_l^f(t_s/G)]
+ f_offset_l + tune_l
P_l = p0_l max(0, 1 + r_p,l t_s + D_p,l sqrt(G) [sqrt(rho_p) W_m^p + sqrt(1 - rho_p) W_l^p])
p_scale_l * max(0, 1 + sqrt(RIN/(2 dt)) z_{l,k}) * enable_l
f0 = grid + static error (realize puts laser.line_offset_ghz there - `draw_static_error_hz` draws one).
r_f (Hz/s), r_p (1/s) - linear drift rates - D_f (Hz/sqrt(s)), D_p (1/sqrt(s)) - random-walk coefficients.

W are standard Brownian motions on a grid of period G (scenario seconds), built by the Levy midpoint construction from counter-RNG draws keyed by the dyadic node, and linearly interpolated between grid points.
the value at any tick is a pure function of (seed, line, tick) - it does not depend on how the run was stepped (multi-tick stepping, quasi-static jumps), on the batch or on the thread count.
rho is the variance fraction shared by the lines of one module (a correlated common-mode offset from one laser module - an option).
RIN - z_{l,k} is the tick average of white relative intensity noise with one-sided PSD RIN (1/Hz) -
Var = RIN/(2 dt), the exact average of white noise over one tick, so window averages are dt-invariant.
RIN is independent between lines (assumed - mode-partition correlations are not modelled).
Time compression (scenario.time_compression = c - slow exogenous signals run c times faster, so a long scenario fits a short run) applies to the drift only (a slow exogenous signal), never to RIN.
nodes.signature: laser_tick_row(k, dt_s, tcomp, grid_s, depth, f0, p0, f_rate, p_rate, f_rw, p_rw, rho_f, rho_p, module, n_mod, rin_per_hz, enable, f_offset, p_scale, tune_hz, key_drift, key_rin, cache_j, w_lo, w_hi, out_f, out_p)

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False, inline="always")
def laser_tick_row(k, dt_s, tcomp, grid_s, depth, f0, p0, f_rate, p_rate, f_rw, p_rw, rho_f, rho_p, module, n_mod,
                   rin_per_hz, enable, f_offset, p_scale, tune_hz, key_drift, key_rin, cache_j, w_lo, w_hi,
                   out_f, out_p):
    n_lines = f0.shape[0]
    t = (k + 0.5) * dt_s * tcomp                 # scenario time at the middle of the tick, s
    t_grid = t / grid_s                          # the same time in Brownian grid periods
    j = np.int64(math.floor(t_grid))
    frac = t_grid - j                            # linear-interpolation weight between nodes j and j + 1
    if cache_j[0] != j:
        if cache_j[0] >= 0 and cache_j[0] + 1 == j:   # the next grid interval - node j is the old node j + 1
            for s in range(2):
                for i in range(n_lines + n_mod):
                    w_lo[s, i] = w_hi[s, i]
        else:
            _fill_brownian_nodes(key_drift, j, depth, n_lines, n_mod, w_lo)
        _fill_brownian_nodes(key_drift, j + 1, depth, n_lines, n_mod, w_hi)
        cache_j[0] = j
    sqrt_grid = math.sqrt(grid_s)
    wf_common = math.sqrt(rho_f)                 # weights of the module (common) and line parts of the walk
    wf_line = math.sqrt(1.0 - rho_f)
    wp_common = math.sqrt(rho_p)
    wp_line = math.sqrt(1.0 - rho_p)
    sd_rin = math.sqrt(0.5 * rin_per_hz / dt_s) if rin_per_hz > 0.0 else 0.0   # rms of the tick-average RIN
    z_next = 0.0
    for l in range(n_lines):
        m = n_lines + module[l]                  # Brownian index of the line's module
        w_line_f = w_lo[_SLOT_FREQ, l] + frac * (w_hi[_SLOT_FREQ, l] - w_lo[_SLOT_FREQ, l])
        w_mod_f = w_lo[_SLOT_FREQ, m] + frac * (w_hi[_SLOT_FREQ, m] - w_lo[_SLOT_FREQ, m])
        w_line_p = w_lo[_SLOT_POWER, l] + frac * (w_hi[_SLOT_POWER, l] - w_lo[_SLOT_POWER, l])
        w_mod_p = w_lo[_SLOT_POWER, m] + frac * (w_hi[_SLOT_POWER, m] - w_lo[_SLOT_POWER, m])
        out_f[l] = (f0[l] + f_rate[l] * t + f_rw[l] * sqrt_grid * (wf_common * w_mod_f + wf_line * w_line_f)
                    + f_offset[l] + tune_hz[l])
        p_drift_factor = 1.0 + p_rate[l] * t + p_rw[l] * sqrt_grid * (wp_common * w_mod_p + wp_line * w_line_p)
        if p_drift_factor < 0.0:
            p_drift_factor = 0.0
        rin_factor = 1.0
        if sd_rin > 0.0:
            if l % 2 == 0:                      # one Box-Muller pair per two lines (ring word = line pair l // 2)
                z, z_next = rng.normal2(key_rin, l >> 1, k, _SLOT_RIN)
            else:
                z = z_next
            rin_factor = 1.0 + sd_rin * z
            if rin_factor < 0.0:
                rin_factor = 0.0
        p_step = p_scale[l] if p_scale[l] > 0.0 else 0.0     # optical power cannot go negative
        out_p[l] = p0[l] * p_drift_factor * p_step * rin_factor if enable[l] else 0.0

def _device_uniforms(device_seeds, lines: LineTable, tag: int, slot: int) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    seeds = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(device_seeds, dtype=np.int64))
    n_worlds, n_lines, n_modules = seeds.size, lines.n_lines, lines.n_lasers
    keys = _keys(seeds, n_worlds, rng.Stream.VARIATION)
    line_draws = np.array([[rng.uniform(keys[b], l, tag, slot) for l in range(n_lines)] for b in range(n_worlds)])
    module_draws = np.array([[rng.uniform(keys[b], n_lines + m, tag,
        slot) for m in range(n_modules)] for b in range(n_worlds)])
    return line_draws, module_draws

@classmethod
    def from_plant_params(cls, pp, lines: LineTable | None = None, **kw) -> "LaserHw":
        laser_params = pp.laser
        lines = LineTable.from_plant_params(pp) if lines is None else lines
        B = int(pp.batch)
        realized_frequencies_hz = np.asarray(laser_params.line_freq_hz, dtype=float)
        static_offsets_hz = realized_frequencies_hz - lines.freq_hz[None, :]
        tune_lsb_hz = pp.values.get("laser.tune.lsb_hz") if hasattr(pp, "values") else None
        settings = dict(power_w=np.asarray(laser_params.power_w, dtype=float), static_error_hz=static_offsets_hz,
                    rin_per_hz=np.asarray(laser_params.rin_per_hz, dtype=float).reshape(-1),
                    tune_lsb_hz=float(np.asarray(tune_lsb_hz).reshape(-1)[0]) if tune_lsb_hz is not None else 0.0)
        settings.update(kw)
        return cls.build(B, float(pp.timing.dt_s), lines, **settings)

def tick(self, k: int, enable=None, f_offset_hz=None, p_scale=None, tune_codes=None, parallel: bool = False
             ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        hw = self.hw
        B, L = hw.B, hw.L
        frequency_offset_hz = self._zero if f_offset_hz is None else _arr_bl(f_offset_hz, B, L, "f_offset_hz")
        power_scale = self._one if p_scale is None else _arr_bl(p_scale, B, L, "p_scale")
        if enable is None:
            enabled_lines = self._en
        else:
            enable_fraction = np.clip(_arr_bl(enable, B, L, "enable"), 0.0,
                1.0)   # bool -> 0/1 - a fraction scales the power
            enabled_lines = enable_fraction > 0.0
            if np.any((enable_fraction > 0.0) & (enable_fraction < 1.0)):
                power_scale = power_scale * enable_fraction
        tuning_offset_hz = self._zero if tune_codes is None else _arr_bl(tune_codes, B, L,
            "tune_codes") * hw.tune_lsb_hz
        tick_kernel = laser_tick_par if parallel else laser_tick
        tick_kernel(np.int64(k), hw.dt_s, self.tcomp, hw.grid_s, hw.depth, hw.f0_hz, hw.p0_w, hw.f_rate_hz_per_s,
           hw.p_rate_per_s, hw.f_rw_hz_per_rt_s, hw.p_rw_per_rt_s, hw.rho_f, hw.rho_p, hw.lines.source_laser,
           hw.lines.n_lasers, hw.rin_per_hz, enabled_lines, frequency_offset_hz, power_scale, tuning_offset_hz,
               self.key_drift, self.key_rin, self.cache_j, self.w_lo,
           self.w_hi, self.f, self.p)
        return self.f, self.p

source_ref.code:
def exact_to_tcmt(
    k2_th: ArrayLike,  # k2_th = K_th^2 (1) - through-coupler power fraction - type scalar, sequence, or NumPy array
    k2_dr: ArrayLike,  # k2_dr = K_dr^2 (1) - drop-coupler power fraction - type scalar, sequence, or NumPy array
    a_rt: ArrayLike,  # a_rt = a (1) - retained round-trip field amplitude - type scalar, sequence, or NumPy array
    t_rt_s: ArrayLike,  # t_rt_s = T_rt (s) - round-trip group delay - type scalar, sequence, or NumPy array
    rb: ArrayLike | None = None,  # rb = r_b (1) - optional complex round-trip backscatter - type scalar, sequence, NumPy array, or None
) -> (
    tuple[
        RealValue,  # intrinsic_decay_rate = kappa_i (1/s) - intrinsic energy decay rate - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
        RealValue,  # through_coupling_decay_rate = kappa_e (1/s) - energy leakage rate to the through bus - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
        RealValue,  # drop_coupling_decay_rate = kappa_d (1/s) - energy leakage rate to the drop bus - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
    ]
    | tuple[
        RealValue,  # intrinsic_decay_rate = kappa_i (1/s) - intrinsic energy decay rate - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
        RealValue,  # through_coupling_decay_rate = kappa_e (1/s) - energy leakage rate to the through bus - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
        RealValue,  # drop_coupling_decay_rate = kappa_d (1/s) - energy leakage rate to the drop bus - type float64 scalar or float64 ndarray, broadcast input shape
        ComplexValue,  # beta_hz = g/(2*pi) (Hz) - returned only when rb is supplied - type complex scalar or complex NumPy array
    ]
):
    k2_th, k2_dr, a_rt, t_rt_s = np.broadcast_arrays(
        *(np.asarray(input_value, dtype=float) for input_value in (k2_th, k2_dr, a_rt, t_rt_s))
    )
    intrinsic_decay_rate = -2.0 * np.log(a_rt) / t_rt_s
    through_coupling_decay_rate = -np.log1p(-k2_th) / t_rt_s
    drop_coupling_decay_rate = -np.log1p(-k2_dr) / t_rt_s
    if rb is None:
        return (
            intrinsic_decay_rate,
            through_coupling_decay_rate,
            drop_coupling_decay_rate,
        )
    beta_hz = np.asarray(rb, dtype=complex) / (TWO_PI * t_rt_s)
    return (
        intrinsic_decay_rate,
        through_coupling_decay_rate,
        drop_coupling_decay_rate,
        beta_hz,
    )

nodes.name: interpolate_scatterer_reflection_and_phase_derivative
nodes.meaning: interpolate each scatterer's complex amplitude reflection coefficient and phase derivative.
comments: interpolate each scatterer's complex amplitude reflection coefficient and phase derivative.
APPROXIMATION: the two scatterers lie at one-quarter and three-quarters of a ring trip.
n=floor(phi/(2*pi)) selects the lower order, and theta=phi-2*pi*n (rad) locates phase within that order.
rho_n = -(i/2)*(-1)^n*conj(r_b[n]) maps each table entry to a scatterer reflection coefficient.
rho(phi) = cos^2(theta/4)*rho_n + sin^2(theta/4)*rho_(n+1).
wrap indices by the backscatter table length and retain the absolute order's alternating sign.
both interpolation weights have zero phase slope at each resonance.
x

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def interpolate_scatterer_reflection_and_phase_derivative(
    round_trip_phase_rad: float,  # round_trip_phase_rad = phi (rad) - absolute round-trip phase including coupler phase - type float scalar
    round_trip_backscatter: Complex128Vector,  # round_trip_backscatter = r_b[n] (1) - complex round-trip backscatter coupling by resonance order - type complex128 ndarray, shape (backscatter_order_count,)
) -> tuple[
    complex,  # scatterer_reflection = rho(phi) (1) - complex field reflection coefficient - type complex scalar
    complex,  # d_scatterer_reflection_dphi = d rho/d phi (1/rad) - reflection coefficient's phase derivative - type complex scalar
]:
    backscatter_order_count = round_trip_backscatter.shape[0]
    lower_order = int(
        np.floor(round_trip_phase_rad / TWO_PI)
    )  # floor calculation to find lowest resonance order
    phase_within_order_rad = round_trip_phase_rad - TWO_PI * lower_order
    quarter_phase_cos = math.cos(0.25 * phase_within_order_rad)
    quarter_phase_sin = math.sin(0.25 * phase_within_order_rad)

    # weights w
    lower_order_weight = quarter_phase_cos * quarter_phase_cos
    upper_order_weight = quarter_phase_sin * quarter_phase_sin
    d_upper_weight_dphi = 0.25 * math.sin(0.5 * phase_within_order_rad)
    # dw_hi/dphi = sin(theta/2)/4, and dw_lo/dphi = -dw_hi/dphi
    lower_order_sign = 1.0 if _wrap_order_index(lower_order, 2) == 0 else -1.0  # (-1) ^n

    # convert r.b.n into p.n
    lower_order_reflection = (
        -0.5j
        * lower_order_sign
        * round_trip_backscatter[_wrap_order_index(lower_order, backscatter_order_count)].conjugate()
    )
    # convert r.b.n+1 into p.n+1
    upper_order_reflection = (
        0.5j
        * lower_order_sign
        * round_trip_backscatter[_wrap_order_index(lower_order + 1, backscatter_order_count)].conjugate()
    )
    # (-1)^(n+1) = -(-1)^n

    # p(theta) = (1-w)(...) + (w)(...)
    scatterer_reflection = (
        lower_order_weight * lower_order_reflection + upper_order_weight * upper_order_reflection
    )
    # approx. slope
    d_scatterer_reflection_dphi = d_upper_weight_dphi * (upper_order_reflection - lower_order_reflection)
    return (
        scatterer_reflection,
        d_scatterer_reflection_dphi,
    )

tests/verification/test_optics.py checks that it agrees with `solve_exact_ring_fields_and_phase_derivatives`.
solve x=M*x+c for the clockwise and counterclockwise fields at z=0+.
M=C1*H*C2*H maps the fields through one round trip.
H=Q*S*Q maps the fields through half a ring.
Q=diag(p,1/p) propagates a quarter trip, with p=exp(-(xi+i*phi)/4).
P2=p^2 and H=[[P2,-conj(rho)],[-rho,1/P2]]/tau.
C_j=diag(t_j,1/t_j) maps fields through coupler j.
c contains the bus-input drive terms.
one 2x2 solve, then one pass for fields and energies.

@njit(cache=True)
def solve_exact_ring_fields_and_energy(
    round_trip_phase_rad: float,  # round_trip_phase_rad = phi (rad) - round-trip phase including coupler phase - type float scalar
    round_trip_field_loss_exponent: float,  # round_trip_field_loss_exponent = -ln(a_rt) (1) - round-trip field attenuation exponent - type float scalar
    through_self_coupling: float,  # through_self_coupling = t_th (1) - through-coupler field self-coupling - type float scalar
    through_cross_coupling: float,  # through_cross_coupling = K_th (1) - through-coupler field cross-coupling - type float scalar
    drop_self_coupling: float,  # drop_self_coupling = t_dr (1) - drop-coupler field self-coupling - type float scalar
    drop_cross_coupling: float,  # drop_cross_coupling = K_dr (1) - drop-coupler field cross-coupling - type float scalar
    round_trip_delay_s: float,  # round_trip_delay_s = T_rt (s) - round-trip group delay - type float scalar
    round_trip_backscatter: Complex128Vector,  # round_trip_backscatter = r_b[n] (1) - complex round-trip backscatter coupling by order - type complex128 ndarray, shape (backscatter_order_count,)
    input_field: complex,  # input_field = s_in,0 (sqrt(W)) - incoming field at the input port - type complex scalar
    backward_through_field: complex,  # backward_through_field = s_in,1 (sqrt(W)) - incoming field at the through port - type complex scalar
    backward_drop_field: complex,  # backward_drop_field = s_in,2 (sqrt(W)) - incoming field at the drop port - type complex scalar
    add_input_field: complex,  # add_input_field = s_in,3 (sqrt(W)) - incoming field at the add port - type complex scalar
) -> tuple[
    complex,  # reflected_field = s_out,0 (sqrt(W)) - reflected field at the input port - type complex scalar
    complex,  # through_field = s_out,1 (sqrt(W)) - through-port field - type complex scalar
    complex,  # drop_field = s_out,2 (sqrt(W)) - clockwise drop-port field - type complex scalar
    complex,  # add_output_field = s_out,3 (sqrt(W)) - counter-clockwise add-port field - type complex scalar
    float,  # return[4] = U_cw (J) - clockwise stored energy - type float scalar
    float,  # return[5] = U_ccw (J) - counter-clockwise stored energy - type float scalar
    float,  # return[6] = P_loss (W) - total intrinsic-loss power - type float scalar
]:
    # s0/s1 enter the input/through ports and drive CW/CCW fields [sqrt(W)].
    # s2/s3 enter the drop/add ports and drive CCW/CW fields [sqrt(W)].
    # rho is each scatterer's reflection coefficient - tau = sqrt(1 - |rho|^2).
    scatterer_reflection, _ = interpolate_scatterer_reflection_and_phase_derivative(round_trip_phase_rad, round_trip_backscatter)
    scatterer_reflection_conj = scatterer_reflection.conjugate()
    inverse_scatterer_field_transmission = 1.0 / math.sqrt(1.0 - _squared_magnitude(scatterer_reflection))

    # quarter-trip attenuation and phase
    quarter_propagation = cmath.exp(-0.25 * (round_trip_field_loss_exponent + 1j * round_trip_phase_rad))
    # undo propagation when tracing CCW light in the clockwise coordinate
    inverse_quarter_propagation = 1.0 / quarter_propagation
    # half-trip attenuation and phase
    half_propagation = quarter_propagation * quarter_propagation
    # inverse half-trip attenuation and phase
    inverse_half_propagation = inverse_quarter_propagation * inverse_quarter_propagation

    # | step | field pair after that step |
    # |---|---|
    # | start | \(x_0\) |
    # | first half-ring | \(Hx_0\) |
    # | drop coupler | \(C_2Hx_0+e\) |
    # | second half-ring | \(HC_2Hx_0+He\) |
    # | input coupler | \(C_1HC_2Hx_0+C_1He+d\) |

    # | incoming field | enters through | couples into |
    # |---|---|---|
    # | `s0` | input port | clockwise ring wave |
    # | `s1` | through port, travelling backward | counterclockwise ring wave |

    # with only the usual forward laser input, s1 = s2 = s3 = 0, e= 0, d only has upper term != 0

    # inverse coupler transmissions for the CCW transfer equations
    inverse_through_self_coupling = 1.0 / through_self_coupling
    inverse_drop_self_coupling = 1.0 / drop_self_coupling

    # H maps [CW, CCW] across one half-ring - h_ij maps component j to i.
    half_transfer_11 = half_propagation * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission
    half_transfer_12 = -scatterer_reflection_conj * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission
    half_transfer_21 = -scatterer_reflection * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission
    half_transfer_22 = inverse_half_propagation * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission

    # K includes both half-rings and the drop coupler, without external drive.
    internal_transfer_11 = (
        half_transfer_11 * drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_11
        + half_transfer_12 * inverse_drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_21
    )  # K = H C2 H
    internal_transfer_12 = (
        half_transfer_11 * drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_12
        + half_transfer_12 * inverse_drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_22
    )
    internal_transfer_21 = (
        half_transfer_21 * drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_11
        + half_transfer_22 * inverse_drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_21
    )
    internal_transfer_22 = (
        half_transfer_21 * drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_12
        + half_transfer_22 * inverse_drop_self_coupling * half_transfer_22
    )
    # e = [e3, e2] adds external drive at the drop coupler.
    cw_drop_coupler_drive = -1j * drop_cross_coupling * add_input_field  # add port -> CW at L/2+
    ccw_drop_coupler_drive = (
        1j * drop_cross_coupling * backward_drop_field * inverse_drop_self_coupling
    )  # drop-port input -> CCW at L/2+
    # c = C1*H*e + d, with d = [-i*k1*s0, i*k1*s1/t1].
    cw_loop_drive = (
        through_self_coupling
        * (half_transfer_11 * cw_drop_coupler_drive + half_transfer_12 * ccw_drop_coupler_drive)
        - 1j * through_cross_coupling * input_field
    )
    ccw_loop_drive = (
        inverse_through_self_coupling
        * (half_transfer_21 * cw_drop_coupler_drive + half_transfer_22 * ccw_drop_coupler_drive)
        + 1j * through_cross_coupling * backward_through_field * inverse_through_self_coupling
    )
    # A = I - M, with M = C1*K - match the fields when the loop closes.
    loop_matrix_11 = 1.0 - through_self_coupling * internal_transfer_11
    loop_matrix_12 = -through_self_coupling * internal_transfer_12
    loop_matrix_21 = -inverse_through_self_coupling * internal_transfer_21
    loop_matrix_22 = 1.0 - inverse_through_self_coupling * internal_transfer_22
    loop_determinant = loop_matrix_11 * loop_matrix_22 - loop_matrix_12 * loop_matrix_21
    # solve A*[CW, CCW] = [cu, cv] just after the input coupler
    cw_field = (
        loop_matrix_22 * cw_loop_drive - loop_matrix_12 * ccw_loop_drive
    ) / loop_determinant  # CW at 0+
    ccw_field = (
        loop_matrix_11 * ccw_loop_drive - loop_matrix_21 * cw_loop_drive
    ) / loop_determinant  # CCW at 0+

    # trace the solved fields around the ring to read outputs and segment powers
    # CW enters a segment at its left end - CCW enters at its right end
    reflected_field = (
        through_self_coupling * backward_through_field - 1j * through_cross_coupling * ccw_field
    )  # reflection out of the input port
    cw_segment_power_sum = _squared_magnitude(cw_field)  # segment 1 (0 -> L/4)
    cw_field = quarter_propagation * cw_field
    ccw_field = ccw_field * inverse_quarter_propagation
    ccw_segment_power_sum = _squared_magnitude(ccw_field)
    cw_field, ccw_field = (
        (cw_field - scatterer_reflection_conj * ccw_field) * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission,
        (ccw_field - scatterer_reflection * cw_field) * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission,
    )  # scatterer A
    cw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(cw_field)  # segment 2 (L/4 -> L/2)
    cw_field = quarter_propagation * cw_field
    ccw_field = ccw_field * inverse_quarter_propagation
    ccw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(ccw_field)
    drop_field = (
        drop_self_coupling * add_input_field - 1j * drop_cross_coupling * cw_field
    )  # CW drop (monitor)
    cw_field = drop_self_coupling * cw_field - 1j * drop_cross_coupling * add_input_field
    ccw_field = (
        ccw_field + 1j * drop_cross_coupling * backward_drop_field
    ) * inverse_drop_self_coupling  # CCW at L/2+
    add_output_field = (
        drop_self_coupling * backward_drop_field - 1j * drop_cross_coupling * ccw_field
    )  # CCW drop out of the add port
    cw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(cw_field)  # segment 3 (L/2 -> 3L/4)
    cw_field = quarter_propagation * cw_field
    ccw_field = ccw_field * inverse_quarter_propagation
    ccw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(ccw_field)
    cw_field, ccw_field = (
        (cw_field - scatterer_reflection_conj * ccw_field) * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission,
        (ccw_field - scatterer_reflection * cw_field) * inverse_scatterer_field_transmission,
    )  # scatterer B
    cw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(cw_field)  # segment 4 (3L/4 -> L)
    cw_field = quarter_propagation * cw_field
    ccw_field = ccw_field * inverse_quarter_propagation
    ccw_segment_power_sum += _squared_magnitude(ccw_field)
    through_field = through_self_coupling * input_field - 1j * through_cross_coupling * cw_field  # through
    # convert segment-entry powers to stored energy and intrinsic lost power
    quarter_ring_energy_per_power, quarter_ring_loss_fraction = calculate_quarter_ring_energy_per_power_and_loss_fraction(
        round_trip_field_loss_exponent, round_trip_delay_s
    )
    return (
        reflected_field,
        through_field,
        drop_field,
        add_output_field,
        cw_segment_power_sum * quarter_ring_energy_per_power,
        ccw_segment_power_sum * quarter_ring_energy_per_power,
        (cw_segment_power_sum + ccw_segment_power_sum) * quarter_ring_loss_fraction,
    )

returns: (reflected_field, through_field, drop_field, add_output_field, cw_segment_power_sum * quarter_ring_energy_per_power, ccw_segment_power_sum * quarter_ring_energy_per_power, (cw_segment_power_sum + ccw_segment_power_sum) * quarter_ring_loss_fraction)
