source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def readback_tick_row(k, v_v, i_a, lsb_v, lsb_i, noise_codes, period, lat, code_max, average, key, st, fv, fr, fm,
                      out_sampled):
    n_rings = v_v.shape[0]
    for n in range(n_rings):
        out_sampled[n] = 0
        if average:
            st[n, 0] += v_v[n]
            st[n, 1] += i_a[n]
            st[n, 2] += 1.0
        if (k + 1) % period != 0:
            continue
        s_tick = k + 1
        if average and st[n, 2] > 0.0:
            v_read = st[n, 0] / st[n, 2]
            i_read = st[n, 1] / st[n, 2]
        else:
            v_read = v_v[n]
            i_read = i_a[n]
        st[n, 0] = 0.0
        st[n, 1] = 0.0
        st[n, 2] = 0.0
        zv = 0.0
        zi = 0.0
        if noise_codes > 0.0:
            zv, zi = rng.normal2(key, n, s_tick, _SLOT_WHITE)
        cv = _round_clip(v_read / lsb_v + noise_codes * zv, code_max)
        ci = _round_clip(i_read / lsb_i + noise_codes * zi, code_max)
        ok = fifo_push(fv, fr, fm, n, cv | (ci << _RB_I_SHIFT), s_tick + lat)
        out_sampled[n] = 1 if ok else 2

nodes.name: flicker_pole_set
nodes.meaning: flicker (Python, build time)
comments: flicker (Python, build time)
Rates (rad/s) and variances of J OU processes whose summed PSD approximates S_f(f) = s_white f_c / f.
one OU process with rate lambda and variance sigma^2 has the one-sided PSD 4 sigma^2 lambda/(lambda^2 + w^2).

Corners f_j = f_min r^(j + 1/2), r = 10^(1/per_decade), j = 0..J-1, J = ceil(per_decade log10(f_max/f_min)), and equal variances sigma^2 = s_white f_c ln(r) give sum_j ~ sigma^2/(f ln r) = s_white f_c / f (a log-uniform mixture of Lorentzians).
the PSD flattens below f_min and falls as 1/f^2 above f_max (band limits).
s_white - one-sided white PSD in the channel's unit^2/Hz - f_corner_hz - frequency where flicker equals white.
returns empty arrays when s_white or f_corner is not positive.
nodes.signature: flicker_pole_set(s_white: float, f_corner_hz: float, f_min_hz: float=_FLICKER_F_MIN_HZ, f_max_hz: float | None=None, per_decade: int=_FLICKER_PER_DECADE)

nodes.meaning: Cholesky factor (l00, l10, l11) of the 2 x 2 covariance [[vx, cxc], [cxc, vc]] (negative pivots -> 0).
comments: Cholesky factor (l00, l10, l11) of the 2 x 2 covariance [[vx, cxc], [cxc, vc]] (negative pivots -> 0).

source_ref.code:
def _chol2(vx: float, cxc: float, vc: float) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    l00 = math.sqrt(max(vx, 0.0))
    l10 = cxc / l00 if l00 > 0.0 else 0.0
    l11 = math.sqrt(max(vc - l10 * l10, 0.0))
    return l00, l10, l11

nodes.name: ou_window_coefficients
nodes.meaning: exact sample-to-sample coefficients (J, N_FLICKER_COEF) of OU processes seen through an integrate-and-dump window.
comments: exact sample-to-sample coefficients (J, N_FLICKER_COEF) of OU processes seen through an integrate-and-dump window.
Between samples (period P) the process runs freely for D = P - W, then the window (W) averages it.
Given x at the previous sample instant x0 (dx = -lam x dt + sqrt(2 lam) sigma dW) -
x(s - W) = a_D x0 + eta,  Var eta = sigma^2 (1 - a_D^2),  a_D = e^{-lam D}
x(s)     = a_W x(s-W) + e1,  Var e1 = sigma^2 (1 - a_W^2)
Y        = integral over W = x(s-W)(1 - a_W)/lam + e2,  Var e2 = 2 sigma^2 g(lam W)/lam^2, Cov(e1, e2) = sigma^2 (1 - a_W)^2 / lam, and the contribution to the sample is the window mean Y/W.
Rows - [P00, P01, P10, P11, L00, L10, L11, S00, S10, S11] (see `flicker_step`) - the window mean is not carried (P01 = P11 = 0) - S = stationary start (x only).
nodes.signature: ou_window_coefficients(lam, var, period_s: float, window_s: float)

source_ref.code:
def ou_window_coefficients(lam, var, period_s: float, window_s: float) -> np.ndarray:
    lam = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(lam, dtype=float))
    var = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(var, dtype=float))
    if window_s <= 0.0 or period_s < window_s:
        raise ValueError(f"need 0 < window ({window_s}) <= period ({period_s})")
    out = np.zeros((lam.size, N_FLICKER_COEF))
    d = period_s - window_s
    for j, (lj, vj) in enumerate(zip(lam, var)):
        a_d = math.exp(-lj * d)
        v_eta = vj * (-math.expm1(-2.0 * lj * d))
        u = lj * window_s
        a_w = math.exp(-u)
        oma = -math.expm1(-u)
        v1 = vj * (-math.expm1(-2.0 * u))
        c12a = vj * oma * oma / lj / window_s
        v2a = 2.0 * vj * _g_window(u) / (u * u)
        m_a = oma / u
        vx = a_w * a_w * v_eta + v1
        va = m_a * m_a * v_eta + v2a
        cxa = a_w * m_a * v_eta + c12a
        l00, l10, l11 = _chol2(vx, cxa, va)
        out[j] = [a_w * a_d, 0.0, m_a * a_d, 0.0, l00, l10, l11, math.sqrt(vj), 0.0, 0.0]
    return out

nodes.name: ou_rc_coefficients
nodes.meaning: exact sample-to-sample coefficients (J, N_FLICKER_COEF) of OU processes seen through a first-order RC front end.
comments: exact sample-to-sample coefficients (J, N_FLICKER_COEF) of OU processes seen through a first-order RC front end.
State (x, y) - dx = -lam x dt + sqrt(2 lam) sigma dW, dy = mu (x - y) dt, mu = 1/tau.
Over the sample period P -
Phi = [[a, 0], [kappa (a - b), b]],  a = e^{-lam P}, b = e^{-mu P}, kappa = mu/(mu - lam) -
Q_xx = sigma^2 (1 - a^2),  Q_xy = 2 lam sigma^2 kappa [E(2 lam) - E(lam + mu)], Q_yy = 2 lam sigma^2 kappa^2 [E(2 lam) - 2 E(lam + mu) + E(2 mu)],  E(alpha) = (1 - e^{-alpha P})/alpha.
Stationary covariance - Var x = sigma^2, Cov = Var y = sigma^2 mu/(lam + mu).
a pole within _RC_NUDGE of mu is moved by that fraction (the closed form is singular there).
Rows as in `ou_window_coefficients`.
nodes.signature: ou_rc_coefficients(lam, var, period_s: float, tau_s: float)

source_ref.code:
def ou_rc_coefficients(lam, var, period_s: float, tau_s: float) -> np.ndarray:
    lam = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(lam, dtype=float))
    var = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(var, dtype=float))
    if not (tau_s > 0.0 and period_s > 0.0):
        raise ValueError("need tau_s > 0 and period_s > 0")
    mu = 1.0 / tau_s
    out = np.zeros((lam.size, N_FLICKER_COEF))

    def e(alpha):
        return -math.expm1(-alpha * period_s) / alpha

    for j, (lj, vj) in enumerate(zip(lam, var)):
        if abs(mu - lj) < _RC_NUDGE * mu:
            lj = mu * (1.0 - _RC_NUDGE)
        a = math.exp(-lj * period_s)
        b = math.exp(-mu * period_s)
        kap = mu / (mu - lj)
        b2 = 2.0 * lj * vj
        qxx = vj * (-math.expm1(-2.0 * lj * period_s))
        qxy = b2 * kap * (e(2.0 * lj) - e(lj + mu))
        qyy = b2 * kap * kap * (e(2.0 * lj) - 2.0 * e(lj + mu) + e(2.0 * mu))
        l00, l10, l11 = _chol2(qxx, qxy, qyy)
        sxy = vj * mu / (lj + mu)
        s00, s10, s11 = _chol2(vj, sxy, sxy)
        out[j] = [a, 0.0, kap * (a - b), b, l00, l10, l11, s00, s10, s11]
    return out

def draw_inl_bow_lsb(device_seeds, N: int, inl_lsb, stream_name: str = "adc_monitor_inl",
                     channels_per_adc: int = 1) -> np.ndarray:
    seeds = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(device_seeds, dtype=np.int64))
    B = seeds.size
    inl = _arr_b(inl_lsb, B, "inl_lsb")
    keys = stream_keys(seeds, B, stream_name)
    cpa = int(channels_per_adc)
    if cpa < 1:
        raise ValueError("channels_per_adc must be >= 1")
    out = np.zeros((B, N))
    for b in range(B):
        for n in range(N):
            out[b, n] = inl[b] * (2.0 * rng.uniform(keys[b], n // cpa, 0, _SLOT_INL) - 1.0)
    return out

nodes.name: build
nodes.meaning: build from SI values.
comments: build from SI values.
Arrays broadcast - per ring (B, N) for responsivity, background_fraction, baseline_a, adc_offset_codes, adc_gain_error_frac, adc_inl_bow_lsb - per world (B,) for the rest.
a 1-D array of length N is per ring (pass a per-world array as (B, 1)).
defaults are fallbacks for tests - presets own the real values.
the 2 us integration window is a printed PAT-2 example.
the 250 kHz ADC rate is inferred from integration plus up to 2 us de-integration.
the 2 us ADC latency assumes one de-integration interval.
the 16-bit ADC width is inferred from RX monitor codes and remains disputed.
see docs/research/01_lightmatter_public.md and docs/handoff/core_control_api.md.
dark current defaults to zero, with inferred E_a=0.37 eV and reference temperature 25 C.
converter errors default to zero, and the default has no PGA.
afe_type - 'integrate_dump' (the default - window integration_window_s, whole ticks, <= the ADC period) or 'rc' (afe_tau_s).
adc_rate_hz is the sample rate PER RING - the ADC period must be whole ticks.
adc_mux - with channels_per_adc = C, ring n is served by converter n // C.
'round_robin' staggers ring n by floor((n mod C) P / C) ticks.
one integrating converter (the PAT-2 dual-slope ADC, whose integrator is the converter) serves its C rings in turn, so their integrate-and-dump windows must not overlap - C W <= P (checked).
the conversion (de-integration) time is not modelled - it is carried by adc_latency_s.
a shared dual-slope converter also needs C (W + T_deint) <= P, which the preset's adc_rate_hz must respect.
'bank' samples every ring at phase 0 (simultaneous sample-and-hold - a front end per ring ahead of the shared quantizer - assumed meaning).
Under both orders the C rings share the quantizer's DNL thresholds and INL bow (adc_inl_bow_lsb must be equal for them - checked).
the per-ring adc_offset_codes and adc_gain_error_frac belong to the front end and stay per ring.

adc_ref_site ('package_base' default, or 'monitor_pd' - ADC_REF_SITES) - where the reference whose tempco adc_ref_tempco_per_k acts sits (`adc_temperature`) - monitor_pd needs channels_per_adc = 1 (one converter per ring, at its PD).
adc_full_scale_a - input current at code 2^bits - 1 (PGA 1).
dark_activation_ev - E_a in eV (0.35-0.38 eV, materials notes section 10).
adc_dnl_lsb - peak |DNL| (clipped to 1).
input_noise_a_per_rt_hz - one-sided input-referred white current noise density - flicker_corner_hz its 1/f corner.
shot_noise = fidelity.shot_noise.
stuck_flagged - a stuck converter marks its samples invalid (monitor_valid False, as the channel doc says) - False models a silent stuck fault.
nodes.signature: build(cls, B: int, N: int, dt_s: float, *, responsivity_a_per_w, adc_full_scale_a, gain_scale=1.0, dark_i0_a=0.0, dark_t0_k=_DEFAULT_T0_K, dark_activation_ev=_DEFAULT_DARK_EA_EV, background_fraction=0.0, baseline_a=0.0, afe_type='integrate_dump', integration_window_s: float | None=PAT2_T_INT_S, afe_tau_s: float | None=None, adc_rate_hz: float=250000.0, adc_latency_s=2e-06, adc_bits: int=16, adc_offset_codes=0.0, adc_gain_error_frac=0.0, adc_inl_bow_lsb=0.0, adc_dnl_lsb=0.0, input_noise_a_per_rt_hz=0.0, flicker_corner_hz=0.0, flicker_f_min_hz: float=_FLICKER_F_MIN_HZ, flicker_f_max_hz: float | None=None, flicker_per_decade: int=_FLICKER_PER_DECADE, adc_ref_tempco_per_k=0.0, adc_ref_t_k=ADC_REF_T_K_DEFAULT, pga_gains=(), channels_per_adc: int=1, mux_order: str='round_robin', shot_noise: bool=True, stuck_flagged: bool=True, slot_base: int=0, stream: str='adc_monitor', adc_ref_site='package_base')

source_ref.code:
@classmethod
    def build(cls, B: int, N: int, dt_s: float, *, responsivity_a_per_w, adc_full_scale_a, gain_scale=1.0,
              dark_i0_a=0.0, dark_t0_k=_DEFAULT_T0_K, dark_activation_ev=_DEFAULT_DARK_EA_EV,
              background_fraction=0.0, baseline_a=0.0, afe_type="integrate_dump",
              integration_window_s: float | None = PAT2_T_INT_S, afe_tau_s: float | None = None,
              adc_rate_hz: float = 250e3, adc_latency_s=2e-6, adc_bits: int = 16, adc_offset_codes=0.0,
              adc_gain_error_frac=0.0, adc_inl_bow_lsb=0.0, adc_dnl_lsb=0.0, input_noise_a_per_rt_hz=0.0,
              flicker_corner_hz=0.0, flicker_f_min_hz: float = _FLICKER_F_MIN_HZ,
              flicker_f_max_hz: float | None = None, flicker_per_decade: int = _FLICKER_PER_DECADE,
              adc_ref_tempco_per_k=0.0, adc_ref_t_k=ADC_REF_T_K_DEFAULT, pga_gains=(), channels_per_adc: int = 1,
              mux_order: str = "round_robin", shot_noise: bool = True, stuck_flagged: bool = True,
              slot_base: int = 0, stream: str = "adc_monitor", adc_ref_site="package_base") -> "MonitorHw":
        dt = float(dt_s)
        afe = AFE_TYPES[afe_type] if isinstance(afe_type, str) else int(afe_type)
        if afe not in (AFE_RC, AFE_INTEGRATE_DUMP):
            raise ValueError(f"afe_type must be one of {tuple(AFE_TYPES)}")
        period = rate_to_period_ticks(adc_rate_hz, dt, "ring.monitor.adc_rate_hz")
        if afe == AFE_INTEGRATE_DUMP:
            if integration_window_s is None:
                raise ValueError("afe_type integrate_dump needs ring.monitor.integration_window_s")
            window = seconds_to_ticks(integration_window_s, dt, "ring.monitor.integration_window_s",
                                      allow_zero=False)
            if window > period:
                raise ValueError(f"integration window ({window} ticks) exceeds the ADC period ({period} ticks): one "
                                 "integrate-and-dump channel cannot overlap its windows")
            tau = 0.0
            a_tick, mu = 1.0, 0.0
        else:
            if afe_tau_s is None or not afe_tau_s > 0.0:
                raise ValueError("afe_type rc needs ring.monitor.afe_tau_s > 0")
            tau = float(afe_tau_s)
            window = 0
            a_tick, mu = math.exp(-dt / tau), 1.0 / tau
        lat = _arr_b(adc_latency_s, B, "adc_latency_s")
        lat_ticks = np.array([seconds_to_ticks(float(x), dt, "ring.monitor.adc_latency_s") for x in lat],
                             dtype=np.int64)
        bits = int(adc_bits)
        if not 1 <= bits <= 32:
            raise ValueError("adc_bits must be in 1..32")
        code_max = (1 << bits) - 1
        fs = _arr_b(adc_full_scale_a, B, "adc_full_scale_a")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(fs) & (fs > 0)):
            raise ValueError("adc_full_scale_a must be finite and > 0")
        dnl = _arr_b(adc_dnl_lsb, B, "adc_dnl_lsb")
        if np.any(dnl < 0):
            raise ValueError("adc_dnl_lsb must be >= 0")
        if np.any(dnl > 1.0):
            warnings.warn("adc_dnl_lsb > 1 LSB clipped to 1 (thresholds must stay monotone)", stacklevel=2)
            dnl = np.minimum(dnl, 1.0)
        cpa = int(channels_per_adc)
        if cpa < 1:
            raise ValueError("channels_per_adc must be >= 1")
        if mux_order == "round_robin":
            phase = np.array([((n % cpa) * period) // cpa for n in range(N)], dtype=np.int64)
            if afe == AFE_INTEGRATE_DUMP and cpa > 1 and cpa * window > period:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"adc_mux round_robin: {cpa} rings share one integrating converter, so their {window}-tick "
                    f"integration windows need {cpa} x {window} = {cpa * window} ticks per ADC period, which is only "
                    f"{period} ticks (overlapping windows of one integrator; shorten "
                    "ring.monitor.integration_window_s, lower ring.monitor.adc_rate_hz or use adc_mux.order bank)")
        elif mux_order == "bank":
            phase = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
        else:
            raise ValueError("mux_order must be 'round_robin' or 'bank'")
        site = ADC_REF_SITES.get(adc_ref_site, -1) if isinstance(adc_ref_site, str) else int(adc_ref_site)
        if site not in ADC_REF_SITES.values():
            raise ValueError(f"adc_ref_site must be one of {tuple(ADC_REF_SITES)}")
        if site == ADC_REF_MONITOR_PD and cpa > 1:
            raise ValueError("adc_ref_site monitor_pd puts each ring's converter at its own PD, but "
                             f"channels_per_adc = {cpa} rings share one converter")
        unit = np.arange(N) // cpa
        pr = np.zeros((B, N, NPR))
        pr[:, :, PR_RESP] = _arr_bn(responsivity_a_per_w, B, N, "responsivity_a_per_w")
        pr[:, :, PR_BG] = _arr_bn(background_fraction, B, N, "background_fraction")
        pr[:, :, PR_IBASE] = _arr_bn(baseline_a, B, N, "baseline_a")
        pr[:, :, PR_GAIN_ERR] = _arr_bn(adc_gain_error_frac, B, N, "adc_gain_error_frac")
        pr[:, :, PR_OFFSET] = _arr_bn(adc_offset_codes, B, N, "adc_offset_codes")
        pr[:, :, PR_INL_BOW] = _arr_bn(adc_inl_bow_lsb, B, N, "adc_inl_bow_lsb")
        pr[:, :, PR_ADC_UNIT] = unit[None, :]
        if cpa > 1:
            bow = pr[:, :, PR_INL_BOW]
            if np.any(bow != bow[:, (unit * cpa)]):
                raise ValueError("adc_inl_bow_lsb: the rings that share one converter (adc_mux, ring n on converter "
                                 "n // channels_per_adc) share its INL bow (draw_inl_bow_lsb(..., channels_per_adc))")
        noise = _arr_b(input_noise_a_per_rt_hz, B, "input_noise_a_per_rt_hz")
        pw = np.zeros((B, NPW))
        pw[:, PW_GAIN_SCALE] = _arr_b(gain_scale, B, "gain_scale")
        pw[:, PW_DARK_I0] = _arr_b(dark_i0_a, B, "dark_i0_a")
        pw[:, PW_DARK_T0] = _arr_b(dark_t0_k, B, "dark_t0_k")
        pw[:, PW_DARK_EA] = _arr_b(dark_activation_ev, B, "dark_activation_ev") * Q_E
        pw[:, PW_S_TIA] = noise ** 2
        pw[:, PW_LSB] = fs / code_max
        pw[:, PW_TEMPCO] = _arr_b(adc_ref_tempco_per_k, B, "adc_ref_tempco_per_k")
        pw[:, PW_T_REF] = _arr_b(adc_ref_t_k, B, "adc_ref_t_k")
        pw[:, PW_DNL] = dnl
        pw[:, PW_A_TICK] = a_tick
        pw[:, PW_MU] = mu
        pw[:, PW_DT] = dt
        fc_hz = _arr_b(flicker_corner_hz, B, "flicker_corner_hz")
        coefs = [flicker_coefficients(float(noise[b] ** 2), float(fc_hz[b]), afe_type=afe,
                                      period_s=period * dt, window_s=window * dt, tau_s=tau,
                                      f_min_hz=flicker_f_min_hz, f_max_hz=flicker_f_max_hz,
                                      per_decade=flicker_per_decade) for b in range(B)]
        gains = np.asarray(pga_gains, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1)
        if gains.size and not np.all(np.isfinite(gains) & (gains > 0)):
            raise ValueError("pga_gains must be finite and > 0")
        return cls(B=int(B), N=int(N), dt_s=dt, afe_type=afe, window_ticks=int(window), period_ticks=int(period),
                   adc_bits=bits, code_max=code_max, shot_on=int(bool(shot_noise)),
                   stuck_flagged=int(bool(stuck_flagged)), phase=phase, latency_ticks=lat_ticks, pga_gains=gains,
                   pr=pr, pw=pw, fl_coef=_stack_coefs(coefs), slot_base=int(slot_base), stream=str(stream),
                   afe_tau_s=tau, adc_ref_site=int(site), channels_per_adc=cpa)

returns: cls(B=int(B), N=int(N), dt_s=dt, afe_type=afe, window_ticks=int(window), period_ticks=int(period), adc_bits=bits, code_max=code_max, shot_on=int(bool(shot_noise)), stuck_flagged=int(bool(stuck_flagged)), phase=phase, latency_ticks=lat_ticks, pga_gains=gains, pr=pr, pw=pw, fl_coef=_stack_coefs(coefs), slot_base=int(slot_base), stream=str(stream), afe_tau_s=tau, adc_ref_site=int(site), channels_per_adc=cpa)

nodes.name: from_plant_params
nodes.meaning: build from `mrm.params.realize` output (`PlantParams` - fields of docs/PARAMETERS_FORMAT.md section 10).
comments: build from `mrm.params.realize` output (`PlantParams` - fields of docs/PARAMETERS_FORMAT.md section 10).

Uses pp.monitor, pp.timing (dt, ADC period, window, monitor latency ticks after the latency scale), pp.flags.shot_noise and pp.seeds['device'] (INL bow draw from ring.monitor.adc_inl_lsb - DNL thresholds via hw.device_seeds).
an absent ring.monitor.dark_activation_ev takes 0.37 eV (inferred, materials notes docs/research/02_materials.md section 10 - realize defaults it the same way).

baseline_a, mux_order, stuck_flagged and flicker_f_min_hz default to the MonitorParams fields (ring.monitor.baseline_ua, adc_mux.order, stuck_flagged, flicker_band_min_hz) - a keyword argument overrides them.
the ADC reference site is ring.monitor.adc_ref_site (MonitorParams.adc_ref_site).
reject ring.monitor.reference_tap.present with NotImplementedError.
PlantParams does not build the reference tap or tx.monitor_ref.* channels.
the optics also does not remove the tap's coupling_frac share from bus power.
the Python building blocks (`reference_tap`, SensingBank(ref_tap=...)) remain for hand-built studies.
nodes.signature: from_plant_params(cls, pp, *, baseline_a=None, mux_order: str | None=None, stuck_flagged: bool | None=None, flicker_f_min_hz: float | None=None, flicker_f_max_hz: float | None=None, flicker_per_decade: int=_FLICKER_PER_DECADE, adc_ref_t_k=ADC_REF_T_K_DEFAULT)

source_ref.code:
@classmethod
    def from_plant_params(cls, pp, *, baseline_a=None, mux_order: str | None = None, stuck_flagged: bool | None = None,
                          flicker_f_min_hz: float | None = None, flicker_f_max_hz: float | None = None,
                          flicker_per_decade: int = _FLICKER_PER_DECADE, adc_ref_t_k=ADC_REF_T_K_DEFAULT
                          ) -> "MonitorHw":
        m, t = pp.monitor, pp.timing
        if bool(getattr(m, "ref_tap_present", False)):
            raise NotImplementedError(
                "ring.monitor.reference_tap.present is true, but the reference tap is not built from PlantParams: the "
                "engine has no tx.monitor_ref.* channels and the optics do not take its coupling_frac share of the "
                "bus power (docs/ENGINE.md section 10). Remove the key; for a hand-built study use "
                "MonitorHw.build(...).reference_tap() with SensingBank(ref_tap=...)")
        B, N = int(pp.batch), int(pp.n_rings)
        dt = float(t.dt_s)
        if baseline_a is None:
            bl = getattr(m, "baseline_a", None)
            # (B, 1) - one baseline per world.
            # a flat (B,) array would read as per ring when B == N (build's 1-D rule)
            baseline_a = 0.0 if bl is None else np.asarray(bl, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)
        if mux_order is None:
            mux_order = str(getattr(m, "mux_order", "round_robin"))
        if stuck_flagged is None:
            stuck_flagged = bool(getattr(m, "stuck_flagged", True))
        if flicker_f_min_hz is None:
            flicker_f_min_hz = float(getattr(m, "flicker_band_min_hz", _FLICKER_F_MIN_HZ))
        inl = np.asarray(m.adc_inl_lsb, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
        cpa = int(m.channels_per_adc)
        bow = draw_inl_bow_lsb(pp.seeds["device"], N, inl, channels_per_adc=cpa) if np.any(inl > 0) else 0.0
        afe = int(m.afe_type)
        ea_ev = m.dark_activation_j.reshape(-1) / Q_E
        if "ring.monitor.dark_activation_ev" not in (getattr(pp, "values", None) or {}):
            # an E_a of 0 would make the dark current temperature-independent, but the law is Arrhenius - an absent key takes the inferred default (materials notes section 10), the same value realize uses
            ea_ev = np.full(B, _DEFAULT_DARK_EA_EV)
        hw = cls.build(
            B, N, dt, responsivity_a_per_w=m.responsivity_a_per_w, adc_full_scale_a=m.adc_full_scale_a.reshape(-1),
            gain_scale=m.gain_scale.reshape(-1), dark_i0_a=m.dark_i0_a.reshape(-1),
            dark_t0_k=np.nan_to_num(m.dark_t0_k.reshape(-1), nan=_DEFAULT_T0_K),
            dark_activation_ev=ea_ev, background_fraction=m.background_fraction,
            baseline_a=baseline_a, afe_type=afe,
            integration_window_s=(t.integration_window_ticks * dt if afe == AFE_INTEGRATE_DUMP else None),
            afe_tau_s=(m.afe_tau_s if afe == AFE_RC else None), adc_rate_hz=1.0 / (m.adc_period_ticks * dt),
            adc_latency_s=np.asarray(t.monitor_latency_ticks).reshape(-1) * dt, adc_bits=m.adc_bits,
            adc_offset_codes=m.adc_offset_codes, adc_gain_error_frac=m.adc_gain_error_frac, adc_inl_bow_lsb=bow,
            adc_dnl_lsb=m.adc_dnl_lsb.reshape(-1), input_noise_a_per_rt_hz=m.input_noise_a_per_rt_hz.reshape(-1),
            flicker_corner_hz=m.flicker_corner_hz.reshape(-1), flicker_f_min_hz=flicker_f_min_hz,
            flicker_f_max_hz=flicker_f_max_hz, flicker_per_decade=flicker_per_decade,
            adc_ref_tempco_per_k=m.adc_ref_tempco_per_k.reshape(-1), adc_ref_t_k=adc_ref_t_k,
            pga_gains=m.pga_gains, channels_per_adc=cpa, mux_order=mux_order,
            shot_noise=bool(pp.flags.shot_noise), stuck_flagged=stuck_flagged,
            adc_ref_site=str(getattr(m, "adc_ref_site", "package_base")))
        hw.device_seeds = _arr_b(pp.seeds["device"], B, "pp.seeds['device']", np.int64)
        return hw

nodes.name: reference_tap
nodes.meaning: a reference-tap channel built from this monitor channel.
comments: a reference-tap channel built from this monitor channel.

it keeps this channel's AFE and ADC, but has its own responsivity, dark current, full scale and analog baseline (default none - the drop channel's baseline is set for the drop current, not for the tap), its own noise stream and the slot offset REF_TAP_SLOT_BASE.
Its optical input is the tap coupling times the bus power (the caller computes it - no background term).

def reference_tap(self, *, responsivity_a_per_w=None, dark_i0_a=None, adc_full_scale_a=None, baseline_a=0.0,
                      stream: str = "adc_monitor_ref") -> "MonitorHw":
        pr = self.pr.copy()
        pw = self.pw.copy()
        if responsivity_a_per_w is not None:
            pr[:, :, PR_RESP] = _arr_bn(responsivity_a_per_w, self.B, self.N, "responsivity_a_per_w")
        pr[:, :, PR_BG] = 0.0
        pr[:, :, PR_IBASE] = _arr_bn(baseline_a, self.B, self.N, "baseline_a")
        if dark_i0_a is not None:
            pw[:, PW_DARK_I0] = _arr_b(dark_i0_a, self.B, "dark_i0_a")
        if adc_full_scale_a is not None:
            pw[:, PW_LSB] = _arr_b(adc_full_scale_a, self.B, "adc_full_scale_a") / self.code_max
        return MonitorHw(B=self.B, N=self.N, dt_s=self.dt_s, afe_type=self.afe_type, window_ticks=self.window_ticks,
                         period_ticks=self.period_ticks, adc_bits=self.adc_bits, code_max=self.code_max,
                         shot_on=self.shot_on, stuck_flagged=self.stuck_flagged, phase=self.phase.copy(),
                         latency_ticks=self.latency_ticks.copy(), pga_gains=self.pga_gains.copy(), pr=pr, pw=pw,
                         fl_coef=self.fl_coef.copy(), slot_base=self.slot_base + REF_TAP_SLOT_BASE, stream=stream,
                         afe_tau_s=self.afe_tau_s,
                         device_seeds=None if self.device_seeds is None else self.device_seeds.copy(),
                         adc_ref_site=self.adc_ref_site, channels_per_adc=self.channels_per_adc)

nodes.name: ideal_code
nodes.meaning: return unquantized ADC codes for input photodiode current i_a in A.
comments: return unquantized ADC codes for input photodiode current i_a in A.
broadcast to (B, N).
include baseline subtraction, PGA gain, reference drift, gain error, and offset.
exclude noise, INL, DNL, and clipping.
t_adc_k defaults to the ADC trim temperature.
calibration replicas and tests use this static transfer.

source_ref.code:
def ideal_code(self, i_a, pga_select=0, t_adc_k=None) -> np.ndarray:
        current_a = _arr_bn(i_a, self.B, self.N, "i_a")
        pga_gain = 1.0
        if self.pga_gains.size:
            pga_gain = self.pga_gains[np.clip(np.asarray(pga_select), 0, self.pga_gains.size - 1)]
        reference_temp_k = (
            self.pw[:, PW_T_REF][:, None] if t_adc_k is None else _arr_bn(t_adc_k, self.B, self.N, "t_adc_k")
        )
        reference_gain_factor = (
            1.0 + self.pw[:, PW_TEMPCO][:, None] * (reference_temp_k - self.pw[:, PW_T_REF][:, None])
        )
        return ((current_a - self.pr[:, :, PR_IBASE]) * pga_gain / self.pw[:, PW_LSB][:, None]
                * (1.0 + self.pr[:, :, PR_GAIN_ERR])
                / reference_gain_factor + self.pr[:, :, PR_OFFSET])

returns: (current_a - self.pr[:, :, PR_IBASE]) * pga_gain / self.pw[:, PW_LSB][:, None] * (1.0 + self.pr[:, :, PR_GAIN_ERR]) / reference_gain_factor + self.pr[:, :, PR_OFFSET]

nodes.name: codes_per_w
nodes.meaning: Small-signal monitor gain, ADC codes per W of optical power at the PD, (B, N) - gain_scale R g (1 + gain_err) / (LSB (1 + tc (T_adc - T_ref))).
comments: Small-signal monitor gain, ADC codes per W of optical power at the PD, (B, N) - gain_scale R g (1 + gain_err) / (LSB (1 + tc (T_adc - T_ref))).
Times 1e-6 it is `monitor_codes_per_uw_at_drop`, the lumped monitor gain that calibration can identify (before the drop-port transfer, which the optics owns).
returns: one * self.pw[:, PW_GAIN_SCALE][:, None] * self.pr[:, :, PR_RESP]

nodes.name: photocurrent_a
nodes.meaning: return (signal_current_a, dark_current_a), each shaped (B, N).
comments: return (signal_current_a, dark_current_a), each shaped (B, N).
signal current includes responsivity, monitor gain, and stray bus light.
dark current depends on PD temperature.
optical powers use W, and t_pd_k uses K.
its default is the dark-current reference temperature.

source_ref.code:
def photocurrent_a(self, p_pd_w, p_bg_w=0.0, t_pd_k=None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        drop_power_w = _arr_bn(p_pd_w, self.B, self.N, "p_pd_w")
        background_power_w = _arr_bn(p_bg_w, self.B, self.N, "p_bg_w")
        pd_temp_k = (
            np.broadcast_to(self.pw[:, PW_DARK_T0][:, None], (self.B, self.N))
            if t_pd_k is None
            else _arr_bn(t_pd_k, self.B, self.N, "t_pd_k")
        )
        signal_current_a = (
            self.pw[:, PW_GAIN_SCALE][:, None]
            * self.pr[:, :, PR_RESP]
            * (drop_power_w + self.pr[:, :, PR_BG] * background_power_w)
        )
        reference_current_a = self.pw[:, PW_DARK_I0][:, None]
        reference_temp_k = self.pw[:, PW_DARK_T0][:, None]
        activation_j = self.pw[:, PW_DARK_EA][:, None]
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            photodiode_dark_current_a = np.where(
                reference_current_a > 0,
                reference_current_a * np.exp(-(activation_j / K_B) * (1.0 / pd_temp_k - 1.0 / reference_temp_k)),
                0.0,
            )
        return signal_current_a, photodiode_dark_current_a

nodes.name: white_sigma_a
nodes.meaning: return one sample's white-noise RMS current in A, shaped (B, N).
comments: return one sample's white-noise RMS current in A, shaped (B, N).
include TIA noise and optional shot noise.
variance is S/(2*window_s) for integrate-and-dump and S/(4*tau_s) for RC.
S is the one-sided current-noise PSD in A^2/Hz.

def __init__(self, hw: MonitorHw, noise_seeds, device_seeds=None, m_max: int | None = None,
                 pop_period_ticks: int = 1, prefix: str = "tx.monitor", valid_name: str = "monitor_valid",
                 overrange_name: str = "adc_overrange"):
        self.hw = hw
        B, N = hw.B, hw.N
        self.prefix, self.valid_name, self.overrange_name = prefix, valid_name, overrange_name
        pop = max(int(pop_period_ticks), 1)
        # default M - the most samples one release can see (ceil of the release period over the ADC period)
        self.m_max = int(m_max) if m_max is not None else max(1, -(-pop // hw.period_ticks))
        if self.m_max < 1:
            raise ValueError("m_max must be >= 1")
        if device_seeds is None:
            device_seeds = hw.device_seeds        # from_plant_params carries pp.seeds['device']
        dev = np.zeros(B, np.int64) if device_seeds is None else _arr_b(device_seeds, B, "device_seeds", np.int64)
        self.key_dnl = stream_keys(dev, B, hw.stream + "_dnl")
        cap = fifo_capacity(int(hw.latency_ticks.max()), hw.period_ticks, pop)
        self.fv = np.zeros((B, N, cap), np.int64)
        self.fr = np.zeros((B, N, cap), np.int64)
        self.fm = np.zeros((B, N, 2), np.int64)
        J = hw.fl_coef.shape[1]
        self.sf = np.zeros((B, N, NSF))
        self.si = np.zeros((B, N, NSI), np.int64)
        self.fx = np.zeros((B, N, J))
        self.fc = np.zeros((B, N, J))
        self.out_sampled = np.zeros((B, N), np.int8)
        dtype = adc_channel_dtype(hw.adc_bits)
        self._samples = np.zeros((B, N, self.m_max), np.int64)
        self._ticks = np.zeros((B, N, self.m_max), np.int64)
        self._count = np.zeros((B, N), np.int64)
        self._latest = np.zeros((B, N), np.int64)
        self._valid = np.ones((B, N), np.bool_)
        self._over = np.zeros((B, N), np.bool_)
        self._new = np.zeros((B, N), np.bool_)
        self._dtype = dtype
        self._zeros_i8 = np.zeros((B, N), np.int8)
        self._zeros_i64 = np.zeros((B, N), np.int64)
        self.fifo_lost = 0               # samples lost because release() was called less often than pop_period_ticks
        self.reset(noise_seeds)

def tick(self, k: int, p_pd_w, p_bg_w=0.0, t_pd_k=None, t_adc_k=None, pga_select=None, fault=None,
             parallel: bool = False, t_base_k=None) -> np.ndarray:
        hw = self.hw
        B, N = hw.B, hw.N
        drop_power_w = _arr_bn(p_pd_w, B, N, "p_pd_w")
        background_power_w = _arr_bn(p_bg_w, B, N, "p_bg_w")
        pd_temp_k = (np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(hw.pw[:, PW_DARK_T0][:, None], (B, N))) if t_pd_k is None
                else _arr_bn(t_pd_k, B, N, "t_pd_k"))
        adc_temp_k = hw.adc_temperature(pd_temp_k, t_base_k) if t_adc_k is None else _arr_bn(t_adc_k, B, N, "t_adc_k")
        pga_selection = self._zeros_i64 if pga_select is None else _arr_bn(pga_select, B, N, "pga_select", np.int64)
        fault_bits = self._zeros_i8 if fault is None else _arr_bn(fault, B, N, "fault", np.int8)
        tick_kernel = monitor_tick_par if parallel else monitor_tick
        tick_kernel(np.int64(k), drop_power_w, background_power_w, pd_temp_k, adc_temp_k, pga_selection, fault_bits,
            hw.pr, hw.pw, hw.latency_ticks, hw.phase, hw.pga_gains,
           hw.fl_coef, hw.afe_type, hw.window_ticks, hw.period_ticks, hw.code_max, hw.shot_on, hw.stuck_flagged,
           hw.slot_base, self.key_adc, self.key_shot, self.key_dnl, self.sf, self.si, self.fx, self.fc, self.fv,
           self.fr, self.fm, self.out_sampled)
        if self.out_sampled.max() > 1:
            self.fifo_lost += int(np.count_nonzero(self.out_sampled == 2))
        return self.out_sampled

def level_codes(self, p1_w, p0_w, p_bg_w=0.0, t_pd_k=None, t_adc_k=None, pga_select=None, tau_s: float = 0.0,
                    noise_a_per_rt_hz: float | None = None, rin_per_hz=0.0, t_base_k=None):
        hw = self.hw
        B, N = hw.B, hw.N
        p1 = _arr_bn(p1_w, B, N, "p1_w")
        p0 = _arr_bn(p0_w, B, N, "p0_w")
        pb = _arr_bn(p_bg_w, B, N, "p_bg_w")
        t_pd = (np.ascontiguousarray(np.broadcast_to(hw.pw[:, PW_DARK_T0][:, None], (B, N))) if t_pd_k is None
                else _arr_bn(t_pd_k, B, N, "t_pd_k"))
        t_adc = hw.adc_temperature(t_pd, t_base_k) if t_adc_k is None else _arr_bn(t_adc_k, B, N, "t_adc_k")
        sel = self._zeros_i64 if pga_select is None else _arr_bn(pga_select, B, N, "pga_select", np.int64)
        s_tia = -1.0 if noise_a_per_rt_hz is None else float(noise_a_per_rt_hz) ** 2
        rin = _arr_b(rin_per_hz, B, "rin_per_hz")
        out = [np.zeros((B, N)) for _ in range(4)]
        for b in range(B):
            monitor_level_codes_row(p1[b], p0[b], pb[b], t_pd[b], t_adc[b], sel[b], hw.pr[b], hw.pw[b],
                                    hw.pga_gains, hw.shot_on, float(tau_s), out[0][b], out[1][b], out[2][b],
                                    out[3][b], s_tia, float(rin[b]))
        return tuple(out)

comments: build the on-die temperature sensors of B worlds from their settings (plant tick dt_s, s).
sensors contains one mapping per sensor, with scalars or (B,) arrays.
name identifies the sensor, and type selects diode, rtd, or thermistor.
sample_rate_hz must give whole ticks, and latency_s sets delivery delay.
noise_rms_k sets per-sample white noise, and flicker_corner_hz sets flicker bandwidth.
resolution_k is the code LSB, and offset_k and gain_error_frac are per-device draws.
self_heating_k sets the sensor's temperature rise.

@classmethod
    def build(cls, B: int, dt_s: float, sensors) -> "TempSensorsHw":
        dt = float(dt_s)
        S = len(sensors)
        names, types, per, cmax = [], [], [], []
        lat = np.zeros((B, S), np.int64)
        tp = np.zeros((B, S, NTP))
        coefs = [[None] * S for _ in range(B)]
        for i, s in enumerate(sensors):
            names.append(str(s.get("name", f"t{i}")))
            types.append(TEMP_SENSOR_TYPES[str(s.get("type", "diode"))])
            p = rate_to_period_ticks(float(s.get("sample_rate_hz", 1e3)), dt, f"temp_sensors[{i}].sample_rate_hz")
            per.append(p)
            bits = int(s.get("adc_bits", 12))
            cmax.append((1 << bits) - 1)
            lat_s = _arr_b(s.get("latency_s", 1e-3), B, "latency_s")
            lat[:, i] = [seconds_to_ticks(float(x), dt, f"temp_sensors[{i}].latency_s") for x in lat_s]
            noise = _arr_b(s.get("noise_rms_k", 0.0), B, "noise_rms_k")
            res = _arr_b(s.get("resolution_k", 0.0625), B, "resolution_k")
            if np.any(res <= 0):
                raise ValueError(f"temp_sensors[{i}].resolution_k must be > 0")
            tp[:, i, _TP_NOISE] = noise
            tp[:, i, _TP_RESOLUTION] = res
            tp[:, i, _TP_OFFSET] = _arr_b(s.get("offset_k", 0.0), B, "offset_k")
            tp[:, i, _TP_GAIN_ERR] = _arr_b(s.get("gain_error_frac", 0.0), B, "gain_error_frac")
            tp[:, i, _TP_SELF_HEAT] = _arr_b(s.get("self_heating_k", 0.0), B, "self_heating_k")
            tp[:, i, _TP_ZERO_K] = _arr_b(s.get("code_zero_k", 233.15), B, "code_zero_k")
            tp[:, i, _TP_GAIN_REF_K] = _arr_b(s.get("gain_ref_k", _TEMP_GAIN_REF_K), B, "gain_ref_k")
            fcn = _arr_b(s.get("flicker_corner_hz", 0.0), B, "flicker_corner_hz")
            t_s = p * dt
            for b in range(B):
                # white PSD equivalent to sigma^2 per boxcar sample of length T_s - S = 2 sigma^2 T_s
                coefs[b][i] = flicker_coefficients(2.0 * noise[b] ** 2 * t_s, float(fcn[b]),
                                                   afe_type=AFE_INTEGRATE_DUMP, period_s=t_s, window_s=t_s)
        jmax = max((c.shape[0] for row in coefs for c in row), default=0)
        fl = np.zeros((B, S, jmax, N_FLICKER_COEF))
        for b in range(B):
            for i in range(S):
                fl[b, i, :coefs[b][i].shape[0]] = coefs[b][i]
        return cls(B=int(B), S=S, dt_s=dt, names=tuple(names), types=np.array(types, np.int64),
                   period_ticks=np.array(per, np.int64), latency_ticks=lat, code_max=np.array(cmax, np.int64),
                   tp=tp, fl_coef=fl)

returns: cls(B=int(B), S=S, dt_s=dt, names=tuple(names), types=np.array(types, np.int64), period_ticks=np.array(per, np.int64), latency_ticks=lat, code_max=np.array(cmax, np.int64), tp=tp, fl_coef=fl)

@classmethod
    def build(cls, B: int, N: int, dt_s: float, *, adc_bits: int = 12, v_full_scale_v=2.0, i_full_scale_a=0.032,
              rate_hz: float = 10e3, latency_s=1e-4, noise_rms_codes=0.0, average: bool = False) -> "ReadbackHw":
        dt = float(dt_s)
        bits = int(adc_bits)
        if not 1 <= bits <= 31:
            raise ValueError(f"ring.heater.readback.adc_bits = {bits}: the readback model supports 1..31 bits")
        code_max = (1 << bits) - 1

        lat = _arr_b(latency_s, B, "latency_s")
        lat_t = np.array([seconds_to_ticks(float(x), dt, "ring.heater.readback.latency_s") for x in lat], np.int64)
        return cls(B=int(B), N=int(N), dt_s=dt, adc_bits=bits, code_max=code_max, period_ticks=per,
                   latency_ticks=lat_t, lsb_v=_arr_b(v_full_scale_v, B, "v_full_scale_v") / code_max,
                   lsb_i=_arr_b(i_full_scale_a, B, "i_full_scale_a") / code_max,
                   noise_codes=_arr_b(noise_rms_codes, B, "noise_rms_codes"), average=int(bool(average)))

nodes.name: calculate_linear_hold_lag_weights
nodes.meaning: integrate one thermal lag with linearly varying source power.
comments: integrate one thermal lag with linearly varying source power.
for tau*dx/dt=-x+r*P, the update is x_next=a*x+r*(b_start*P_start+b_end*P_end).
with y=h/tau, a=exp(-y), b_end=1-(1-a)/y, and b_start=(1-a)/y-a.
use the Taylor forms at small y to avoid cancellation.
a nonpositive step leaves the state unchanged.

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def calculate_linear_hold_lag_weights(
    tau: float,  # tau = tau (s) - thermal lag time constant - type float scalar
    h: float,  # h = h (s) - thermal step duration - type float scalar
) -> tuple[
    float,  # return[0] = a (1) - retained state fraction - type float scalar
    float,  # return[1] = b_start (1) - weight on starting source power - type float scalar
    float,  # return[2] = b_end (1) - weight on ending source power - type float scalar
]:
    if h <= 0.0:
        return (
            1.0,
            0.0,
            0.0,
        )
    step_over_time_constant = h / tau
    state_retention = math.exp(-step_over_time_constant)
    if step_over_time_constant < 1.0e-3:
        step_ratio_squared = step_over_time_constant * step_over_time_constant
        step_ratio_cubed = step_ratio_squared * step_over_time_constant
        step_ratio_fourth = step_ratio_cubed * step_over_time_constant
        step_ratio_fifth = step_ratio_fourth * step_over_time_constant
        end_power_weight = (
            step_over_time_constant / 2.0
            - step_ratio_squared / 6.0
            + step_ratio_cubed / 24.0
            - step_ratio_fourth / 120.0
            + step_ratio_fifth / 720.0
        )
        start_power_weight = (
            step_over_time_constant / 2.0
            - step_ratio_squared / 3.0
            + step_ratio_cubed / 8.0
            - step_ratio_fourth / 30.0
            + step_ratio_fifth / 144.0
        )
        return (
            state_retention,
            start_power_weight,
            end_power_weight,
        )
    mean_state_retention = -math.expm1(-step_over_time_constant) / step_over_time_constant
    return (
        state_retention,
        mean_state_retention - state_retention,
        1.0 - mean_state_retention,
    )

nodes.name: calculate_linear_hold_coefficients
nodes.meaning: calculate exact thermal update coefficients for linearly varying source power.
comments: calculate exact thermal update coefficients for linearly varying source power.
x_next=a*x+c_start*P_start+c_end*P_end.
multiply each scalar hold weight by its thermal residue in K/W.
a zero-duration step retains every state.

source_ref.code:
def calculate_linear_hold_coefficients(
    taus_s: ArrayLike,  # taus_s = tau (s) - thermal time constants - type array-like, broadcast input shape
    res_k_per_w: ArrayLike,  # res_k_per_w = r (K/W) - thermal residues - type array-like, broadcast input shape
    h_s: float,  # h_s = h (s) - thermal step duration - type float scalar
) -> tuple[
    Float64Array,  # return[0] = a (1) - retained state fractions - type float64 ndarray, shape broadcast shape of time constants and residues
    Float64Array,  # return[1] = c_start (K/W) - starting-power coefficients - type float64 ndarray, shape broadcast shape of time constants and residues
    Float64Array,  # return[2] = c_end (K/W) - ending-power coefficients - type float64 ndarray, shape broadcast shape of time constants and residues
]:
    time_constants_s = np.asarray(taus_s, dtype=np.float64)
    thermal_residues_k_per_w = np.asarray(res_k_per_w, dtype=np.float64)
    step_duration_s = float(h_s)
    if step_duration_s < 0.0:
        raise ValueError(f"step h_s must be >= 0, got {h_s}")
    if np.any(~(time_constants_s > 0.0)):
        raise ValueError("every tau must be > 0")
    if step_duration_s == 0.0:
        one = np.ones(np.broadcast(time_constants_s, thermal_residues_k_per_w).shape)
        return (
            one,
            np.zeros_like(one),
            np.zeros_like(one),
        )
    step_over_time_constant = step_duration_s / time_constants_s
    state_retention = np.exp(-step_over_time_constant)
    mean_state_retention = -np.expm1(-step_over_time_constant) / step_over_time_constant
    end_power_weight = 1.0 - mean_state_retention
    start_power_weight = mean_state_retention - state_retention
    use_small_step_series = step_over_time_constant < _FOH_SERIES_Y
    if np.any(use_small_step_series):
        small_step_ratios = step_over_time_constant[use_small_step_series]
        end_power_weight[use_small_step_series] = (
            small_step_ratios / 2.0
            - small_step_ratios**2 / 6.0
            + small_step_ratios**3 / 24.0
            - small_step_ratios**4 / 120.0
            + small_step_ratios**5 / 720.0
        )
        start_power_weight[use_small_step_series] = (
            small_step_ratios / 2.0
            - small_step_ratios**2 / 3.0
            + small_step_ratios**3 / 8.0
            - small_step_ratios**4 / 30.0
            + small_step_ratios**5 / 144.0
        )
    state_retention, start_power_weight, end_power_weight = np.broadcast_arrays(
        state_retention, start_power_weight, end_power_weight
    )
    return (
        state_retention.copy(),
        start_power_weight * thermal_residues_k_per_w,
        end_power_weight * thermal_residues_k_per_w,
    )

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def advance_thermal_state_and_temperatures_for_world(
    state_rise_k: Float64Array,  # state_rise_k = x (K) - lag-state temperature rises updated in place - type float64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    state_retention: Float64Array,  # state_retention = a (1) - retained thermal state fractions - type float64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    start_power_gain_k_per_w: Float64Array,  # start_power_gain_k_per_w = c0 (K/W) - starting-power gain - type float64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    end_power_gain_k_per_w: Float64Array,  # end_power_gain_k_per_w = c1 (K/W) - ending-power gain - type float64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    lag_source_indices: Int64Array,  # lag_source_indices = s_m (1) - source index driving each lag - type int64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    observer_lag_boundaries: Int64Array,  # observer_lag_boundaries = p_observer (1) - lag-array boundaries of each observer - type int64 ndarray, shape (O+1,)
    start_source_power_w: Float64Array,  # start_source_power_w = P_start (W) - source powers at the step boundary - type float64 ndarray, shape (S,)
    end_source_power_w: Float64Array,  # end_source_power_w = P_end (W) - source powers at the step boundary - type float64 ndarray, shape (S,)
    source_residue_scale: Float64Array,  # source_residue_scale = s_source (1) - per-source residue multipliers - type float64 ndarray, shape (S,)
    base_temperature_k: float,  # base_temperature_k = T_base (K) - base temperature - type float scalar
    out_observer_temperature_k: Float64Array,  # out_observer_temperature_k = T_observer (K) - absolute observer temperatures written in place - type float64 ndarray, shape (O,)
) -> (
    None  # return = None - results are written into the supplied state or record - type None
):
    for observer_index in range(out_observer_temperature_k.shape[0]):
        temperature_k = base_temperature_k
        for lag_index in range(observer_lag_boundaries[observer_index], observer_lag_boundaries[observer_index + 1]):
            source_index = lag_source_indices[lag_index]
            next_lag_k = state_retention[lag_index] * state_rise_k[lag_index] + source_residue_scale[source_index] * (start_power_gain_k_per_w[lag_index] * start_source_power_w[source_index] + end_power_gain_k_per_w[lag_index] * end_source_power_w[source_index])
            state_rise_k[lag_index] = next_lag_k
            temperature_k += next_lag_k
        out_observer_temperature_k[observer_index] = temperature_k

def save_rom(
    path: str | Path,  # path = path (1) - thermal artifact path - type str or Path
    rom: ThermalRom,  # rom = model (mixed units) - extracted poles, thermal residues, and site metadata - type ThermalRom record
    sidecar: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,  # sidecar = metadata (mixed units) - optional artifact provenance and validation fields - type mapping or None
) -> (
    Path  # return = path (1) - written ROM artifact path - type Path
):
    path = Path(path)
    names = sorted(rom.site_offsets_um)
    offs = np.array([rom.site_offsets_um[n] for n in names], dtype=np.float64).reshape(len(names), 2)
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        np.savez(f, taus_s=np.asarray(rom.taus_s, np.float64), sources=np.array(rom.sources, dtype="U32"),
                 observers=np.array(rom.observers, dtype="U32"), self_res=np.asarray(rom.self_res, np.float64),
                 cross_r_um=np.asarray(rom.cross_r_um, np.float64), cross_res=np.asarray(rom.cross_res, np.float64),
                 site_offset_names=np.array(names, dtype="U32"), site_offsets_um=offs)
    side = dict(sidecar or {})
    side["schema"] = SCHEMA_ROM
    side["sha256"] = sha256_file(path)
    side["data_file"] = path.name
    with open(build_rom_sidecar_path(path), "w") as f:
        json.dump(side, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    return path

def add(
        self: _Lags,  # self = self (mixed units) - record fields and units described above the class - type _Lags record
        obs: int,  # obs = obs (1) - observer index - type int scalar
        src: int,  # src = src (1) - source index - type int scalar
        tau: ArrayLike,  # tau = tau (s) - lag time constant for each world - type array-like, scalar or shape (B,)
        res: ArrayLike,  # res = r (K/W) - thermal residue for each world - type array-like, scalar or shape (B,)
        layer: int,  # layer = layer (1) - fast or slow layer code - type int scalar
        pair: int,  # pair = pair (1) - self, cross-ring, or site pair code - type int scalar
        tailable: bool = False,  # tailable = tailable (1) - pair permits replacing its package tail - type bool scalar
        tail: bool = False,  # tail = tail (1) - this lag is a package tail - type bool scalar
        fixed_tau: bool = False,  # fixed_tau = fixed_tau (1) - keep the lag time constant absolute - type bool scalar
    ) -> (
        None  # return = None - results are written into the supplied state or record - type None
    ):
        self.observer_indices.append(obs)
        self.source_indices.append(src)
        self.time_constants_s.append(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(tau, float), (self.world_count,)).copy())
        self.residues_k_per_w.append(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(res, float), (self.world_count,)).copy())
        self.layer_codes.append(layer)
        self.pair_codes.append(pair)
        self.tail_replaceable.append(bool(tailable))
        self.tail_flags.append(bool(tail))
        self.fixed_time_constants.append(bool(fixed_tau))    # absolute tau - no time_scale, no 'resistance' factor

source_ref.code:
def append_interim_heat_path_lags(
    spec: InterimRom,  # spec = model (mixed units) - interim thermal resistance and time-constant parameters - type InterimRom record
    elements: _Elements,  # elements = elements (mixed units) - source and observer instances with ring attachments and coordinates - type thermal element builder
    layout: LayoutSites,  # layout = sites (um) - source and observer site coordinates - type LayoutSites record
    ring_count: int,  # ring_count = N (1) - number of rings - type int scalar
    world_count: int,  # world_count = B (1) - number of worlds - type int scalar
    parameter_arrays: dict[str, Float64Array],  # parameter_arrays = parameters (field units) - broadcast interim parameters in their named physical units - type dict of float64 ndarrays, shape (B, N)
    lag_builder: _Lags,  # lag_builder = lags (mixed units) - lag indices, time constants, and thermal residues - type thermal lag builder
) -> (
    None  # return = None - results are written into the supplied state or record - type None
):
    heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w = parameter_arrays["z0"]                                  # (B, N) K/W - Z0, heater -> ring at DC
    mean_heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w = heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w.mean(axis=1)
    optical_to_heater_gain_ratio = parameter_arrays["z_ratio"]                             # z = Z_opt/Z_heater
    fast_residue_share, tail_residue_share = parameter_arrays["share_fast"], parameter_arrays["tail_share"]   # f_F, f_T
    slow_residue_share = 1.0 - fast_residue_share - tail_residue_share                         # share of the slow pole tau_S
    fast_time_constants_s, slow_time_constants_s, tail_time_constants_s = parameter_arrays["tau_fast"], parameter_arrays["tau_slow"], parameter_arrays["tail_tau"]
    optical_self_residue_share = parameter_arrays["f_sh"]
    heater_self_gain_ratio = parameter_arrays["heater_self_ratio"]                   # h = R_th,H / Z0
    ring_radii_um = parameter_arrays["ring_radius"]                         # (B, N) um
    rank, ring_distances_um = calculate_neighbor_ranks_and_distances(layout.ring_xy_um)

    # convert centre spacing to a source-to-victim crosstalk time constant.
    def calculate_path_time_constant_s(
        d_cc: ArrayLike,  # d_cc = d_centres (um) - centre separation - type array-like, broadcast input shape
        r_src: ArrayLike,  # r_src = R_source (um) - element radius - type array-like, broadcast input shape
        r_obs: ArrayLike,  # r_obs = R_observer (um) - element radius - type array-like, broadcast input shape
    ) -> (
        Float64Array  # return = tau_cross (s) - time constants at source-to-victim distances - type float64 ndarray, shape (B,)
    ):
        # the law's distance is heat source to victim (its imec anchor, crosstalk_tau_s) - the centre distance less the radius of each ring element (0 for a point site)
        distance_um = np.maximum(d_cc - r_src - r_obs, 0.0)
        return calculate_crosstalk_time_constant_s(distance_um, parameter_arrays["xt_tau_ref"][:, 0], spec.xt_dist_ref_um, parameter_arrays["xt_tau_min"][:, 0],
                               None if spec.xt_tau_far_s is None else parameter_arrays["xt_tau_far"][:, 0], spec.xt_far_um,
                               spec.xt_tau_law)

    # evaluate the distance-based site coupling fraction.
    def calculate_path_coupling_fraction(
        distance_um: ArrayLike,  # distance_um = d (um) - source-to-observer distance - type array-like, broadcast input shape
    ) -> (
        Float64Array  # return = c_site (1) - site coupling fractions - type float64 ndarray, shape (B,)
    ):
        return calculate_site_coupling_fraction(distance_um, parameter_arrays["xt_nearest"][:, 0], parameter_arrays["site_floor"][:, 0], spec.site_ref_um, spec.site_max_frac)

    # Z = scale * S_H(s) for ring i's self-path shape.
    def append_heater_response_shape(
        observer_index: int,  # observer_index = o (1) - observer index - type int scalar
        source_index: int,  # source_index = s (1) - source index - type int scalar
        thermal_gain_k_per_w: ArrayLike,  # thermal_gain_k_per_w = Z_0 (K/W) - DC gain of the heater response shape - type array-like, shape (B,)
        ring_index: int,  # ring_index = i (1) - ring index - type int scalar
        pair_type: int,  # pair_type = pair (1) - pair type code - type int scalar
        with_tail: bool = True,  # with_tail = tail_enabled (1) - append the package-tail lag - type bool scalar
    ) -> (
        None  # return = None - results are written into the supplied state or record - type None
    ):
        lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, fast_time_constants_s[:, ring_index], thermal_gain_k_per_w * fast_residue_share[:, ring_index], LAYER_FAST, pair_type, tailable=True)
        lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, slow_time_constants_s[:, ring_index], thermal_gain_k_per_w * slow_residue_share[:, ring_index], LAYER_FAST, pair_type, tailable=True)
        if with_tail:
            lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, tail_time_constants_s[:, ring_index], thermal_gain_k_per_w * tail_residue_share[:, ring_index], LAYER_SLOW, pair_type, tailable=True, tail=True)

    ringlike = (SRC_WG, SRC_JUNCTION)
    n_src = len(elements.src_kind)
    n_obs = len(elements.obs_kind)
    for source_index in range(n_src):
        source_kind, source_ring, source_xy = elements.src_kind[source_index], elements.src_ring[source_index], elements.src_xy[source_index]
        for observer_index in range(n_obs):
            observer_kind, observer_ring, observer_xy = elements.obs_kind[observer_index], elements.obs_ring[observer_index], elements.obs_xy[observer_index]
            local_src = source_kind in (SRC_HEATER, SRC_WG, SRC_JUNCTION)
            local_obs = observer_kind in (OBS_RING, OBS_HEATER)
            if source_ring >= 0 and observer_ring >= 0:
                pair_type = PAIR_SELF if source_ring == observer_ring else PAIR_CROSS
            else:
                pair_type = PAIR_SITE
            if pair_type == PAIR_SELF and local_src and local_obs:
                ring_index = source_ring
                if source_kind == SRC_HEATER and observer_kind == OBS_RING:
                    append_heater_response_shape(observer_index, source_index, heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], ring_index, pair_type)
                elif source_kind == SRC_HEATER and observer_kind == OBS_HEATER:
                    append_heater_response_shape(observer_index, source_index, heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], ring_index, pair_type)
                    lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, parameter_arrays["heater_node_tau"][:, ring_index], (heater_self_gain_ratio[:, ring_index] - 1.0) * heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], LAYER_FAST, pair_type)
                elif source_kind in ringlike and observer_kind == OBS_RING:
                    # absorbed light -> ring temperature - four first-order terms, one per time scale with data.
                    # selfheat_tau (~0.4 us) - heat leaving the waveguide core [de Cea 2019].
                    # tau_fast (~3.2 us), tau_slow (~13 us) - the ring and nearby oxide [imec two-term fit].
                    # tail_tau (~ms) - the die and package (via add_shape).
                    # fewer terms would drop a time range.
                    # no public data supports more.
                    # real step-response data (docs/QUESTIONS_FOR_LIGHTMATTER.md, question 1) replaces these values.
                    lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, parameter_arrays["selfheat_tau"][:, ring_index], optical_to_heater_gain_ratio[:, ring_index] * optical_self_residue_share[:, ring_index] * heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], LAYER_FAST, pair_type)
                    append_heater_response_shape(observer_index, source_index, optical_to_heater_gain_ratio[:, ring_index] * (1.0 - optical_self_residue_share[:, ring_index]) * heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], ring_index, pair_type)
                else:   # ring-like source -> heater resistor - reciprocal of heater -> ring
                    append_heater_response_shape(observer_index, source_index, heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index], ring_index, pair_type)
                continue
            if pair_type == PAIR_CROSS and local_src and local_obs:
                source_ring_index, ring_index = source_ring, observer_ring                      # source ring j -> observer ring i
                neighbour_rank = rank[ring_index, source_ring_index]
                coupling_fraction = (parameter_arrays["xt_nearest"][:, 0] if neighbour_rank == 1 else
                     (parameter_arrays["xt_next"][:, 0] if (neighbour_rank == 2 and spec.xt_next_frac is not None)
                      else parameter_arrays["xt_floor"][:, 0]))
                if source_kind == SRC_HEATER and observer_kind == OBS_RING:
                    reference_gain = heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, source_ring_index]
                elif source_kind in ringlike and observer_kind == OBS_HEATER:
                    reference_gain = heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index]
                else:                                # heater<->heater or ring-like<->ring - symmetric
                    reference_gain = np.sqrt(heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, ring_index] * heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, source_ring_index])
                if spec.crosstalk_dynamics == "self":
                    append_heater_response_shape(observer_index, source_index, coupling_fraction * reference_gain, source_ring_index, pair_type)
                else:
                    lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, calculate_path_time_constant_s(ring_distances_um[ring_index, source_ring_index], ring_radii_um[:, source_ring_index], ring_radii_um[:, ring_index]),
                        coupling_fraction * reference_gain, LAYER_SLOW, pair_type)
                continue
            # site law - monitor PDs, drivers, temperature sensors, aggressors
            distance_um = float(np.linalg.norm(source_xy - observer_xy))
            if source_ring >= 0:
                reference_gain = heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, source_ring]
            elif observer_ring >= 0:
                reference_gain = heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w[:, observer_ring]
            else:
                reference_gain = mean_heater_ring_dc_gain_k_per_w
            # ring heat sources and ring/heater observers have nonzero spatial extent.
            source_radius_um = ring_radii_um[:, source_ring] if (source_ring >= 0 and local_src) else 0.0
            observer_radius_um = ring_radii_um[:, observer_ring] if (observer_ring >= 0 and local_obs) else 0.0
            lag_builder.add(observer_index, source_index, calculate_path_time_constant_s(distance_um, source_radius_um, observer_radius_um), calculate_path_coupling_fraction(distance_um) * reference_gain, LAYER_SLOW, pair_type)

    src: Int64Array,  # src = s_m (1) - source indices - type int64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    layer: Int64Array,  # layer = layer (1) - fast or slow layer code of each lag - type int64 ndarray, shape (M,)
    fixed: BoolArray,  # fixed = fixed_tau (1) - lags whose absolute time constants must not be rescaled - type bool ndarray, shape (M,)
    s_fast: ArrayLike,  # s_fast = s_fast (1) - fast-layer time-scale multipliers - type array-like, shape (B,)
    s_slow: ArrayLike,  # s_slow = s_slow (1) - slow-layer time-scale multipliers - type array-like, shape (B,)
    tau_split: float,  # tau_split = tau_split (s) - boundary between fast and slow time scales - type float scalar
) -> tuple[
    BoolArray,  # return[0] = whole_pair (1) - lags that require one shared pair time scale - type bool ndarray, shape (M,)
    Float64Array | None,  # return[1] = s_pair (1) - shared time scales, or None when no pair needs coupling - type float64 ndarray, shape (B, M), or None
]:
    M = obs.shape[0]
    whole = np.zeros(M, bool)
    free = ~fixed
    if M == 0 or not free.any():
        return (
            whole,
            None,
        )
    pair_keys = obs.astype(np.int64) * (int(src.max()) + 1) + src.astype(np.int64)
    _, pair_index = np.unique(pair_keys, return_inverse=True)
    pair_index = pair_index.reshape(-1)
    n_pairs = int(pair_index.max()) + 1
    free_pair_index = pair_index[free]
    has_fast = np.zeros(n_pairs, bool)
    has_slow = np.zeros(n_pairs, bool)
    has_fast[free_pair_index[layer[free] == LAYER_FAST]] = True
    has_slow[free_pair_index[layer[free] != LAYER_FAST]] = True
    B = res.shape[0]
    min_residue = np.full((n_pairs, B), np.inf)
    max_residue = np.full((n_pairs, B), -np.inf)
    np.minimum.at(min_residue, free_pair_index, res[:, free].T)
    np.maximum.at(max_residue, free_pair_index, res[:, free].T)
    mixed = np.any((min_residue < 0.0) & (max_residue > 0.0), axis=1)
    coupled_pairs = has_fast & has_slow & mixed
    whole = free & coupled_pairs[pair_index]
    if not whole.any():
        return (
            whole,
            None,
        )
    whole_pair_index = pair_index[whole]
    dc = np.zeros((n_pairs, B))
    step_at_split = np.zeros((n_pairs, B))
    np.add.at(dc, whole_pair_index, res[:, whole].T)
    np.add.at(step_at_split, whole_pair_index, (res[:, whole] * -np.expm1(-float(tau_split) / tau[:, whole])).T)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        w = np.clip(np.where(dc != 0.0, step_at_split / dc, 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)        # (G, B)
        fast_factor = np.asarray(s_fast, float)[None, :]
        slow_factor = np.asarray(s_slow, float)[None, :]
        k = np.where(fast_factor == slow_factor, fast_factor,
            np.exp(w * np.log(fast_factor) + (1.0 - w) * np.log(slow_factor)))
    return (
        whole,
        np.ascontiguousarray(k[pair_index].T),
    )

nodes.name: assemble
nodes.meaning: assemble the source-to-observer thermal system for the requested ring layout.
comments: assemble the source-to-observer thermal system for the requested ring layout.
expand extracted or interim heat paths over every included source and observer.
apply DC, crosstalk, and time-scale factors without changing the selected uncertainty model.
preserve mixed-sign pair cancellation and the DC gain of replaced package tails.
prune negligible residues and sort lags by observer, source, and time constant.
classify optical heat paths for the implicit self-heating solver.
nodes.signature: assemble(rom: ThermalRom | InterimRom, layout: LayoutSites | Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None, n_rings: int, scales: ThermalScales | Mapping[str, Any] | None=None, *, sources: Sequence[str] | None=None, observers: Sequence[str] | None=None, temp_sensors: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None=None, ring_pitch_um: float | None=None, prune_abs_k_per_w: float=0.0)

source_ref.code:
def assemble(
    rom: ThermalRom | InterimRom,  # rom = model (mixed units) - extracted or interim thermal heat-path model - type ThermalRom or InterimRom record
    layout: LayoutSites | Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None,  # layout = layout (um) - site coordinates or layout records - type LayoutSites, mapping, or None
    n_rings: int,  # n_rings = N (1) - number of rings - type int scalar
    scales: ThermalScales | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,  # scales = scales (mixed units) - thermal uncertainty factors and optional package-tail parameters - type ThermalScales record, mapping, or None
    *,
    sources: Sequence[str] | None = None,  # sources = source_kinds (1) - source kind names to include, or all kinds - type sequence of strings or None
    observers: Sequence[str] | None = None,  # observers = observer_kinds (1) - observer kind names to include, or all kinds - type sequence of strings or None
    temp_sensors: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,  # temp_sensors = sensors (mixed units) - sensor site or attachment records - type sequence of mappings or None
    ring_pitch_um: float | None = None,  # ring_pitch_um = d_pitch (um) - optional spacing for missing ring sites - type float or None
    prune_abs_k_per_w: float = 0.0,  # prune_abs_k_per_w = r_min (K/W) - prune lags whose residue magnitude never exceeds this threshold - type float scalar
) -> (
    ThermalSystem  # return = system (mixed units) - assembled and scaled source-to-observer heat paths - type ThermalSystem record
):
    ring_count = int(n_rings)
    if layout is None:
        if ring_count != 1:
            raise ValueError("layout is required for more than one ring")
        layout = LayoutSites(np.zeros((1, 2)))
    elif not isinstance(layout, LayoutSites):
        layout = LayoutSites.from_sites(layout, ring_count, ring_pitch_um, temp_sensors)
    if layout.n_rings != ring_count:
        raise ValueError(f"layout has {layout.n_rings} rings, n_rings is {ring_count}")
    if scales is None:
        scales = ThermalScales()
    elif isinstance(scales, Mapping):
        scales = ThermalScales(**scales)
    src_kinds = tuple(SOURCE_KINDS if sources is None else sources)
    obs_kinds = tuple(OBSERVER_KINDS if observers is None else observers)
    for k in src_kinds:
        if k not in SOURCE_KINDS:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown source kind {k!r}")
    for k in obs_kinds:
        if k not in OBSERVER_KINDS:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown observer kind {k!r}")

    scale_arrays = {"time_scale_fast": normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.time_scale_fast, "time_scale_fast"),
          "time_scale_slow": normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.time_scale_slow, "time_scale_slow"),
          "crosstalk_scale": normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.crosstalk_scale, "crosstalk_scale")}
    if scales.package_tail_share_frac is not None:
        scale_arrays["pkg_tail_share"] = normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.package_tail_share_frac, "package_tail_share_frac")
        # default tau when only the share is drawn - assumed 4 ms, [CO22-TCPMT] circuit-level start-up (row T2)
        scale_arrays["pkg_tail_tau"] = normalize_world_parameter_vector(4.0e-3 if scales.package_tail_tau_s is None else scales.package_tail_tau_s,
                               "package_tail_tau_s")
    if isinstance(scales.dc_scale, Mapping):
        for k, v in scales.dc_scale.items():
            scale_arrays[f"dc[{k}]"] = normalize_world_parameter_vector(v, f"dc_scale[{k}]")
    else:
        scale_arrays["dc"] = normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.dc_scale, "dc_scale")
    scale_arrays["transport_delay_s"] = normalize_world_parameter_vector(scales.transport_delay_s, "transport_delay_s")
    if np.any(~(scale_arrays["transport_delay_s"] >= 0.0)):
        raise ValueError("transport_delay_s must be >= 0")
    hyp_raw = scales.scaling_hypothesis
    scale_arrays["scaling_hypothesis"] = np.zeros(1 if isinstance(hyp_raw,
        str) else np.asarray(hyp_raw).reshape(-1).shape[0])
    meta: dict = {"n_rings": ring_count}

    if isinstance(rom, InterimRom):
        interim_params = validate_and_broadcast_interim_parameters(rom, ring_count)
        world_count = infer_world_count({**scale_arrays, **{k: v[:, 0] if v.shape[1] == 1 else v for k, v in interim_params.items()}})
        interim_params = {k: np.broadcast_to(v, (world_count, ring_count)) for k, v in interim_params.items()}
        elements, element_indices = build_thermal_sources_and_observers(layout, ring_count, src_kinds, obs_kinds, rom.pd_offset_um,
            rom.temp_sensor_offset_um,
                                  rom.driver_offset_um)
        lags = _Lags(world_count)
        append_interim_heat_path_lags(rom, elements, layout, ring_count, world_count, interim_params, lags)
        meta.update(model="interim", name=rom.name, crosstalk_dynamics=rom.crosstalk_dynamics,
                    xt_tau_law=rom.xt_tau_law)
        bad = (interim_params["z_ratio"] * (1.0 - interim_params["f_sh"]) < 1.0 - 1e-12)
        if np.any(bad):
            warnings.warn("interim thermal model: z_ratio*(1 - selfheat_share) < 1, so the heater/ring residue matrix "
                          "of the heater poles is not positive semidefinite (not a passive RC network); "
                          "selfheat_share_frac = (z - 1)/z restores it", RuntimeWarning, stacklevel=2)
    elif isinstance(rom, ThermalRom):
        world_count = infer_world_count(scale_arrays)
        for nm in ("monitor_pd", "temp_sensor"):
            if nm in obs_kinds and nm in rom.observers and nm not in rom.site_offsets_um:
                warnings.warn(f"thermal ROM has no site offset for {nm}; its sites are placed at the ring centre",
                              RuntimeWarning, stacklevel=2)
        # include drivers at explicit layout sites.
        # an explicitly requested driver may use the ROM default offset.
        # G26 places its drivers on a separate EIC beside the PIC.
        driver_offset = (rom.site_offsets_um.get("driver") if ("driver" in rom.sources and sources is not None
                                                         and "driver" in sources) else None)
        elements, element_indices = build_thermal_sources_and_observers(layout, ring_count, src_kinds, obs_kinds,
                                  rom.site_offsets_um.get("monitor_pd", (0.0, 0.0)),
                                  rom.site_offsets_um.get("temp_sensor", (0.0, 0.0)), driver_offset)
        lags = _Lags(world_count)
        append_extracted_heat_path_lags(rom, elements, layout, world_count, float(scales.tau_split_s), lags, meta)
        meta.update(model="rom", rom_path=rom.meta.get("path"), rom_sha256=rom.meta.get("sha256"),
                    family=rom.meta.get("family"), film_nm=rom.meta.get("film_nm"))
    else:
        raise TypeError(f"rom must be a ThermalRom or an InterimRom, got {type(rom).__name__}")

    if "pkg_tail_share" in scale_arrays:
        package_tail_share = np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["pkg_tail_share"], (world_count,))
        if np.any((package_tail_share < 0) | (package_tail_share >= 1)):
            raise ValueError("package_tail_share_frac must be in [0, 1)")
        replace_package_tail_preserving_dc_gain(lags, np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["pkg_tail_tau"], (world_count,)), package_tail_share)

    lag_count = len(lags.observer_indices)
    if lag_count == 0:
        raise ValueError("the assembled thermal system has no lags (no sources or observers)")
    time_constants_s = np.stack(lags.time_constants_s, axis=1)
    thermal_residues_k_per_w = np.stack(lags.residues_k_per_w, axis=1)
    lag_observer_indices = np.array(lags.observer_indices, np.int64)
    lag_source_indices = np.array(lags.source_indices, np.int64)
    lag_layers = np.array(lags.layer_codes, np.int64)
    lag_pair_types = np.array(lags.pair_codes, np.int64)
    lag_tail_flags = np.array(lags.tail_flags, np.int64)
    fixed_time_constants = np.array(lags.fixed_time_constants, bool)
    src_kind = np.array(elements.src_kind, np.int64)
    src_ring = np.array(elements.src_ring, np.int64)
    obs_kind = np.array(elements.obs_kind, np.int64)
    obs_ring = np.array(elements.obs_ring, np.int64)

    # per-world scaling
    hypothesis_codes = encode_thermal_scaling_hypotheses(scales.scaling_hypothesis, world_count)
    dc_factors = np.ones((world_count, lag_count))
    for m in range(lag_count):
        dc_factors[:, m] = calculate_pair_dc_scale(scales.dc_scale, SOURCE_KINDS[src_kind[lag_source_indices[m]]],
            OBSERVER_KINDS[obs_kind[lag_observer_indices[m]]], world_count)
    cross_factors = np.ones((world_count, lag_count))
    cross_factors[:, lag_pair_types == PAIR_CROSS] = np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["crosstalk_scale"], (world_count,))[:, None]
    fast_time_scale = np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["time_scale_fast"], (world_count,))
    slow_time_scale = np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["time_scale_slow"], (world_count,))
    time_factors = np.where(lag_layers[None, :] == LAYER_FAST, fast_time_scale[:, None], slow_time_scale[:, None])
    # give each mixed-sign pair one time factor when its poles span both layers.
    # independent layer factors would separate cancelling poles.
    whole_pair_mask, whole_pair_factors = calculate_shared_pair_time_scales(time_constants_s, thermal_residues_k_per_w, lag_observer_indices, lag_source_indices, lag_layers, fixed_time_constants, fast_time_scale, slow_time_scale,
        float(scales.tau_split_s))
    if whole_pair_factors is not None:
        time_factors = np.where(whole_pair_mask[None, :], whole_pair_factors, time_factors)
    meta["time_scale_whole_pairs"] = int(np.unique(
        lag_observer_indices[whole_pair_mask] * len(elements.src_kind) + lag_source_indices[whole_pair_mask]).size)
    resistance = (hypothesis_codes == SCALING_HYPOTHESES.index("resistance"))[:, None]
    # tau follows dc_factors under 'resistance' (tau = RC).
    # crosstalk_scale is a magnitude uncertainty and never moves tau.
    # a package tail given in ThermalScales keeps its absolute tau
    time_constants_s = np.where(fixed_time_constants[None, :], time_constants_s, time_constants_s * time_factors * np.where(resistance, dc_factors, 1.0))
    thermal_residues_k_per_w = thermal_residues_k_per_w * dc_factors * cross_factors
    if np.any(~(time_constants_s > 0)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(time_constants_s)):
        raise ValueError("assembled time constants must be finite and > 0 (check time scales and dc_scale)")

    # prune, sort by observer, then source, then tau
    keep = np.any(np.abs(thermal_residues_k_per_w) > float(prune_abs_k_per_w), axis=0)
    if prune_abs_k_per_w == 0.0:
        keep = np.any(thermal_residues_k_per_w != 0.0, axis=0)
    order = np.lexsort((time_constants_s[0], lag_source_indices, lag_observer_indices))
    order = order[keep[order]]
    time_constants_s, thermal_residues_k_per_w, lag_observer_indices, lag_source_indices, lag_layers, lag_pair_types, lag_tail_flags = (time_constants_s[:, order], thermal_residues_k_per_w[:, order], lag_observer_indices[order], lag_source_indices[order], lag_layers[order],
                                             lag_pair_types[order], lag_tail_flags[order])
    observer_count = obs_kind.shape[0]
    obs_ptr = np.zeros(observer_count + 1, np.int64)
    np.add.at(obs_ptr, lag_observer_indices + 1, 1)
    obs_ptr = np.cumsum(obs_ptr)

    kind = np.zeros(lag_observer_indices.shape[0], np.int64)
    optical_source_mask = src_kind[lag_source_indices] == SRC_WG
    ring_observer_mask = obs_kind[lag_observer_indices] == OBS_RING
    same_ring_mask = src_ring[lag_source_indices] == obs_ring[lag_observer_indices]
    kind[optical_source_mask & ring_observer_mask & same_ring_mask] = LAG_OPT_SELF
    kind[optical_source_mask & ring_observer_mask & ~same_ring_mask] = LAG_OPT_CROSS_RING
    kind[optical_source_mask & ~ring_observer_mask] = LAG_OPT_OTHER

    meta.update(scaling_hypothesis=[SCALING_HYPOTHESES[c] for c in np.unique(hypothesis_codes)],
                tail_from_scales="pkg_tail_share" in scale_arrays, layout=layout)
    return ThermalSystem(
        np.ascontiguousarray(time_constants_s), np.ascontiguousarray(thermal_residues_k_per_w), lag_source_indices, lag_observer_indices, kind, lag_pair_types, lag_layers, lag_tail_flags, obs_ptr,
        src_kind, src_ring, tuple(elements.src_names), obs_kind, obs_ring, tuple(elements.obs_names),
        element_indices["ring_obs"], element_indices["heater_obs"], element_indices["pd_obs"],
        element_indices["temp_obs"], element_indices["heater_src"], element_indices["wg_src"],
        element_indices["junction_src"], element_indices["driver_src"], element_indices["aggressor_src"],
        np.flatnonzero((kind == LAG_OPT_SELF) | (kind == LAG_OPT_OTHER)).astype(np.int64), ring_count, meta,
        np.broadcast_to(scale_arrays["transport_delay_s"], (world_count,)).copy())
