def _kind_run(exp: Experiment, log) -> tuple[dict, list[CaseResult], list[str], bool | None, str, dict]:
    (main,) = _plan(exp)
    lines = _report_header(exp, main.controller is not None)
    ok, results, extra, glines = _compression_gate(exp, main, log)
    lines += glines
    if not ok:
        summary = {"status": "refused", "reason": glines[-1], "convergence": extra.get("convergence")}
        return summary, results, lines, None, "refused", extra
    r = _execute(exp, main, log)
    results.append(r)
    ws = world_summary(r.metrics)
    summary = {"status": "ok", "world_summary": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in ws.items()},
               "start": main.start, "batch": main.batch, "duration_s": main.duration_s}
    lines.append(f"start {main.start}; B = {main.batch}; {main.duration_s:g} s simulated; wall {r.wall_s:.1f} s")
    lines += _world_table({"main": ws})
    passed, status = _criteria_step(exp, [r], lines, summary)
    summary["status"] = status
    return summary, results, lines, passed, status, extra

def _kind_sweep(exp, log):
    _refuse_compression(exp, "sweep")
    cases = _plan(exp)
    _prebuild(exp, cases)
    results = []
    rows = {}
    pts = []
    for c in cases:
        r = _execute(exp, c, log)
        results.append(r)
        rows[f"{c.label} {json.dumps(c.meta['assignment'], default=str)}"] = world_summary(r.metrics)
        pts.append({"label": c.label, "assignment": c.meta["assignment"],
                    "world_summary": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in world_summary(r.metrics).items()}})
    lines = _report_header(exp, any(c.controller is not None for c in cases)) + _world_table(rows)
    summary = {"points": pts}
    passed, status = _criteria_step(exp, results, lines, summary, "every point")
    return summary, results, lines, passed, status, {}

def _criteria_lines(ev: Sequence[dict], title: str) -> list[str]:
    out = ["## Criteria" + (f" ({title})" if title else ""),
           "| id | metric | op | value | worst | pass | source |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for e in ev:
        rings = "" if e["rings"] is None else f" rings {e['rings']}"
        out.append(f"| {e['id']} | {e['metric']} ({e['reduce']}{rings}) | {e['op']} | {_fmt(e['value'])} | "
                   f"{_fmt(e['worst'])} | {'PASS' if e['pass'] else 'FAIL'} | {e['source']} |")
    return out

comments: solve one locked steady-state survey and return its CaseResult, summary and arrays.
amb contains ambient temperatures in degC.
bv contains bias voltages in V.

source_ref.code:
def _locked_steady_state_case(exp: Experiment, cfg, amb, bv, u, v, label: str, log
                              ) -> tuple[CaseResult, dict, dict]:
    from mrm.sim import runner
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as wl:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        survey = runner.solve_locked_steady_state(cfg, ambient_c=amb, bias_v=bv, batch=exp.batch, seeds=exp.seeds,
                                                  p_in_w=exp.option("p_in_w"), uncertainty=u, variation=v)
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
    log(f"  {label}: {amb.size} ambient x {bv.size} bias x B = {exp.batch}, {wall:.1f} s wall")
    arrays = {k: np.asarray(getattr(survey, k)) for k in ("ambient_c", "bias_v", "detuning_target_m", "reloma_db",
                                                          "reloma_unrestricted_db", "t_ring_k", "p_abs_w",
                                                          "p_heater_w", "heater_code", "code_ok", "fsr_hop_risk",
                                                          "wrong_line_risk", "code_range_coverage",
                                                          "bnd4_reloma_variation_db", "supply_scale",
                                                          "supply_limited")}
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore", category=RuntimeWarning)
        bank = 10 * np.log10(np.nanmean(10 ** (arrays["reloma_db"] / 10), axis=3))          # (A, V, B)
    arrays["oracle_reloma_bank_db"] = bank
    fin = np.isfinite(arrays["heater_code"])
    summary = {
        "code_range_coverage": arrays["code_range_coverage"].tolist(),
        "points_without_code": int((~arrays["code_ok"]).sum()),
        "fsr_hop_risk_points": int(arrays["fsr_hop_risk"].sum()),
        "supply_limited_points": int(arrays["supply_limited"].sum()),
        "supply_scale_min": float(arrays["supply_scale"].min()) if arrays["supply_scale"].size else 1.0,
        "wrong_line_risk_max": int(arrays["wrong_line_risk"].max()) if arrays["wrong_line_risk"].size else 0,
        "wrong_line_risk_mean": float(arrays["wrong_line_risk"].mean()) if arrays["wrong_line_risk"].size else 0.0,
        "bnd4_reloma_variation_db": arrays["bnd4_reloma_variation_db"].tolist(),
        "bnd4_max_db": float(np.nanmax(arrays["bnd4_reloma_variation_db"])),
        "oracle_reloma_bank_db": bank.tolist(),
        "heater_code_min": float(np.nanmin(arrays["heater_code"])) if fin.any() else float("nan"),
        "heater_code_max": float(np.nanmax(arrays["heater_code"])) if fin.any() else float("nan"),
        "notes": list(survey.notes), "wall_s": wall,
        "warnings": sorted({f"{w.category.__name__}: {w.message}" for w in wl}),
    }
    metrics = {"world": {"code_range_coverage": arrays["code_range_coverage"],
                         "bnd4_max_db": np.nanmax(arrays["bnd4_reloma_variation_db"], axis=0)},
               "bnd4_reloma_variation_db": arrays["bnd4_reloma_variation_db"],
               "code_range_coverage": arrays["code_range_coverage"],
               "fsr_hop_risk_points": arrays["fsr_hop_risk"].sum(axis=(0, 1)),
               "supply_limited_points": arrays["supply_limited"].sum(axis=(0, 1)),
               "wrong_line_risk_max": arrays["wrong_line_risk"].max(axis=(0, 1)),
               "no_code_points": (~arrays["code_ok"]).sum(axis=(0, 1))}
    res = CaseResult(label=label, metrics=metrics, trace=None, truth_final={},
                     manifest_inputs={"locked_steady_state": True, "uncertainty": u, "variation": v, "batch": exp.batch,
                                      "seeds": exp.seeds, "p_in_w": exp.option("p_in_w"),
                                      "config_hash": cfg.hash(), "case_config_hash": cfg.hash()},
                     wall_s=wall, warnings=summary["warnings"], group="locked_steady_state")
    return res, summary, arrays

nodes.name: _kind_locked_steady_state
nodes.meaning: survey the main config and each requested corner at locked steady state.
comments: survey the main config and each requested corner at locked steady state.
default to ambient 0..105 degC in 5 K steps and bias 1.0..3.75 V in 0.25 V steps.
Report code coverage, FSR-hop risk, wrong-line risk and the oracle relOMA map.
BND-4 asks for less than 1 dB variation over ambient.

source_ref.code:
def _kind_locked_steady_state(exp, log):
    g = exp.grid
    amb = np.asarray(g.get("ambient_c", np.arange(0.0, 105.0 + 1e-9, 5.0)), float)
    bv = np.asarray(g.get("bias_v", np.arange(1.0, 3.75 + 1e-9, 0.25)), float)
    extra_keys = set(g) - {"ambient_c", "bias_v"}
    if extra_keys:
        raise ExperimentError(f"locked_steady_state grid takes ambient_c and bias_v only, got {sorted(extra_keys)}")
    u, v = _uncertainty_variation(exp, default_unc="nominal", default_var="off")
    cases = [("locked_steady_state", {})] + [(f"locked_steady_state/corner/{cn}", calts)
                                             for cn, calts in _corners(exp, ())]
    results, per, arrays_all = [], {}, {}
    for label, calts in cases:
        cfg = exp.config((), calts) if calts else exp.cfg
        r, sm, ar = _locked_steady_state_case(exp, cfg, amb, bv, u, v, label, log)
        results.append(r)
        per[label] = sm
        arrays_all[label.replace("/", "|")] = ar
    main = per["locked_steady_state"]
    arrays = arrays_all["locked_steady_state"]
    bank = arrays["oracle_reloma_bank_db"]
    summary = {"ambient_c": amb.tolist(), "bias_v": bv.tolist(), "batch": exp.batch, "uncertainty": u,
               "variation": v, **main, "cases": {k: {kk: vv for kk, vv in sm.items() if kk != "oracle_reloma_bank_db"}
                                                 for k, sm in per.items()}}
    lines = _report_header(exp, False)
    lines.append(f"locked steady state (validation bound BND-4): {amb.size} ambient points "
                 f"{_fmt(amb.min())}..{_fmt(amb.max())} degC x {bv.size} bias points {_fmt(bv.min())}..{_fmt(bv.max())}"
                 f" V, B = {exp.batch} ({u}, variation {v})")
    lines.append("| case | code-range coverage | points without a code | FSR-hop risk points | supply-limited points "
                 "(min droop) | wrong-line risk max (mean) | heater codes | BND-4 max (dB) |")
    lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for lab, sm in per.items():
        lines.append(f"| {lab} | {_fmt(sm['code_range_coverage'])} | {sm['points_without_code']} | "
                     f"{sm['fsr_hop_risk_points']} | {sm['supply_limited_points']} ({_fmt(sm['supply_scale_min'])}) | "
                     f"{sm['wrong_line_risk_max']} ({_fmt(sm['wrong_line_risk_mean'])}) "
                     f"| {_fmt(sm['heater_code_min'])}..{_fmt(sm['heater_code_max'])} | {_fmt(sm['bnd4_max_db'])} |")
    lines.append("code-range coverage: fraction of (ambient, bias) points with every ring reachable within the array "
                 "heater supply limit; points without a code count rings (a supply-limited point counts all of its "
                 "rings); supply-limited: the bank's lock powers exceed the supply, with the smallest "
                 "droop factor; wrong-line risk: foreign lines a heater-up sweep from code_min crosses; BND-4: oracle "
                 "relOMA variation over ambient at a fixed bias (BND-4 asks < 1 dB; only a heater-temperature loss "
                 "mechanism can move it)")
    lines.append("oracle relOMA, bank mean (dB, OMA / P_in), world 0, rows ambient, columns bias:")
    lines.append("| degC | " + " | ".join(_fmt(b) for b in bv) + " |")
    lines.append("|---" * (bv.size + 1) + "|")
    for ia, a in enumerate(amb):
        lines.append(f"| {_fmt(a)} | " + " | ".join(_fmt(bank[ia, iv, 0], 2) for iv in range(bv.size)) + " |")
    passed, status = _criteria_step(exp, results, lines, summary)
    # one layout with or without corners - /locked_steady_state/<case label, '/' -> '|'>/<array>
    extra = {"locked_steady_state": arrays_all}
    return summary, results, lines, passed, status, extra

nodes.meaning: run an experiment and normally write `<runs_dir>/<UTC>_<hash8>/`.
comments: run an experiment and normally write `<runs_dir>/<UTC>_<hash8>/`.
`experiment` accepts a YAML path, preset name, Config or Experiment.
`overrides` and `alts` follow `load`.
`options` sets extension options from Python, such as {"n_threads": 4}.
`kind` overrides experiment.kind.
`runs_dir` defaults to $MRM_RUNS_DIR or ./runs.
set `write` False to return results without a run directory.
`argv` records command arguments in the manifest and defaults to sys.argv.
`log` receives progress lines and defaults to stderr.
`rerun_of` records the reproduced run id.
return an ExperimentResult.
nodes.signature: run(experiment, *, overrides=None, alts=None, options: Mapping | None=None, kind: str | None=None, runs_dir: str | Path | None=None, write: bool=True, argv: Sequence[str] | None=None, log: Callable[[str], None] | None=None, rerun_of: str | None=None)

source_ref.code:
def run(experiment, *, overrides=None, alts=None, options: Mapping | None = None, kind: str | None = None,
        runs_dir: str | Path | None = None, write: bool = True, argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None, rerun_of: str | None = None) -> ExperimentResult:
    log = log or (lambda s: print(s, file=sys.stderr, flush=True))
    ov = list(_plain_override_list(overrides)) if overrides else []
    if kind is not None:
        kind = KIND_ALIASES.get(kind, kind)
        if kind not in KINDS:
            raise ExperimentError(f"kind {kind!r} not in {KINDS}")
        ov.append(f"experiment.kind={kind}")
    exp = _as_experiment(experiment, ov or None, alts, options)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    import datetime as dt
    started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    log(f"mrm experiment {exp.name}: kind {exp.kind}, hash {exp.hash[:8]}")
    from mrm.sim import manifest
    state0 = {"git": manifest.git_state(), "environment": manifest.environment()} if write else {}
    summary, results, lines, passed, status, extra = _KIND_RUNNERS[exp.kind](exp, log)
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0
    if passed is not None:
        lines.insert(1 if lines and lines[0] == Q1_CAVEAT else 0, f"RESULT: {'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}")
    elif status != "ok":
        lines.insert(1 if lines and lines[0] == Q1_CAVEAT else 0, f"RESULT: {status.upper()}")
    lines.append(f"wall time {wall:.1f} s")
    report = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    cases = {r.label: r for r in results}
    res = ExperimentResult(kind=exp.kind, name=exp.name, experiment_hash=exp.hash, cases=cases, summary=summary,
                           report=report, passed=passed, status=status, run_dir=None, wall_s=wall, extra=extra)
    if write:
        res.run_dir = _write_run(exp, res, started, argv, rerun_of, runs_dir, state0)
        log(f"run directory: {res.run_dir}")
    return res

def _write_run(exp: Experiment, res: ExperimentResult, started, argv, rerun_of, runs_dir,
               state0: Mapping | None = None) -> Path:
    from mrm.sim import manifest
    d = manifest.new_run_dir(runs_dir, exp.hash[:8], now=started)
    run_id = d.name
    src = exp.source
    inputs = []
    if src.get("path"):
        copies = src.get("input_copies") or _input_copies(Path(src["path"]))
        for c in copies:
            (d / "inputs" / c["name"]).write_text(c["text"])
            e = {"file": f"inputs/{c['name']}", "original": c["original"], "sha256": c["sha256"]}
            if c.get("corner") is not None:
                e["corner"] = c["corner"]
            inputs.append(e)
    # resolved YAML includes config provenance, resolved options and source details
    import yaml
    tree = exp.cfg.resolved_tree()
    tree.setdefault("experiment", {})
    for k, v in exp.resolved_options().items():
        tree["experiment"][k] = manifest.to_jsonable(v["value"])
    tree["_source"] = {"files": list(exp.cfg.files), "overrides": list(src.get("overrides") or []),
                       "alts": dict(src.get("alts") or {}), "options_given": sorted(
                           k for k, v in exp.resolved_options().items() if v["given"])}
    (d / "experiment.resolved.yaml").write_text(
        "# experiment.resolved.yaml: every config leaf with its provenance, the resolved experiment\n"
        "# options and the source; written by mrm.sim.experiment\n"
        + yaml.safe_dump(manifest.to_jsonable(tree), sort_keys=True, default_flow_style=None, width=120))
    # include artefacts from every case because corners and sweep points can select different thermal ROMs
    arts = _artefacts_of_cases(exp)
    case_hashes = sorted({r.manifest_inputs.get("case_config_hash") for r in res.cases.values()
                          if r.manifest_inputs.get("case_config_hash")})
    man = {
        "schema": manifest.MANIFEST_SCHEMA, "run_id": run_id, "kind": exp.kind, "name": exp.name,
        "status": res.status, "passed": res.passed,
        "experiment_hash": exp.hash, "config_hash": exp.cfg.hash(), "case_config_hashes": case_hashes,
        "created_utc": started.isoformat(), "wall_s": res.wall_s, "rerun_of": rerun_of,
        # use code and environment details captured at run start so later edits cannot change the manifest
        "git": (state0 or {}).get("git") or manifest.git_state(),
        "environment": (state0 or {}).get("environment") or manifest.environment(),
        "argv": list(argv) if argv is not None else list(sys.argv),
        "seeds": exp.seeds, "source": {"path": src.get("path"), "overrides": list(src.get("overrides") or []),
                                       "alts": dict(src.get("alts") or {}), "chain": src.get("chain") or [],
                                       "inputs": inputs},
        "options": {k: v["value"] for k, v in exp.resolved_options().items()},
        "artefacts": arts,
        "cases": {lab: {"manifest_inputs": r.manifest_inputs, "wall_s": r.wall_s, "warnings": r.warnings,
                        "group": r.group, "meta": r.meta,
                        "self_reference": None if r.reference is None else {
                            "duration_s": r.reference["duration_s"], "window_s": r.reference["window_s"]}}
                  for lab, r in res.cases.items()},
        "perf_reference": PERF_REFERENCE["source"],
    }
    if "convergence" in res.extra:
        manifest.write_json(d / "convergence.json", res.extra["convergence"])
        man["convergence"] = {"file": "convergence.json",
                              "max_validated_factor": res.extra["convergence"].get("max_validated_factor")
                              if "max_validated_factor" in res.extra["convergence"]
                              else (res.extra["convergence"].get("certificate") or {}).get("max_validated_factor")}
    res.manifest = man
    manifest.write_json(d / "manifest.json", man)
    manifest.write_json(d / "metrics.json", {"kind": exp.kind, "name": exp.name, "status": res.status,
                                       "passed": res.passed, "summary": res.summary,
                                       "cases": {lab: _metrics_for_json(r.metrics) for lab, r in res.cases.items()}})
    groups: dict = {"metrics": {}, "trace": {}, "truth_final": {}, "self_reference": {}}
    for lab, r in res.cases.items():
        key = lab.replace("/", "|")
        mm = {k: v for k, v in r.metrics.items() if k != "settings"}
        if "detuning_histogram" in mm:
            mm["detuning_histogram"] = dict(mm["detuning_histogram"])
        groups["metrics"][key] = mm
        if r.trace:
            groups["trace"][key] = {k: {"t_s": v["t_s"], "value": v["value"]} for k, v in r.trace.items()}
        if r.truth_final:
            groups["truth_final"][key] = r.truth_final
        if r.reference is not None:
            groups["self_reference"][key] = {"d_ref_pm": r.reference["d_ref_pm"],
                                             "i_monitor_ref_a": r.reference["i_monitor_ref_a"]}
    if "locked_steady_state" in res.extra:
        groups["locked_steady_state"] = res.extra["locked_steady_state"]
    manifest.write_trace_h5(d / "trace.h5", groups, attrs={"run_id": run_id, "kind": exp.kind,
                                                      "experiment_hash": exp.hash})
    (d / "report.txt").write_text(res.report)
    return d

nodes.name: rerun
nodes.meaning: rerun
comments: rerun
reproduce a run from its directory and return (result, comparison or None).
reload copied inputs with recorded overrides, alternatives and options.
use copied corner files and any reused certificate in the run's convergence.json.
check the experiment hash before running.
a mismatch raises ExperimentError unless allow_changed_config is True.
when write is True, write a new directory with rerun_of set to the original id.
when compare is also True, compare every trace.h5 array bit for bit.
Warn if code or numerical-library versions differ.
Differences can change rounding.
a reused certificate from different code is refused.
nodes.signature: rerun(run_dir: str | Path, *, runs_dir: str | Path | None=None, write: bool=True, compare: bool=True, log: Callable[[str], None] | None=None, allow_changed_config: bool=False)

source_ref.code:
def rerun(run_dir: str | Path, *, runs_dir: str | Path | None = None, write: bool = True, compare: bool = True,
          log: Callable[[str], None] | None = None, allow_changed_config: bool = False) -> tuple[ExperimentResult,
                                                                                                dict | None]:
    from mrm.sim import manifest
    log = log or (lambda s: print(s, file=sys.stderr, flush=True))
    d = Path(run_dir)
    old = manifest.read_run(d)
    man = old["manifest"]
    src = man.get("source") or {}
    ins = src.get("inputs") or []
    if not ins:
        raise ExperimentError(f"{d}: the run has no copied experiment file (it was run from a Config without a "
                              f"source file); it cannot be rerun")
    path = d / ins[0]["file"]
    opts = {}
    for k, v in (man.get("options") or {}).items():
        if k in _EXTENSION_BY_NAME and v is not None and v != _EXTENSION_BY_NAME[k].default:
            opts[k] = v
    corner_files = {e["corner"]: d / e["file"] for e in ins if e.get("corner") is not None}
    exp = load(path, overrides=src.get("overrides") or None, alts=src.get("alts") or None, corner_files=corner_files)
    exp = dataclasses.replace(exp, options=_validate_options({**exp.options, **opts}), _cache={})
    exp.source["path"] = str(path)
    _snapshot_corners(exp, corner_files)
    conv = d / "convergence.json"
    if exp.option("convergence_certificate") and conv.exists():
        with open(conv) as f:
            cj = json.load(f)
        if cj.get("certificate") and "from" in cj:      # the reused certificate, as the run recorded it
            exp.source["certificate"] = cj["certificate"]
    man_kind = KIND_ALIASES.get(man.get("kind"), man.get("kind"))      # a run recorded under an old kind name
    if exp.kind != man_kind:
        raise ExperimentError(f"rerun: kind {exp.kind} != recorded {man.get('kind')}")
    legacy = exp.hash != man.get("experiment_hash") and man.get("experiment_hash") in exp.legacy_hashes()
    if exp.hash != man.get("experiment_hash") and not legacy:
        msg = (f"rerun: experiment hash {exp.hash[:12]} != recorded {str(man.get('experiment_hash'))[:12]}: the "
               f"presets, artefacts or the loader changed since the run")
        if not allow_changed_config:
            raise ExperimentError(msg)
        log("WARNING " + msg)
    g_now, g_then = manifest.git_state(), man.get("git") or {}
    if (g_now.get("commit"), g_now.get("diff_sha256")) != (g_then.get("commit"), g_then.get("diff_sha256")):
        log(f"WARNING rerun: code differs from the run (commit {str(g_then.get('commit'))[:10]} dirty-diff "
            f"{str(g_then.get('diff_sha256'))[:10]} -> {str(g_now.get('commit'))[:10]} "
            f"{str(g_now.get('diff_sha256'))[:10]}); a bit-for-bit match is not guaranteed")
    env_now, env_then = manifest.environment(), man.get("environment") or {}
    for k in ("numpy", "scipy", "numba", "llvmlite", "python"):
        if env_now.get(k) != env_then.get(k):
            log(f"WARNING rerun: {k} {env_then.get(k)} -> {env_now.get(k)}")
    res = run(exp, runs_dir=runs_dir, write=write, log=log, rerun_of=man.get("run_id"),
              argv=["mrm", "rerun", str(d)])
    cmp = None
    if compare and write:
        # a run recorded under an old kind name - its hash was checked above (legacy_hashes) - the new run records the new hash
        cmp = manifest.compare_runs(d, res.run_dir, ignore=("@experiment_hash",) if legacy else ())
        log("rerun: bit-for-bit IDENTICAL" if cmp["identical"] else
            f"rerun: {len(cmp['differing'])} arrays differ (e.g. {cmp['differing'][:5]})")
        manifest.write_json(Path(res.run_dir) / "rerun_comparison.json", {"original": str(d), **cmp})
    return res, cmp

comments: dry run
estimate each case's world count, plant ticks, RAM in GB and wall time in s without running it.
use measured engine costs from PERF_REFERENCE.
Arguments follow `run`, including Python extension options such as {"n_threads": 4}.

nodes.signature: estimate(experiment, *, overrides=None, alts=None, kind: str | None=None, options: Mapping | None=None)

source_ref.code:
def estimate(experiment, *, overrides=None, alts=None, kind: str | None = None,
             options: Mapping | None = None) -> dict:
    from mrm.control.api import CompiledController
    ov = list(_plain_override_list(overrides)) if overrides else []
    if kind is not None:
        ov.append(f"experiment.kind={kind}")
    exp = _as_experiment(experiment, ov or None, alts, options)
    perf = PERF_REFERENCE
    cfg = exp.cfg
    dt = float(cfg.get("sim.dt_plant_s"))
    policy = str(cfg.get("sim.substep_policy", "fixed"))
    rate = cfg.get("controller_interface.update_rate_hz")
    n_threads = exp.n_threads
    rows = []
    cases = _plan(exp)
    sc = _scenario(cfg)
    if exp.kind in ("run", "acceptance") and cases and float(sc.time_compression) != 1.0 \
            and not exp.option("convergence_certificate"):
        from mrm.scenarios import convergence_plan
        for c, (sc_c, d) in sorted(convergence_plan(sc, exp.option("compression_factors")).items(), reverse=True):
            cases.insert(0, dataclasses.replace(cases[-1], label=f"convergence_c{c:g}",
                                                duration_s=round(float(d) / dt) * dt, record=None,
                                                record_default=False))
    for c in cases:
        # the case's own config and controller (a sweep may change the controller, its rate or the policy)
        cfg_c, entry, _, _ = _case_config(exp, c)
        ctrl = _make_controller(entry) if entry else None
        rate_c = cfg_c.get("controller_interface.update_rate_hz")
        policy_c = str(cfg_c.get("sim.substep_policy", "fixed"))
        path = "open" if ctrl is None else ("compiled" if isinstance(ctrl, CompiledController) else "python")
        n_ticks = int(round(c.duration_s / dt))
        pre_ticks = int(round(float((c.self_reference or {}).get("duration_s", 0.02)) / dt)) if c.self_reference \
            else 0
        B = int(c.batch)
        # estimate wall time per tick in us from the larger of two limits - aggregate throughput and the serial groups of worlds assigned to each thread
        us_per_tick = max(B * perf["us_per_world_tick_parallel"],
                          math.ceil(B / n_threads) * perf["us_per_tick_b1_fixed"])
        if policy_c == "auto":
            # auto_factor scales the fixed-tick cost.
            # for B = 1, interpolate over log10(rate in Hz) between 10 kHz and 100 kHz and clamp outside that range.
            # Larger batches use the parallel factor.
            if B == 1:
                log10_rate = math.log10(float(rate_c)) if rate_c else 4.0
                factor_100khz = perf["auto_factor_b1_100khz_ramp"] if any(cc.slow for cc in sc.all_components) \
                    else perf["auto_factor_b1_100khz"]
                auto_factor = np.interp(log10_rate, [4.0, 5.0], [perf["auto_factor_b1_10khz"], factor_100khz])
            else:
                auto_factor = perf["auto_factor_parallel"]
            us_per_tick *= float(auto_factor)
        edges = (n_ticks + pre_ticks) * dt * float(rate_c) if (rate_c and path == "python") else 0.0
        t_py = edges * (perf["python_us_per_edge"] + perf["python_us_per_edge_per_world"] * B) * 1e-6
        t_setup = perf["setup_s"] * (2 if c.self_reference else 1) + (
            perf["locked_steady_state_s_per_point_world"] * B * (2 if c.self_reference else 1)
            if c.start == "warm" else 0.0)
        wall = (n_ticks + pre_ticks) * us_per_tick * 1e-6 + t_py + t_setup
        rec = c.record if c.record is not None else (default_records(n_ticks, _period_ticks(cfg_c))
                                                     if c.record_default else [])
        N = cfg_c.n_rings
        rec_bytes = sum((n_ticks // r.decimation) * B * N * 8 for r in rec)
        ram = (perf["ram_base_gb"]
               + B * (perf["ram_mb_per_world"]
                      + (perf["ram_mb_per_world_histogram"] if exp.option("histogram") else 0.0)) / 1e3
               + rec_bytes / 1e9)
        rows.append({"case": c.label, "B": B, "ticks": n_ticks, "pre_ticks": pre_ticks,
                     "controller": None if entry is None else entry["name"], "path": path,
                     "controller_edges": int(round((n_ticks + pre_ticks) * dt * float(rate_c))) if rate_c and ctrl
                     else 0, "policy": policy_c, "start": c.start, "records": len(rec),
                     "record_mb": rec_bytes / 1e6, "ram_gb": ram, "wall_s": wall})
    if exp.kind == "locked_steady_state":
        g = exp.grid
        A = len(g.get("ambient_c", np.arange(0.0, 105.0 + 1e-9, 5.0)))
        V = len(g.get("bias_v", np.arange(1.0, 3.75 + 1e-9, 0.25)))
        wall = A * V * exp.batch * perf["locked_steady_state_s_per_point_world"]
        for lab in ["locked_steady_state"] + [f"locked_steady_state/corner/{cn}" for cn, _ in _corners(exp, ())]:
            rows.append({"case": lab, "B": exp.batch, "ticks": 0, "points": A * V, "path": "static",
                         "ram_gb": perf["ram_base_gb"] + exp.batch * perf["ram_mb_per_world"] / 1e3,
                         "wall_s": wall})
    from mrm.sim import kernel
    cache = Path(kernel.__file__).parent / "__pycache__"  # the numba disk cache of the kernel
    warm = any(p.name.startswith("kernel.") and p.suffix == ".nbi" for p in cache.iterdir()) if cache.is_dir() \
        else False
    total = sum(r["wall_s"] for r in rows) + (0.0 if warm else perf["cold_compile_s"])
    ram = max([r["ram_gb"] for r in rows] + [0.0])
    ram_total = (max(ram, perf["cold_compile_gb"] if not warm else 0.0)
                 + sum(r.get("record_mb", 0.0) for r in rows) / 1e3)
    return {"experiment": exp.name, "kind": exp.kind, "experiment_hash": exp.hash, "dt_s": dt,
            "substep_policy": policy, "controller_rate_hz": rate, "n_threads": n_threads, "cases": rows,
            "total_ticks": int(sum(r["ticks"] + r.get("pre_ticks", 0) for r in rows)),
            "world_ticks": int(sum((r["ticks"] + r.get("pre_ticks", 0)) * r["B"] for r in rows)),
            "est_wall_s": total, "est_peak_ram_gb": ram_total, "numba_cache_warm": warm,
            "basis": (f"estimated from the measured engine speed in {perf['source']}: "
                      f"B = 1 fixed {perf['us_per_tick_b1_fixed']} us per tick, "
                      f"B >= 8 on 8 threads {perf['us_per_world_tick_parallel']} us per world-tick, "
                      f"auto policy x{perf['auto_factor_b1_100khz']:.2f} (100 kHz; "
                      f"x{perf['auto_factor_b1_100khz_ramp']:.2f} measured under a soak ramp) to "
                      f"x{perf['auto_factor_b1_10khz']:.2f} (10 kHz), "
                      f"Python controllers +{perf['python_us_per_edge']:g} us per edge; "
                      f"RAM {perf['ram_base_gb']} GB + {perf['ram_mb_per_world']} MB per world (measured); "
                      + ("warm numba cache" if warm else
                         f"cold numba cache: +{perf['cold_compile_s']:g} s compile, {perf['cold_compile_gb']:.1f} GB"))}

@njit(cache=True, inline="always")
def _output_row_views(packed_f, packed_i):
    n_rings = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RING_COUNT]
    n_lines = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_LASER_LINE_COUNT]
    offset = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RING_LINE_OUTPUTS_OFFSET]
    out_rl = packed_f[offset : offset + optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT * n_rings * n_lines].reshape(
        (optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT, n_rings, n_lines)
    )
    offset = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RING_OUTPUTS_OFFSET]
    out_r = packed_f[offset : offset + optics.RING_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT * n_rings].reshape(
        (optics.RING_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT, n_rings)
    )
    offset = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_LASER_LINE_OUTPUTS_OFFSET]
    out_l = packed_f[offset : offset + optics.LASER_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT * n_lines].reshape(
        (optics.LASER_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_COUNT, n_lines)
    )
    return out_rl, out_r, out_l

nodes.name: dphi_dlamres
nodes.meaning: return the round-trip phase slope d phi / d lambda_res (rad/m) at lam_l (m).
comments: return the round-trip phase slope d phi / d lambda_res (rad/m) at lam_l (m).
shift (m) moves the cold phase curve rigidly.
t_rt (s) is the group delay n_g(x) L / c from mrm.plant.phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs.
at the shifted coordinate x = lam_l - shift, d phi / d lambda_res = 2 pi n_g(x) L / x^2 = 2 pi c t_rt / x^2
see mrm.plant.phase equation 2.
evaluating at lam_l instead of x would add about 1.2 % error for the 7.6 nm shift of the heated g26 rings.

nodes.name: cold_coordinate
nodes.meaning: return the cold wavelength x (m) whose round-trip phase is 2 pi target.
comments: return the cold wavelength x (m) whose round-trip phase is 2 pi target.
rp_row holds one ring's phase constants (RP_* columns of mrm.plant.phase).
x0 (m) starts the Newton search for n(x) L / x = target.
the cold curve is mrm.plant.phase equation 2 -
n(x) = n_eff + (n_eff - n_g) D / lam_res - (dn_g/dlambda) D^2 / (2 lam_res),   D = x - lam_res
the exact derivative is -n_g(x) L / x^2, where n_g(x) = n - x n'(x) = n_g + dn_g D +
dn_g D^2 / (2 lam_res).
five iterations give an error below 1e-21 m from half an FSR (5 nm) away.
an exact floating-point fixed point ends the search early.
an integer target m selects that order's cold resonance.
a state with phase phi at the line
sits at x(phi / 2 pi).
its order-m resonance is lambda_res = lam_l + x(m) - x(phi / 2 pi).

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def cold_coordinate(rp_row, x0, target):
    lam_r = rp_row[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_COLD_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH]
    ne = rp_row[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_EFFECTIVE_INDEX]
    ng = rp_row[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_GROUP_INDEX]
    dng = rp_row[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_GROUP_INDEX_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE]
    ln = rp_row[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH]
    x = x0
    for _ in range(5):
        dd = x - lam_r
        n_x = ne + (ne - ng) * dd / lam_r - 0.5 * dng * dd * dd / lam_r
        ng_x = ng + dng * dd + 0.5 * dng * dd * dd / lam_r
        g = n_x * ln / x - target
        x_new = x + g * x * x / (ng_x * ln)
        if x_new == x:
            # an exact floating-point fixed point - every remaining iteration would return x again (the update is a function of x alone), so stopping here is bit-identical to the five iterations
            break
        x = x_new
    return x

nodes.name: extend_selfheat_rows
nodes.meaning: return packed rows with space for the engine optics adapter.
comments: return packed rows with space for the engine optics adapter.
append N_EXT int64 offsets to packed_i and the corresponding E_* blocks to packed_f.
keep the float row length even.
E_LAM starts as NaN so the first wavelength check refreshes K^2.

source_ref.code:
def extend_selfheat_rows(packed_f, packed_i):
    B = packed_f.shape[0]
    N = int(packed_i[0, optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RING_COUNT])
    L = int(packed_i[0, optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_LASER_LINE_COUNT])
    nf = packed_f.shape[1]
    sizes = (L, L, N * L)
    offs = []
    o = nf
    for sz in sizes:
        offs.append(o)
        o += sz
    extra = o - nf
    extra += (nf + extra) % 2
    af = np.zeros((B, nf + extra))
    af[:, :nf] = packed_f
    ai = np.zeros((B, packed_i.shape[1] + N_EXT), np.int64)
    ai[:, :packed_i.shape[1]] = packed_i
    for j, oo in enumerate(offs):
        ai[:, packed_i.shape[1] + j] = oo
    af[:, offs[E_LAM]:offs[E_LAM] + L] = np.nan
    return np.ascontiguousarray(af), np.ascontiguousarray(ai)

save ring k and temperature t so `eng_commit` can reuse this evaluation.

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def _eng_pabs_general(t, k, packed_f, packed_i):
    p_in, pcur, ring_rows, line_rows, rbk, cw, fw = optics._sh_core(packed_f, packed_i)
    orl, orr, ol = optics._sh_outputs(packed_f, packed_i)
    n = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RING_COUNT]
    o_thru = _ext_offset(packed_i, E_THRU)
    nl = p_in.shape[0]
    d_resonance_wavelength_dtemp = optics._sh_prepare(
        t, k, packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_FIXED_FIELD_COUNT + n + k], p_in, pcur, ring_rows, line_rows
    )
    two = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_TWO_DATA_LEVELS_FLAG] != 0
    pth = packed_f[o_thru : o_thru + nl]
    optics.evaluate_ring_optical_outputs(
        k,
        pcur,
        ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_PROBABILITY_OF_ONE, k],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_CURRENT_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_CURRENT_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_ROUND_TRIP_FIELD_TRANSMISSION],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_ROUND_TRIP_FIELD_TRANSMISSION],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_COUPLER_PHASE],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_THROUGH_COUPLER_POWER_COUPLING],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_DROP_COUPLER_POWER_COUPLING],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_ROUND_TRIP_GROUP_DELAY],
        rbk,
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_PHASE_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE],
        two,
        packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RESERVED_MODEL_FLAG] != 0,
        packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_RESERVED_MODE_ORDER_COUNT],
        True,
        orl,
        orr,
        pth,
        cw,
        fw,
    )
    res0 = fw[
        optics.REAL_WORKSPACE_LEVEL_ZERO_RESPONSE_START_ROW : optics.REAL_WORKSPACE_LEVEL_ZERO_RESPONSE_START_ROW
        + optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_COUNT
    ]
    res1 = fw[
        optics.REAL_WORKSPACE_LEVEL_ONE_RESPONSE_START_ROW : optics.REAL_WORKSPACE_LEVEL_ONE_RESPONSE_START_ROW
        + optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_COUNT
    ]
    q1 = ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_PROBABILITY_OF_ONE, k] if two else 0.0
    q0 = 1.0 - q1
    level0_absorbed_share_of_loss = line_rows[
        optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS
    ]
    level1_absorbed_share_of_loss = line_rows[
        optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS
    ]
    d_phase_d_resonance_wavelength = line_rows[
        optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_PHASE_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE
    ]
    absorbed_power_w = 0.0
    d_absorbed_power_d_resonance_wavelength = 0.0
    for l in range(nl):
        absorbed_power_fraction = (
            q0
            * level0_absorbed_share_of_loss[k, l]
            * res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION, l]
        )
        d_absorbed_fraction_dphi = (
            q0
            * level0_absorbed_share_of_loss[k, l]
            * res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE, l]
        )
        if two:
            absorbed_power_fraction += (
                q1
                * level1_absorbed_share_of_loss[k, l]
                * res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION, l]
            )
            d_absorbed_fraction_dphi += (
                q1
                * level1_absorbed_share_of_loss[k, l]
                * res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE, l]
            )
        absorbed_power_w += pcur[l] * absorbed_power_fraction
        d_absorbed_power_d_resonance_wavelength += (
            pcur[l] * d_absorbed_fraction_dphi * d_phase_d_resonance_wavelength[k, l]
        )
    o_last = (
        packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_LAST_EVALUATION_CACHE_OFFSET]
        + 2 * nl * optics.LAST_EVALUATION_CACHE_FIELD_COUNT
    )
    packed_f[o_last] = k
    packed_f[o_last + 1] = t
    return absorbed_power_w, d_absorbed_power_d_resonance_wavelength * d_resonance_wavelength_dtemp

nodes.name: swing_capacitance_row
nodes.meaning: write each ring's charge-equivalent NRZ swing capacitance (F) into out_c_eff (N,).
comments: write each ring's charge-equivalent NRZ swing capacitance (F) into out_c_eff (N,).
C_eff = f L (Q(V_hi) - Q(V_lo)) / (V_hi - V_lo)
f is the junction fill fraction (1).
L is the ring length (m).
V_lo and V_hi are reverse voltages (V).
Q(V) (C/m) integrates capacitance per length c'(V) (F/m) from grid[0] to V.
c' is piecewise linear on the bias grid and constant beyond its ends.
cum_q (G,) holds Q at the grid nodes from `cumulative_capacitance`.
for |V_hi - V_lo| <= 1e-9 V, use f L c'(mid).
this computes the quantity in electrical.junction_swing_capacitance_row through two charge lookups.
the segment-walking implementation agrees to 1e-12 relative.

nodes.name: cumulative_capacitance

comments: return integrated charge cum_q (Bt, G) (C/m) at each bias-grid node.

source_ref.code:
def cumulative_capacitance(grid, c_tab):
    c = np.asarray(c_tab, float)
    g = np.asarray(grid, float)
    seg = 0.5 * (c[:, 1:] + c[:, :-1]) * np.diff(g)[None, :]
    out = np.zeros_like(c)
    out[:, 1:] = np.cumsum(seg, axis=1)
    return np.ascontiguousarray(out)

each first-order thermal lag m connects heat source lag_src[m] to observer lag_obs[m].
its state x[m] is a temperature rise (K).
each observer adds its lag states to the base temperature.
over a step of length h -
x[m] = a[m] x[m] + src_scale[s] (c0[m] u0[s] + c1[m] u1[s])

@njit(cache=True)
def _lag_pair_tables(idx_cross, opt_lags, lag_src, lag_obs, src_ring):
    ms_cross = np.empty(_PAIR_STRIDE * idx_cross.shape[0], np.int64)
    for i in range(idx_cross.shape[0]):
        m = idx_cross[i]
        ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_LAG] = m
        ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_SRC] = src_ring[lag_src[m]]
    opt_tab = np.empty(_TRIPLE_STRIDE * opt_lags.shape[0], np.int64)
    for i in range(opt_lags.shape[0]):
        m = opt_lags[i]
        opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_LAG] = m
        opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_OBS] = lag_obs[m]
        opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_RING] = src_ring[lag_src[m]]
    return ms_cross, opt_tab

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False, inline="always")
def _heater_split_all(
    x,
    a,
    c0,
    c1,
    lag_src,
    obs_ptr,
    obs_end,
    heater_obs,
    heater_src,
    hs_lo,
    hs_hi,
    unit,
    u0,
    u1,
    src_scale,
    ln,
    hs_tab,
    coef,
    uu,
    sums,
    out_pre,
):
    nr = heater_obs.shape[0]
    if ln < 0 or not unit:
        for n in range(nr):
            out_pre[n] = _heater_split(
                x,
                a,
                c0,
                c1,
                lag_src,
                obs_ptr,
                obs_end,
                heater_obs[n],
                heater_src[n],
                hs_lo[n],
                hs_hi[n],
                unit,
                u0,
                u1,
                src_scale,
            )
        return
    for n in range(nr):
        sums[n] = 0.0
    q = 0
    for j in range(ln):
        for n in range(nr):
            m = _as_unsigned_array_index(hs_tab[q + _PAIR_LAG])
            sv = hs_tab[q + _PAIR_SRC]  # source of lag m. -1 for the ring's own heater
            q += _PAIR_STRIDE
            m_coef = m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE)
            pre = sums[n] + coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_A)] * x[m]
            if sv >= 0:
                s_uu = _as_unsigned_array_index(
                    _UU_STRIDE * sv
                )  # uu[s_uu] - the power at the start of the step
                pre = pre + (
                    coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C0)] * uu[s_uu]
                    + coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C1)]
                    * uu[s_uu + _as_unsigned_array_index(_UU_END)]
                )
            sums[n] = pre
    for n in range(nr):
        out_pre[n] = sums[n]

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def _implicit_step_eng(
    x,
    coef,
    uu,
    ms_exo,
    ms_cross,
    idx_ax,
    opt_tab,
    lag_obs,
    obs_ptr,
    obs_end,
    ring_obs,
    bus_order,
    src_scale,
    unit,
    t_base,
    p_prev,
    t_prev,
    packed_f,
    packed_i,
    p_max,
    d2p_max,
    max_iter,
    tol_k,
    n_outer,
    g_work,
    t_obs,
    p_new,
    t_ring,
    n_iter,
    gobs,
    full,
    p_cross,
):
    nr = ring_obs.shape[0]
    if bus_order.shape[0] != nr:
        raise ValueError("implicit_step: bus_order must list every ring once")
    for k in range(nr):
        n_iter[k] = 0
    for q in range(nr):  # bus_order must be a permutation of 0..N-1 (n_iter as the marker)
        k = bus_order[q]
        if k < 0 or k >= nr or n_iter[k] != 0:
            raise ValueError("implicit_step: bus_order must be a permutation of the ring indices")
        if ring_obs[k] < 0:
            raise ValueError("implicit_step needs the ring_mode_weighted observer of every ring")
        n_iter[k] = 1
    # every lag advanced with the known inputs (observer sums and implicit gains)
    n_obs = obs_ptr.shape[0] - 1
    # advance each lag with its known input, then sum lags per observer.
    # the kind lists and gobs table replace repeated tests and gain sums.
    # skip src_scale only when every scale is exactly 1.0.
    # unsigned indices avoid negative-index checks.
    # each observer keeps the reference summation order.
    n_exo = ms_exo.shape[0] // _PAIR_STRIDE
    if unit:
        for i in range(n_exo):
            m = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_exo[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_LAG])
            s_uu = _as_unsigned_array_index(_UU_STRIDE * ms_exo[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_SRC])
            m_coef = m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE)
            x[m] = coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_A)] * x[m] + (
                coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C0)] * uu[s_uu]
                + coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C1)]
                * uu[s_uu + _as_unsigned_array_index(_UU_END)]
            )
    else:
        for i in range(n_exo):
            m = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_exo[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_LAG])
            sv = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_exo[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_SRC])
            s_uu = sv * _as_unsigned_array_index(_UU_STRIDE)
            m_coef = m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE)
            x[m] = coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_A)] * x[m] + src_scale[sv] * (
                coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C0)] * uu[s_uu]
                + coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_C1)]
                * uu[s_uu + _as_unsigned_array_index(_UU_END)]
            )
    n_cross = ms_cross.shape[0] // _PAIR_STRIDE
    for i in range(n_cross):
        m = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_LAG])
        m_coef = m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE)
        x[m] = (
            coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_A)] * x[m]
            + coef[m_coef + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_W)]
            * p_prev[_as_unsigned_array_index(ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_SRC])]
        )
    for i in range(idx_ax.shape[0]):
        m = _as_unsigned_array_index(idx_ax[i])
        x[m] = coef[m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE) + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_A)] * x[m]
    for o in range(n_obs):
        e = t_base
        for m in range(obs_ptr[o], obs_end[o]):
            e += x[_as_unsigned_array_index(m)]
        t_obs[o] = e  # everything except the new optical inputs
        g_work[o] = gobs[o]
    # ring solves in bus order
    n_fail = 0
    # p_cross - the P_abs currently driving the LAG_OPT_CROSS_RING lags
    for k in range(nr):
        p_cross[k] = p_prev[k]
        t_ring[k] = t_prev[k]
        n_iter[k] = 0
    for sweep in range(max(n_outer, 1)):
        n_fail = 0
        for q in range(nr):
            k = bus_order[q]
            o = ring_obs[k]
            if o < 0:
                raise ValueError("implicit_step needs the ring_mode_weighted observer of every ring")
            # ring solve (Newton, ring evaluations)
            t, p, d, it, st = _solve_ring_eng(
                k, packed_f, packed_i, t_obs[o], g_work[o], t_ring[k], p_max[k], d2p_max[k], max_iter, tol_k
            )
            t_ring[k] = t
            p_new[k] = p
            n_iter[k] += it
            if st != STATUS_CONVERGED:
                n_fail += 1
                # on failure, choose the thermal input power that puts the ring at the returned temperature.
                # this lets a long branch crossing continue next substep without overshoot under valid bounds.
                # a NaN gain keeps the evaluated P_abs because no matching thermal input power exists.
                gk = g_work[o]
                if gk != 0.0 and st != STATUS_NAN_GAIN:
                    p_new[k] = (t - t_obs[o]) / gk
            # commit (outputs of the ring, through power to the next ring)
            eng_commit(t, k, packed_f, packed_i, full)
        if sweep + 1 >= n_outer:
            break
        # Gauss-Seidel - drive the cross-ring lags with the newest P_abs, then sweep again
        change = 0.0
        scale = 0.0
        for k in range(nr):
            change = max(change, abs(p_new[k] - p_cross[k]))
            scale = max(scale, abs(p_new[k]))
        if change <= 1e-12 * scale:
            break
        for i in range(n_cross):
            m = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_LAG])
            j = _as_unsigned_array_index(ms_cross[_PAIR_STRIDE * i + _PAIR_SRC])
            dx = coef[m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE) + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_W)] * (
                p_new[j] - p_cross[j]
            )
            x[m] += dx
            t_obs[_as_unsigned_array_index(lag_obs[m])] += dx
        for k in range(nr):
            p_cross[k] = p_new[k]
    # optical lags with the new absorbed powers
    # carry an observer's sum across its consecutive lags to avoid a store and reload per lag.
    # keep the additions in the same order as t_obs[lag_obs[m]] += dx.
    o_cur = -1
    t_run = 0.0
    for i in range(opt_tab.shape[0] // _TRIPLE_STRIDE):
        m = _as_unsigned_array_index(opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_LAG])
        o = opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_OBS]
        if o != o_cur:
            if o_cur >= 0:
                t_obs[_as_unsigned_array_index(o_cur)] = t_run
            o_cur = o
            t_run = t_obs[_as_unsigned_array_index(o)]
        dx = (
            coef[m * _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_STRIDE) + _as_unsigned_array_index(_COEF_W)]
            * p_new[_as_unsigned_array_index(opt_tab[_TRIPLE_STRIDE * i + _TRIPLE_RING])]
        )
        x[m] += dx
        t_run += dx
    if o_cur >= 0:
        t_obs[o_cur] = t_run
    return n_fail

@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def _fast_tick_a(fast_fn, k, n_r, lat, fo, ring_int, fv, fr, fm, ctrl_p_i64, ctrl_p_f64, ctrl_s_i64, ctrl_s_f64, fact,
                 world_int):
    cap = fv.shape[1]
    while True:
        any_new = False
        fo[FO_TICK] = k
        fo[FO_N] = n_r
        for n in range(n_r):
            fo[FO_HEADER + n] = 0                    # new-sample flag of ring n
            fo[FO_HEADER + n_r + n] = 0              # its ADC code
            fo[FO_HEADER + 2 * n_r + n] = 0          # its sample tick
            h = fm[n, 0]
            cnt = fm[n, 1]
            for i in range(cnt):
                idx = (h + i) % cap
                rel = fr[n, idx]
                if rel > k:
                    break
                if rel <= ring_int[RI_FAST_SEEN, n]:
                    continue
                val = fv[n, idx]
                ring_int[RI_FAST_SEEN, n] = rel
                if ((val >> SAMPLE_FLAG_SHIFT) & SAMPLE_DROPPED) != 0:
                    continue
                fo[FO_HEADER + n] = 1
                fo[FO_HEADER + n_r + n] = val & SAMPLE_CODE_MASK
                fo[FO_HEADER + 2 * n_r + n] = rel - lat
                any_new = True
                break
        if not any_new:
            break
        fast_fn(ctrl_p_i64, ctrl_p_f64, ctrl_s_i64, ctrl_s_f64, fo, fact)
        world_int[WI_FAST_CALLS] += 1

    fwhm_b,
    wrong_window,
    assign_mode,
    with_db,
    dark_known,
    ws,
):
    ring_rows, line_rows = _input_row_views(packed_f, packed_i)
    phi0r, phi1r, dpl = (
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_REFERENCE_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_REFERENCE_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE],
        line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_PHASE_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE],
    )
    tref, s0v, betav = (
        ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE],
        ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_REFERENCE_THERMAL_TUNING_SLOPE],
        ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_RELATIVE_THERMAL_TUNING_CURVATURE],
    )
    out_rl, out_r, out_l = _output_row_views(packed_f, packed_i)
    o_fwhm = _ext_offset(packed_i, E_FWHM)
    # per ring - line search, exact detuning of the declared line, truth fields
    for n in range(n_r):
        dT = ring_float[RF_T_RING, n] - tref[n]
        shift = s0v[n] * (dT + 0.5 * betav[n] * dT * dT)  # thermal shift (m) from T_ref (the previous T_ring)
        dl = ring_int[RI_DECL, n]
        best = -1
        best_d = _INF
        order_decl = 0
        o_fw = o_fwhm + n * n_l
        for l in range(n_l):
            dpl_nl = dpl[n, l]
            ph = 0.5 * (phi0r[n, l] + phi1r[n, l]) + dpl_nl * shift
            m = math.floor(ph / _TWO_PI + 0.5)
            num = ph - _TWO_PI * m
            if l == dl:
                order_decl = np.int64(m)
            lim = (
                wrong_window * packed_f[_as_unsigned_array_index(o_fw + l)]
            )  # window x linewidth lam_l^2 fwhm_hz / c (m)
            # d = num / dpl = lambda_res - lambda_line (m, first order in d).
            # the division runs only for a line that can be inside the window - |num| > lim |dpl| (1 + 1e-12) gives fl(|num / dpl|) > lim, so the skipped lines are exactly the ones that the test below rejects (bit-identical).
            if abs(num) <= lim * abs(dpl_nl) * (1.0 + 1e-12):
                d = num / dpl_nl
                if abs(d) <= lim and abs(d) < best_d:
                    best_d = abs(d)
                    best = l
        # compute the declared line's exact detuning for the nearest order.
        # shift the cold curve by the mean junction shift of the two NRZ levels at T_ref, plus the thermal shift since T_ref.
        # resonance_detuning(ring_phase[n], lam_l, 0.5 (j0 + j1) + shift, order) = x_m - x_end.
        # the lockstep Newton loop below computes x_m.
        ring_int[RI_ORDER, n] = order_decl
        ring_int[RI_LINE_ON, n] = best
        x_end = line_float[LF_LAM, _as_unsigned_array_index(dl)] - (
            0.5 * (junction[_JUNCTION_SHIFT, n, 0] + junction[_JUNCTION_SHIFT, n, 1]) + shift
        )
        ws[0, n] = x_end  # ws rows - x_end, the Newton iterate x, 1.0 while the ring iterates
        ws[1, n] = x_end
        ws[2, n] = 1.0
    # cold_coordinate(ring_phase[n], x_end, order) of every ring, in lockstep
    for _ in range(5):
        busy = False
        for n in range(n_r):
            if ws[2, n] == 0.0:
                continue
            lam_r = ring_phase[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_COLD_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH]
            ne = ring_phase[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_EFFECTIVE_INDEX]
            ng = ring_phase[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_GROUP_INDEX]
            dng = ring_phase[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_GROUP_INDEX_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE]
            ln = ring_phase[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH]
            x = ws[1, n]
            dd = x - lam_r
            n_x = ne + (ne - ng) * dd / lam_r - 0.5 * dng * dd * dd / lam_r
            ng_x = ng + dng * dd + 0.5 * dng * dd * dd / lam_r
            g = n_x * ln / x - float(ring_int[RI_ORDER, n])
            x_new = x + g * x * x / (ng_x * ln)
            if x_new == x:
                ws[2, n] = 0.0  # an exact fixed point (cold_coordinate stops here)
            else:
                ws[1, n] = x_new
                busy = True
        if not busy:
            break
    # truth fields
    for n in range(n_r):
        dl = ring_int[RI_DECL, n]
        dlu = _as_unsigned_array_index(dl)
        lam_l = line_float[LF_LAM, dlu]
        det_decl = ws[1, n] - ws[0, n]
        order_decl = ring_int[RI_ORDER, n]
        best = ring_int[RI_LINE_ON, n]
        ring_float[RF_DET, n] = det_decl
        hw = 0.5 * lam_l * lam_l * fwhm_b[n] / C0
        truth[TR_T_RING, n] = ring_float[RF_T_RING, n]
        truth[TR_T_HEATER, n] = ring_float[RF_T_HEATER, n]
        truth[TR_T_PD, n] = ring_float[RF_T_PD, n]
        truth[TR_P_HEATER, n] = ring_float[RF_HE_P, n]
        pabs = out_r[optics.RING_OUTPUT_ROW_TOTAL_ABSORBED_POWER, n]
        ring_float[RF_P_ABS, n] = pabs
        truth[TR_P_ABS, n] = pabs
        truth[TR_LAM_RES, n] = lam_l + det_decl
        truth[TR_DET, n] = det_decl
        truth[TR_DET_HW, n] = det_decl / hw
        truth[TR_P_DROP, n] = out_r[optics.RING_OUTPUT_ROW_TOTAL_CLOCKWISE_DROP_POWER, n]
        i_sig = (
            pw[PW_GAIN_SCALE]
            * mo_pr[n, PR_RESP]
            * (
                out_r[optics.RING_OUTPUT_ROW_TOTAL_CLOCKWISE_DROP_POWER, n]
                + mo_pr[n, PR_BG] * ring_float[RF_P_BG, n]
            )
        )
        if dark_known:
            truth[TR_I_MON, n] = i_sig + ring_float[RF_I_DARK, n]
        else:
            truth[TR_I_MON, n] = i_sig + dark_current_a(
                pw[PW_DARK_I0], ring_float[RF_T_PD, n], pw[PW_DARK_T0], pw[PW_DARK_EA]
            )
        pin = out_rl[optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_INPUT_POWER, n, dlu]
        t1 = out_rl[optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_THROUGH_POWER, n, dlu]
        t0 = out_rl[optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_THROUGH_POWER, n, dlu]
        truth[TR_P_IN, n] = pin
        truth[TR_OMA, n] = ring_float[RF_OMA, n]
        rel = abs(t1 - t0) / pin if pin > 0.0 else 0.0
        truth[TR_RELOMA, n] = rel
        if with_db:
            hi = t1 if t1 > t0 else t0
            lo = t0 if t1 > t0 else t1
            truth[TR_ER, n] = 10.0 * math.log10(hi / lo) if lo > 0.0 else _INF
            truth[TR_IL, n] = -10.0 * math.log10(hi / pin) if (pin > 0.0 and hi > 0.0) else _INF
        truth[TR_CODE, n] = ring_int[RI_HE_REG, n]
        truth[TR_BIAS, n] = ring_float[RF_BI_VAVG, n]
        truth[TR_ORDER, n] = order_decl
        truth[TR_T_BASE, n] = t_base
        truth[TR_MON_CODE, n] = ring_int[RI_MO_LATEST, n]
        truth[TR_ORACLE, n] = ring_float[RF_ORACLE, n]
        truth[TR_DECL, n] = dl
        truth[TR_BER, n] = ring_float[
            RF_BER, n
        ]  # ber_from_oma of ring_float[RF_OMA], set with it (_world_loop)
    # wrong line against the declared assignment (metrics.allowed_assignments)
    for n in range(n_r):
        lo_ = ring_int[RI_LINE_ON, n]
        w = False
        if lo_ >= 0 and assign_mode == 0:
            w = lo_ != ring_int[RI_DECL, n]
        elif lo_ >= 0 and assign_mode == 1:
            off = (lo_ - ring_int[RI_DECL, n]) % n_l
            # the common (most frequent) offset of the rings that sit on a line - a barrel shift is allowed (PAT-1)
            best_c = -1
            best_o = 0
            for m in range(n_r):
                lm = ring_int[RI_LINE_ON, m]
                if lm < 0:
                    continue
                om = (lm - ring_int[RI_DECL, m]) % n_l
                c = 0
                for q in range(n_r):
                    lq = ring_int[RI_LINE_ON, q]
                    if lq >= 0 and (lq - ring_int[RI_DECL, q]) % n_l == om:
                        c += 1
                if c > best_c or (c == best_c and om < best_o):
                    best_c = c
                    best_o = om
            w = off != best_o
        ring_bool[RB_WRONG, n] = w
        truth[TR_LINE_ON, n] = lo_
    for l in range(n_l):
        truth_line[0, l] = line_float[LF_PCHIP, l]  # chip input power (W)
        truth_line[1, l] = out_l[optics.LASER_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_BUS_OUTPUT_POWER, l]  # bus output power (W)
        truth_line[2, l] = line_float[LF_LAM, l]  # line wavelength (m)

nodes.name: _oracle
nodes.meaning: find each ring's best current relative OMA over a heater-detuning scan.
comments: find each ring's best current relative OMA over a heater-detuning scan.
scan the mean resonance over +-1.5 FWHM.
maximize |T1 - T0| at the declared line's through
port where static self-heating loop gain G dP_abs/dlambda_res < 1.
G = s(T) Z_opt,self (m/W).
only the declared line's absorption slope counts.
other lines are assumed at least 2.29 nm away.
RF_ORACLE_UNR stores the maximum without the stability limit.
preserve the NRZ phase difference and use the plant's exact ring model at each scan point.
P.lock_ref_mode = 1 writes the best stable detuning to S.m_ref (m).
if no point is stable, use the unrestricted maximum.
refine with a parabola through neighboring points and convert with `cold_coordinate`.
this is the oracle lock reference in mrm.sim.metrics.

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True, _nrt=False)
def _oracle_a(
    n_r,
    ring_float,
    ring_int,
    packed_f,
    packed_i,
    phi,
    rk2t,
    rk2d,
    ra,
    rtrt,
    rpsi,
    res0,
    res1,
    cw,
    fw,
    line_float,
    ring_phase,
    junction,
    fwhm_b,
    z_opt_b,
    use_tcmt,
    m_orders,
    lock_ref_mode,
    m_ref,
):
    (
        _p_in,
        _bus_t2,
        _bus_t2_out,
        _p1,
        phi0r,
        phi1r,
        _phi0,
        _phi1,
        a0,
        a1,
        e0,
        e1,
        psi,
        k2t,
        k2d,
        trt,
        dpl,
        tref,
        s0v,
        betav,
        rbk,
        _p_cur,
        out_rl,
        _out_r,
        _out_l,
        _cw,
        _fw,
        _bus_order,
        _bus_pos,
    ) = optics.unpack_self_heating_optical_state(packed_f, packed_i)
    npts = phi.shape[0]
    for n in range(n_r):
        dl = ring_int[RI_DECL, n]
        lam = line_float[LF_LAM, dl]
        fwhm = lam * lam * fwhm_b[n] / C0
        dphi = phi1r[n, dl] - phi0r[n, dl]
        mean = 0.5 * (phi0r[n, dl] + phi1r[n, dl])
        m = math.floor(mean / _TWO_PI + 0.5)
        temperature_change_k = ring_float[RF_T_RING, n] - tref[n]
        tuning_slope_m_per_k = s0v[n] * (1.0 + betav[n] * temperature_change_k)
        self_heating_gain_m_per_w = (
            z_opt_b[n] * tuning_slope_m_per_k
        )  # static resonance shift per absorbed power (m/W)
        pin = out_rl[optics.RING_LINE_OUTPUT_ROW_INPUT_POWER, n, dl]
        q1 = (
            ring_float[RF_RHO, n]
            if packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_TWO_DATA_LEVELS_FLAG] != 0
            else 0.0
        )
        for lvl in range(2):
            for i in range(npts):
                d = (-1.5 + 3.0 * i / (npts - 1)) * fwhm
                phi[i] = _TWO_PI * m + dpl[n, dl] * d + (-0.5 if lvl == 0 else 0.5) * dphi
                rk2t[i] = k2t[n, dl]
                rk2d[i] = k2d[n, dl]
                ra[i] = a0[n, dl] if lvl == 0 else a1[n, dl]
                rtrt[i] = trt[n, dl]
                rpsi[i] = psi[n, dl]
            optics.evaluate_ring_response_per_input_watt(
                phi,
                rpsi,
                rk2t,
                rk2d,
                ra,
                rtrt,
                rbk[n],
                use_tcmt != 0,
                m_orders,
                True,
                cw,
                fw,
                res0 if lvl == 0 else res1,
            )
        best = 0.0
        best_u = 0.0
        i_best = -1
        i_best_u = 0
        for i in range(npts):
            rel = abs(
                res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, i]
                - res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, i]
            )
            d_absorbed_power_d_resonance_wavelength = (
                pin
                * (
                    (1.0 - q1)
                    * e0[n, dl]
                    * res0[
                        optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE, i
                    ]
                    + q1
                    * e1[n, dl]
                    * res1[
                        optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE, i
                    ]
                )
                * dpl[n, dl]
            )
            if rel > best_u:
                best_u = rel
                i_best_u = i
            if self_heating_gain_m_per_w * d_absorbed_power_d_resonance_wavelength < 1.0 and rel > best:
                best = rel
                i_best = i
        ring_float[RF_ORACLE, n] = best
        ring_float[RF_ORACLE_UNR, n] = best_u
        if lock_ref_mode == 1:
            ib = i_best if i_best >= 0 else i_best_u
            d_ib = (-1.5 + 3.0 * ib / (npts - 1)) * fwhm
            # the scan step is 0.02 FWHM (~7 pm in g26) - refine the maximum by the vertex of the parabola through ib and its neighbours when they lie on the same side of the stability limit (a lock reference must be finer than the 5 pm lock threshold)
            if ib > 0 and ib < npts - 1:
                ok = True
                if i_best >= 0:
                    for j in (ib - 1, ib + 1):
                        sl = (
                            pin
                            * (
                                (1.0 - q1)
                                * e0[n, dl]
                                * res0[
                                    optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE,
                                    j,
                                ]
                                + q1
                                * e1[n, dl]
                                * res1[
                                    optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_INTRINSIC_LOSS_POWER_FRACTION_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE_DERIVATIVE,
                                    j,
                                ]
                            )
                            * dpl[n, dl]
                        )
                        if not self_heating_gain_m_per_w * sl < 1.0:
                            ok = False
                if ok:
                    ym = abs(
                        res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib - 1]
                        - res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib - 1]
                    )
                    y0 = abs(
                        res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib]
                        - res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib]
                    )
                    yp = abs(
                        res1[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib + 1]
                        - res0[optics.RING_RESPONSE_ROW_THROUGH_POWER_FRACTION, ib + 1]
                    )
                    den = ym - 2.0 * y0 + yp
                    if den < 0.0:
                        off = 0.5 * (ym - yp) / den
                        off = -0.5 if off < -0.5 else (0.5 if off > 0.5 else off)
                        d_ib = d_ib + off * 3.0 / (npts - 1) * fwhm
            # scan point d_ib has the mean phase 2 pi m + dpl d_ib at the line - its exact detuning is x_m - x(phase)
            x_now = lam - (
                0.5 * (junction[_JUNCTION_SHIFT, n, 0] + junction[_JUNCTION_SHIFT, n, 1])
                + s0v[n]
                * (temperature_change_k + 0.5 * betav[n] * temperature_change_k * temperature_change_k)
            )
            x_m = cold_coordinate(ring_phase[n], x_now, float(m))
            m_ref[n] = x_m - cold_coordinate(ring_phase[n], x_m, m + dpl[n, dl] * d_ib / _TWO_PI)

nodes.name: _auto_substep
nodes.meaning: auto substep policy
comments: auto substep policy
return the largest allowed power-of-two step h (ticks) at tick k.
stop at the next controller edge, command latch, record window, BER window, oracle tick or bias-noise redraw when its period exceeds one tick.
force one tick during the laser ramp, with a fast kernel, heater PWM ripple or dac_glitch offset, and when a latch changes a DAC register.
both DAC paths must have no pending write and must have reached their targets.
their FIFO entries must match the held registers.
base temperature, XPU rise and aggressor power use a first-order hold and must stay linear.
all other scenario signals must stay constant.
scen_next_break_b bounds these intervals.
the previous detuning rate times h must not exceed sim.max_detuning_step_pm.
the previous absorbed-power change must be within au_pabs_tol relative tolerance.
two forward guards limit the response to a new disturbance.
a changed held signal or a first-order-hold slope change of more than half forces one tick.
h can at most double from the previous step.
after reset, start with one tick while the rate estimate develops.

def _bus_walk(packed_f, packed_i, bus_order, use_tcmt, m_orders):

nodes.name: _world_block
nodes.meaning: the world block
comments: the world block
passing KParams and KState copies about 270 array descriptors.
take the tuples once in _world_block, which allocates views, tables and scratch arrays with the numba runtime.
pass these arrays to _world_loop and its per-tick helpers.
tuple wrappers remain for external callers and to document the array interfaces.
_world_loop and its hot helpers use _nrt=False to avoid per-call array reference counting.
follow these rules -
allocate only in setup functions with the numba runtime.
inline view-returning helpers so a runtime-free caller does not retain an unreleased array reference.
a callee with the runtime must not make argument views.
numba 0.68 leaks a reference per block in that case.
pass views into the callee or compile it without the runtime.
test_kernel_releases_every_array in tests/verification/test_kernel_parity.py checks array reference release.

@njit(cache=True)
def _world_block(step_fn, fast_fn, b, k0, n_ticks, mode, resume, P, S):
    n_r = P.n_rings
    n_l = P.n_lines
    # views of this world's arrays, taken once per block
    ring_float = S.ring_float[b]
    ring_int = S.ring_int[b]
    ring_int8 = S.ring_int8[b]
    ring_bool = S.ring_bool[b]
    line_float = S.line_float[b]
    world_int = S.world_int[b]
    world_float = S.world_float[b]
    truth = S.truth[b]
    packed_f = S.selfheat_float[b]
    packed_i = P.selfheat_int[b]
    ring_rows, line_rows = _input_row_views(packed_f, packed_i)
    o_pin = packed_i[optics.SELF_HEATING_HEADER_INDEX_BUS_INPUT_POWER_OFFSET]
    p_in = packed_f[o_pin : o_pin + n_l]
    p1 = ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_PROBABILITY_OF_ONE]
    tref = ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE]
    s0v = ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_REFERENCE_THERMAL_TUNING_SLOPE]
    betav = ring_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_ROW_RELATIVE_THERMAL_TUNING_CURVATURE]
    phi0r = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_REFERENCE_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE]
    phi1r = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_REFERENCE_ROUND_TRIP_PHASE]
    a0 = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_ROUND_TRIP_FIELD_TRANSMISSION]
    a1 = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_ROUND_TRIP_FIELD_TRANSMISSION]
    e0 = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ZERO_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS]
    e1 = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_LEVEL_ONE_ABSORBED_SHARE_OF_INTRINSIC_LOSS]
    k2t = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_THROUGH_COUPLER_POWER_COUPLING]
    k2d = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_DROP_COUPLER_POWER_COUPLING]
    trt = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_ROUND_TRIP_GROUP_DELAY]
    dpl = line_rows[optics.SELF_HEATING_RING_LINE_ROW_PHASE_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH_DERIVATIVE]
    out_rl, out_r, out_l = optics._sh_outputs(packed_f, packed_i)
    o_fwhm = _ext_offset(packed_i, E_FWHM)
    fwhm_b = P.fwhm_hz[b]
    v0 = S.sc_v0[b]
    v1 = S.sc_v1[b]
    vp = S.sc_vp[b]
    bsc = b if P.sc_comp_f.shape[0] > 1 else 0
    sc_comp_f = P.sc_comp_f[bsc]
    sc_tab = P.sc_tab[bsc]
    sc_keys = P.sc_keys[b]
    sc_cache = S.sc_cache[b]
    off_ctrl_reset = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_CONTROLLER_RESET)
    off_line_enable = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_LINE_ENABLE)
    off_laser_dfreq = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_LASER_DFREQ)
    off_power_db = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_LASER_POWER_DB)
    off_input_loss = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_INPUT_LOSS_DB)
    off_ones_density = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_ONES_DENSITY)
    off_trans_density = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_TRANSITION_DENSITY)
    off_swing_scale = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_SWING_SCALE)
    off_driver_enable = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_DRIVER_ENABLE)
    off_bias_offset = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_BIAS_OFFSET)
    off_bias_v = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_BIAS_V)
    off_fault_drop = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_FAULT_ADC_DROP)
    off_fault_stuck = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_FAULT_ADC_STUCK)
    off_fault_saturate = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_FAULT_ADC_SATURATE)
    off_fault_glitch = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_FAULT_DAC_GLITCH)
    off_aggressor = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_AGGRESSOR)
    off_t_base = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_T_BASE)
    off_xpu_rise = _signal_offset(P, _SIG_XPU_RISE)
    swing = _world_row(P.drv_swing, b)
    input_t = P.las_input_t[b]
    ring_phase = P.ph_ring[b]
    tb = b if P.jt_dn.shape[0] > 1 else 0
    jt_dn = P.jt_dn[tb]
    jt_al = P.jt_al[tb]
    jt_c = P.jt_c[tb]
    jt_rs = P.jt_rs[tb]
    jt_cum = P.jt_cum[tb]
    ring_fill = ring_phase[:, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_JUNCTION_FILL_FRACTION]
    ring_len_m = ring_phase[:, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH]
    ph_ws = np.empty((6, n_r))  # scratch of the phase model (no allocation per tick)
    # thermal system
    junction = S.junction[b]
    u0 = S.th_u0[b]
    u1 = S.th_u1[b]
    x_th = S.th_x[b]
    t_obs = S.th_t_obs[b]
    th_g = S.th_g[b]
    th_a = _world_row(P.th_a, b)
    th_c0 = _world_row(P.th_c0, b)
    th_c1 = _world_row(P.th_c1, b)
    # lag-pass tables (see "thermal lag-pass tables" above) - the lag lists now, the gains of each substep length on first use (P may change between blocks - Plant.settle swaps the coefficient tables).
    th_idx_exo, th_idx_cross, th_idx_ax, th_unit, th_hs_lo, th_hs_hi = _lag_lists(
        P.th_lag_src, P.th_lag_kind, P.th_obs_ptr, P.th_heater_obs, P.th_heater_src, P.th_src_scale
    )
    th_npow = th_a.shape[0]
    th_w = np.empty((th_npow, th_a.shape[1]))
    th_gobs = np.empty((th_npow, P.th_obs_ptr.shape[0] - 1))
    th_gsplit = np.empty((th_npow, n_r))
    th_ok = np.zeros(th_npow, np.bool_)
    th_pre = np.empty(n_r)
    th_sums = np.empty(n_r)
    th_pcross = np.empty(n_r)
    # sources without input whose lags are all +0.0 stay so.
    # they are skipped while that lasts (_find_dead_sources)
    th_dead = np.empty(P.th_src_scale.shape[0], np.bool_)
    th_ndead = _find_dead_sources(x_th, P.th_lag_src, P.th_lag_kind, P.th_src_scale.shape[0], th_dead)
    th_exo_buf = np.empty(_PAIR_STRIDE * th_idx_exo.shape[0], np.int64)
    th_obs_end = np.empty(P.th_obs_ptr.shape[0] - 1, np.int64)
    th_nexo = _live_lags(th_dead, P.th_lag_src, P.th_obs_ptr, th_idx_exo, th_exo_buf, th_obs_end)
    th_exo = th_exo_buf[: _PAIR_STRIDE * th_nexo]
    th_hs_max = 0
    for n in range(n_r):
        th_hs_max = max(th_hs_max, P.th_obs_ptr[P.th_heater_obs[n] + 1] - P.th_obs_ptr[P.th_heater_obs[n]])
    th_hs_tab = np.empty(_PAIR_STRIDE * th_hs_max * n_r, np.int64)
    th_hln = _heater_split_table(
        P.th_obs_ptr, th_obs_end, P.th_lag_src, P.th_heater_obs, P.th_heater_src, th_hs_tab
    )
    # per-lag coefficients (a, c0, c1, w) of each substep length, index pairs, source powers side by side
    th_coef = np.empty((th_npow, _COEF_STRIDE * th_a.shape[1]))
    th_ms_cross, th_opt_tab = _lag_pair_tables(
        th_idx_cross, P.th_opt_lags, P.th_lag_src, P.th_lag_obs, P.th_src_ring
    )
    th_uu = np.empty(_UU_STRIDE * u0.shape[0])
    fact = S.fact[b]  # fast-kernel action - [heater offset[N], bias offset[N]] (codes)
    # bias DAC
    bi_code_max = (1 << P.bi_bits) - 1
    bi_vmin = _world_row(P.bi_vmin, b)
    bi_vmax = _world_row(P.bi_vmax, b)
    bi_bit_err = _world_row(P.bi_bit_err, b)
    bi_bow = _world_row(P.bi_bow, b)
    bi_noise = _world_row(P.bi_noise, b)
    bi_key = P.bi_key[b]
    bi_lat = _world_row(P.bi_lat, b)
    bi_fifo = S.bi_fifo[b]
    bi_slew = _world_row(P.bi_slew, b)
    bi_settle = _world_row(P.bi_settle, b)
    # heater DAC
    he_full = (1 << P.he_bits) - 1
    he_law = _world_row(P.he_law, b)
    he_bit_err = _world_row(P.he_bit_err, b)
    he_bow = _world_row(P.he_bow, b)
    he_lat = _world_row(P.he_lat, b)
    he_fifo = S.he_fifo[b]
    he_slew = _world_row(P.he_slew, b)
    he_settle = _world_row(P.he_settle, b)
    # sensors
    assign = ring_int[RI_ASSIGN]
    ring_to_line = P.ring_to_line
    link_t = P.dp_link_t[b]
    oma_sens = P.dp_oma_sens[b]
    n_temp = S.ts_in.shape[1]
    ts_in = S.ts_in[b]
    mo_lat = _world_row(P.mo_lat, b)
    mo_pw = P.mo_pw[b]
    en_b = np.empty(n_l, np.bool_)  # laser line enable of the step (no allocation per tick)
    truth_ws = np.empty((3, n_r))  # scratch of _truth_a
    # controller edge - this world's controller parameters and state, observation and command vectors, pipeline
    ctrl_p_i64 = _world_row(S.ctrl_p_i64, b)
    ctrl_p_f64 = _world_row(S.ctrl_p_f64, b)
    ctrl_s_i64 = S.ctrl_s_i64[b]
    ctrl_s_f64 = S.ctrl_s_f64[b]
    obs_i64 = S.obs[b]
    act_i64 = S.act[b]
    sat_count = S.sat[b]
    pipe_vals = S.pipe_vals[b]
    pipe_ticks = S.pipe_ticks[b]
    pipe_meta = S.pipe_meta[b]
    key_sched = P.key_sched[b]
    rec_db = False  # a record reads er_db / il_db (else truth skips their log10)
    for r in range(P.rec_i.shape[0]):
        if P.rec_i[r, _REC_FIELD] == TR_ER or P.rec_i[r, _REC_FIELD] == TR_IL:
            rec_db = True
    return _world_loop(
        step_fn,
        fast_fn,
        b,
