def _hold_in_data_state(data_arrays, b, N, L, v_bias, swing_b, level_b, rp, v_grid, dneff_tab, alpha_tab, cap_tab,
                        rs_tab, lam_b, t_amb_k, t_ring_k, t_heater_k, det_m, phi_lock, m_up, bus_order, ring_to_line,
                        bus_t2_b, p_chip_b, ring_fn, rb_fn, thermal_sys, gain_b, ring_obs, heater_obs, junction_src,
                        driver_src, pp, iterations):
    from mrm.plant import electrical
    from mrm.plant import phase
    driver_enable = data_arrays["driver_enable"][b]
    transition_density = data_arrays["transition_density"][b]
    ones_density = data_arrays["ones_density"][b]
    v_lo, v_hi, nrz_flags = np.zeros(N), np.zeros(N), np.zeros(N, np.int8)
    electrical.nrz_levels_row(np.full(N, v_bias), swing_b * data_arrays["swing_scale"][b], level_b,
                              electrical.JUNCTION_GRID_V_MIN, electrical.JUNCTION_GRID_V_MAX, v_lo, v_hi, nrz_flags)
    t_ring_k = np.array(t_ring_k, float)
    t_heater_k = np.array(t_heater_k, float)
    p_abs_w = np.zeros(N)
    p_heater_w = np.zeros(N)
    lam_line_m = np.ascontiguousarray(lam_b)
    bitrate = float(np.nan_to_num(pp.datapath.bitrate_hz[b, 0]))
    r_out = np.nan_to_num(np.asarray(pp.datapath.driver_output_resistance_ohm[b]))
    p_static = np.nan_to_num(np.asarray(pp.datapath.driver_static_power_w[b]))
    e_tr = np.nan_to_num(np.asarray(pp.datapath.driver_energy_per_transition_j[b]))
    z_heater = gain_b[np.ix_(ring_obs, thermal_sys.heater_src)]       # heater -> ring, K/W
    for _ in range(iterations):
        optics_outputs = {k: np.zeros((N, L)) for k in _OPTICS_OUT_KEYS}
        shift, c_junction, r_series, junction_flags = (np.zeros((N, 2)), np.zeros((N, 2)), np.zeros((N, 2)),
                                                       np.zeros(N, np.int8))
        phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs(rp, lam_line_m, t_ring_k, t_heater_k, v_lo, v_hi, v_grid, dneff_tab, alpha_tab, cap_tab,
                              rs_tab, optics_outputs["phi0"], optics_outputs["phi1"], optics_outputs["a0"],
                                  optics_outputs["a1"], optics_outputs["e0"], optics_outputs["e1"],
                              optics_outputs["k2t"], optics_outputs["k2d"], optics_outputs["trt"], shift,
                                  c_junction, r_series, junction_flags)
        p_bus_w = p_chip_b.copy()
        t_target_k = np.zeros(N)
        for q in range(N):
            n = int(bus_order[q])
            l = int(ring_to_line[n])
            p_bus_w *= bus_t2_b[n]
            dphi = optics_outputs["phi1"][n, l] - optics_outputs["phi0"][n, l]
            level_zero = ring_fn(np.array([phi_lock[n] - 0.5 * dphi]), optics_outputs["k2t"][n, l],
                optics_outputs["k2d"][n, l], optics_outputs["a0"][n, l],
                           optics_outputs["trt"][n, l], rb=rb_fn(n))
            level_one = ring_fn(np.array([phi_lock[n] + 0.5 * dphi]), optics_outputs["k2t"][n, l],
                optics_outputs["k2d"][n, l], optics_outputs["a1"][n, l],
                           optics_outputs["trt"][n, l], rb=rb_fn(n))
            ones_fraction = float(ones_density[n])
            p_abs_w[n] = p_bus_w[l] * ((1.0 - ones_fraction) * optics_outputs["e0"][n, l] * float(level_zero.p_loss[0])
                                       + ones_fraction * optics_outputs["e1"][n, l] * float(level_one.p_loss[0]))
            dlam_dt = rp[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_THERMAL_TUNING_SLOPE] * (1 + rp[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_RELATIVE_THERMAL_TUNING_CURVATURE] * (t_ring_k[n] - rp[n, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_TUNING_EXPANSION_TEMPERATURE]))
            d_now = kernel.resonance_detuning(rp[n], lam_b[l], 0.5 * (shift[n, 0] + shift[n, 1]), float(m_up[n]))
            t_target_k[n] = t_ring_k[n] + (det_m[n] - d_now) / dlam_dt
            p_bus_w[l] *= (1.0 - ones_fraction) * float(level_zero.p_thru[0]) + ones_fraction * float(level_one.p_thru[0])
        src_w = np.zeros(thermal_sys.n_src)
        src_w[thermal_sys.wg_src] = p_abs_w
        p_junction_w, p_driver_w = np.zeros(N), np.zeros(N)
        c_swing = np.zeros(N)
        electrical.junction_swing_capacitance_row(v_lo, v_hi, v_grid, cap_tab, rp[:, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_JUNCTION_FILL_FRACTION],
                                                  rp[:, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH], c_swing)
        electrical.data_activity_heat_row(c_swing, v_hi - v_lo, bitrate, np.ascontiguousarray(transition_density),
                                          np.ascontiguousarray(driver_enable), 0.5 * (r_series[:, 0] + r_series[:, 1]),
                                          r_out, p_static, e_tr, 0, p_junction_w, p_driver_w)
        for n in range(N):
            if junction_src.size > n and junction_src[n] >= 0:
                src_w[junction_src[n]] = p_junction_w[n]
            if driver_src.size > n and driver_src[n] >= 0:
                src_w[driver_src[n]] = p_driver_w[n]
        dt_heater_k = t_target_k - t_amb_k - gain_b[ring_obs] @ src_w
        p_heater_w = np.linalg.solve(z_heater, dt_heater_k)
        src_w[thermal_sys.heater_src] = p_heater_w
        t_obs_k = t_amb_k + gain_b @ src_w
        t_ring_k = t_obs_k[ring_obs]
        t_heater_k = t_obs_k[heater_obs]
    return p_abs_w, p_heater_w, t_ring_k, t_heater_k

nodes.name: _heater_drive
nodes.meaning: return power in W, voltage in V, and current in A before supply droop.
comments: return power in W, voltage in V, and current in A before supply droop.
use the static heater driver law with DAC errors and resistance at t_heater_k.
the thermal state already includes heating, so pass zero extra self-heating gain.

source_ref.code:
def _heater_drive(heater_params, b, n, code, t_heater_k) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    from mrm.plant import electrical
    law = int(heater_params.law[b if heater_params.law.shape[0] > 1 else 0])
    drive = np.zeros(1)                       # normalized drive u of the code (V/V_FS, I/I_FS or P/P_FS)
    ripple = np.zeros(1)
    electrical.heater_target_row(np.array([int(code)], np.int64), law, heater_params.bits, heater_params.pwm_bits,
                                 heater_params.bit_err_lsb[min(b, heater_params.bit_err_lsb.shape[0] - 1)][n:n + 1],
                                 heater_params.inl_bow_lsb[min(b, heater_params.inl_bow_lsb.shape[0] - 1)][n:n + 1],
                                 0, 0, 1, drive, ripple)
    power_w = np.zeros(1)
    voltage_v = np.zeros(1)
    current_a = np.zeros(1)
    resistance_ohm = np.zeros(1)
    flags = np.zeros(1, np.int8)

    # the value of ring n in world b of a per-world, per-ring or scalar parameter, as a (1,) array.
    def row(a):
        a = np.asarray(a, float)
        a = a[min(b, a.shape[0] - 1)] if a.ndim == 2 else a
        return np.ascontiguousarray(a[n:n + 1] if a.size > 1 else a.reshape(1))
    electrical.heater_power_row(drive, law, np.array([t_heater_k]), np.zeros(1), row(heater_params.r_cold_ohm),
                                row(heater_params.tcr_per_k), row(heater_params.tcr_ref_k),
                                row(heater_params.v_full_scale_v), row(heater_params.i_full_scale_a),
                                row(heater_params.p_full_scale_w), row(heater_params.compliance_v), power_w,
                                    voltage_v, current_a, resistance_ohm, flags)
    return float(power_w[0]), float(voltage_v[0]), float(current_a[0])

nodes.name: layout_signature
nodes.meaning: return a 62-bit compatibility signature for the ordered compiled layout.
comments: return a 62-bit compatibility signature for the ordered compiled layout.
combine CRC32 and Adler32 over block row names and KParams/KState field names.
the kernel embeds this signature in cached code and checks it before use.

source_ref.code:
def layout_signature() -> int:
    import zlib
    text = "|".join([";".join(b.key + ":" + ",".join(b.names) for b in BLOCKS), ",".join(KPARAMS_NAMES),
                     ",".join(KSTATE_NAMES)])
    crc = zlib.crc32(text.encode())
    checksum = zlib.adler32(text.encode())
    return ((crc << 30) ^ checksum) & ((1 << 62) - 1)

def __init__(self, controller: Any, *, max_steps: int | None = None):

def step(self, obs: Observation) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        spec = self.spec
        if spec is None:
            raise RuntimeError("VectorRecorder: call reset(spec) first")
        layout = spec.layout
        B = spec.n_batch
        record = self.max_steps is None or len(self._ticks) < self.max_steps
        observation_vector = layout.pack_obs(obs.tick, obs.sensors, obs.new, obs.active_ring) if record else None
        compiled = isinstance(self.inner, CompiledController)
        act_in = self._held_before(obs) if compiled else None
        actions = self.inner.step(obs)
        if compiled:
            # mirror the runner clip so the next step sees the applied held command.
            clip_held_command(self.inner, spec)
        if record:
            action_vector = np.zeros((B, layout.act_size), dtype=np.int64) if act_in is None else act_in.copy()
            written_flags = np.zeros(len(layout.act), dtype=bool)
            for j, field_info in enumerate(layout.act):
                if field_info.name in actions:
                    value = np.asarray(actions[field_info.name])
                    if value.dtype == np.uint64:
                        value = np.minimum(value, np.uint64(2**63 - 1))
                    action_vector[:, field_info.offset:field_info.offset + field_info.size] = value.astype(np.int64).reshape(B, field_info.size)
                    written_flags[j] = True
            self._ticks.append(int(obs.tick))
            self._obs.append(observation_vector)
            self._act.append(action_vector)
            if act_in is not None:
                self._act_in.append(act_in)
            self._written.append(written_flags)
            self._reset.append(self._pending_reset)
            self._pending_reset = False
        else:
            self.truncated = True
        return actions

def stream(self, meta: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> VectorStream:
        spec = self.spec
        if spec is None:
            raise RuntimeError("nothing recorded: the controller was never reset")
        K, B = len(self._ticks), spec.n_batch
        layout = spec.layout
        obs = np.stack(self._obs) if K else np.zeros((0, B, layout.obs_size), np.int64)
        act = np.stack(self._act) if K else np.zeros((0, B, layout.act_size), np.int64)
        act_in = (np.stack(self._act_in) if self._act_in else None) if isinstance(self.inner, CompiledController) \
            else None
        if isinstance(self.inner, CompiledController) and act_in is None:
            act_in = np.zeros((0, B, layout.act_size), np.int64)
        metadata = {"controller": self.name, "controller_class": f"{type(self.inner).__module__}."
                                                          f"{type(self.inner).__qualname__}",
             "latency_ticks": self.latency_ticks, "truncated": bool(self.truncated), "n_batch": B,
             "n_rings": spec.n_rings, "tick_s": spec.tick_s, "period_ticks": spec.period_ticks,
             "samples_per_step": spec.samples_per_step}
        describe = getattr(self.inner, "describe", None)
        if callable(describe):
            metadata["controller_params"] = describe()
        metadata.update(dict(meta or {}))
        integer_spec, float_spec = (self._spec_arrays if self._spec_arrays is not None else (None, None))
        return VectorStream(
            ticks=np.asarray(self._ticks, dtype=np.int64), obs=obs, act=act,
            written=(np.stack(self._written) if K else np.zeros((0, len(layout.act)), bool)),
            reset_before=np.asarray(self._reset, dtype=bool), layout_rows=_json_rows(layout.describe()),
            layout_fingerprint=layout.fingerprint(), spec_fingerprint=spec.fingerprint(), act_in=act_in,
            spec_i64=integer_spec, spec_f64=float_spec, meta=metadata)

returns: VectorStream(ticks=np.asarray(self._ticks, dtype=np.int64), obs=obs, act=act, written=np.stack(self._written) if K else np.zeros((0, len(layout.act)), bool), reset_before=np.asarray(self._reset, dtype=bool), layout_rows=_json_rows(layout.describe()), layout_fingerprint=layout.fingerprint(), spec_fingerprint=spec.fingerprint(), act_in=act_in, spec_i64=integer_spec, spec_f64=float_spec, meta=metadata)

def record_vectors(run, path, *, hex: bool = True, meta: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Path]:
    vec = stream_of(run)
    stem = _stem(path)
    stem.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    metadata = dict(vec.meta)
    metadata.update(dict(meta or {}))
    header = {"format": FORMAT, "abi_version": ABI_VERSION, "layout_fingerprint": vec.layout_fingerprint,
            "spec_fingerprint": vec.spec_fingerprint, "layout": vec.layout_rows, "n_records": vec.n_records,
            "n_batch": vec.n_batch, "obs_size": vec.obs_size, "act_size": vec.act_size,
            "act_channels": [r["name"] for r in vec.act_fields], "sha256": vec.sha256(), "meta": metadata}
    arrays = vec.arrays()
    arrays["meta_json"] = np.array(json.dumps(header, sort_keys=True, default=_json_default))
    out: dict[str, Path] = {"npz": stem.with_suffix(".npz")}
    np.savez_compressed(out["npz"], **arrays)
    if hex:
        note = [f"{FORMAT} layout {vec.layout_fingerprint} spec {vec.spec_fingerprint} sha256 {header['sha256'][:16]}"]
        K, B = vec.n_records, vec.n_batch
        out["obs_hex"] = write_hex(stem.with_name(stem.name + ".obs.hex"), vec.obs,
                                   note + [f"obs_i64: K={K} B={B} OBS_SIZE={vec.obs_size}, order (k, b, i)"])
        out["act_hex"] = write_hex(stem.with_name(stem.name + ".act.hex"), vec.act,
                                   note + [f"act_i64 after step: K={K} B={B} ACT_SIZE={vec.act_size}, order (k, b, i)"])
        if vec.act_in is not None:
            out["act_in_hex"] = write_hex(stem.with_name(stem.name + ".act_in.hex"), vec.act_in,
                                          note + [f"act_i64 held on entry: K={K} B={B} ACT_SIZE={vec.act_size}"])
        out["ticks_hex"] = write_hex(stem.with_name(stem.name + ".ticks.hex"), vec.ticks, note + [f"ticks: K={K}"])
        bits = np.zeros(K, dtype=np.int64)
        for j in range(vec.written.shape[1]):
            bits |= vec.written[:, j].astype(np.int64) << j
        out["written_hex"] = write_hex(stem.with_name(stem.name + ".written.hex"), bits,
                                       note + ["bit j = action channel j written: "
                                               + ", ".join(f"{j}={r['name']}" for j, r in enumerate(vec.act_fields))])
        header_path = stem.with_name(stem.name + ".layout.vh")
        header_path.write_text(layout_vh(vec))
        out["vh"] = header_path
    return out

comments: write int64 `words` (any shape, row-major) as 64-bit two's-complement hex, one word per line, after `//` comment lines.

source_ref.code:
def write_hex(path, words: np.ndarray, comments=()) -> Path:
    output_path = Path(path)
    unsigned_words = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(words, dtype=np.int64)).ravel().view(np.uint64)
    header = "".join(f"// {c}\n" for c in comments)
    body = "\n".join(f"{int(x):016x}" for x in unsigned_words.tolist())
    output_path.write_text(header + body + ("\n" if unsigned_words.size else ""))
    return output_path

source_ref.code:
def layout_vh(vec: VectorStream) -> str:
    lines = [f"// generated by mrm.sim.vectors ({FORMAT}); layout {vec.layout_fingerprint}, "
             f"spec {vec.spec_fingerprint}",
             "// word index of element i of channel X, record k, world b: (k*MRMV_B + b)*MRMV_<VEC>_SIZE + "
             "MRMV_<VEC>_<X> + i",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_ABI_VERSION = {ABI_VERSION};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_K = {vec.n_records};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_B = {vec.n_batch};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_OBS_SIZE = {vec.obs_size};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_ACT_SIZE = {vec.act_size};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_OBS_TICK = {OBS_TICK};",
             f"localparam integer MRMV_OBS_ACTIVE_RING = {OBS_ACTIVE_RING};"]
    for row in vec.layout_rows:
        if row["id"] < 0:
            continue
        prefix = {"obs": "OBS", "new": "NEW", "act": "ACT"}[row["vector"]]
        name = _verilog_name(row["name"])
        lines.append(f"localparam integer MRMV_{prefix}_{name} = {row['offset']};")
        lines.append(f"localparam integer MRMV_{prefix}_{name}_SIZE = {row['size']};")
    for j, row in enumerate(vec.act_fields):
        lines.append(f"localparam integer MRMV_WRITTEN_BIT_{_verilog_name(row['name'])} = {j};")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

nodes.meaning: feed saved observations through a controller and compare recorded action channels.
comments: feed saved observations through a controller and compare recorded action channels.
require a matching layout and batch size.
also check the spec fingerprint unless check_spec is false.

source_ref.code:
def replay(controller, vec: VectorStream, spec: ControllerSpec, *, check_spec: bool = True) -> ReplayResult:
    _check_layout(spec, vec, check_spec)
    layout = spec.layout
    K, B = vec.n_records, vec.n_batch
    out = np.zeros((K, B, layout.act_size), dtype=np.int64)
    written_flags = np.zeros((K, len(layout.act)), dtype=bool)
    compiled = isinstance(controller, CompiledController)
    for k in range(K):
        if vec.reset_before[k]:
            controller.reset(spec)
        obs = observation_from_flat(spec, vec.obs[k], int(vec.ticks[k]))
        actions = controller.step(obs)
        if compiled:                      # the plant's clip of the held command, as in the recording
            clip_held_command(controller, spec)
        held = vec.act_in[k] if (vec.act_in is not None and vec.act_in.shape[0] == K) else None
        action_vector = np.zeros((B, layout.act_size), np.int64) if held is None else held.copy()
        for j, field_info in enumerate(layout.act):
            if field_info.name in actions:
                action_vector[:, field_info.offset:field_info.offset + field_info.size] = (
                    np.asarray(actions[field_info.name]).astype(np.int64).reshape(B, field_info.size))
                written_flags[k, j] = True
        out[k] = action_vector
    return _replay_result(vec, out, written_flags)

nodes.meaning: replay compiled init and step functions using saved flat arrays.
comments: replay compiled init and step functions using saved flat arrays.
initialize independent state for each world and repeat initialization at reset markers.
seed each step's action vector from recorded act_in.
spec arrays default to the recording but may be supplied explicitly.
return replayed actions and the comparison, without building a ControllerSpec or plant.

source_ref.code:
def replay_abi(init_fn: Callable, step_fn: Callable, vec: VectorStream, *, spec_i64: np.ndarray | None = None,
               spec_f64: np.ndarray | None = None) -> ReplayResult:
    integer_spec = vec.spec_i64 if spec_i64 is None else np.asarray(spec_i64, np.int64)
    float_spec = vec.spec_f64 if spec_f64 is None else np.asarray(spec_f64, np.float64)
    if integer_spec is None or float_spec is None:
        raise VectorError("no spec arrays in these vectors (recorded from a Python controller): pass spec_i64 and "
                          "spec_f64")
    if vec.act_in is None or vec.act_in.shape[0] != vec.n_records:
        raise VectorError("replay_abi needs the held commands act_in (a CompiledController recording)")
    K, B = vec.n_records, vec.n_batch
    out = np.zeros_like(vec.act)
    state = None
    for k in range(K):
        if state is None or vec.reset_before[k]:
            state = []
            for _b in range(B):
                p, pf, s, sfs = init_fn(integer_spec, float_spec)
                state.append((np.array(p, np.int64), np.array(pf, np.float64), np.array(s, np.int64),
                              np.array(sfs, np.float64)))
        for b in range(B):
            action_vector = np.array(vec.act_in[k, b], dtype=np.int64, copy=True)
            observation_vector = np.ascontiguousarray(vec.obs[k, b])
            p, pf, s, sfs = state[b]
            step_fn(p, pf, s, sfs, observation_vector, action_vector)
            out[k, b] = action_vector
    written_flags = np.ones((K, len(vec.act_fields)), dtype=bool)
    return _replay_result(vec, out, written_flags)

comments: the oracle's target in every world of the TRUE PlantParams `pp`.

source_ref.code:
def oracle_target(pp, conditions, *, stable_margin: float = 0.0, cfg=None) -> OracleTarget:
    B, N = int(pp.batch), int(pp.n_rings)
    out = {k: np.zeros((B, N)) for k in ("detuning_m", "oma_w", "oma_unrestricted_w", "detuning_unrestricted_m",
                                         "p_in_w", "loop_gain", "heater_code")}
    reachable_points = np.zeros((B, N), bool)
    statics = []
    for b in range(B):
        world_conditions = (linear_models.conditions_from_config(pp, b,
            cfg=cfg) if conditions is None else conditions[b])
        det_m, oma_w, oma_u_w, det_u_m = linear_models.oma_optimal_detuning(pp, b, cond=world_conditions,
                                                                           stable_margin=stable_margin)
        operating_point = linear_models.static_point(pp, b, det_m, cond=world_conditions)
        statics.append(operating_point)
        (out["detuning_m"][b], out["oma_w"][b], out["oma_unrestricted_w"][b],
         out["detuning_unrestricted_m"][b]) = det_m, oma_w, oma_u_w, det_u_m
        out["p_in_w"][b] = operating_point.p_in_w
        out["loop_gain"][b] = operating_point.loop_gain_opt
        out["heater_code"][b] = operating_point.heater_code
        reachable_points[b] = reachable(pp, operating_point)
    return OracleTarget(detuning_m=out["detuning_m"], oma_w=out["oma_w"], oma_unrestricted_w=out["oma_unrestricted_w"],
                        detuning_unrestricted_m=out["detuning_unrestricted_m"], p_in_w=out["p_in_w"],
                        reloma_db=reloma_db(out["oma_w"], out["p_in_w"]), loop_gain=out["loop_gain"],
                        heater_code=out["heater_code"], reachable=reachable_points, static=statics)

returns: OracleTarget(detuning_m=out['detuning_m'], oma_w=out['oma_w'], oma_unrestricted_w=out['oma_unrestricted_w'], detuning_unrestricted_m=out['detuning_unrestricted_m'], p_in_w=out['p_in_w'], reloma_db=reloma_db(out['oma_w'], out['p_in_w']), loop_gain=out['loop_gain'], heater_code=out['heater_code'], reachable=reachable_points, static=statics)

source_ref.code:
def _design_world(self, b: int, cond) -> None:
        pp, spec = self.pp, self.spec
        N = int(pp.n_rings)
        optimal_detuning, oma, _, _ = linear_models.oma_optimal_detuning(pp, b, cond=cond,
            stable_margin=self.stable_margin)
        ring_models = linear_models.linearize_bank(self.cfg, linear_models.OperatingPoint(detuning_m=optimal_detuning),
                                                   spec.period_s, latency_ticks=self.latency_ticks,
                                                   measurement="none", pp=pp, b=b, cond=cond)
        design = design_lqg(ring_models, q_pm=self.q_pm, r_codes=self.r_codes, kalman=False)   # full state - no filter
        old_design = self.designs[b]
        self.designs[b] = design
        self.lag_maps[b] = [linear_models.ring_block_lags(pp, b, n) for n in range(N)]
        # c_R - ring temperature (K) per grouped thermal state = (detuning per state) / (detuning per kelvin)
        self.ring_k_per_state[b] = [ring_model.Cc[_Y_DETUNING] / ring_model.Dc[_Y_DETUNING,
            _U_DISTURBANCE] for ring_model in ring_models]
        self.det_target[b] = optimal_detuning
        self.oma_target[b] = oma
        self.reach[b] = reachable(pp, ring_models[0].op)
        self.design_conditions[b] = cond
        if old_design is None:
            self.bumpless[b] = True               # first design - start from the code in the register
        else:
            # retarget - the commands in flight change reference.
            # the integral (the linearization's gain error) carries over, and the new model's feed-forward moves the ring to the new equilibrium at once.
            self.delay_line[b] = self.delay_line[b] + (old_design.u0 - design.u0)[:, None]

def _design_all(self, truth: TruthState) -> None:
        spec, pp = self.spec, self.pp
        B, N = int(pp.batch), int(pp.n_rings)
        if (spec.n_batch, spec.n_rings) != (B, N):
            raise ValueError(f"spec is (B, N) = {(spec.n_batch, spec.n_rings)}, Truth {(B, N)}")
        self.designs = [None] * B
        self.lag_maps = [None] * B
        self.ring_k_per_state = [None] * B
        self.design_conditions = [None] * B
        self.det_target = np.zeros((B, N))
        self.oma_target = np.zeros((B, N))
        self.reach = np.ones((B, N), bool)
        self.bumpless = np.ones(B, bool)
        # commands in flight (deviations from each world's u*), newest first - one (N, n_delay) array per world (the thermal block and the delay line may differ between worlds - sampled transport delay, ROM family)
        self.delay_line = [None] * B
        for b in range(B):
            self._design_world(b, truth.conditions[b])
        applied = (np.asarray(truth.heater_applied, float) if truth.heater_applied is not None
                   else np.stack([design.u0 for design in self.designs]))
        for b in range(B):
            design = self.designs[b]
            n_delay = design.nc - design.models[0].Ac.shape[0]
            self.delay_line[b] = np.repeat((applied[b] - design.u0)[:, None], n_delay, axis=1)
        self._d_prev_pm = np.full((B, N), np.nan)
        self.integral_pm = np.zeros((B, N))
        self.code_min = float(spec.heater_dac.code_min)
        self.code_max = float(spec.heater_dac.code_max)
        self._last_codes = np.zeros((B, N))
        self._last_retarget = np.full(B, -(1 << 62), np.int64)      # tick of the last retarget (none yet)
        self.n_retargets = 0
        self._designed = True

nodes.name: _disturbance_pm
nodes.meaning: one controller edge
comments: one controller edge
the exact model state from Truth.
returns (z_dev, d_pm, err_pm) — z_dev, one (N, n_thermal) array per world of thermal states minus their values at the operating point.
d_pm (B, N), the disturbance d as pm of open-loop resonance shift.
err_pm (B, N), the true detuning error (pm).

source_ref.code:
def _disturbance_pm(self, truth: TruthState):
        B, N = self._last_codes.shape
        z_dev = []
        d_pm = np.zeros((B, N))
        err_pm = np.zeros((B, N))
        for b in range(B):
            design = self.designs[b]
            op_point = design.models[0].op
            n_thermal = design.models[0].Ac.shape[0]
            z_world = np.zeros((N, n_thermal))
            detuning_m = linear_models.resonance_detuning_m(self.pp, b, truth.t_ring_k[b], truth.conditions[b])
            for n in range(N):
                lag_index, residue, source = self.lag_maps[b][n]
                z_lag = truth.x[b, lag_index] / residue
                z_op = np.where(source == 0, op_point.heater_power_w[n], op_point.p_abs_w[n])
                z_world[n, :lag_index.size] = z_lag - z_op
                if n_thermal > lag_index.size:          # heater settle-filter state (models._model_for_ring) - its
                    z_world[n, lag_index.size:] = self.delay_line[b][n, -1]  # input is the code leaving the line
                shift_m_per_k = design.models[n].Dc[_Y_DETUNING, _U_DISTURBANCE]
                disturbance_k = ((detuning_m[n] - self.det_target[b, n]) / shift_m_per_k
                       - self.ring_k_per_state[b][n] @ z_world[n])
                d_pm[b, n] = disturbance_k * shift_m_per_k * _PM
                err_pm[b, n] = (detuning_m[n] - self.det_target[b, n]) * _PM
            z_dev.append(z_world)
        return z_dev, d_pm, err_pm

comments: heater codes (B, N) for this edge from the exact state in `truth` (`obs` is not used).

source_ref.code:
def step(self, obs, truth: TruthState) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        if self.spec is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Oracle: call reset(spec, truth_pp, truth) first")
        if not (hasattr(truth, "x") and hasattr(truth, "conditions")):
            raise TypeError("Oracle.step needs a mrm.validation.oracle.TruthState (thermal lag states x, ring "
                            "temperatures, per-world Conditions); got " + type(truth).__name__)
        if not self._designed:
            self._design_all(truth)
        B, N = self._last_codes.shape
        if self.retarget:
            for b in range(B):
                if (truth.tick - self._last_retarget[b] >= self.retarget_min_ticks
                        and self._conditions_moved(self.design_conditions[b], truth.conditions[b])):
                    self._design_world(b, truth.conditions[b])
                    # d changes reference with the design (target, operating point, s, c_R).
                    # the change of d across the retarget is not a rate, so the rate of this edge is 0, as on the first edge.
                    self._d_prev_pm[b] = np.nan
                    self._last_retarget[b] = truth.tick
                    self.n_retargets += 1
        z_dev, d_pm, err_pm = self._disturbance_pm(truth)
        period_ms = self.spec.period_s * 1e3
        d_rate_pm_per_ms = np.where(np.isfinite(self._d_prev_pm), (d_pm - self._d_prev_pm) / period_ms, 0.0)
        d_rate_pm_per_ms = np.where(self.bumpless[:, None], 0.0, d_rate_pm_per_ms)
        self._d_prev_pm = d_pm
        # integral of the TRUE detuning error, added to d - it removes what the linearization gets wrong (the heater gain at a code far from the linearization point, the TCR) - with the exact d the loop is otherwise open in DC
        self.integral_pm = self.integral_pm + self.ki_per_step * err_pm
        codes = np.zeros((B, N))
        for b in range(B):
            design = self.designs[b]
            if self.bumpless[b]:
                # bumpless (re)start - the integrator takes the value that reproduces the code now in the register
                z_core = np.concatenate([z_dev[b], self.delay_line[b]], axis=1)[:, :design.nc]
                k_d = design.Kf[:, design.nc]                       # feedback gain on the d state
                rest = np.einsum("nz,nz->n", design.Kf[:, :design.nc], z_core) + k_d * d_pm[b]
                applied = design.u0 + self.delay_line[b][:, 0]
                k_d_safe = np.where(np.abs(k_d) > 0, k_d, 1.0)
                self.integral_pm[b] = np.where(np.abs(k_d) > 0, (design.u0 - applied - rest) / k_d_safe, 0.0)
                self.bumpless[b] = False
            # the augmented state stacks thermal states, delay registers, d + I, and the disturbance rate.
            # trim the vector to the design size.
            z_full = np.concatenate([z_dev[b], self.delay_line[b], (d_pm[b] + self.integral_pm[b])[:, None],
                                     d_rate_pm_per_ms[b][:, None]], axis=1)[:, :design.nz]
            code_deviation = -np.einsum("nz,nz->n", design.Kf, z_full)
            # an unreachable target (reachable() - beyond the code range, no heater authority, bank over the supply) is not regulated - the oracle holds the code nearest to it (the range end) instead of winding up
            requested_code = np.where(self.reach[b], design.u0 + code_deviation, design.u0)
            codes[b] = np.clip(np.rint(np.nan_to_num(requested_code, nan=design.u0)), self.code_min, self.code_max)
            self.integral_pm[b] = np.where(self.reach[b], self.integral_pm[b], 0.0)
            self.delay_line[b] = np.concatenate([(codes[b] - design.u0)[:, None], self.delay_line[b][:, :-1]],
                                                axis=1)
        self._last_codes = codes
        return {"tx.heater": codes.astype(np.int64)}

source_ref.code:
def resolve_plant(plant, *, batch: int = 1, uncertainty: str = "nominal", variation: str = "off", seeds=0,
                  alts: Mapping[str, str] | None = None, overrides: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None):
    from mrm import params
    if _is_plant_params(plant):
        if alts or overrides:
            raise TypeError("hypothesis alternatives need a preset name or a Config, not a PlantParams")
        return None, plant
    cfg = load_config(plant, alts=alts, overrides=overrides)
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        pp = params.realize(cfg, int(batch), seeds=seeds, uncertainty=uncertainty, variation=variation)
    return cfg, pp

source_ref.code:
def __init__(self, pp, *, b: int = 0, n: int = 0, topology: str = "add_drop", driver_law: str | None = None,
                 _cache: dict | None = None):
        if topology not in ("add_drop", "all_pass"):
            raise ValueError(f"topology must be add_drop or all_pass, got {topology!r}")
        cache = _cache if _cache is not None else _plant_cache(pp)
        self.pp, self.b, self.n, self.topology = pp, int(b), int(n), topology
        # phase-model row of this ring (phase.RP_* columns) and the junction table of this world
        phase_params = cache["phase"]
        rp = np.array(phase_params.ring[self.b, self.n], dtype=float)
        if topology == "all_pass":
            rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_DROP_POWER_COUPLING] = 0.0
        self.rp = rp
        table_row = phase_params.table_row(self.b)
        self.grid = phase_params.grid
        # (dneff, alpha_fca, capacitance, r_series) columns of the junction table, in the order phase.*_row expect
        self.junction_tables = (np.ascontiguousarray(phase_params.dneff[table_row]),
                                np.ascontiguousarray(phase_params.alpha_fca[table_row]),
                                np.ascontiguousarray(phase_params.capacitance[table_row]),
                                np.ascontiguousarray(phase_params.r_series[table_row]))
        rb = np.asarray(pp.optics.backscatter_rb[self.b, self.n])
        self.rb = rb if (rb.size and np.any(rb != 0)) else None      # backscatter of optics.evaluate_exact_ring_response (None - off)
        # DC thermal gains of this ring's own sources - see the StaticRing source-observer keys
        sysm = pp.thermal.system
        G = cache["dc"][self.b]                                    # (O, S) K/W
        n = self.n

        def gain(obs, src):
            return float(G[obs, src]) if (obs >= 0 and src >= 0) else 0.0
        ring_obs, heater_obs = int(sysm.ring_obs[n]), int(sysm.heater_obs[n])
        pd_obs = int(sysm.pd_obs[n]) if sysm.pd_obs.size else -1
        heater_src, wg_src = int(sysm.heater_src[n]), int(sysm.wg_src[n])
        junction_src = int(sysm.junction_src[n]) if sysm.junction_src.size else -1
        driver_src = int(sysm.driver_src[n]) if sysm.driver_src.size else -1
        self.z = {"hr": gain(ring_obs, heater_src), "hh": gain(heater_obs, heater_src),
                  "or": gain(ring_obs, wg_src), "oh": gain(heater_obs, wg_src),
                  "jr": gain(ring_obs, junction_src), "jh": gain(heater_obs, junction_src),
                  "dr": gain(ring_obs, driver_src), "dh": gain(heater_obs, driver_src),
                  "hp": gain(pd_obs, heater_src), "op": gain(pd_obs, wg_src),
                  "jp": gain(pd_obs, junction_src), "dp": gain(pd_obs, driver_src)}
        if not self.z["hr"] > 0:
            raise ValueError("the thermal system has no heater -> ring path for this ring")
        # heater driver (realized DAC path of this ring) - law -1 is the bench voltage source (u = V)
        heater_hw = cache["heater"]
        law = int(np.asarray(heater_hw.law).reshape(-1)[self.b if heater_hw.law.size > 1 else 0])
        if driver_law is not None:
            law = -1 if driver_law == "bench_voltage" else electrical.DRIVER_LAWS[driver_law]
        self.law = law
        b_idx = self.b if heater_hw.r_cold_ohm.shape[0] > 1 else 0
        n_idx = self.n if heater_hw.r_cold_ohm.shape[1] > 1 else 0

        def heater_value(a):
            a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
            return float(a[b_idx if a.shape[0] > 1 else 0, n_idx if a.shape[1] > 1 else 0])
        self.r_cold_ohm = heater_value(heater_hw.r_cold_ohm)
        self.tcr_per_k = heater_value(heater_hw.tcr_per_k)
        self.tcr_ref_k = heater_value(heater_hw.tcr_ref_k)
        self.v_fs, self.i_fs, self.p_fs = (heater_value(heater_hw.v_full_scale_v),
                                           heater_value(heater_hw.i_full_scale_a),
                                           heater_value(heater_hw.p_full_scale_w))
        # driver output compliance (V) - electrical.heater_power_row saturates as a voltage source there - a bench voltage source has none
        self.v_comp = math.inf if law == -1 else heater_value(heater_hw.compliance_v)
        self.bits, self.pwm_bits = int(heater_hw.bits), int(heater_hw.pwm_bits)
        bit_err = np.asarray(heater_hw.bit_err_lsb)
        self.bit_err_lsb = np.ascontiguousarray(
            bit_err[b_idx if bit_err.shape[0] > 1 else 0, n_idx if bit_err.shape[1] > 1 else 0][None, :])
        bow = np.asarray(heater_hw.inl_bow_lsb, dtype=float)
        self.inl_bow_lsb = np.array([bow[b_idx if bow.shape[0] > 1 else 0, n_idx if bow.shape[1] > 1 else 0]])
        self._dac_table = None
        # optics constants and the laser line of this ring
        opt = pp.optics
        self.lam_res = float(rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_COLD_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH])          # cold resonance (m)
        self.t_ref = float(rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE])              # its reference ring temperature (K)
        # thermo-optic slope - s(T) = s0 (1 + beta (T - T0)), s0 in m/K, beta in 1/K, T0 in K
        self.s0, self.beta, self.t0 = float(rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_THERMAL_TUNING_SLOPE]), float(rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_RELATIVE_THERMAL_TUNING_CURVATURE]), float(rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_TUNING_EXPANSION_TEMPERATURE])
        self.q_loaded = float(np.asarray(opt.q_loaded)[self.b, self.n])
        self.fsr_hz = float(np.asarray(opt.fsr_hz)[self.b, self.n])
        self.line = int(np.asarray(pp.layout.ring_to_line)[self.n])
        self.lam_line = float(C0 / np.asarray(pp.laser.line_freq_hz)[self.b, self.line])
        input_transmission = float(np.asarray(pp.laser.input_transmission).reshape(-1)[
            self.b if pp.batch > 1 and np.size(pp.laser.input_transmission) > 1 else 0])
        self.p_line_w = float(np.asarray(pp.laser.power_w)[self.b, self.line]) * input_transmission
        # every TX line on the bus at its chip-input power.
        # in bank protocols the other lines leak into the drop monitor and heat the ring (the drop monitor sums every line and every order).
        # these are chip-input powers - the bank protocols (_bank_codes, bus_line_powers) apply the filtering by the rings upstream.
        tx_lines = [i for i, d_ in enumerate(pp.laser.direction) if d_ == "tx"] if len(pp.laser.direction) else \
            list(range(int(pp.n_lines)))
        self.other_lines = np.array([i for i in tx_lines if i != self.line], dtype=np.int64)
        self.lam_lines = C0 / np.asarray(pp.laser.line_freq_hz, dtype=float)[self.b]
        self.p_lines_w = np.asarray(pp.laser.power_w, dtype=float)[self.b] * input_transmission
        # data path - NRZ swing and level convention, and the junction and driver heat of the data
        datapath = pp.datapath
        self.swing_pp_v = float(np.asarray(datapath.swing_pp_v)[self.b, self.n])
        self.level_mode = int(np.asarray(datapath.level_convention).reshape(-1)[
            self.b if np.size(datapath.level_convention) > 1 else 0])
        self.bitrate_hz = float(np.asarray(datapath.bitrate_hz).reshape(-1)[
            self.b if np.size(datapath.bitrate_hz) > 1 else 0])
        td = np.asarray(datapath.transition_density).reshape(-1)
        td = float(td[self.b if td.size > 1 else 0])
        self.transition_density = td if math.isfinite(td) else 0.5
        # (driver output resistance ohm, driver static power W, driver energy per transition J)
        self._driver_heat_params = tuple(float(np.asarray(x).reshape(-1)[self.b if np.size(x) > 1 else 0])
                                         for x in (datapath.driver_output_resistance_ohm,
                                                   datapath.driver_static_power_w,
                                                   datapath.driver_energy_per_transition_j))
        self._monitor_hw = cache["monitor"]
        self.cache = cache

def optics(self, lam, t_ring, t_heater=None, v_lo=0.0, v_hi=None) -> dict:
        lam = np.ascontiguousarray(np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(lam, dtype=float)))
        t_ring_k = np.ascontiguousarray(np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t_ring, dtype=float)))
        M, L = t_ring_k.size, lam.size
        # use writable contiguous arrays because the compiled row functions require them
        t_heater_k = t_ring_k if t_heater is None else _writeable_full(t_heater, (M,))
        v0 = _writeable_full(v_lo, (M,))
        cw = v_hi is None
        v1 = v0 if cw else _writeable_full(v_hi, (M,))
        rp = _writeable_full(self.rp, (M, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_COUNT))
        # phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs returns phase, amplitude and heat fraction eta for each level.
        # it also returns couplings, round-trip time, junction shift, capacitance, series resistance and flags.
        out = {k: np.zeros((M, L)) for k in ("phi0", "phi1", "a0", "a1", "e0", "e1", "k2t", "k2d", "trt")}
        out.update(shift=np.zeros((M, 2)), cj=np.zeros((M, 2)), rs=np.zeros((M, 2)), flags=np.zeros(M, np.int8))
        dn_tab, al_tab, c_tab, rs_tab = self.junction_tables
        phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs(rp, lam, t_ring_k, t_heater_k, v0, v1, self.grid, dn_tab, al_tab, c_tab, rs_tab,
                              out["phi0"], out["phi1"], out["a0"], out["a1"], out["e0"], out["e1"], out["k2t"],
                              out["k2d"], out["trt"], out["shift"], out["cj"], out["rs"], out["flags"])
        exact0 = optics.evaluate_exact_ring_response(out["phi0"], out["k2t"], out["k2d"], out["a0"], out["trt"], rb=self.rb)
        res = {"thru0": np.abs(exact0.thru) ** 2, "drop0": np.abs(exact0.drop) ** 2, "loss0": exact0.p_loss}
        res["abs0"] = out["e0"] * res["loss0"]
        if cw:
            for k in ("thru", "drop", "loss", "abs"):
                res[k + "1"] = res[k + "0"]
        else:
            exact1 = optics.evaluate_exact_ring_response(out["phi1"], out["k2t"], out["k2d"], out["a1"], out["trt"], rb=self.rb)
            res.update(thru1=np.abs(exact1.thru) ** 2, drop1=np.abs(exact1.drop) ** 2, loss1=exact1.p_loss)
            res["abs1"] = out["e1"] * res["loss1"]
        res.update(shift=out["shift"], cj=out["cj"], rs=out["rs"], k2t=out["k2t"], k2d=out["k2d"], a0=out["a0"],
                   trt=out["trt"], flags=out["flags"])
        return res

def _phase_at(self, x) -> np.ndarray:
        x = np.ascontiguousarray(np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(x, dtype=float)))
        rp = np.ascontiguousarray(self.rp[None, :])
        level_outs = [np.zeros((1, x.size)) for _ in range(9)]       # phi0 first (see optics())

                              *self.junction_tables, *level_outs, *pair_outs, np.zeros(1, np.int8))

def power_from_u(self, u, t_pre_k, g_self=None) -> np.ndarray:

def _dac_transfer(self):
        if self._dac_table is None:
            if self.law == -1:
                raise ValueError("bench_voltage has no DAC codes")
            codes = np.arange(1 << self.bits, dtype=np.int64)
            u = np.empty(codes.size)
            ripple = np.empty(codes.size)
            # pwm_ripple 0 (period average only), tick 0, dt_clk 1
            electrical.heater_target_row(codes, self.law, self.bits, self.pwm_bits, self.bit_err_lsb,
                                         self.inl_bow_lsb, 0, 0, 1, u, ripple)
            self._dac_table = (codes.astype(float), u, np.maximum.accumulate(u))
        return self._dac_table

def data_heat(self, v_lo: float, v_hi: float, *, enable: bool = True) -> tuple[float, float]:
        if not enable:
            return 0.0, 0.0
        grid = self.grid
        c_tab = self.junction_tables[2]                  # capacitance column
        c_eff_f = np.zeros(1)
        electrical.junction_swing_capacitance_row(np.array([v_lo]), np.array([v_hi]), grid, c_tab,
                                                  np.array([self.rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_JUNCTION_FILL_FRACTION]]),
                                                  np.array([self.rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH]]), c_eff_f)
        o = self.optics(self.lam_line, [self.t_ref], None, v_lo, v_hi)
        r_s = 0.5 * float(o["rs"][0, 0] + o["rs"][0, 1])     # series resistance, mean of the two levels (ohm)
        p_j, p_d = np.zeros(1), np.zeros(1)
        r_drv, p_static, e_transition = self._driver_heat_params
        electrical.data_activity_heat_row(c_eff_f, np.array([v_hi - v_lo]),
                                          self.bitrate_hz if math.isfinite(self.bitrate_hz) else 0.0,
                                          np.array([self.transition_density]), np.array([1.0]),
                                          np.array([r_s]), np.array([r_drv if math.isfinite(r_drv) else 0.0]),
                                          np.array([p_static]), np.array([e_transition]), 0, p_j, p_d)
        return float(p_j[0]), float(p_d[0])

def monitor_current_a(self, p_drop_w, p_bus_w=0.0, t_pd_k=None) -> np.ndarray:
        hw = self._monitor_hw
        p = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(p_drop_w, dtype=float))
        out = np.empty(p.shape)
        for i, p_drop in enumerate(p.ravel()):
            p_drop_bn = np.zeros((hw.B, hw.N))
            p_drop_bn[self.b, self.n] = p_drop
            p_bus_bn = np.zeros((hw.B, hw.N))
            p_bus_bn[self.b, self.n] = float(np.asarray(p_bus_w).ravel()[i if np.size(p_bus_w) > 1 else 0])
            t = None
            if t_pd_k is not None:
                t = np.full((hw.B, hw.N), float(np.asarray(t_pd_k).ravel()[i if np.size(t_pd_k) > 1 else 0]))
            i_signal, i_dark = hw.photocurrent_a(p_drop_bn, p_bus_bn, t)
            out.ravel()[i] = i_signal[self.b, self.n] + i_dark[self.b, self.n]
        return out

comments: static states
(absorbed heat, drop power) in W, each (M,), from every TX line except the ring's own.
Evaluated on the ring-temperature grid t_grid (M,) in K, as the level average for NRZ.
`p_lines_w` (L,) - the line powers at this ring (W - default - the chip-input powers, that is no upstream filtering - `_bank_codes` passes the bus-filtered ones).
every order of the ring counts (the exact ring is periodic), so a neighbouring order near another line (BND-1, the adjacent-order bound) shows up here.
nodes.signature: other_lines_terms(self, t_grid, t_heater=None, v_lo: float=0.0, v_hi: float | None=None, rho: float=0.5, p_lines_w=None)

source_ref.code:
def other_lines_terms(self, t_grid, t_heater=None, v_lo: float = 0.0, v_hi: float | None = None,
                          rho: float = 0.5, p_lines_w=None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        tg = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(t_grid, dtype=float))
        if self.other_lines.size == 0:
            return np.zeros(tg.size), np.zeros(tg.size)
        other = self.other_lines
        o = self.optics(self.lam_lines[other], tg, t_heater, v_lo, v_hi)
        rho_ = 0.0 if v_hi is None else float(rho)
        p = (self.p_lines_w if p_lines_w is None else np.asarray(p_lines_w, dtype=float))[other]
        p_abs_w = (rho_ * o["abs1"] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["abs0"]) @ p
        p_drop_w = (rho_ * o["drop1"] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["drop0"]) @ p
        return p_abs_w, p_drop_w

source_ref.code:
def state_grid(self, lam, t_grid, *, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v_lo: float = 0.0, v_hi: float | None = None,
                   rho: float = 0.5, p_j: float = 0.0, p_d: float = 0.0, agg_r: float = 0.0, agg_h: float = 0.0,
                   heater_loss_passes: int = 2, lines: str = "own", p_lines_w=None) -> dict:
        if lines not in ("own", "all"):
            raise ValueError(f"lines must be 'own' or 'all', got {lines!r}")
        tg = np.asarray(t_grid, dtype=float)
        lam = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(lam, dtype=float))
        kw = dict(t_base=t_base, p_in_w=p_in_w, v_lo=v_lo, v_hi=v_hi, rho=rho, p_j=p_j, p_d=p_d, agg_r=agg_r,
                  agg_h=agg_h)
        if self.rp[phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_LOG_LOSS_HEATER_TEMPERATURE_DERIVATIVE] == 0.0:
            extra = self.other_lines_terms(tg, None, v_lo, v_hi, rho, p_lines_w) if lines == "all" else (0.0, 0.0)
            return self.heat_balance(self.optics(lam, tg, None, v_lo, v_hi), tg, p_abs_extra=extra[0],
                                     p_drop_extra=extra[1], **kw)
        if lam.size > 1:                     # the heater temperature differs per wavelength - one column at a time
            cols = [self.state_grid(lam[i:i + 1], tg, heater_loss_passes=heater_loss_passes, lines=lines,
                                    p_lines_w=p_lines_w, **kw) for i in range(lam.size)]
            out = {}
            for k, v in cols[0].items():
                out[k] = (np.concatenate([c[k] for c in cols], axis=1) if isinstance(v, np.ndarray) and v.ndim == 2
                          and v.shape[1] == 1 else v)
            return out
        z = self.z
        t_h = tg + (z["hh"] / z["hr"] - 1.0) * (tg - t_base)          # first guess - heater-only ratio
        for _ in range(max(1, int(heater_loss_passes))):
            extra = self.other_lines_terms(tg, t_h, v_lo, v_hi, rho, p_lines_w) if lines == "all" else (0.0, 0.0)
            o = self.heat_balance(self.optics(lam, tg, t_h, v_lo, v_hi), tg, p_abs_extra=extra[0],
                                  p_drop_extra=extra[1], **kw)
            t_h = o["t_h"][:, 0]
        return o

returns: self.heat_balance(self.optics(lam, tg, None, v_lo, v_hi), tg, p_abs_extra=extra[0], p_drop_extra=extra[1], **kw)

nodes.name: heat_balance
nodes.meaning: find the heater power and drive that sustain each ring temperature in t_grid (M,) in K.
comments: find the heater power and drive that sustain each ring temperature in t_grid (M,) in K.
o contains optics from optics or state_grid.
return a new dict without changing o.
p_abs, p_h, t_h, u and t_pd have shape (M, L).
power is in W and temperature is in K.
drop_avg and thru_avg are level-averaged fractions of probe power.
reloma is |T1 - T0|.
p_abs_extra and p_drop_extra are scalar or (M,) powers in W from the other lines.
drop_other_w stores their drop power with shape (M,).
use temperature as the independent variable so the required heater power is explicit.
for each temperature T and wavelength, with rho the probability of level 1, P_abs(T) = P_in [rho A_1(T) + (1 - rho) A_0(T)] + P_abs_extra
P_h(T) = (T - T_base - Z_or P_abs - Z_jr P_j - Z_dr P_d - agg_r) / Z_hr
T_H(T) = T_base + Z_hh P_h + Z_oh P_abs + Z_jh P_j + Z_dh P_d + agg_h
A_0 and A_1 are absorbed-heat fractions.
P_j and P_d are junction and driver heat in W.
agg_r and agg_h are aggressor temperature rises in K.
StaticRing defines the Z source-observer keys.
u_from_power inverts the driver law at R(T_H) = R0 (1 + alpha (T_H - T_R0)).
R0 is cold resistance in ohm, alpha is TCR in 1/K and T_R0 is its reference temperature in K.
for voltage drive u = sqrt(P_h R) / V_FS.
for current drive u = sqrt(P_h / R) / I_FS.
for power drive u = P_h / P_FS.
for dac_pwm u = P_h R / V_FS^2.
nodes.signature: heat_balance(self, o: dict, t_grid, *, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v_lo: float=0.0, v_hi: float | None=None, rho: float=0.5, p_j: float=0.0, p_d: float=0.0, agg_r: float=0.0, agg_h: float=0.0, p_abs_extra=0.0, p_drop_extra=0.0)

source_ref.code:
def heat_balance(self, o: dict, t_grid, *, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v_lo: float = 0.0,
                     v_hi: float | None = None, rho: float = 0.5, p_j: float = 0.0, p_d: float = 0.0,
                     agg_r: float = 0.0, agg_h: float = 0.0, p_abs_extra=0.0, p_drop_extra=0.0) -> dict:
        tg = np.asarray(t_grid, dtype=float)
        z = self.z
        rho_ = 0.0 if v_hi is None else float(rho)
        o = dict(o)
        extra = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(p_abs_extra, dtype=float), tg.shape)
        p_abs = p_in_w * (rho_ * o["abs1"] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["abs0"]) + extra[:, None]
        o["drop_other_w"] = np.array(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(p_drop_extra, dtype=float), tg.shape))
        p_h = (tg[:, None] - t_base - z["or"] * p_abs - z["jr"] * p_j - z["dr"] * p_d - agg_r) / z["hr"]
        t_h = t_base + z["hh"] * p_h + z["oh"] * p_abs + z["jh"] * p_j + z["dh"] * p_d + agg_h
        o.update(p_abs=p_abs, p_h=p_h, t_h=t_h, u=self.u_from_power(p_h, t_h), rho=rho_,
                 drop_avg=rho_ * o["drop1"] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["drop0"],
                 thru_avg=rho_ * o["thru1"] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["thru0"],
                 reloma=np.abs(o["thru1"] - o["thru0"]),
                 t_pd=t_base + z["hp"] * p_h + z["op"] * p_abs + z["jp"] * p_j + z["dp"] * p_d)
        return o

the fraction-of-peak locks then use total monitor drop power.
p_lines_w gives line powers (L,) in W at the ring.
None uses their chip-input powers.
t_base is stage temperature in K.
p_in_w is own-line power at the ring in W.
agg_r and agg_h are aggressor rises in K.
lam is laser wavelength in m, or None for the ring's line.
n_grid samples span_linewidths linewidths on each side of resonance in ring-temperature units.
nodes.signature: lock(self, *, mode: str='half_max', lam: float | None=None, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, bias_v: float=0.0, modulate: bool=False, rho: float=0.5, data_heat: bool | None=None, fraction: float | None=None, side: str='hot', stable_only: bool=True, n_grid: int=2001, span_linewidths: float=6.0, agg_r: float=0.0, agg_h: float=0.0, order: int | str=0, lines: str='own', p_lines_w=None)

source_ref.code:
def lock(self, *, mode: str = "half_max", lam: float | None = None, t_base: float, p_in_w: float,
             bias_v: float = 0.0, modulate: bool = False, rho: float = 0.5, data_heat: bool | None = None,
             fraction: float | None = None, side: str = "hot", stable_only: bool = True, n_grid: int = 2001,
             span_linewidths: float = 6.0, agg_r: float = 0.0, agg_h: float = 0.0,
             order: int | str = 0, lines: str = "own", p_lines_w=None) -> LockPoint:
        lam = self.lam_line if lam is None else float(lam)
        if modulate:
            v_lo, v_hi = self.nrz_levels(bias_v)
        else:
            v_lo, v_hi = float(bias_v), None
        with_data_heat = modulate if data_heat is None else bool(data_heat)
        p_j, p_d = self.data_heat(v_lo, v_hi if v_hi is not None else v_lo, enable=with_data_heat)
        v_mid = 0.5 * (v_lo + (v_hi if v_hi is not None else v_lo))
        if order == "first":
            order = self.first_order(lam, v_mid, t_base + self.z["jr"] * p_j + self.z["dr"] * p_d + agg_r)
        t_res_k = self.t_res(lam, v_mid, int(order))
        width_k = self.linewidth_k(t_res_k)
        tg = np.linspace(t_res_k - span_linewidths * width_k, t_res_k + span_linewidths * width_k, int(n_grid))
        state = self.state_grid(lam, tg, t_base=t_base, p_in_w=p_in_w, v_lo=v_lo, v_hi=v_hi, rho=rho, p_j=p_j,
                                p_d=p_d, agg_r=agg_r, agg_h=agg_h, lines=lines, p_lines_w=p_lines_w)
        # the drop seen by the monitor (W) - own line, plus the other lines' leakage with lines='all'
        drop_w = p_in_w * state["drop_avg"][:, 0] + state["drop_other_w"]
        # level search on the per-unit own drop for lines='own' (works at P_in -> 0), on the monitor power otherwise
        # (unless no light reaches the ring at all)
        drop = state["drop_avg"][:, 0] if (lines == "own" or not np.max(drop_w) > 0.0) else drop_w
        du_dt = np.gradient(state["u"][:, 0], tg)
        stable = du_dt > 0
        i_peak = int(np.argmax(drop))
        # i - the fractional grid index of the lock point
        if mode == "peak":
            i = _refine_argmax(tg, drop, i_peak)
        elif mode == "resonance":
            i = float(np.interp(t_res_k, tg, np.arange(tg.size)))
        elif mode in ("half_max", "fraction"):
            f = 0.5 if mode == "half_max" else float(fraction)
            level = f * drop[i_peak]
            if side == "hot":
                walk = np.arange(i_peak, tg.size)          # from the peak towards hotter ring temperatures
            else:
                walk = np.arange(i_peak, -1, -1)
            j = walk[np.flatnonzero(drop[walk] <= level)]
            if j.size == 0:
                raise ValueError("the lock level is not reached inside the grid; widen span_linewidths")
            j = int(j[0])
            k = j - 1 if side == "hot" else j + 1
            i = k + (drop[k] - level) / (drop[k] - drop[j]) * (j - k)
        elif mode == "oracle":
            if v_hi is None:
                raise ValueError("oracle lock needs modulate=True")
            reloma = state["reloma"][:, 0].copy()
            if stable_only:
                reloma[~stable] = -np.inf
            if not np.any(np.isfinite(reloma)):
                raise ValueError("no stable operating point on the grid")
            i = _refine_argmax(tg, reloma, int(np.argmax(reloma)))
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown lock mode {mode!r}")
        idx = np.arange(tg.size, dtype=float)

        def at_lock(a):
            return float(np.interp(i, idx, np.asarray(a, dtype=float)))
        t_lock = at_lock(tg)
        p_lines = self.p_lines_w if p_lines_w is None else np.asarray(p_lines_w, dtype=float)
        p_bus = p_in_w + (float(np.sum(p_lines[self.other_lines])) if lines == "all" else 0.0)
        return LockPoint(mode=mode, order=int(order), t_ring_k=t_lock, t_res_k=t_res_k,
                         p_abs_w=at_lock(state["p_abs"][:, 0]), p_drop_w=at_lock(drop_w),
                         p_thru_w=p_in_w * at_lock(state["thru_avg"][:, 0]), reloma=at_lock(state["reloma"][:, 0]),
                         drop_peak_w=float(drop_w[i_peak]), p_j_w=p_j, p_d_w=p_d,
                         p_heater_w=at_lock(state["p_h"][:, 0]), t_heater_k=at_lock(state["t_h"][:, 0]),
                         u=at_lock(state["u"][:, 0]), stable=bool(at_lock(du_dt) > 0),
                         detuning_m=float(lam - (self.lam_res + self.order_offset_m(int(order))
                                                 + self.thermal_shift_m(t_lock) + self.junction_shift_m(v_mid)[0])),
                         t_pd_k=at_lock(state["t_pd"][:, 0]), p_drop_other_w=at_lock(state["drop_other_w"]),
                         p_bus_w=p_bus)

returns: LockPoint(mode=mode, order=int(order), t_ring_k=t_lock, t_res_k=t_res_k, p_abs_w=at_lock(state['p_abs'][:, 0]), p_drop_w=at_lock(drop_w), p_thru_w=p_in_w * at_lock(state['thru_avg'][:, 0]), reloma=at_lock(state['reloma'][:, 0]), drop_peak_w=float(drop_w[i_peak]), p_j_w=p_j, p_d_w=p_d, p_heater_w=at_lock(state['p_h'][:, 0]), t_heater_k=at_lock(state['t_h'][:, 0]), u=at_lock(state['u'][:, 0]), stable=bool(at_lock(du_dt) > 0), detuning_m=float(lam - (self.lam_res + self.order_offset_m(int(order)) + self.thermal_shift_m(t_lock) + self.junction_shift_m(v_mid)[0])), t_pd_k=at_lock(state['t_pd'][:, 0]), p_drop_other_w=at_lock(state['drop_other_w']), p_bus_w=p_bus)

source_ref.code:
def bus_line_powers(pp, b: int, t_ring_k, *, bias_v: float | None = None, v_lo=None, v_hi=None, rho: float = 0.5,
                    p_chip_w=None) -> np.ndarray:
    N = int(pp.n_rings)
    t = np.asarray(t_ring_k, dtype=float).reshape(-1)
    rings = [StaticRing(pp, b=b, n=n) for n in range(N)]
    p_at = (rings[0].p_lines_w.copy() if p_chip_w is None else
            np.array(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(p_chip_w, dtype=float), rings[0].p_lines_w.shape)))
    seg_t2 = _bus_segment_t2(pp, b)
    out = np.zeros((N, p_at.size))
    for q, n in enumerate(np.asarray(pp.layout.bus_order, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)):
        if q > 0:
            p_at = p_at * seg_t2
        out[n] = p_at
        ring = rings[n]
        if bias_v is not None:
            lo, hi = ring.nrz_levels(bias_v)
        else:
            lo = 0.0 if v_lo is None else float(np.asarray(v_lo, dtype=float).reshape(-1)[n])
            hi = None if v_hi is None else float(np.asarray(v_hi, dtype=float).reshape(-1)[n])
        o = ring.optics(ring.lam_lines, [t[n]], None, lo, hi)
        rho_ = 0.0 if hi is None else float(rho)
        p_at = p_at * (rho_ * o["thru1"][0] + (1.0 - rho_) * o["thru0"][0])
    return out

nodes.meaning: measure one low-power through notch with no optical self-heating.
comments: measure one low-power through notch with no optical self-heating.
t_ring and t_heater are ring and heater-resistor temperatures in K.
v is reverse bias in V.
sample n wavelengths across lam_guess +- half_window in m.
the default half_window is FSR/2, which includes the anti-resonance.

source_ref.code:
def _notch(ring: StaticRing, *, t_ring: float, t_heater: float, v: float, lam_guess: float,
           half_window: float | None = None, n: int = 4001) -> dict:
    half = 0.5 * _fsr_m(ring) if half_window is None else float(half_window)
    lam = np.linspace(lam_guess - half, lam_guess + half, int(n))
    thru = ring.optics(lam, [t_ring], [t_heater], v)["thru0"][0]
    i = int(np.argmin(thru))

    # through transmission (fraction, level 0) at laser wavelength x (m).
    def thru_at(x):
        return float(ring.optics([x], [t_ring], [t_heater], v)["thru0"][0, 0])
    lo, hi = lam[max(i - 2, 0)], lam[min(i + 2, lam.size - 1)]
    res = optimize.minimize_scalar(thru_at, bounds=(lo, hi), method="bounded",
                                   options={"xatol": 1e-17, "maxiter": 200})
    lam_min, t_min = (float(res.x), float(res.fun)) if res.fun <= thru[i] else (float(lam[i]), float(thru[i]))
    t_max = float(thru.max())

    # Full width (m) of the notch at through transmission `level` - nan when the level is not crossed.
    def width(level):
        if not t_min < level < t_max:
            return math.nan
        left = np.flatnonzero((thru >= level) & (lam < lam_min))
        right = np.flatnonzero((thru >= level) & (lam > lam_min))
        if left.size == 0 or right.size == 0:
            return math.nan
        a = optimize.brentq(lambda x: thru_at(x) - level, lam[left[-1]], lam_min, xtol=1e-17)
        b = optimize.brentq(lambda x: thru_at(x) - level, lam_min, lam[right[0]], xtol=1e-17)
        return b - a
    fwhm = width(0.5 * (t_max + t_min))
    return {"lam_min": lam_min, "t_min": t_min, "t_max": t_max,
            "er_db": 10.0 * math.log10(t_max / t_min) if t_min > 0 else math.inf,
            "fwhm_m": fwhm, "fwhm_3db_m": width(0.5 * t_max), "q": lam_min / fwhm if fwhm > 0 else math.nan}

returns: {'lam_min': lam_min, 't_min': t_min, 't_max': t_max, 'er_db': 10.0 * math.log10(t_max / t_min) if t_min > 0 else math.inf, 'fwhm_m': fwhm, 'fwhm_3db_m': width(0.5 * t_max), 'q': lam_min / fwhm if fwhm > 0 else math.nan}

comments: sweep laser wavelength at fixed heater drive u0 with quasi-static optical self-heating.

t_grid is the ring-temperature grid in K.
direction='up' increases
wavelength, as in a red sweep through a thermal triangle.

with a fractional grid index.

source_ref.code:
def _laser_sweep(ring: StaticRing, lam_grid, t_grid, *, u0: float, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v_lo: float = 0.0,
                 v_hi: float | None = None, rho: float = 0.5, direction: str = "up", start: str = "cold",
                 state: dict | None = None, i_start: float | None = None) -> dict:
    lam_grid = np.asarray(lam_grid, dtype=float)
    tg = np.asarray(t_grid, dtype=float)
    grid_state = state if state is not None else ring.state_grid(lam_grid, tg, t_base=t_base, p_in_w=p_in_w,
                                                                 v_lo=v_lo, v_hi=v_hi, rho=rho)
    drive_excess = u0 - grid_state["u"]                 # u_0 - u(T) - the ring heats where it is positive
    order = np.arange(lam_grid.size) if direction == "up" else np.arange(lam_grid.size)[::-1]
    i_prev = (0.0 if start == "cold" else float(tg.size - 1)) if i_start is None else float(i_start)
    out = {k: np.zeros(lam_grid.size) for k in ("t_ring", "thru", "drop", "idx")}
    edge = np.zeros(lam_grid.size, bool)
    idx = np.arange(tg.size, dtype=float)
    for j, col in enumerate(order):
        t, i_prev, edge_hit = _relax(tg, drive_excess[:, col], i_prev)
        out["t_ring"][j] = t
        out["idx"][j] = i_prev
        out["thru"][j] = np.interp(i_prev, idx, grid_state["thru_avg"][:, col])
        out["drop"][j] = np.interp(i_prev, idx, grid_state["drop_avg"][:, col])
        edge[j] = edge_hit
    out["lam"] = lam_grid[order]
    out["hit_edge"] = edge
    return out

nodes.name: _dip_at_power
nodes.meaning: Position of the through minimum of a swept spectrum at power p_in_w (W) - the thermal triangle.
comments: Position of the through minimum of a swept spectrum at power p_in_w (W) - the thermal triangle.
a coarse sweep (steps of coarse_pm, pm) covers the whole dragged notch.
a fine sweep (steps of fine_pm, pm) around the minimum then continues from the coarse state.
returns lam_min (m), t_min (through per unit power), t_ring_at_min (K), the coarse sweep, the edge flag and lam_cold (the cold notch position, m).
nodes.signature: _dip_at_power(ring: StaticRing, *, u0: float, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v: float, direction: str='up', coarse_pm: float=4.0, fine_pm: float=0.1)

source_ref.code:
def _dip_at_power(ring: StaticRing, *, u0: float, t_base: float, p_in_w: float, v: float, direction: str = "up",
                  coarse_pm: float = 4.0, fine_pm: float = 0.1) -> dict:
    t_cold, t_heater_cold, _ = _ring_temps_from_drive(ring, u0, t_base)
    lam0 = ring.lam_res + float(ring.thermal_shift_m(t_cold)) + float(ring.junction_shift_m(v)[0])
    fwhm_m = ring.lam_res / ring.q_loaded
    width_k = ring.linewidth_k(t_cold)
    rise_max_k = ring.z["or"] * p_in_w                       # absorbed fraction <= 1
    drag_m = float(ring.s_at(t_cold + rise_max_k)) * rise_max_k
    lam = np.arange(lam0 - 4 * fwhm_m, lam0 + drag_m + 4 * fwhm_m, coarse_pm * 1e-12)
    if direction == "down":
        lam = lam[::-1]
    step_k = width_k / 80.0
    tg = np.arange(t_cold - 3 * width_k, t_cold + rise_max_k + 3 * width_k, step_k)
    lam_sorted = np.sort(lam)
    coarse = _laser_sweep(ring, lam_sorted, tg, u0=u0, t_base=t_base, p_in_w=p_in_w, v_lo=v, direction=direction)
    j = int(np.argmin(coarse["thru"]))
    j0 = max(j - 3, 0)
    lam_a, lam_b = coarse["lam"][j0], coarse["lam"][min(j + 3, coarse["lam"].size - 1)]
    lam_fine = np.arange(min(lam_a, lam_b), max(lam_a, lam_b) + 0.5 * fine_pm * 1e-12, fine_pm * 1e-12)
    t_at_min = coarse["t_ring"][j]
    tg_fine = np.arange(min(t_at_min, coarse["t_ring"][j0]) - 1.5 * width_k,
                        max(t_at_min, coarse["t_ring"][j0]) + 1.5 * width_k, width_k / 400.0)
    i_start = float(np.interp(coarse["t_ring"][j0], tg_fine, np.arange(tg_fine.size)))
    fine = _laser_sweep(ring, lam_fine, tg_fine, u0=u0, t_base=t_base, p_in_w=p_in_w, v_lo=v, direction=direction,
                        i_start=i_start)
    k = int(np.argmin(fine["thru"]))
    return {"lam_min": float(fine["lam"][k]), "t_min": float(fine["thru"][k]),
            "t_ring_at_min": float(fine["t_ring"][k]), "coarse": coarse,
            "hit_edge": bool(np.any(coarse["hit_edge"]) or np.any(fine["hit_edge"])), "lam_cold": lam0}

returns: {'lam_min': float(fine['lam'][k]), 't_min': float(fine['thru'][k]), 't_ring_at_min': float(fine['t_ring'][k]), 'coarse': coarse, 'hit_edge': bool(np.any(coarse['hit_edge']) or np.any(fine['hit_edge'])), 'lam_cold': lam0}

nodes.name: loaded_q_from_3db_width
nodes.meaning: Replicas - G25 bench protocols (laser sweeps at P_in -> 0 unless stated)
comments: Replicas - G25 bench protocols (laser sweeps at P_in -> 0 unless stated)
CAL-1 (loaded Q) - a low-power laser sweep through the notch, Q_L = lambda_min / FWHM.
FWHM is the full width at half depth of the through notch (linear).

Conditions as the target assumes ("low power, cold, 0 V") - P_in -> 0 unless `p_in_dbm` is given (then the swept triangle is read the same way), heater `heater_v` (default 0 V, bench voltage source), bias `bias_v` (default 0 V), stage at the reference temperature.
the primary topology is the plant's own - the other topology is a variant.
Variant `3db_below_max` -
the width where T = T_max / 2.

source_ref.code:
def loaded_q_from_3db_width(plant, target=None, *, ring: int = 0, **kw) -> ReplicaResult:
    a = _replica_args(target, kw)
    cfg, pp = resolve_plant(plant)
    own = _plant_topology(pp, ring)
    topos = list(dict.fromkeys([own] + _topologies(a, own) + ["all_pass", "add_drop"]))
    v_h = float(a.get("heater_v") or 0.0)
    bias = float(a.get("bias_v") or 0.0)
    p_in = _dbm_to_w(a.get("p_in_dbm"))
    res = {}
    for tp in topos:
        r = StaticRing(pp, n=ring, topology=tp, driver_law="bench_voltage")
        tb = _t_base_k(a, r)
        if p_in <= 0:
            t_r, t_h, _ = _ring_temps_from_drive(r, v_h, tb)
            guess = r.lam_res + float(r.thermal_shift_m(t_r)) + float(r.junction_shift_m(bias)[0])
            nt = _notch(r, t_ring=t_r, t_heater=t_h, v=bias, lam_guess=guess)
            res[tp] = {"q": nt["q"], "q_3db": nt["lam_min"] / nt["fwhm_3db_m"], "er_db": nt["er_db"],
                       "fwhm_pm": nt["fwhm_m"] * 1e12, "lam_min_nm": nt["lam_min"] * 1e9}
        else:
            d = _dip_at_power(r, u0=v_h, t_base=tb, p_in_w=p_in, v=bias)
            sw = d["coarse"]
            tmin, tmax = float(np.min(sw["thru"])), float(np.max(sw["thru"]))
            lev = 0.5 * (tmin + tmax)
            below = sw["lam"][sw["thru"] <= lev]
            fw = float(below.max() - below.min()) if below.size else math.nan
            res[tp] = {"q": d["lam_min"] / fw, "q_3db": math.nan, "fwhm_pm": fw * 1e12,
                       "lam_min_nm": d["lam_min"] * 1e9}
    out = ReplicaResult("loaded_q_from_3db_width", float(res[own]["q"]), _target_unit(target, "1"),
                        target_id=getattr(target, "id", None))
    out.variants = {f"topology={tp}": float(v["q"]) for tp, v in res.items() if tp != own}
    out.variants["width=3db_below_max"] = float(res[own]["q_3db"])
    out.detail = res
    out.conditions = {**_plant_meta(cfg, pp), "ring": ring, "topology": own, "heater_v": v_h, "bias_v": bias,
                      "p_in_w": p_in, "t_base_c": _t_base_k(a, StaticRing(pp, n=ring)) - T0_K,
                      "readout": "full width at half depth (linear) of the through notch; Q = lambda_min / FWHM",
                      "assumption": "P_in -> 0, heater 0 V, bias 0 V (not printed; the calibration target reads it as "
                                    "low power, cold, 0 V)"
                      if p_in <= 0 else "swept at the stated power (thermal triangle)"}
    return out

def _heater_v_list(target, a) -> tuple[list[float], bool]:
    if target is not None and getattr(target, "kind", None) == "curve" and \
            getattr(target, "value", {}).get("x_name") == "heater_v":
        return [float(x) for x in target.value["x"]], True
    v = a.get("heater_v")
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [float(x) for x in v], True
    return [float(v if v is not None else 0.0)], False

nodes.name: notch_er_vs_heater_v
nodes.meaning: CAL-2, VAL-2a/b (notch depth against heater voltage) - a low-power laser sweep at each bench heater voltage.
comments: CAL-2, VAL-2a/b (notch depth against heater voltage) - a low-power laser sweep at each bench heater voltage.
Notch depth = 10 log10(T_max / T_min) of the through port over one FSR around the shifted resonance (dB).
the heater is a voltage source whose resistance follows its temperature (TCR, solved self-consistently).
P_in -> 0 unless `p_in_dbm` is given (the G25 sweep power is not printed) - bias 0 V - stage at the reference temperature.
Topologies - `add_drop` is the realized ring - `all_pass` removes the drop coupler (K^2_drop = 0) and keeps every other parameter.
the G25 TX topology is ambiguous, so the targets list both topologies (`topology` in replica_args).
the primary prediction uses the plant's own topology - the other listed ones are variants.

source_ref.code:
def notch_er_vs_heater_v(plant, target=None, *, ring: int = 0, **kw) -> ReplicaResult:
    a = _replica_args(target, kw)
    cfg, pp = resolve_plant(plant)
    own = _plant_topology(pp, ring)
    topos = list(dict.fromkeys([own] + _topologies(a, own)))
    vs, is_list = _heater_v_list(target, a)
    bias = float(a.get("bias_v") or 0.0)
    p_in = _dbm_to_w(a.get("p_in_dbm"))
    res, det = {}, {}
    for tp in topos:
        r = StaticRing(pp, n=ring, topology=tp, driver_law="bench_voltage")
        tb = _t_base_k(a, r)
        ers, rows = [], []
        for v in vs:
            t_r, t_h, p_h = _ring_temps_from_drive(r, v, tb)
            guess = r.lam_res + float(r.thermal_shift_m(t_r)) + float(r.junction_shift_m(bias)[0])
            if p_in <= 0:
                nt = _notch(r, t_ring=t_r, t_heater=t_h, v=bias, lam_guess=guess)
                er = nt["er_db"]
            else:
                d = _dip_at_power(r, u0=v, t_base=tb, p_in_w=p_in, v=bias)
                er = 10.0 * math.log10(float(np.max(d["coarse"]["thru"])) / d["t_min"])
                nt = {"lam_min": d["lam_min"]}
            ers.append(float(er))
            rows.append({"heater_v": v, "p_heater_mw": p_h * 1e3, "t_ring_c": t_r - T0_K, "er_db": er,
                         "lam_min_nm": nt["lam_min"] * 1e9})
        res[tp] = ers if is_list else ers[0]
        det[tp] = rows
    out = ReplicaResult("notch_er_vs_heater_v", res[own], _target_unit(target, "db"),
                        target_id=getattr(target, "id", None),
                        variants={f"topology={tp}": res[tp] for tp in topos if tp != own}, detail=det)
    out.conditions = {**_plant_meta(cfg, pp), "ring": ring, "topology": own, "heater_v": vs, "bias_v": bias,
                      "p_in_w": p_in, "port": "through", "heater_drive": "bench voltage source, TCR solved",
                      "t_base_c": _t_base_k(a, StaticRing(pp, n=ring)) - T0_K,
                      "assumption": "P_in -> 0 (sweep power not printed)" if p_in <= 0 else "swept at power"}
    return out

def _resonance_shift_curve(pp, a, vs, *, ring: int, p_in: float, bias: float, rel_v: float):
    r = StaticRing(pp, n=ring, driver_law="bench_voltage")
    tb = _t_base_k(a, r)
    ref = _resonance_position(r, u0=rel_v, t_base=tb, v=bias, p_in_w=p_in)["lam_min"]
    rows, shifts = [], []
    for v in vs:
        pos = _resonance_position(r, u0=v, t_base=tb, v=bias, p_in_w=p_in)
        shifts.append(pos["lam_min"] - ref)
        rows.append({"heater_v": v, "lam_min_nm": pos["lam_min"] * 1e9, "shift_nm": (pos["lam_min"] - ref) * 1e9})
    return np.array(shifts), rows, ref, tb
