nodes.name: simulate
nodes.meaning: end-to-end run
comments: end-to-end run
run the driver + junction + TCMT chain on the cyclic pattern `bits` at `bitrate_hz` (module comments).
v_bias (V, reverse) and swing_vpp (V) give the NRZ levels (level_mode 0 centered, 1 one-sided).
p_in_w is the power at the ring's input port (W. the TCMT is linear in it).
samples_per_bit S sets the optical step T/S and the half-step electrical grid.
a precomputed `junction` run (same pattern and grid) may be passed.
nodes.signature: simulate(ring: RingTCMT, drv: DriverJunction, bits, bitrate_hz: float, *, v_bias: float, swing_vpp: float, level_mode: int=0, samples_per_bit: int=64, p_in_w: float=0.001, n_warm_bits: int | None=None, junction: JunctionRun | None=None)

source_ref.code:
def simulate(ring: RingTCMT, drv: DriverJunction, bits, bitrate_hz: float, *, v_bias: float, swing_vpp: float,
             level_mode: int = 0, samples_per_bit: int = 64, p_in_w: float = 1e-3,
             n_warm_bits: int | None = None, junction: JunctionRun | None = None) -> WaveformResult:
    bits = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(bits, dtype=np.uint8))
    t_bit = 1.0 / float(bitrate_hz)
    v_lo, v_hi, flags = drv.levels(v_bias, swing_vpp, level_mode)
    if junction is not None:
        # the static references below use (v_lo, v_hi) of this call - the run must be of the same pattern and drive
        jun_levels = getattr(junction, "levels", None)
        if (junction.bits.shape != bits.shape or np.any(junction.bits != bits)
                or not math.isclose(junction.t_bit_s, t_bit, rel_tol=1e-12)
                or (jun_levels is not None and not np.allclose(jun_levels, (v_lo, v_hi), rtol=0.0, atol=1e-12))):
            raise ValueError("the junction run was computed for another pattern, bit rate or NRZ levels")
    junction_run = junction if junction is not None else drv.run(bits, t_bit, samples_per_bit, v_lo, v_hi,
                                                         n_warm_bits=n_warm_bits)
    samples = junction_run.samples_per_bit
    n_bits = bits.size
    step_s = t_bit / samples                                    # optical step (s)
    n_steps = (junction_run.v_j.size - 1) // 2
    a1 = np.empty(n_steps + 1, complex)
    a2 = np.empty(n_steps + 1, complex)
    work_delta = np.empty(junction_run.v_j.size)
    work_kappa_i = np.empty(junction_run.v_j.size)
    s_in = complex(math.sqrt(p_in_w))
    tcmt_run_tables_nb(step_s, s_in, ring.kappa_e, ring.kappa_d, ring.g, np.ascontiguousarray(junction_run.v_j),
        ring.v_grid,
                       ring.delta_tab, ring.kappa_i_tab, a1, a2, work_delta, work_kappa_i)
    record_start = junction_run.n_warm_bits * samples
    window = slice(record_start, record_start + n_bits * samples)                   # the recorded window [0, n_bits T) on the optical grid
    v_j = junction_run.v_j[::2][window]
    powers = port_powers(a1[window], a2[window], s_in, work_kappa_i[::2][window], ring.kappa_e, ring.kappa_d,
                         ring.eta(v_j))
    p1 = float(bits.mean())
    steady_hi = ring.steady(v_hi, p_in_w)
    steady_lo = ring.steady(v_lo, p_in_w)
    static = {k: {"p1": float(steady_hi[k][0]), "p0": float(steady_lo[k][0]),
                  "mean": p1 * float(steady_hi[k][0]) + (1.0 - p1) * float(steady_lo[k][0])} for k in steady_hi}
    x_levels = (float(ring.x(v_lo)), float(ring.x(v_hi)))
    return WaveformResult(junction_run.t_s[::2][window], junction_run.v_src[::2][window], v_j, bits, t_bit, samples,
        float(p_in_w), powers,
                          static, (v_lo, v_hi, flags), x_levels,
                          meta={"rise_time_s": drv.rise_time_s, "r_drv_ohm": drv.r_drv_ohm, "c_pad_f": drv.c_pad_f,
                                "n_warm_bits": junction_run.n_warm_bits, "v_bias": float(v_bias),
                                "swing_vpp": float(swing_vpp), "level_mode": int(level_mode)})

returns: WaveformResult(junction_run.t_s[::2][window], junction_run.v_src[::2][window], v_j, bits, t_bit, samples, float(p_in_w), powers, static, (v_lo, v_hi, flags), x_levels, meta={'rise_time_s': drv.rise_time_s, 'r_drv_ohm': drv.r_drv_ohm, 'c_pad_f': drv.c_pad_f, 'n_warm_bits': junction_run.n_warm_bits, 'v_bias': float(v_bias), 'swing_vpp': float(swing_vpp), 'level_mode': int(level_mode)})

source_ref.code:
def eye_metrics(p, bits, samples_per_bit: int, t_bit_s: float = 1.0) -> EyeMetrics:
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    bits = np.asarray(bits).astype(bool)
    samples = int(samples_per_bit)
    n_bits = bits.size
    if p.size != n_bits * samples:
        raise ValueError("p must have n_bits * samples_per_bit samples")
    if bits.all() or not bits.any():
        raise ValueError("the pattern needs both ones and zeros")
    phases = np.arange(2 * samples)
    idx = (np.arange(n_bits)[:, None] * samples + phases[None,
        :]) % (n_bits * samples)      # (n, 2S) - sample of bit k at phase j
    folded = p[idx]
    ones, zeros = folded[bits], folded[~bits]
    mean1, mean0 = ones.mean(axis=0), zeros.mean(axis=0)
    j_pol = int(np.argmax(np.abs(mean1 - mean0)))
    polarity = 1 if mean1[j_pol] >= mean0[j_pol] else -1
    if polarity > 0:
        height = ones.min(axis=0) - zeros.max(axis=0)
    else:
        height = zeros.min(axis=0) - ones.max(axis=0)
    # best phase (sample index + fractional offset) of the eye height and of the OMA
    j_height, d_height, height_best = _best_phase(np.ascontiguousarray(height, dtype=float))
    j_oma, d_oma, _ = _best_phase(np.ascontiguousarray(np.abs(mean1 - mean0), dtype=float))
    phase_oma = j_oma + d_oma
    p1 = float(_at_phase(mean1, j_oma, d_oma))
    p0 = float(_at_phase(mean0, j_oma, d_oma))
    mid_level = 0.5 * (float(_at_phase(mean1, j_height, d_height)) + float(_at_phase(mean0, j_height, d_height)))
    if polarity > 0:
        margin = np.minimum(ones.min(axis=0) - mid_level, mid_level - zeros.max(axis=0))
    else:
        margin = np.minimum(zeros.min(axis=0) - mid_level, mid_level - ones.max(axis=0))
    if margin[j_height] <= 0:
        width = 0.0
    else:
        lo = j_height
        while lo > 0 and margin[lo - 1] > 0:
            lo -= 1
        hi = j_height
        while hi < 2 * samples - 1 and margin[hi + 1] > 0:
            hi += 1
        left = lo - (margin[lo] / (margin[lo] - margin[lo - 1]) if lo > 0 else 0.0)
        right = hi + (margin[hi] / (margin[hi] - margin[hi + 1]) if hi < 2 * samples - 1 else 0.0)
        width = min(float(right - left) / samples, 1.0)
    hi_level, lo_level = max(p1, p0), min(p1, p0)
    extinction_db = 10.0 * math.log10(hi_level / lo_level) if lo_level > 0 else float("inf")
    return EyeMetrics(p1, p0, abs(p1 - p0), extinction_db, float(height_best), width * t_bit_s, width,
        phase_oma * t_bit_s / samples,
                      float(p.mean()), polarity)

returns: EyeMetrics(p1, p0, abs(p1 - p0), extinction_db, float(height_best), width * t_bit_s, width, phase_oma * t_bit_s / samples, float(p.mean()), polarity)

def normalized_node(x0: float, x1: float, bits, tau_ui: float, tr_ui: float, re_grid=(0.5,), *,
                    samples_per_bit: int | None = None, n_warm: int | None = None) -> dict:
    bits = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(bits, dtype=np.uint8))
    samples = samples_per_bit_for(tau_ui) if samples_per_bit is None else int(samples_per_bit)
    warm_bits = min(bits.size, 32) if n_warm is None else int(n_warm)
    coupling_ratios = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(re_grid, dtype=float))
    energy_outputs = np.zeros(4)
    through_outputs = np.zeros((2, coupling_ratios.size))
    _normalized_node_nb(float(x0), float(x1), bits, warm_bits, samples, float(tau_ui), float(tr_ui),
        coupling_ratios, energy_outputs, through_outputs)
    p1, td = pattern_stats(bits)
    return {"u_td": energy_outputs[0], "u_st": energy_outputs[1], "c_mean": energy_outputs[0] / energy_outputs[1],
        "oma_drop_td": energy_outputs[2], "oma_drop_st": energy_outputs[3],
            "oma_thru_td": through_outputs[0].copy(), "oma_thru_st": through_outputs[1].copy(),
                "re": coupling_ratios, "p1": p1, "td": td,
            "samples_per_bit": samples}

nodes.name: _normalized_node_nb
nodes.meaning: one normalized node (module comments).
comments: one normalized node (module comments).
Simulates the cyclic pattern `bits` (warm-up n_warm bits, then n + 1 recorded bits) at s samples per UI.
Writes out6 (4,) = (u_td, u_st with the pattern's p1, oma_drop_td, oma_drop_st) and out7 (2, n_re) =
(oma_thru_td, oma_thru_st) per r_e.
nodes.signature: _normalized_node_nb(x0, x1, bits, n_warm, s, tau_ui, tr_ui, re_grid, out6, out7)

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def _normalized_node_nb(x0, x1, bits, n_warm, s, tau_ui, tr_ui, re_grid, out6, out7):
    n = bits.shape[0]
    n_tot = n_warm + n + 1
    h = 1.0 / s                                        # step (UI)
    half_rate = 0.5 / tau_ui                           # 1/(2 tau_p) - the field decay rate (1/UI)
    beta = -1j * half_rate                             # forcing -i/(2 tau_p)
    dx = x1 - x0
    # the single-pole edge e(t) relaxes toward the current bit by this factor per half step
    edge_decay = math.exp(-0.5 * h * _LN9 / tr_ui) if tr_ui > 0.0 else 0.0
    b_rec = np.empty((n + 1) * s, np.complex128)       # b at the recorded samples
    edge = float(bits[(-n_warm) % n])
    b = -1j / (1.0 + 1j * (x0 + dx * edge))            # start in the static state of the first bit
    for i in range(n_tot):
        bit = float(bits[(i - n_warm) % n])
        if tr_ui <= 0.0:
            edge = bit
        recording = i >= n_warm
        base = (i - n_warm) * s
        for j in range(s):
            if recording:
                b_rec[base + j] = b
            edge0 = edge
            edge_mid = bit + (edge0 - bit) * edge_decay
            edge1 = bit + (edge_mid - bit) * edge_decay
            lam0 = -half_rate * (1.0 + 1j * (x0 + dx * edge0))
            lam_mid = -half_rate * (1.0 + 1j * (x0 + dx * edge_mid))
            lam1 = -half_rate * (1.0 + 1j * (x0 + dx * edge1))
            b = _mode_step(b, beta, lam0, lam_mid, lam1, h)
            edge = edge1
    u_sum = 0.0
    for k in range(n * s):
        z = b_rec[k]
        u_sum += z.real * z.real + z.imag * z.imag
    n_ones = 0
    for k in range(n):
        n_ones += int(bits[k])
    p1_emp = n_ones / n
    lor0 = _lorentzian(x0)
    lor1 = _lorentzian(x1)
    out6[0] = u_sum / (n * s)
    out6[1] = p1_emp * lor1 + (1.0 - p1_emp) * lor0
    out6[3] = abs(lor1 - lor0)
    n_re = re_grid.shape[0]
    for r in range(n_re):
        out7[1, r] = 4.0 * re_grid[r] * (1.0 - re_grid[r]) * abs(lor1 - lor0)
    if n_ones == 0 or n_ones == n:
        out6[2] = 0.0
        for r in range(n_re):
            out7[0, r] = 0.0
        return
    # conditional sums over the phases j in [0, 2s) - sample k s + j is labelled with bit k
    n_phase = 2 * s
    u_sum_by_bit = np.zeros((2, n_phase))
    im_sum_by_bit = np.zeros((2, n_phase))
    for k in range(n):
        bit_k = bits[k]
        for j in range(n_phase):
            z = b_rec[k * s + j]
            u_sum_by_bit[bit_k, j] += z.real * z.real + z.imag * z.imag
            im_sum_by_bit[bit_k, j] += z.imag
    n1_f = float(n_ones)
    n0_f = float(n - n_ones)
    level_diff = np.empty(n_phase)
    for j in range(n_phase):
        level_diff[j] = u_sum_by_bit[1, j] / n1_f - u_sum_by_bit[0, j] / n0_f
    out6[2] = _oma_max(level_diff)
    for r in range(n_re):
        r_e = re_grid[r]
        for j in range(n_phase):
            # through power / P_in = 1 + 4 r_e Im(b) + 4 r_e^2 u (module comments) - the 1 cancels in P1 - P0
            level_diff[j] = 4.0 * r_e * (im_sum_by_bit[1, j] / n1_f - im_sum_by_bit[0, j] / n0_f) + 4.0 * r_e * r_e * (
                u_sum_by_bit[1, j] / n1_f - u_sum_by_bit[0, j] / n0_f)
        out7[0, r] = _oma_max(level_diff)

nodes.name: _build_group_nb
nodes.meaning: all (xc, w, tr, tau) nodes of one pattern, in parallel.
comments: all (xc, w, tr, tau) nodes of one pattern, in parallel.
out6 (nxc, nw, ntr, ntau, 4) and out7 (nxc, nw, ntr, ntau, 2, nre) as in `_normalized_node_nb`.
nodes.signature: _build_group_nb(ax_xc, ax_w, ax_tr, ax_tau, s_tau, re_grid, bits, n_warm, out6, out7)

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True, parallel=True)
def _build_group_nb(ax_xc, ax_w, ax_tr, ax_tau, s_tau, re_grid, bits, n_warm, out6, out7):
    nxc = ax_xc.shape[0]
    nw = ax_w.shape[0]
    ntr = ax_tr.shape[0]
    ntau = ax_tau.shape[0]
    total = nxc * nw * ntr * ntau
    for flat in prange(total):
        # flat index -> (ix, iw, ir, it), C order over (xc, w, tr, tau)
        it = flat % ntau
        r1 = flat // ntau
        ir = r1 % ntr
        r2 = r1 // ntr
        iw = r2 % nw
        ix = r2 // nw
        xc = ax_xc[ix]
        w = ax_w[iw]
        if w <= 0.0:                    # no swing - the static level, OMA 0
            static_energy = _lorentzian(xc)
            out6[ix, iw, ir, it, 0] = static_energy
            out6[ix, iw, ir, it, 1] = static_energy
            out6[ix, iw, ir, it, 2] = 0.0
            out6[ix, iw, ir, it, 3] = 0.0
            for f in range(2):
                for r in range(out7.shape[5]):
                    out7[ix, iw, ir, it, f, r] = 0.0
            continue
        _normalized_node_nb(xc - w, xc + w, bits, n_warm, s_tau[it], ax_tau[it], ax_tr[ir], re_grid,
                            out6[ix, iw, ir, it], out7[ix, iw, ir, it])

nodes.name: lut_eval_nb
nodes.meaning: lookup kernels
comments: lookup kernels
evaluate the LUT (module comments) for one query.

inputs (floats) — the static level detunings x0, x1 (= 2 Delta/kappa of NRZ levels 0 and 1), the mark density p1 (of level 1), the transition density td, the rise time t_r/UI, the photon lifetime tau_p/UI and r_e = kappa_e/kappa.
Writes out (N_OUT,) (OUT_* indices) and returns a status — 0 inside the validity domain, else
ST_* bits (the query is then clamped to the domain. the outputs are NaN for a non-finite input).
it allocates nothing, so an engine kernel can call it (about 1-2 us per call).
tab6 (N_F6, n6) and tab7 (N_F7, n6 n_re) are the C-ordered flattened tables over (xc, w, p1, td, tr, tau[, re]).
nodes.signature: lut_eval_nb(ax_xc, ax_w, ax_p1, ax_td, ax_tr, ax_tau, ax_re, tab6, tab7, x0, x1, p1, td, tr_ui, tau_ui, r_e, out)

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def lut_eval_nb(ax_xc, ax_w, ax_p1, ax_td, ax_tr, ax_tau, ax_re, tab6, tab7, x0, x1, p1, td, tr_ui, tau_ui, r_e,
                out):
    status = 0
    if not (math.isfinite(x0) and math.isfinite(x1) and math.isfinite(p1) and math.isfinite(td)
            and math.isfinite(tr_ui) and math.isfinite(tau_ui) and math.isfinite(r_e)):
        for k in range(out.shape[0]):
            out[k] = np.nan
        return ST_NONFINITE
    # canonical keys - p is the mark density of the level with the larger x, and x_c >= 0 by the symmetry
    p = p1
    if x1 < x0:
        p = 1.0 - p
    xc = 0.5 * (x0 + x1)
    w = 0.5 * abs(x1 - x0)
    if xc < 0.0:
        xc = -xc
        p = 1.0 - p
    if td > 2.0 * min(p, 1.0 - p) + 1e-9 or td < 0.0:
        status |= ST_TD
    # per axis (0 xc, 1 w, 2 p1, 3 td, 4 tr, 5 tau, 6 re) - cell index i<a>, fraction f<a> in the cell, outside flag o<a>
    i0, f0, o0 = _locate_cell(ax_xc, xc)
    i1, f1, o1 = _locate_cell(ax_w, w)
    i2, f2, o2 = _locate_cell(ax_p1, p)
    i3, f3, o3 = _locate_cell(ax_td, td)
    i4, f4, o4 = _locate_cell(ax_tr, tr_ui)
    i5, f5, o5 = _locate_cell(ax_tau, tau_ui)
    i6, f6, o6 = _locate_cell(ax_re, r_e)
    if o0:
        status |= ST_XC
    if o1:
        status |= ST_W
    if o2:
        status |= ST_P1
    if o3:
        status |= ST_TD
    if o4:
        status |= ST_TR
    if o5:
        status |= ST_TAU
    if o6:
        status |= ST_RE
    n_w = ax_w.shape[0]
    n_p1 = ax_p1.shape[0]
    n_td = ax_td.shape[0]
    n_tr = ax_tr.shape[0]
    n_tau = ax_tau.shape[0]
    n_re = ax_re.shape[0]
    # strides of the flattened tab6 index (the tau stride is 1)
    stride_tr = n_tau
    stride_td = n_tr * stride_tr
    stride_p1 = n_td * stride_td
    stride_w = n_p1 * stride_p1
    stride_xc = n_w * stride_w
    re_lo = ax_re[i6]
    re_hi = ax_re[i6 + 1]
    re_factor_lo = 4.0 * re_lo * (1.0 - re_lo)         # 4 r_e (1 - r_e) - through OMA per drop OMA (static)
    re_factor_hi = 4.0 * re_hi * (1.0 - re_hi)
    u_td = 0.0
    u_st = 0.0
    oma_d_td = 0.0
    oma_d_st = 0.0
    oma_t_td = 0.0
    oma_t_st = 0.0
    for corner in range(64):                           # the 2^6 corners of the 6-D cell - bit a picks axis a's side
        b0 = corner & 1
        b1 = (corner >> 1) & 1
        b2 = (corner >> 2) & 1
        b3 = (corner >> 3) & 1
        b4 = (corner >> 4) & 1
        b5 = (corner >> 5) & 1
        weight = ((f0 if b0 else 1.0 - f0) * (f1 if b1 else 1.0 - f1) * (f2 if b2 else 1.0 - f2)
                  * (f3 if b3 else 1.0 - f3) * (f4 if b4 else 1.0 - f4) * (f5 if b5 else 1.0 - f5))
        if weight == 0.0:
            continue
        idx = ((i0 + b0) * stride_xc + (i1 + b1) * stride_w + (i2 + b2) * stride_p1 + (i3 + b3) * stride_td
               + (i4 + b4) * stride_tr + (i5 + b5))
        # the analytic static values at this corner node
        xc_node = ax_xc[i0 + b0]
        w_node = ax_w[i1 + b1]
        p_node = ax_p1[i2 + b2]
        lor_lo = 1.0 / (1.0 + (xc_node - w_node) * (xc_node - w_node))
        lor_hi = 1.0 / (1.0 + (xc_node + w_node) * (xc_node + w_node))
        lor_gap = abs(lor_hi - lor_lo)
        u_td += weight * tab6[F6_U_TD, idx]
        u_st += weight * (p_node * lor_hi + (1.0 - p_node) * lor_lo)
        oma_d_td += weight * tab6[F6_OMA_D_TD, idx]
        oma_d_st += weight * lor_gap
        idx7 = idx * n_re + i6
        oma_t_td += weight * ((1.0 - f6) * tab7[F7_OMA_T_TD, idx7] + f6 * tab7[F7_OMA_T_TD, idx7 + 1])
        oma_t_st += weight * ((1.0 - f6) * re_factor_lo + f6 * re_factor_hi) * lor_gap
    out[OUT_C_MEAN] = u_td / u_st
    out[OUT_D_MEAN_U] = u_td - u_st
    out[OUT_C_OMA_DROP] = oma_d_td / oma_d_st if oma_d_st > 0.0 else 1.0
    out[OUT_D_OMA_DROP] = oma_d_td - oma_d_st
    out[OUT_C_OMA_THRU] = oma_t_td / oma_t_st if oma_t_st > 0.0 else 1.0
    out[OUT_D_OMA_THRU] = oma_t_td - oma_t_st
    return status

nodes.meaning: lUT keys from the plant's optics inputs of one (ring, line) (the mrm.plant.phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs outputs).
comments: lUT keys from the plant's optics inputs of one (ring, line) (the mrm.plant.phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs outputs).

inputs — the round-trip phases phi0, phi1 (rad) and amplitudes a0, a1 (-) of the two NRZ levels, the per-pass K^2 of the through and drop couplers, the group delay t_rt (s), the bit rate (1/s) and the 10-90 % rise time of the junction-charge edge (s).
the rates come from the logarithmic mapping (mrm.plant.optics.tcmt_rates), and Delta_l = (phi_l - 2 pi m)/t_rt with m the order nearest the mean phase.
the normalization uses the mean kappa of the two levels.
Writes out (5,) = (x0, x1, t_r/UI, tau_p/UI, r_e).
nodes.signature: lut_query_nb(phi0, phi1, k2_th, k2_dr, a0, a1, t_rt_s, bitrate_hz, rise_time_s, out)

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def lut_query_nb(phi0, phi1, k2_th, k2_dr, a0, a1, t_rt_s, bitrate_hz, rise_time_s, out):
    order = math.floor(0.5 * (phi0 + phi1) / (2.0 * math.pi) + 0.5)
    kappa_e = -math.log1p(-k2_th) / t_rt_s
    kappa_d = -math.log1p(-k2_dr) / t_rt_s
    kappa_i0 = -2.0 * math.log(a0) / t_rt_s
    kappa_i1 = -2.0 * math.log(a1) / t_rt_s
    kappa_mean = 0.5 * (kappa_i0 + kappa_i1) + kappa_e + kappa_d
    out[0] = 2.0 * (phi0 - 2.0 * math.pi * order) / t_rt_s / kappa_mean
    out[1] = 2.0 * (phi1 - 2.0 * math.pi * order) / t_rt_s / kappa_mean
    out[2] = rise_time_s * bitrate_hz
    out[3] = bitrate_hz / kappa_mean
    out[4] = kappa_e / kappa_mean

def eval(self, x0, x1, p1, td, tr_ui, tau_ui, r_e=0.5, *, strict: bool = True) -> dict:
        out = np.zeros(N_OUT)
        status = lut_eval_nb(*self.kernel_args(), float(x0), float(x1), float(p1), float(td), float(tr_ui),
                             float(tau_ui), float(r_e), out)
        if status and strict:
            outside_keys = [name for bit, name in _STATUS_NAMES.items() if status & bit]
            raise LutDomainError(f"waveform LUT query outside the validity domain: {', '.join(outside_keys)} "
                                 f"(query x0={x0}, x1={x1}, p1={p1}, td={td}, tr/UI={tr_ui}, tau_p/UI={tau_ui}, "
                                 f"r_e={r_e}; domain {self.domain}; LUT {self.config_hash[:12]})")
        keys = ("c_mean", "c_oma_thru", "d_oma_thru", "c_oma_drop", "d_oma_drop", "d_mean_u")
        result = {k: float(out[i]) for i, k in enumerate(keys)}
        result["status"] = int(status)
        return result

def save(self, name: str, out_dir: Path | None = None) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
        directory = Path(out_dir) if out_dir is not None else EXTRACTED_DIR
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = directory / f"waveform_lut_{name}.npz"
        arrays = {f"ax_{k}": v for k, v in self.axes.items()}
        np.savez_compressed(path, tab6=self.tab6.astype(np.float32), tab7=self.tab7.astype(np.float32),
                            config_json=np.array(json.dumps(self.config, sort_keys=True)),
                            config_hash=np.array(self.config_hash), **arrays)
        sidecar = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "file": path.name, "sha256": _sha256(path),
            "description": "Normalized-coordinate data-modulation LUT: time-domain corrections, relative to "
                           "the two-level static average, of the mean stored energy (drop, loss, heat; through by "
                           "energy conservation) and of the through and drop OMA, from the single-mode TCMT in "
                           "normalized time (mrm/waveform/lut.py docstring).",
            "fields6": ["u_td"], "fields6_extra": ["oma_drop_td"], "fields7": ["oma_thru_td"],
            "static_parts": "analytic: u_st = p L(x1) + (1 - p) L(x0), oma_drop_st = |L(x1) - L(x0)|, "
                            "oma_thru_st = 4 r_e (1 - r_e) oma_drop_st, L(x) = 1/(1 + x^2)",
            "storage": "float32, C order over (xc, w, p1, td, tr, tau[, re])",
            "axes": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in self.axes.items()},
            "axes_meaning": {"xc": "(x0 + x1)/2, detuning/HWHM at the level midpoint (x_c >= 0 stored; symmetry)",
                             "w": "|x1 - x0|/2 = resonance swing / FWHM", "p1": "mark density of the higher-x level",
                             "td": "transition density (cyclic)", "tr": "10-90 % rise of the junction-charge edge / UI",
                             "tau": "photon energy lifetime 1/kappa / UI", "re": "kappa_e/kappa"},
            "domain": self.domain, "config": self.config, "config_hash": self.config_hash,
            "validation": self.validation, "inputs": {"model": "normalized single-mode TCMT, g = 0, q = 0",
                                                      "code": "mrm/waveform/lut.py"},
            "tool_versions": _tool_versions(),
            "created_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        }
        side_path = directory / f"waveform_lut_{name}.json"
        side_path.write_text(json.dumps(sidecar, indent=1, sort_keys=False))
        self.path, self.sha256 = str(path), sidecar["sha256"]
        return path, side_path

nodes.name: build_lut
nodes.meaning: builder
comments: builder
build the table on `axes` (default DEFAULT_AXES).
one cyclic Markov pattern of n_bits per (p1, td) (seed seed + 1000 i_p1 + 100 i_td), the same pattern for every (xc, w, tr, tau) node, so the table is smooth across them.
the nodes run in parallel (numba prange).
the td = 0
and w = 0 nodes are exact without simulation (no transitions — the static levels. no swing — u = L(x_c), OMA 0).
U_TD is stored as c_node x U_ST(nominal p1), so the analytic static part of the lookup carries the node's own correction exactly.
nodes.signature: build_lut(axes: dict | None=None, *, n_bits: int=1024, n_warm: int=32, base_samples: int=32, seed: int=2026, progress: bool=False)

source_ref.code:
def build_lut(axes: dict | None = None, *, n_bits: int = 1024, n_warm: int = 32, base_samples: int = 32,
              seed: int = 2026, progress: bool = False) -> WaveformLUT:
    import time

    ax = {k: np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for k, v in (DEFAULT_AXES if axes is None else axes).items()}
    nxc, nw, np1, ntd, ntr, ntau, nre = (ax[k].size for k in _TAB6_AXES + ("re",))
    s_tau = np.array([samples_per_bit_for(t, base_samples) for t in ax["tau"]], np.int64)
    t6 = np.zeros((nxc, nw, np1, ntd, ntr, ntau, N_F6))          # tab6 before flattening (field axis last)
    t7 = np.zeros((nxc, nw, np1, ntd, ntr, ntau, N_F7, nre))     # tab7 before flattening (field, re axes last)
    xc = ax["xc"][:, None]
    w = ax["w"][None, :]
    lor0 = 1.0 / (1.0 + (xc - w) ** 2)                 # (nxc, nw) - static L(x) of level 0 (x = xc - w)
    lor1 = 1.0 / (1.0 + (xc + w) ** 2)                 # and of level 1 (x = xc + w)
    lor_gap = np.abs(lor1 - lor0)                      # static drop OMA (u units)
    re_factor = 4.0 * ax["re"] * (1.0 - ax["re"])      # 4 r_e (1 - r_e) - through OMA per drop OMA (static)
    patterns = {}
    t_start = time.time()
    for ip, p1 in enumerate(ax["p1"]):
        u_st_nominal = p1 * lor1 + (1 - p1) * lor0         # (nxc, nw) - static mean u at the node's nominal p1
        for it, td in enumerate(ax["td"]):
            if td <= 0.0:
                t6[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F6_U_TD] = u_st_nominal[:, :, None, None]
                t6[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F6_OMA_D_TD] = lor_gap[:, :, None, None]
                t7[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F7_OMA_T_TD, :] = lor_gap[:, :, None, None, None] * re_factor
                continue
            bits = markov_bits(n_bits, p1, td, seed=seed + 1000 * ip + 100 * it)
            patterns[f"{p1:g}_{td:g}"] = list(pattern_stats(bits))
            o6 = np.zeros((nxc, nw, ntr, ntau, 4))
            o7 = np.zeros((nxc, nw, ntr, ntau, 2, nre))
            _build_group_nb(ax["xc"], ax["w"], ax["tr"], ax["tau"], s_tau, ax["re"], bits, int(n_warm), o6, o7)
            t6[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F6_U_TD] = o6[..., 0] / o6[..., 1] * u_st_nominal[:, :, None, None]
            t6[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F6_OMA_D_TD] = o6[..., 2]
            t7[:, :, ip, it, :, :, F7_OMA_T_TD, :] = o7[..., 0, :]
            if progress:
                print(f"waveform LUT: p1={p1:g} td={td:g} done ({time.time() - t_start:.1f} s)", flush=True)
    tab6 = np.moveaxis(t6, -1, 0).reshape(N_F6, -1)
    tab7 = np.moveaxis(t7, -2, 0).reshape(N_F7, -1)
    config = {"schema": SCHEMA, "axes": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in ax.items()}, "n_bits": int(n_bits),
              "n_warm": int(n_warm), "base_samples": int(base_samples), "samples_per_bit": s_tau.tolist(),
              "seed": int(seed), "pattern": "cyclic two-state Markov (driver.markov_bits, best of 64 seeds)",
              "edge": "single pole, tau_e = t_r/ln 9", "integrator": "exponential, Simpson exponent + first-order "
              "forcing correction (tcmt_time._mode_step)", "model": "normalized single-mode TCMT, g = 0, q = 0",
              "oma": "max over phases [0, 2 UI) of |P1 - P0|, parabola-refined", "storage": "float32"}
    lut = WaveformLUT(ax, tab6.astype(np.float32), tab7.astype(np.float32), config, _config_hash(config),
                      validation={"build_seconds": round(time.time() - t_start, 1), "pattern_stats": patterns})
    return lut

the test quantity of the LUT requirement — |c_mean - 1|, the correction to the mean drop power, for PRBS data.
for PRBS-`order` data at tau_p/UI = tau_ui (3 ps at a 20 ps UI is 0.15), computed directly (without the table) over a grid of detuning x_c, swing w and edge rise time t_r/UI.

source_ref.code:
def prbs_mean_correction_check(tau_ui: float = 0.15, *, order: int = 9, xc=None, w=None, tr=None,
                               limit: float = 0.03) -> dict:
    from mrm.waveform.driver import prbs
    xc = np.asarray(DEFAULT_AXES["xc"] if xc is None else xc, float)
    w = np.asarray([0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0] if w is None else w, float)
    tr = np.asarray(DEFAULT_AXES["tr"] if tr is None else tr, float)
    bits = prbs(order)
    c = np.zeros((xc.size, w.size, tr.size))
    for i, xc_i in enumerate(xc):
        for j, w_j in enumerate(w):
            for k, tr_k in enumerate(tr):
                c[i, j, k] = normalized_correction(xc_i - w_j, xc_i + w_j, bits, tau_ui, tr_k, re_grid=(0.5,))
    dev = np.abs(c - 1.0)
    imax = np.unravel_index(int(np.argmax(dev)), dev.shape)
    ok_w = [float(w_j) for j, w_j in enumerate(w) if np.all(dev[:, : j + 1, :] < limit)]
    return {"tau_ui": float(tau_ui), "pattern": f"PRBS{order}", "max_abs_correction": float(dev.max()),
            "at": {"xc": float(xc[imax[0]]), "w": float(w[imax[1]]), "tr_ui": float(tr[imax[2]])},
            "max_swing_w_below_limit": max(ok_w) if ok_w else 0.0, "limit": float(limit),
            "max_abs_correction_by_w": {f"{w_j:g}": float(dev[:, j, :].max()) for j, w_j in enumerate(w)},
            "max_abs_correction_by_tr_at_w0p3": ({f"{tr_k:g}": float(dev[:, list(w).index(0.3), k].max())
                                                  for k, tr_k in enumerate(tr)} if 0.3 in list(w) else {}),
            "grid": {"xc": xc.tolist(), "w": w.tolist(), "tr": tr.tolist()}, "c_mean": c.tolist()}

returns: {'tau_ui': float(tau_ui), 'pattern': f'PRBS{order}', 'max_abs_correction': float(dev.max()), 'at': {'xc': float(xc[imax[0]]), 'w': float(w[imax[1]]), 'tr_ui': float(tr[imax[2]])}, 'max_swing_w_below_limit': max(ok_w) if ok_w else 0.0, 'limit': float(limit), 'max_abs_correction_by_w': {f'{w_j:g}': float(dev[:, j, :].max()) for j, w_j in enumerate(w)}, 'max_abs_correction_by_tr_at_w0p3': {f'{tr_k:g}': float(dev[:, list(w).index(0.3), k].max()) for k, tr_k in enumerate(tr)} if 0.3 in list(w) else {}, 'grid': {'xc': xc.tolist(), 'w': w.tolist(), 'tr': tr.tolist()}, 'c_mean': c.tolist()}

def interpolation_check(lut: WaveformLUT, n_random: int = 200, seed: int = 7, n_bits: int = 1024,
                        practical: bool = False) -> dict:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    axes = lut.axes
    err_c_mean, err_oma_diff, err_oma_ratio = [], [], []
    x_scan = np.linspace(0.0, 6.0, 1201)
    for _ in range(int(n_random)):
        if practical:
            xc, w, p1, td = rng.uniform(0.3, 3.0), rng.uniform(0.05, 0.6), 0.5, 0.5
            tr, tau, re_ = rng.uniform(0, 0.5), rng.uniform(0.1, 0.2), rng.uniform(0.4, 0.6)
        else:
            xc = rng.uniform(0, axes["xc"][-1])
            w = rng.uniform(0.02, axes["w"][-1])
            p1 = float(rng.choice([0.5, rng.uniform(axes["p1"][0], axes["p1"][-1])]))
            td = rng.uniform(0.05, min(axes["td"][-1], 2 * min(p1, 1 - p1)))
            tr = rng.uniform(axes["tr"][0], axes["tr"][-1])
            tau = rng.uniform(axes["tau"][0], axes["tau"][-1])
            re_ = rng.uniform(axes["re"][0], axes["re"][-1])
        bits = markov_bits(n_bits, p1, td, seed=int(rng.integers(1 << 30)))
        direct = normalized_node(xc - w, xc + w, bits, tau, tr, re_grid=(re_,))
        interpolated = lut.eval(xc - w, xc + w, p1, td, tr, tau, re_)
        err_c_mean.append(abs(interpolated["c_mean"] - direct["c_mean"]))
        scale = 4 * re_ * (1 - re_) * np.max(np.abs(1 / (1 + (x_scan + w) ** 2) - 1 / (1 + (x_scan - w) ** 2)))
        err_oma_diff.append(abs(interpolated["d_oma_thru"] - (direct["oma_thru_td"][0] - direct["oma_thru_st"][0])) / scale)
        if direct["oma_thru_st"][0] > 0.25 * scale:
            err_oma_ratio.append(abs(interpolated["c_oma_thru"] - direct["oma_thru_td"][0] / direct["oma_thru_st"][0]))
    err_c_mean, err_oma_diff, err_oma_ratio = np.array(err_c_mean), np.array(err_oma_diff), np.array(err_oma_ratio)
    pct = lambda x, p: float(np.percentile(x, p)) if x.size else None  # noqa: E731
    return {"n": int(n_random), "practical": bool(practical),
            "c_mean_abs_err_max": float(err_c_mean.max()), "c_mean_abs_err_p95": pct(err_c_mean, 95),
            "oma_thru_diff_err_rel_scale_max": float(err_oma_diff.max()),
            "oma_thru_diff_err_rel_scale_p95": pct(err_oma_diff, 95),
            "c_oma_thru_abs_err_max": float(err_oma_ratio.max()) if err_oma_ratio.size else None,
            "c_oma_thru_abs_err_p95": pct(err_oma_ratio, 95),
            "n_ratio": int(err_oma_ratio.size)}

returns: {'n': int(n_random), 'practical': bool(practical), 'c_mean_abs_err_max': float(err_c_mean.max()), 'c_mean_abs_err_p95': pct(err_c_mean, 95), 'oma_thru_diff_err_rel_scale_max': float(err_oma_diff.max()), 'oma_thru_diff_err_rel_scale_p95': pct(err_oma_diff, 95), 'c_oma_thru_abs_err_max': float(err_oma_ratio.max()) if err_oma_ratio.size else None, 'c_oma_thru_abs_err_p95': pct(err_oma_ratio, 95), 'n_ratio': int(err_oma_ratio.size)}

def main(argv=None) -> int:
    import argparse
    import time
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="build the waveform data-modulation LUT artefact (mrm/waveform/lut.py)")
    parser.add_argument("--name", default=None, help="artefact name (default nrz; quick with --quick)")
    parser.add_argument("--quick", action="store_true", help="small axes (smoke test), not for the engine")
    parser.add_argument("--n-random", type=int, default=300)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    name = args.name or ("quick" if args.quick else "nrz")
    if args.quick and name == "nrz":
        parser.error("--quick builds a smoke-test table: it must not replace the engine artefact waveform_lut_nrz")
    axes = None
    if args.quick:
        axes = {"xc": [0, 1, 2, 6], "w": [0, 0.3, 1.0], "p1": [0.3, 0.5, 0.7], "td": [0, 0.3, 0.6],
                "tr": [0, 0.7], "tau": [0.07, 0.25], "re": [0.3, 0.7]}
    t0 = time.time()
    lut = build_lut(axes, progress=True)
    print(f"built in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s", flush=True)
    t1 = time.time()
    # the tables as stored (float32) are what the engine sees - validate those
    lut = WaveformLUT(lut.axes, lut.tab6.astype(np.float32), lut.tab7.astype(np.float32), lut.config,
                      lut.config_hash, validation=lut.validation)
    # the sidecar key "p2_6_prbs9_tau_0p15" is kept as it is - the committed artefact uses it
    lut.validation["p2_6_prbs9_tau_0p15"] = {k: v for k, v in prbs_mean_correction_check(0.15).items()
                                              if k != "c_mean"}
    lut.validation["interpolation"] = interpolation_check(lut, n_random=args.n_random)
    lut.validation["interpolation_practical"] = interpolation_check(lut, n_random=args.n_random // 2, seed=8,
                                                                    practical=True)
    lut.validation["validation_seconds"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in lut.validation.items() if k != "pattern_stats"}, indent=1), flush=True)
    data_path, sidecar_path = lut.save(name)
    print(f"wrote {data_path} ({data_path.stat().st_size / 1e6:.2f} MB) and {sidecar_path}", flush=True)
    return 0

nodes.name: tcmt_steady_nb
nodes.meaning: kernels
comments: kernels
solve steady clockwise and counter-clockwise mode amplitudes.
input - delta = Delta = omega_L-omega_r (rad/s) - laser detuning
input - kappa_i = kappa_i (1/s) - intrinsic energy decay
input - kappa_e = kappa_e (1/s) - energy leakage to the bus
input - kappa_d = kappa_d (1/s) - energy leakage to the drop guide
input - g = g (rad/s) - complex CW/CCW coupling rate
input - s_in = s_in (sqrt(W)) - incoming optical field
output - cw_mode_amplitude = a_cw (sqrt(J)) - clockwise mode amplitude
output - ccw_mode_amplitude = a_ccw (sqrt(J)) - counter-clockwise mode amplitude
D = (kappa_i+kappa_e+kappa_d)/2 + i*Delta (1/s).
a_cw = -i*sqrt(kappa_e)*D*s_in/(D^2+|g|^2).
a_ccw = -sqrt(kappa_e)*conj(g)*s_in/(D^2+|g|^2).

nodes.name: _mode_step

lambda_0, lambda_mid, and lambda_1 are the start, midpoint, and end rates.
h uses the matching time unit.
Simpson integration supplies the exponent.
the forcing correction accounts for changing rates.
constant rates are exact to rounding.
the LUT reuses this step with time measured in UI.

input - mode_drive = beta (mode amplitude units/time unit) - constant drive
input - start_growth_rate = lambda_0 (1/time unit) - complex field evolution rate at the start

nodes.name: tcmt_run_nb
nodes.meaning: integrate the CW/CCW TCMT over K = out_a1.shape[0] - 1 steps of h (s).
comments: integrate the CW/CCW TCMT over K = out_a1.shape[0] - 1 steps of h (s).
delta_half, kappa_i_half (2K+1,) — Delta (rad/s) and kappa_i (1/s) at the half-step instants t0 + j h/2 (even j — grid points, odd j — midpoints).
kappa_e, kappa_d (1/s) and g (rad/s, complex) are constant.
s_in (sqrt(W), complex) is the constant input amplitude.

Writes out_a1, out_a2 (K+1,) complex (J^0.5) at the grid points.

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def tcmt_run_nb(h, s_in, kappa_e, kappa_d, g, delta_half, kappa_i_half, a1_0, a2_0, out_a1, out_a2):
    total_coupling_decay_rate = kappa_e + kappa_d  # coupling part of kappa - constant
    backscatter_rate_magnitude = abs(g)
    if backscatter_rate_magnitude > 0.0:
        backscatter_phase_factor = g / backscatter_rate_magnitude  # e^{i theta}
    else:
        backscatter_phase_factor = 1.0 + 0j
    eigenmode_drive = -1j * math.sqrt(kappa_e) * s_in / math.sqrt(2.0)
    inv_sqrt2 = 1.0 / math.sqrt(2.0)
    symmetric_mode_amplitude = (
        a1_0 + backscatter_phase_factor * a2_0
    ) * inv_sqrt2  # eigenmodes of the backscatter coupling
    antisymmetric_mode_amplitude = (a1_0 - backscatter_phase_factor * a2_0) * inv_sqrt2
    out_a1[0] = a1_0
    out_a2[0] = a2_0
    n_steps = out_a1.shape[0] - 1
    for k in range(n_steps):
        j = 2 * k
        start_growth_rate = -(1j * delta_half[j] + 0.5 * (kappa_i_half[j] + total_coupling_decay_rate))
        midpoint_growth_rate = -(
            1j * delta_half[j + 1] + 0.5 * (kappa_i_half[j + 1] + total_coupling_decay_rate)
        )
        end_growth_rate = -(1j * delta_half[j + 2] + 0.5 * (kappa_i_half[j + 2] + total_coupling_decay_rate))
        imaginary_mode_splitting_rate = 1j * backscatter_rate_magnitude
        symmetric_mode_amplitude = _mode_step(
            symmetric_mode_amplitude,
            eigenmode_drive,
            start_growth_rate - imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            midpoint_growth_rate - imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            end_growth_rate - imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            h,
        )
        antisymmetric_mode_amplitude = _mode_step(
            antisymmetric_mode_amplitude,
            eigenmode_drive,
            start_growth_rate + imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            midpoint_growth_rate + imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            end_growth_rate + imaginary_mode_splitting_rate,
            h,
        )
        out_a1[k + 1] = (symmetric_mode_amplitude + antisymmetric_mode_amplitude) * inv_sqrt2
        out_a2[k + 1] = (
            (symmetric_mode_amplitude - antisymmetric_mode_amplitude)
            * inv_sqrt2
            * backscatter_phase_factor.conjugate()
        )

source_ref.code:
@njit(cache=True)
def tcmt_run_tables_nb(
    h,
    s_in,
    kappa_e,
    kappa_d,
    g,
    v_half,
    grid,
    delta_tab,
    kappa_i_tab,
    out_a1,
    out_a2,
    work_delta,
    work_kappa_i,
):
    tables_at_nb(v_half, grid, delta_tab, kappa_i_tab, work_delta, work_kappa_i)
    initial_cw_mode_amplitude, initial_ccw_mode_amplitude = tcmt_steady_nb(
        work_delta[0], work_kappa_i[0], kappa_e, kappa_d, g, s_in
    )
    tcmt_run_nb(
        h,
        s_in,
        kappa_e,
        kappa_d,
        g,
        work_delta,
        work_kappa_i,
        initial_cw_mode_amplitude,
        initial_ccw_mode_amplitude,
        out_a1,
        out_a2,
    )

source_ref.code:
def port_powers(a1, a2, s_in, kappa_i, kappa_e, kappa_d, eta=1.0) -> dict:
    a1 = np.asarray(a1)
    a2 = np.asarray(a2)
    cw_energy_j = np.abs(a1) ** 2
    ccw_energy_j = np.abs(a2) ** 2
    intrinsic_loss_power_w = np.asarray(kappa_i) * (cw_energy_j + ccw_energy_j)
    return {
        "thru": np.abs(s_in - 1j * math.sqrt(kappa_e) * a1) ** 2,
        "drop": kappa_d * cw_energy_j,
        "refl": kappa_e * ccw_energy_j,
        "add": kappa_d * ccw_energy_j,
        "loss": intrinsic_loss_power_w,
        "abs": np.asarray(eta) * intrinsic_loss_power_w,
        "u_cw": cw_energy_j,
        "u_ccw": ccw_energy_j,
    }

returns: {'thru': np.abs(s_in - 1j * math.sqrt(kappa_e) * a1) ** 2, 'drop': kappa_d * cw_energy_j, 'refl': kappa_e * ccw_energy_j, 'add': kappa_d * ccw_energy_j, 'loss': intrinsic_loss_power_w, 'abs': np.asarray(eta) * intrinsic_loss_power_w, 'u_cw': cw_energy_j, 'u_ccw': ccw_energy_j}

nodes.meaning: build voltage tables from the plant phase model for one world, ring, and line.
comments: build voltage tables from the plant phase model for one world, ring, and line.
choose a line index or a wavelength in m.
give either ring temperature in K
or x_bias = 2 Delta/kappa at v_bias in V.
x_bias solves for the temperature
that would hold that detuning.
heater temperature defaults to ring temperature.
with x_bias, the default order is the cold resonance order.
warn if reaching it requires a shift outside -0.5 to 1.5 FSR.

source_ref.code:
@classmethod
    def from_plant_params(cls, pp, b: int = 0, ring: int = 0, *, v_bias: float, x_bias: float | None = None,
                          t_ring_k: float | None = None, t_heater_k: float | None = None, line: int | None = None,
                          lambda_line_m: float | None = None, backscatter: bool | None = None,
                          v_grid=None, order: int | None = None) -> "RingTCMT":
        from scipy.optimize import brentq

        from mrm.plant import phase
        from mrm.plant.optics import tcmt_rates

        phase_params = phase.PhaseParams.from_plant_params(pp)
        ring_rows = phase_params.ring[b]                 # (N, N_RP) - the phase-model parameters of world b
        table_row = phase_params.table_row(b)            # row of the junction table for world b
        n_rings = ring_rows.shape[0]
        if lambda_line_m is None:
            line_idx = int(pp.layout.ring_to_line[ring]) if line is None else int(line)
            lambda_line_m = C0 / float(np.asarray(pp.laser.line_freq_hz)[b, line_idx])
        lam_lines = np.array([float(lambda_line_m)])     # one line - (L,) = (1,)
        grid = phase_params.grid if v_grid is None else np.asarray(v_grid, dtype=float)

        # (phi (rad), a, eta, K^2 through, K^2 drop, t_rt (s)) of ring `ring` at ring temperature t_ring (K) and junction voltage v (V).
        # evaluate_ring_optical_inputs computes two NRZ levels.
        # both are set to v, and level 0 is returned.
        def optics_at(t_ring, v):
            out = {k: np.zeros((n_rings, 1))
                   for k in ("phi0", "phi1", "a0", "a1", "eta0", "eta1", "k2t", "k2d", "trt")}
            shift, c_j, r_s = np.zeros((n_rings, 2)), np.zeros((n_rings, 2)), np.zeros((n_rings, 2))
            flags = np.zeros(n_rings, np.int8)
            t_ring_arr = np.full(n_rings, float(t_ring))
            t_heater_arr = np.full(n_rings, float(t_ring if t_heater_k is None else t_heater_k))
            v_arr = np.full(n_rings, float(v))
            phase.evaluate_ring_optical_inputs(ring_rows, lam_lines, t_ring_arr, t_heater_arr, v_arr, v_arr, phase_params.grid,
                                  phase_params.dneff[table_row], phase_params.alpha_fca[table_row],
                                  phase_params.capacitance[table_row], phase_params.r_series[table_row],
                                  out["phi0"], out["phi1"], out["a0"], out["a1"], out["eta0"], out["eta1"],
                                  out["k2t"], out["k2d"], out["trt"], shift, c_j, r_s, flags)
            return (out["phi0"][ring, 0], out["a0"][ring, 0], out["eta0"][ring, 0], out["k2t"][ring, 0],
                    out["k2d"][ring, 0], out["trt"][ring, 0])

        if t_ring_k is not None and x_bias is not None:
            raise ValueError("give either t_ring_k or x_bias, not both")
        if t_ring_k is None:
            if x_bias is None:
                raise ValueError("give t_ring_k or x_bias")
            # the lock order is by default the order of the cold resonance (n_eff L = m lambda_res, relation R3 - the convention of mrm.control.models.resonance_detuning_m) - phi = 2 pi m at the line once the comb is shifted by lambda_line - lambda_res.
            # `order` selects another one - order m_cold - k sits k cold FSRs red of lambda_res.
            # first guess - relation R1 inverted for the shift that brings the chosen order to the line.
            t_ref = ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE]
            s0, beta, t0 = ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_THERMAL_TUNING_SLOPE], ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_RELATIVE_THERMAL_TUNING_CURVATURE], ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_TUNING_EXPANSION_TEMPERATURE]
            lambda_res = ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_COLD_RESONANCE_WAVELENGTH]
            m_cold = int(round(ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_EFFECTIVE_INDEX] * ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH] / lambda_res))
            m_line = m_cold if order is None else int(order)
            fsr_m = lambda_res * lambda_res / (ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_GROUP_INDEX] * ring_rows[ring, phase.RING_PARAMETER_COLUMN_ROUND_TRIP_LENGTH])
            shift_m = float(lambda_line_m) - lambda_res - (m_cold - m_line) * fsr_m    # comb shift needed (m)
            if order is None and not -0.5 <= shift_m / fsr_m <= 1.5:
                warnings.warn(f"RingTCMT.from_plant_params: the cold-resonance order {m_cold} of ring {ring} (world "
                              f"{b}) needs a comb shift of {shift_m * 1e9:.2f} nm ({shift_m / fsr_m:.2f} FSR) to "
                              f"reach the line: the solved ring temperature is far from T_ref = {t_ref:.1f} K. Pass "
                              f"order= (order m_cold - k sits k FSR red of the cold resonance) or t_ring_k to choose "
                              f"another lock order.", stacklevel=2)

            # Ring temperature (K) whose thermo-optic shift is `shift` (m), relation R1 inverted.
            def t_for_shift(shift):
                # s0 [(T - Tref) + beta ((T - T0)^2 - (Tref - T0)^2)/2] = shift
                if beta == 0.0:
                    return t_ref + shift / s0
                a_ = 0.5 * beta
                b_ = 1.0 - beta * t0
                c_ = -(t_ref + 0.5 * beta * ((t_ref - t0) ** 2 - t0 * t0)) - shift / s0
                # a T^2 + b T + c = 0 written in T - take the root continuous with beta -> 0
                disc = b_ * b_ - 4 * a_ * c_
                if disc < 0.0:                 # no real root (extreme beta) - the linear law as a first guess
                    return t_ref + shift / s0
                return (-b_ + math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a_)

            # Delta - x_bias kappa/2 (rad/s) at ring temperature t_ring (K) - zero at the wanted detuning.
            def f_detune(t_ring):
                phi, a_rt, _, k2_thru, k2_drop, trt = optics_at(t_ring, v_bias)
                kappa_i, kappa_e, kappa_d = tcmt_rates(k2_thru, k2_drop, a_rt, trt)
                delta = (phi - _TWO_PI * m_line) / trt
                return delta - 0.5 * x_bias * (kappa_i + kappa_e + kappa_d)

            t_guess = t_for_shift(shift_m)
            lo, hi = t_guess - 30.0, t_guess + 30.0
            if f_detune(lo) * f_detune(hi) > 0:
                raise ValueError("could not bracket the ring temperature for x_bias (check the line and order)")
            t_ring_k = brentq(f_detune, lo, hi, xtol=1e-12, rtol=1e-14, maxiter=200)
        else:
            phi_b = optics_at(t_ring_k, v_bias)[0]
            m_line = int(round(phi_b / _TWO_PI)) if order is None else int(order)

        phi_b, a_b, eta_b, k2_thru_b, k2_drop_b, trt_b = optics_at(t_ring_k, v_bias)
        _, kappa_e, kappa_d = tcmt_rates(k2_thru_b, k2_drop_b, a_b, trt_b)
        detuning_table = np.empty(grid.size)
        loss_table = np.empty(grid.size)
        heat_fraction_table = np.empty(grid.size)
        for i, v in enumerate(grid):
            phi, a_rt, eta, _k2_thru, _k2_drop, trt = optics_at(t_ring_k, v)
            loss_table[i] = -2.0 * math.log(a_rt) / trt
            detuning_table[i] = (phi - _TWO_PI * m_line) / trt
            heat_fraction_table[i] = eta
        use_backscatter = bool(pp.flags.backscatter) if backscatter is None else bool(backscatter)
        g = 0j
        if use_backscatter:
            rb = np.asarray(pp.optics.backscatter_rb)[b, ring]
            if rb.size:
                g = complex(rb[m_line % rb.size]) / trt_b
        meta = {"kind": "plant_params", "world": int(b), "ring": int(ring), "lambda_line_m": float(lambda_line_m),
                "t_ring_k": float(t_ring_k), "order": int(m_line), "v_bias": float(v_bias),
                "x_bias": None if x_bias is None else float(x_bias), "t_rt_s": float(trt_b),
                "junction_model": int(pp.junction.model), "config_hash": getattr(pp, "config_hash", None)}
        return cls(kappa_e, kappa_d, g, grid, detuning_table, loss_table, heat_fraction_table,
            omega_l=_TWO_PI * C0 / float(lambda_line_m),
                   meta=meta)

source_ref.code:
def t_for_shift(shift):
                # s0 [(T - Tref) + beta ((T - T0)^2 - (Tref - T0)^2)/2] = shift
                if beta == 0.0:
                    return t_ref + shift / s0
                a_ = 0.5 * beta
                b_ = 1.0 - beta * t0
                c_ = -(t_ref + 0.5 * beta * ((t_ref - t0) ** 2 - t0 * t0)) - shift / s0
                # a T^2 + b T + c = 0 written in T - take the root continuous with beta -> 0
                disc = b_ * b_ - 4 * a_ * c_
                if disc < 0.0:                 # no real root (extreme beta) - the linear law as a first guess
                    return t_ref + shift / s0
                return (-b_ + math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a_)

nodes.name: run
nodes.meaning: dynamics
comments: dynamics
integrate with the junction voltage v_half (2K+1,) (V), given at the half-step instants t0 + j h/2.
Starts in the steady state of v_half[0].
h_s — step (s).
p_in_w — input power (W).
returns a `TcmtTrace` at the K+1 grid points.

source_ref.code:
def run(self, v_half, h_s, p_in_w=1.0, t0_s=0.0) -> TcmtTrace:
        v_half = np.ascontiguousarray(np.asarray(v_half, dtype=float))
        if v_half.ndim != 1 or v_half.size < 3 or v_half.size % 2 == 0:
            raise ValueError("v_half must have 2K+1 >= 3 samples")
        n_steps = (v_half.size - 1) // 2
        cw_mode_amplitude = np.empty(n_steps + 1, complex)
        ccw_mode_amplitude = np.empty(n_steps + 1, complex)
        work_delta = np.empty(v_half.size)
        work_kappa_i = np.empty(v_half.size)
        s_in = complex(math.sqrt(p_in_w))
        tcmt_run_tables_nb(
            float(h_s),
            s_in,
            self.kappa_e,
            self.kappa_d,
            self.g,
            v_half,
            self.v_grid,
            self.delta_tab,
            self.kappa_i_tab,
            cw_mode_amplitude,
            ccw_mode_amplitude,
            work_delta,
            work_kappa_i,
        )
        v_j = v_half[::2]
        powers = port_powers(
            cw_mode_amplitude,
            ccw_mode_amplitude,
            s_in,
            work_kappa_i[::2],
            self.kappa_e,
            self.kappa_d,
            self.eta(v_j),
        )
        return TcmtTrace(
            t0_s + h_s * np.arange(n_steps + 1),
            v_j,
            cw_mode_amplitude,
            ccw_mode_amplitude,
            work_delta[::2],
            work_kappa_i[::2],
            powers,
            float(p_in_w),
        )

returns: TcmtTrace(t0_s + h_s * np.arange(n_steps + 1), v_j, cw_mode_amplitude, ccw_mode_amplitude, work_delta[::2], work_kappa_i[::2], powers, float(p_in_w))

cfg.fidelity.self_heating.code: self_heating: "on"                 # on in every preset except teaching_* (self-heating changes the lock side)

cfg.fidelity.thermo_optic_order.code: thermo_optic_order: 2              # one thermo-optic anchor — s(T) = s0 (1 + beta (T - T0))

cfg.fidelity.thermal_model.code: thermal_model: interim             # docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 5.3: interim until the FEM ROM passes the calibration split

cfg.fidelity.junction_model.code:
junction_model: analytic           # junction_rib160.json exists in mrm/data/extracted.
                                     # no rib200 or lateral LUT covers uncertainty.film_thickness.
                                     # one lut_file cannot switch between those worlds.
                                     # compare bias-shift and EO-bandwidth fits before switching.

cfg.fidelity.backscatter.code: backscatter: "off"                 # schema default; turn on for BiDi and reflection studies (cost, plant_optics 2)

cfg.fidelity.nonlinear_optics.code: nonlinear_optics: "off"            # TPA, FCA, and Kerr — excluded with a computed bound

cfg.fidelity.heater_anchor.code:
heater_anchor: fsr_integral       # Z = dT_FSR/P_FSR from the full tuning interval.
                                   # lock_slope is 4-5 percent lower and depends on offset.
                                   # select it explicitly with --set for comparison.

cfg.sim.dt_plant_s.code: dt_plant_s: 1.0e-6                 # 1 us is enough because the self-heating solve is implicit

cfg.sim.reset_protocol.code:
reset_protocol: laser_ramp         # reset through a defined history — the lasers ramp up, every heater at code_min
  # The lasers ramp over >= 10 tau_slow. tau_slow x time_scale_slow is at most 2 x 45.7 us (undercut
  # family) in the drawn worlds and 300 us in the textbook corner (time scales pinned at 1), so 3 ms covers every
  # preset (the textbook family with a drawn x2 slow scale would need 6 ms). MODEL choice.

      note: >-
        d ln K^2 of the through and drop couplers per nm of width, film, slab and their own edge-to-edge gaps, at

        derivatives at fixed edge-to-edge gaps: variation.geometry.width_closes_gaps makes a width error close both
        gaps by the same amount (the artefact's note: total = d/dw - d/dgap; through -0.0145 + 0.0135 = -0.0010 /nm,
        drop -0.0189 + 0.0141 = -0.0048 /nm). realize moves the per-pass couplings of the nominal-geometry device
        (the R4 anchors) by it and by the coupler dispersion times the resonance move (mrm.params.relations R4_q). The
        200 nm film world keeps these 160 nm couplers (as it keeps their dispersion): the rib200 couplers have no 2-D
        full-wave check

kappa_d_over_kappa:
      value: 0.007
      provenance: inferred
      generation: G26
      source: D07
      range: [0.004, 0.18]
      note: >-
        drop decay rate over total (q_drop = q_loaded/x). 0.7 % is the log-centre of the [PHY] back-calculation 0.4-1.2 %
        from the ~15.5 uA G26 monitor current (07 D7; LM26-P Fig. 3b). In this preset's nominal world (+4 dBm at the
        ring, 0.95 A/W, the 27.9 dB G25 notch) it gives a drop peak of 0.0134 x P_in = 32 uA and 16 uA at a half-maximum
        lock (CAL-8 15-16 uA); a max-slope lock would need 0.45 %, a peak lock 0.34 %. (1 % would put the drop peak at
        46 uA, above the 40 uA ADC full scale.) The GF PDK '~5 % drop coupling' reading gives ~18 % (07 P1-9). Only the
        lumped monitor gain is calibrated (CAL-8); uncertainty.monitor.gain_scale carries the rest
      alternatives:
        phy_low: {value: 0.004, provenance: inferred, source: D07, note: "low end of the [PHY] back-calculation (07 D7)"}
        phy_high: {value: 0.012, provenance: inferred, source: D07, note: "high end of the [PHY] back-calculation (07 D7)"}
        gf_pdk: {value: 0.18, provenance: inferred, generation: GF, source: GF-ECIO, note: "5 % per-pass drop coupling on a near-critical ring. The drop decay then removes ~18 % of the energy, so the 27.9 dB G25 notch at Q_L 3850 needs Q_i ~12,000 (alpha_i ~70 dB/cm): selecting this alone gives an ~8.3 dB notch; rebalance the loss budget with it"}

cfg.ring.optics.loss_budget.alpha_other_.code:
alpha_other_abs_db_per_cm:
        value: 13.35
        provenance: assumed
        generation: none
        source: D07
        range: [0.0, 30.0]
        note: "heat-producing loss besides the junction: in-ring heater doping and contacts overlapping the mode, surface states. 13.35 sets alpha_i = 110.08 dB/cm (Q_i 7503 at 1301.9 nm with the modes_rib160 n_g 3.9405 and alpha_rad 0.119 dB/cm) so the exact G25 ring at Q_L 3850 and kappa_d/kappa 0.007 is under-coupled with the CAL-2 27.9 dB notch at 0 V, and eta = (80 + 13.35)/110.08 = 0.848. Re-solve alpha_i from the notch whenever modes_rib160 n_g or alpha_rad changes (was 14.74 with the n_g 4.0 / 1.0 dB/cm fallbacks)"
        alternatives:
          over: {value: 4.71, provenance: inferred, source: D07, note: "lowers alpha_i to 101.44 dB/cm (Q_i ~8140) so the exact G25 ring is over-coupled with the same 27.9 dB notch at Q_L 3850 (07 P1-5)"}

cfg.ring.optics.loss_budget.alpha_bend_r.code:
alpha_bend_radiation_db_per_cm:
        value: {from: "extracted/modes_rib160.json:alpha_rad_db_per_cm"}
        provenance: solver(assumed-geometry)
        generation: none
        source: X-MODES
        note: "bend and slab radiation at r_ref (07 P0-2): 0.119 dB/cm for rib160, 0.1 % of alpha_i 110.08 dB/cm. Q_i is fixed by Q_L and the notch (07 D1), so when n_g or this term changes alpha_other_abs is re-solved to keep Q_i, not alpha_i. Exponential in the geometry: realize applies the Jacobian's secant as d ln alpha_rad/dp from the artefact's stored evaluations (-0.0485, -0.1785, +0.4104 per nm of width, film, slab), so a sampled device never gets a negative radiation loss"
        alternatives:
          fallback: {value: 1.0, provenance: assumed, generation: none, source: X-MODES, note: "strip bends radiate ~1e-13 dB/cm at r_ref (modes_strip400x200) and 2e-4 dB/cm at 7.5 um (05 t01); the 60 nm slab may leak more"}
          strip400x200: {from: "extracted/modes_strip400x200.json:alpha_rad_db_per_cm", provenance: solver(assumed-geometry), generation: none, source: X-MODES}
          strip400x200_q_anchor:
            value: 11.09
            provenance: inferred
            generation: G25
            source: LM-T
            note: >-
              selected by uncertainty.film_thickness '200'. The measured G25 Q_L and 0 V notch (CAL-1, CAL-2) pin Q_i,
              not alpha_i, and Q_i = 2 pi n_g/(lambda alpha_i): with the strip's n_g 4.349 the budget must total
              alpha_i,160 x 4.349/3.9405 dB/cm to keep Q_i. The strip's own radiation is ~1e-13 dB/cm, so this term is
              the strip radiation plus the non-heating loss that keeps Q_i (11.54 dB/cm for under, 10.64 for over with the modes_rib160 n_g 3.9405; 11.09
